CROSSROAD: Hòn Sóng crossroad at an old coach stop on the inland road: cracked, sun-bleached asphalt edged with sand, low salt-faded concrete houses with rusted corrugated-iron roofs, casuarinas bending in the sea wind, small fishing boats far out on the sea beyond the south side. Lived-in, quiet and slightly desolate, never a tourist postcard; no readable signs.
STREET: Hòn Sóng main street between inland crossroad and market: worn narrow asphalt, low tube houses with half-raised roll-up shutters, motorbikes parked on the pavement, fishing nets drying along the sea wall, coffee stall beside the sea wall. No readable signs.
distant motorcycles and muted market voices
STALL: Bảy coffee stall, green canvas awning, counter landward, low plastic stools and tables seaward, aluminium phin filters and glasses of iced coffee on the counter, street visible in the counter mirror, no readable signs.
glasses touching and awning cloth in sea wind
STALL_REAR: Covered rear lane behind the coffee stall under a patched corrugated-iron roof, isolated from the public road, map table beside the rear door, crates of empty bottles against the wall.
muted coffee stall voices and soft canvas movement
DUNE: White-sand dune under wind-bent casuarina pines, creeping beach vines along a sandy footpath, cabin uphill, main path down toward market, grey-blue sea below.
wind moving pine needles and distant surf

wind through wood joints and remote surf

soft surf, pine wind and porch-board creaks

scenes.title: Ngày Thứ Nhất
scenes.purpose: Sơn tới Hòn Sóng và tự đặt hạn chờ.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Let the porch sea wind fall under rain on the silk-shop awning. Cut to the existing silk curtain, not to another coach arrival.

clips.start_frame: Stationary coach at the crossroad stop, door open left of center; Sơn on the doorway step, backpack on his left shoulder, left hand on its strap, eyes on the road ahead.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Sơn steps down from the coach onto the cracked asphalt and stops two paces clear of the door, posture controlled and alert. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): The door folds shut and the coach pulls away in one continuous move, leaving frame left; Sơn stays still and watches it go, jaw tightening almost imperceptibly, a fleeting trace of regret in his eyes as the engine fades into sea wind. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He takes one controlled breath; his gaze leaves the empty road and turns toward town, regret hardening into cold resolve, and his weight shifts forward into his first step.
clips.end_frame: Sơn alone at the crossroad, turned toward town and moving into his first step, backpack on his left shoulder, left hand on its strap; the road where the coach stood is empty, fine dust still settling.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi là Sơn. Giang hồ gọi tôi là Bóng Ma. Rắn Đen bắt Hạ rồi. Tôi chỉ còn bảy ngày để đưa cô ấy về.

clips.lighting: Coastal dawn: blue sea haze, low warm sun grazing building edges and rimming his hair and jacket, soft cool sea fill on his face, restrained contrast with natural shadow detail.

cinematic.intent: Make arrival feel like a deliberate loss of escape, not a travel postcard.
cinematic.composition: Medium-wide framing at eye level: coach door left of center, Sơn central-left with open negative space toward town on the right; a slow lateral dolly follows his step down, then eases into a very gentle push-in as the coach clears.
cinematic.blocking: Coach door left of center; Sơn exits toward camera, then turns screen right toward town while the coach leaves frame left. Backpack stays on his left shoulder, left hand on the strap; no other bag.
cinematic.performance: Restrained and battle-worn: regret while he watches the coach, restraint in the jaw and one controlled breath, then cold determination toward town. No theatrical frown, no tears, no hero pose.
cinematic.focus: Keep Sơn and the coach edge readable in the established wide depth.
cinematic.texture: Fine dust moves naturally around worn boots; jacket fabric lifts only with sea wind.
cinematic.sound_detail: Engine weight recedes continuously into exposed sea wind; narration remains dry and close.
cinematic.rhythm: A clean quick exit, a long held look while the coach leaves, then a decisive turn that carries straight into motion without a frozen tail.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his weathered dark-olive canvas backpack slung over his left shoulder, left hand gripping the canvas strap; closed silver pocket watch chained inside his right jacket pocket, not visible. No other bag.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu bạc màu, đi giày cổ thấp sờn cũ, vai trái đeo ba lô vải bố màu ô liu sẫm (bên trong đựng sổ đen, USB, hộp thiếc thuốc Tê và hộp khóa kín), tay trái nắm chắc quai ba lô, túi áo phải cất đồng hồ quả quýt bạc đóng nắp.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Ngã ba đường ven biển Hòn Sóng (trạm dừng xe đò) (D1 dawn) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (WATCH, BACKPACK).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–2.5s): Sơn bước xuống xe khách, dừng cách cửa hai bước, dáng kiềm chế và cảnh giác. Nhịp 2 (2.5–6.5s): Cửa xe gập lại, xe chạy liền một mạch ra khỏi khung bên trái; Sơn đứng yên nhìn theo, quai hàm siết rất nhẹ, ánh mắt thoáng tiếc nuối khi tiếng máy tan vào gió biển. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Một hơi thở kìm lại; ánh mắt rời con đường trống, quay về phía thị trấn, nỗi tiếc hóa thành quyết tâm lạnh; anh dồn trọng tâm vào bước chân đầu tiên. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy suốt từ 0.2s.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (WATCH, BACKPACK) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo · Đạo cụ khóa: WATCH, BACKPACK.

clips.start_frame: Dawn on the main street by the sea wall: Sơn walking screen right toward Bảy's coffee stall, backpack on his left shoulder, left hand on its strap; Bảy at the stall edge stacking empty plastic crates, checkered cloth over his shoulder.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn walks toward the stall at a steady pace, eyes on the road; as Bảy stacks one more crate, the top crate tips off and rolls across the pavement toward the road. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Without breaking stride Sơn steps into its path, stops it with his right hand and sets it into Bảy's hands; Bảy thanks him and asks who he is looking for. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn stops beside the counter, right hand back at his side, and gives his name and a short answer, eyes flicking to the road; Bảy hugs the crate, squint softening into curiosity, as the tracking move settles.
clips.end_frame: Sơn standing beside the stall counter facing Bảy, backpack on his left shoulder, left hand on the strap, right hand at his side; Bảy holding the recovered crate against his chest, cloth on his shoulder; the road behind them, sea wind lifting the awning edge.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Cảm ơn chú nghen. Mới xuống xe đò hả, kiếm ai vậy?

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi tên Sơn. Tìm người quen gần bến cảng.

clips.lighting: Coastal dawn: low warm sun from the east grazing walls and faces from the side, soft cool fill from sea and sky, restrained contrast, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Earn Bảy's later kindness through an ordinary helpful act, without making Sơn heroic.
cinematic.composition: Track at pedestrian height with the road edge and rolling crate visible together.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn travels screen left to right along the sea-wall street; the crate rolls from the stall across his line toward the road. He uses only his right hand; the backpack never leaves his left shoulder. He ends at the counter, Bảy at his right.
cinematic.performance: Sơn treats the catch as nothing, routine competence with his attention already back on the road, guarded but polite. Bảy's surprise turns into easy curiosity rather than gratitude. No hero pose, no beaming smile, no comic fumble.
cinematic.focus: Favor the returning crate and both upper bodies; keep the road legible behind.
cinematic.texture: Scuffed crate corners and sun-faded awning establish a working town rather than a polished set.
cinematic.sound_detail: One scrape, restrained footfall and Bảy's breath precede his thanks; no triumphant accent.
cinematic.rhythm: Walking pace from the first frame; the rolling crate is the only sudden moment and is absorbed in one movement. Speech begins at the handover, and the clip ends on Sơn's short answer with both men still settling.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn keeps his weathered dark-olive canvas backpack slung over his left shoulder throughout the movement. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác màu ô liu, vai trái luôn đeo chiếc ba lô vải bố sẫm màu nặng trĩu vật chứng suốt dọc đường từ ngã ba qua quán nước lên đồi dương. Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly, tay thao tác với khay ly cà phê hoặc thùng nhựa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Trục đường chính thị trấn biển Hòn Sóng (D1 dawn) · Góc máy: Máy trượt ngang (35mm Tracking) — bám sát bước chân và nhịp di chuyển nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (BACKPACK, COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn đi đều bước sang phải dọc phố về phía quán ông Bảy, ba lô trên vai trái, mắt đọc con đường phía trước; ông Bảy chất thêm thùng, chiếc thùng nhựa trên cùng rớt khỏi chồng và lăn ra phía lòng đường. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Không chững bước, Sơn chặn thùng bằng tay phải, xách lên và đặt vào tay ông Bảy; ông Bảy cảm ơn rồi hỏi anh tìm ai. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn dừng cạnh quầy, tay phải buông xuống, tay trái vẫn giữ quai ba lô, trả lời ngắn và liếc nhanh ra đường; ông Bảy ôm thùng trước ngực, nheo mắt tò mò. Ông Bảy nói ở nhịp 2, Sơn đáp ở nhịp 3.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (BACKPACK, COFFEE_TRAY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: Under the green awning, Bảy behind his counter wiping a coffee glass with the checkered cloth; Sơn facing him from the customer side, backpack on his left shoulder, left hand on its strap, right hand flat on the worn wood.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn leans a fraction toward the counter and asks his question quietly, eyes steady on Bảy, voice too low to carry to the tables behind him. Beat 2 (3.5–6.5s): Bảy's hands stop on the glass; he sets it down, studies Sơn for a moment without suspicion, then turns his whole body toward the dune rising behind the stall. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Bảy lifts his arm and points uphill as he answers; Sơn turns his head along the line of that arm, eyes narrowing on the casuarina slope, breath slow, the awning cloth stirring above them.
clips.end_frame: Bảy behind the counter, turned toward the dune with his arm extended uphill, cloth on his shoulder; Sơn at the counter following the pointing line toward the casuarina slope, backpack on his left shoulder, left hand on the strap; awning shadows moving across both men.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Chú biết chỗ nào vắng, nhìn được ra đường với cảng không?

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Trên đồi dương có căn chòi trống, ngó xuống thấy hết trơn.

clips.lighting: Coastal dawn: low warm sun from the east grazing walls and faces from the side, soft cool fill from sea and sky, restrained contrast, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Show Sơn choosing isolation while Bảy offers practical shelter without demanding a confession.
cinematic.composition: Frame the counter as a modest boundary, both faces readable in the medium setup.
cinematic.blocking: Counter between them: Bảy landward behind it, Sơn on the customer side. Bảy turns to his left to point at the dune behind the stall; Sơn only turns his head. Backpack stays on Sơn's left shoulder.
cinematic.performance: Sơn wants isolation and a view of every approach, but asks as if it were a small favour, hiding the reason. Bảy answers from habit and kindness, not suspicion. No sly looks, no conspiratorial whisper.
cinematic.focus: Hold both eyelines and the pointing hand at a usable shared depth.
cinematic.texture: Condensation on existing glasses and weathered counter grain give the exchange everyday weight.
cinematic.sound_detail: Keep low stall ambience below the line; let the sea remain present but unromantic.
cinematic.rhythm: A quiet question, a short silent assessment while the glass is set down, then the pointing arm and answer land together; the eyeline toward the hill carries the cut.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn keeps his weathered dark-olive canvas backpack slung over his left shoulder throughout the movement. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác màu ô liu, vai trái luôn đeo chiếc ba lô vải bố sẫm màu nặng trĩu vật chứng suốt dọc đường từ ngã ba qua quán nước lên đồi dương. Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly, tay thao tác với khay ly cà phê hoặc thùng nhựa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Quán cà phê cóc của Ông Bảy bên bờ kè biển (D1 dawn) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (BACKPACK, COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn hơi nghiêng người về phía quầy, hỏi nhỏ, mắt nhìn thẳng ông Bảy, giọng không lọt tới mấy bàn phía sau. Nhịp 2 (3.5–6.5s): Tay ông Bảy dừng trên chiếc ly; ông đặt ly xuống, nhìn Sơn một thoáng không nghi ngại, rồi xoay cả người về phía đồi cát sau quán. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Ông Bảy giơ tay chỉ lên đồi và trả lời; Sơn quay đầu nhìn theo cánh tay, mắt nheo lại trên triền dương, hơi thở chậm, mép bạt lay trong gió. Sơn hỏi ở nhịp 1, ông Bảy đáp ở nhịp 3.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (BACKPACK, COFFEE_TRAY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: Halfway up the sandy dune path under casuarina pines: Bảy a step ahead and slightly winded, Sơn behind him with the backpack on his left shoulder, left hand on its strap; the small wooden cabin and its porch visible uphill.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The two men climb the last stretch of sand toward the cabin, Bảy breathing harder with each step, Sơn following at an even pace, pine shadows sliding across their shoulders. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): They step onto the porch boards; Bảy digs a small used key from his shorts pocket and holds it out while making a dry remark about the empty house and the wind. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn opens his right palm and Bảy drops the key into it; Sơn gives his short reply about staying one week, his fingers not yet closing, eyes on the cabin door rather than the sea view.
clips.end_frame: Sơn and Bảy on the porch boards, the small key resting in Sơn's open right palm, Bảy's hand just withdrawn, his breathing still settling; backpack on Sơn's left shoulder, left hand on the strap; pine shadows moving over the cabin wall and sand.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Chìa đây chú. Nhà hổng có ai, chỉ có gió là ở hoài.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Một tuần thôi chú. Tôi lo xong chuyện riêng rồi đi.

clips.lighting: Coastal dawn: low warm sun from the east grazing walls and faces from the side, soft cool fill from sea and sky, restrained contrast, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Make receiving the key feel like accepting a temporary place, not finding safety.
cinematic.composition: Keep cabin, last stretch of path and the two men in the same wide geography.
cinematic.blocking: Path rises from frame left to the cabin at frame right; Bảy leads, Sơn one step behind and downhill. On the porch they face each other, the handover zone between them at waist height. Backpack stays on Sơn's left shoulder.
cinematic.performance: Bảy is winded and matter-of-fact, offering a roof without questions. Sơn accepts a temporary place, not safety: polite, closed, already measuring the door. No vacation ease, no warm handshake.
cinematic.focus: Maintain readable figures and the handover zone; do not cut to a separate key insert.
cinematic.texture: Pine shadows cross the sand; the small metal key looks used rather than ceremonial.
cinematic.sound_detail: Retain their breathing under the pine wind; Bảy's dry joke should not invite a music cue.
cinematic.rhythm: The climb uses its effort, the porch arrival gives Bảy his joke, and the key lands in the palm near the end, so the open hand is still live at the match cut.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn keeps his weathered dark-olive canvas backpack slung over his left shoulder throughout the movement. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Triền đồi cát trắng dưới rặng dương liễu (D1 dawn) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (BACKPACK, COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hai người leo đoạn cát cuối lên chòi gỗ, ông Bảy thở mỗi lúc một nặng, Sơn bước đều phía sau, bóng dương lướt qua vai. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Lên tới sàn hiên, ông Bảy móc chiếc chìa khóa cũ trong túi quần, chìa ra và buông một câu đùa khô về căn nhà vắng với gió. clips.start_frame: The cabin's bare wooden entry doorframe at chest height in cool dawn light; the small used key lies on the narrow shelf beside the frame next to a short carving tool, Sơn's bare right hand resting on the shelf edge.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's right hand leaves the key where it lies, closes around the carving tool's worn handle and lifts its tip to the clean, unmarked wood of the doorframe. Beat 2 (3.0–7.0s): The tip bites into the grain; with a steady wrist and controlled pressure he draws one short vertical stroke downward, pale fibres curling out of the dark old wood. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): The tip lifts clear; his thumb brushes the loose fibres from the fresh cut, and the hand lowers the tool out of frame, leaving a single pale mark in the light while one loose fibre trembles in the draught.
clips.end_frame: One fresh pale tally on the dark doorframe at chest height, a few loose fibres still lifting in the draught; the key on the shelf beside it; tool and hand lowered out of frame; cool dawn light shifting on the grain.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Mỗi sáng một vạch. Hết vạch thứ bảy, tàu đêm sẽ chở Hạ đi.

clips.lighting: Coastal dawn: low warm sun from the east grazing walls and faces from the side, soft cool fill from sea and sky, restrained contrast, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Turn a vague stay into an exact private deadline that the audience cannot yet explain.
cinematic.composition: Use the existing detail angle on tool, clean wood and the newly cut single mark.
cinematic.blocking: One detail plane: doorframe filling the frame, shelf with the key just below and right of the cut. Only Sơn's right hand enters, holding the tool; the backpack stays on the floor below, out of the detail.
cinematic.performance: A private vow made with the hand, not the face: grief held under procedure, no hesitation once the tip bites, then a quick, almost embarrassed release. No violent flourish, no stabbing gesture.
cinematic.focus: Keep the cut and adjacent untouched grain sharp; the room remains unimportant beyond.
cinematic.texture: Fresh pale wood contrasts with the dark old frame; a few loose fibers catch daylight.
cinematic.sound_detail: One brief wood scrape sits beneath the voice-over; no clock tick is added here.
cinematic.rhythm: A short reach for the tool, one unhurried cut that owns the middle of the clip, then the hand leaves quickly while dust and fibres keep the frame alive.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn's weathered dark-olive canvas backpack rests beside him near the doorframe.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Chiếc ba lô vải bố màu ô liu sẫm của Sơn đặt dưới sàn sát khung cửa ra vào, ngay cạnh chân anh.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong căn chòi gỗ một gian trên đồi dương (D1 dawn) · Góc máy: Đặc tả đạo cụ (85mm Insert) — khóa nét vào bàn tay và vật dụng mấu chốt. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (MARKS, BACKPACK).

Nhịp 2 (3.0–7.0s): Mũi dao cắm vào thớ gỗ; cổ tay vững, lực đều, anh kéo đúng một vạch dọc ngắn, thớ gỗ nhạt cuộn lên trên nền gỗ cũ sẫm màu. Nhịp 3 (7.0–10.0s): Mũi dao nhấc ra, ngón cái phủi vụn gỗ khỏi vết mới, bàn tay hạ dao ra khỏi khung, để lại một vạch nhạt trong ánh sáng, một sợi vụn còn rung trong gió lùa. Lời dẫn của Sơn bắt đầu từ 0.2s, phủ nhịp 1 và đầu nhịp 2.

clips.start_frame: Sơn seated on a porch stool facing the sea, elbows on his knees, the closed silver watch lying in his bare right palm with the chain looped over his fingers; low dawn light from one side, the sea soft beyond his shoulder.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn tilts his right palm so the engraved flower on the closed lid turns into the low dawn light; the chain slides over his knuckles and a thin glint crosses the silver. Beat 2 (3.0–7.0s): His left thumb settles on the lid's edge beside the release clasp and stops without pressing; his jaw tightens and he holds his breath, eyes on the engraved flower, not the sea. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): He breathes out through his nose, moves the thumb off the clasp and closes his fingers loosely around the case, then lifts his eyes to the sea as wind moves his collar.
clips.end_frame: Sơn seated on the porch stool, the closed watch in his loosely curled right hand on his knee, chain over his fingers, left hand open on his thigh; eyes on the sea beyond his shoulder, wind lifting his jacket collar, light flickering off the surf.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Đồng hồ của Hạ đứng từ đêm đó. Chừng nào cô ấy về, tôi mới mở nắp.

clips.lighting: Coastal dawn: low warm sun from the east grazing walls and faces from the side, soft cool fill from sea and sky, restrained contrast, no night lighting.

cinematic.intent: Attach the closed watch to a withheld emotional truth rather than explaining its contents.
cinematic.composition: Keep the watch at chest-to-lap height inside the medium frame, sea soft beyond his shoulder.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn seated center frame on the porch stool, body angled toward the sea, watch held at chest-to-lap height in his right hand. The left thumb reaches only the lid edge, never the clasp. He stays seated throughout.
cinematic.performance: He wants to open it and will not; the vow shows as restraint in the jaw and one withheld breath, grief kept behind the eyes. No tears, no trembling lip, no mournful stare held for effect.
cinematic.focus: Share useful focus between his fingers and face, never revealing the hidden watch interior.
cinematic.texture: Worn silver catches a narrow natural glint; jacket cuffs and salt air remain tactile.
cinematic.sound_detail: The watch is silent in the present; only porch wood, wind and his breathing remain.
cinematic.rhythm: The turn into the light is quick; the long middle belongs to the thumb resting near the clasp; the release and the look to sea close the scene without a frozen tail.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Hợp Đồng Cuối
scenes.purpose: Bà Hai giao việc cuối và Dũng lộ sự ghen tức.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Match the rectangle of the building sketch to the stall mirror edge. Replace city rain with present-day coastal morning sound.

clips.start_frame: Night in the silk shop: silk curtain hanging beside the rear door; Bà Hai seated behind the teak desk under the warm lamp, unlit holder in her right fingers; Sơn in his black suit mid-stride from the rear door; Dũng just inside that open door, hand on its edge.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn crosses the shop toward the teak desk with an even, controlled stride, gloved hands loose at his sides, as Bà Hai greets him without rising. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He stops at the desk's near edge; behind him Dũng eases the rear door shut, the latch clicking softly, and stays planted beside it, while Bà Hai points the unlit holder at the empty chair, inviting him to sit. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn glances at the chair and remains standing, hands still, answering in a few low words; Bà Hai lowers the holder, her composed half-smile unchanged, and Dũng stays motionless by the door.
clips.end_frame: Sơn standing at the near edge of the teak desk facing Bà Hai, gloved hands at his sides, the empty chair beside him; Bà Hai seated with the holder lowered, eyes on him; Dũng planted by the shut rear door, bag strap across his chest; lamp light warm on the silk.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Nửa đêm con ghé là có chuyện. Ngồi đi, rồi nói má nghe.

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.text: Con đứng được, má. Con nói không lâu.

clips.lighting: Night interior: warm desk lamp as low side key across the teak desk, shop practicals as soft warm fill, cool wet-alley spill through the rear door; deep but readable shadows.

cinematic.intent: Introduce a household invitation whose geometry already limits Sơn's freedom to leave.
cinematic.composition: Keep Bà Hai behind the desk and Dũng near the rear door within one wide frame.
cinematic.blocking: Rear door at frame left, desk at frame right: Sơn walks left to right and stops at the desk's near edge with the empty chair at his right hip. Dũng stays at the door behind him; Bà Hai remains seated.
cinematic.performance: Bà Hai's warmth is practiced and real enough to unsettle; she wants him seated, inside the family again. Sơn declines politely, already guarding his exit. Dũng gives nothing away. No sinister glare, no raised voice.
cinematic.focus: Keep all three positions legible, with the door not swallowed by excessive blur.
cinematic.texture: Silk absorbs the warm lamp light while the desk retains a hard reflective edge.
cinematic.sound_detail: Door latch is quiet but distinct; her invitation stays conversational, without a sinister sting.
cinematic.rhythm: A clean walk to the desk, the soft door click held as the room closes, the invitation, then Sơn's short refusal; the frame ends with three people placed and nobody yielding.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt, and concealed underarm holster; black leather gloves worn on night jobs or tucked in pocket at the flower shop. Bà Hai wears her deep-violet silk áo bà ba, green jade bracelet on her LEFT wrist, holding her unlit black cigarette holder between her right fingers. Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn (một tháng trước) mặc bộ vest đen lịch lãm, sơ mi trắng mở cổ, bao da đeo ẩn dưới nách áo, đi giày da đen và mang đôi găng tay da đen. Bà Hai mặc bộ áo bà ba lụa tím sẫm sang trọng, cổ tay TRÁI đeo vòng ngọc bích xanh bóng, các ngón tay phải cầm chiếc tẩu đen không châm lửa. clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bà Hai's left hand flips the photograph face up on the teak, revealing a printed portrait of Kiên in a white suit, the jade bracelet sliding against her wrist bone as her voice begins off screen. dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Vũ Kiên giữ cuốn sổ gốc của nhà mình. Con lấy về cho má.

clips.lighting: Night interior: warm desk lamp as low side key across the teak desk, shop practicals as soft warm fill, cool wet-alley spill through the rear door; deep but readable shadows.

cinematic.intent: Let a single sliding photograph define the transaction more clearly than exposition can.
cinematic.composition: Place the bracelet, portrait and Sơn's black glove within the same stable detail plane.
cinematic.blocking: One detail plane across the desk: Bà Hai's left hand enters from frame right, Sơn's gloved right hand rests at frame left. The photograph travels right to left in a straight line and stops short of the glove; no hands touch.
cinematic.performance: Her hand assumes compliance, unhurried and proprietary, the gesture of someone who has never been refused. His glove's stillness is the refusal he cannot yet say aloud. No dramatic slam, no tremor.
cinematic.focus: Keep the photographed face readable as a picture, not an extra living person in the room.
cinematic.texture: Jade and paper move against polished wood; the glove's matte leather interrupts both reflections.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft paper drag and faint bracelet contact support her off-screen sentence, not compete with it.
cinematic.rhythm: Her voice starts with the quick flip, the slide takes its time, and the stop leaves the offer hanging with both hands still live at the cut.

clips.start_frame: Sơn standing at the teak desk facing Bà Hai, who sits behind it with the unlit holder in her right fingers; Kiên's photograph lies face up near his side of the desk, his gloved hands at his sides.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's eyes drop to Kiên's photograph and come back up without his hands moving toward it; his right hand goes to the outer pocket of his jacket. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): His gloved hand withdraws and both hands settle at his sides, very still, as if rehearsed; he holds Bà Hai's gaze, breathing evenly, while she looks from the ticket up to his face without answering.
clips.end_frame: The slim paper ticket lies on the teak desk between them, apart from Kiên's untouched photograph; Sơn standing still, gloved hands at his sides, holding Bà Hai's gaze; Bà Hai seated, holder in her right fingers, eyes on his face.

clips.lighting: Night interior: warm desk lamp as low side key across the teak desk, shop practicals as soft warm fill, cool wet-alley spill through the rear door; deep but readable shadows.

cinematic.intent: Give Sơn's wish to leave a concrete cost by putting his return ticket between them.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium composition to include his face and the ticket landing near the desk edge.
cinematic.blocking: Same desk geometry: Sơn standing on the near side, Bà Hai seated across. The ticket lands centered between them, a hand's width from the photograph. Only his right hand travels, pocket to desk and back.
cinematic.performance: Restrained and prepared, braced for resistance: he states terms rather than asking permission. The rehearsed stillness afterward hides how badly he wants this. No pleading, no defiance, no smile.
cinematic.focus: Keep the ticket shape visible without readable print while his eyes remain the emotional center.
cinematic.texture: The thin ticket lies exposed against heavy wood and dense folded silk nearby.
cinematic.sound_detail: A small paper tap should be heard before the sentence ends; keep room tone steady.
cinematic.rhythm: A quick look at the photograph, a deliberate placement under the line, then a long held stillness that hands the silence to Bà Hai at the seam.

cinematic.intent: Show Bà Hai answering departure with possession through an almost affectionate domestic gesture.
cinematic.composition: Keep the exact prior medium setup, positions and lens; the desk remains the shared boundary.
cinematic.blocking: Exact prior setup: Bà Hai seated, Sơn standing across the desk. Her left hand takes the silk from the stack at her elbow and covers the ticket where it lies; her right keeps the holder. Sơn's feet and hands stay put.
cinematic.performance: She answers departure with possession disguised as family need, gentle enough to be unbearable. Sơn's anger stays locked in the jaw; he wants to leave clean and knows he cannot. No raised voices, no slammed hand.
cinematic.focus: Preserve the previous depth and eyelines instead of inventing a new close-up on her hand.
cinematic.texture: Soft fabric settling over paper makes the ticket disappear through an ordinary, reversible act.
cinematic.sound_detail: Silk rub replaces the paper sound; her gentle line should remain more troubling than a raised voice.
cinematic.rhythm: Her question starts at once over the reach for the silk; the covering is slow and domestic; his low answer comes late and changes nothing while her hand stays down.

clips.start_frame: At the rear door: Sơn one pace from the threshold facing Dũng, who holds the door half open with his right hand, heavy bag strap across his chest; wet alley light beyond the gap.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Dũng's eyes slide past Sơn's shoulder to the chair still pushed in at the desk, untouched, then come back to Sơn's face. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He shifts his heavy shoulder into the gap, the door edge moving with him to fill the opening, and makes his remark low and almost casual, the nail earring catching the alley light. clips.end_frame: Sơn and Dũng facing each other across the half-open rear door, the door edge between them, Dũng's right hand on the wood, bag strap across his chest; a narrow gap open at Sơn's side; wet alley light on the jamb.

dialogue.text: Má chừa ghế cho mày hoài. Còn tao bao năm nay vẫn đứng canh cửa.

clips.lighting: Night interior: warm desk lamp as low side key across the teak desk, shop practicals as soft warm fill, cool wet-alley spill through the rear door; deep but readable shadows.

cinematic.intent: Make Dũng's jealousy specific to the place Sơn receives in the household.
cinematic.composition: Frame over Sơn's near shoulder toward Dũng's three-quarter face and the rear door edge.
cinematic.blocking: Over Sơn's near shoulder toward Dũng at the rear door; the chair at the desk sits behind Sơn, reached only by Dũng's eyeline. Dũng's body and the door edge fill the opening, then he yields half a step. Sơn holds his spot.
cinematic.performance: Dũng's resentment leaks as a casual complaint; he wants Sơn to feel the cost of being favoured, and to be noticed himself. Sơn refuses the bait, calm and level. No sneer, no taunt, no squaring up.
cinematic.focus: Keep Dũng's mouth and the blocking door edge clear, with the chair only a secondary cue.
cinematic.texture: The narrow opening compresses bodies against hanging silk and a scuffed door jamb.
cinematic.sound_detail: Door wood shifts under his hand; the spoken complaint carries no added threat effect.
cinematic.rhythm: The chair glance comes first and fast, the line lands in the middle with the blocked doorway, then a held silence before Dũng gives way, ending with the gap open and nobody through it.

clips.start_frame: Night rear lane in light rain: Sơn just outside the silk shop's rear door as it swings shut behind him, Kiên's photograph in his gloved right hand, portrait side up; the lit tower entrance across the road beyond the lane.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The door clicks shut behind him; Sơn turns the photograph over in his gloved fingers, Kiên's portrait giving way to a hand-drawn sketch of a building entrance on the back. Beat 2 (3.0–7.0s): He lifts it to eye height so the sketch sits beside the real tower entrance across the road; his eyes move between drawn lines and real doors, counting steps and corners. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): His eyes stop on the entrance and stay there, the photograph still raised beside it, rain ticking on its sleeve, as the slow push-in settles on the sketch's rectangle and his narrowed eyes.
clips.end_frame: Sơn in the wet lane holding the photograph at eye height, sketch side out, its rectangle beside the lit tower entrance across the road; eyes fixed on the real doors; rain beading on his shoulders and the photo sleeve; the silk shop door shut behind him.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Mặt sau tấm ảnh là lối vào tòa tháp. Đối diện nó, một tiệm hoa nhỏ sắp đổi cả đời tôi.

clips.lighting: Recent-past rainy night in the alley: cool street-lamp spill as side key, warm spill from the silk-shop door behind him as rim, rain streaks catching the light.

cinematic.intent: Connect the assigned target to a real place before the audience sees the woman living there.
cinematic.composition: Use the slow push to keep Sơn, the turning photo and tower in a single spatial relationship.
cinematic.blocking: Shut rear door at frame left behind Sơn, tower across the road at frame right. The photograph stays in his gloved right hand, raised in line with the tower entrance; he does not walk toward it.
cinematic.performance: Narrow professional attention, a man memorising an entrance; the job has hooked him despite his wish to quit. No romantic softness, no foreboding stare into the distance.
cinematic.focus: Favor his reading distance and the sketch edge, while leaving the tower recognizable beyond.

cinematic.performance: Sơn's road-watching is habit, not panic; he offers a plausible small excuse and keeps the real reason shut. Bảy notices the oddity with amused curiosity. No suspicious squint, no nervous glancing around.

dialogue.speaker: MAY

cinematic.intent: Let a routine question reveal Sơn's need to control space without making him rude.

cinematic.performance: Mây is courteous but attentive, reading behaviour more than answers. Sơn's tidying is a reflex he cannot suppress, not staged concealment; he wants to seem ordinary. No hostile stare, no visible guilt.

cinematic.texture: Weathered plastic and coffee condensation ground the exchange in an ordinary public place.
cinematic.sound_detail: The bag settles beneath the chair with a modest cloth scrape; ambience does not stop for the question.
cinematic.rhythm: Her question starts at once; his hands find a useful task inside it; the last seconds belong to her look at his hands and the answer he has not yet given.

cinematic.intent: Show Mây converting curiosity into a discreet check while keeping the encounter socially ordinary.

cinematic.performance: Mây lowers her voice only enough for privacy; curiosity becomes a discreet check, and a sharper concern surfaces in the look uphill. Thành's note-taking is routine work. No conspiratorial huddle, no nervous gag.

cinematic.texture: Helmet edges, notebook paper and worn handlebar surfaces remain practical, unglamorized details.
cinematic.sound_detail: Keep distant traffic and stall glasses under her sentence; the parked engine should not roar again.
cinematic.rhythm: One instruction, one acknowledgement while the pen moves, then the hill glance holds the final seconds and motivates the next concern.

clips.lighting: Morning coastal sun from the east backlighting the street; faces in cool open shade under the green awning with soft bounce from the counter; natural skin tones.

cinematic.intent: Leave a trace of controlled unease after Mây departs without adding a new clue.
cinematic.composition: Hold the detail frame on Sơn's right hand, existing cup handle and closed belt watch.

cinematic.performance: Controlled unease after Mây has gone: the watch touch betrays him, and the cup correction is how he takes control back. He wants to look like any customer. No fidgeting, no visible fear.

cinematic.rhythm: The unconscious rubbing stops early; the precise quarter turn takes the middle; the delayed release of the handle is the last held tension, with condensation keeping the frame alive.

clips.start_frame: Afternoon flower shop: Hạ behind the wooden counter cutting lily stems with her pocket shears; the entrance door swinging open, bell ringing; Sơn on the threshold in his black suit, bare hands, gloves tucked in his pocket; the tower lobby visible through the front window across the road.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn steps in under the ringing bell; Hạ glances up from the lilies, shears pausing, gives an easy nod and goes back to cutting. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Crossing past the bucket rows, Sơn looks through the front window at the tower lobby across the road and holds on it; he takes the chair by the window that faces the lobby and sits, while Hạ, still cutting, asks him a light, direct question. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn answers without fully looking away from the window, one hand resting on his knee; Hạ's shears snip one more stem while her eyes stay on him, curious.
clips.end_frame: Sơn seated in the chair by the front window, angled toward the tower lobby across the road, bare hands on his knees; Hạ behind the counter with shears and lily stems, eyes on him; the bell above the door still trembling.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Khách vô tiệm hoa mà hổng nhìn hoa. Anh mua tặng ai?

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.text: Cô chọn giúp tôi một cành hoa trắng.

clips.lighting: Recent-past afternoon: warm sun through the front window as side key across the counter, soft bounce from petals and pale walls, cooler shade toward the back; no night grade.

cinematic.intent: Show the professional reason for entering before Hạ makes the encounter personal.
cinematic.composition: The wide frame links counter, window chair and the tower lobby across the road without changing location.
cinematic.blocking: Door at frame left, counter at frame right, the window chair in the foreground facing the road. Sơn crosses left to right past the buckets to the chair; Hạ stays behind the counter. His gloves remain tucked in his jacket pocket.
cinematic.performance: Sơn is working: the lobby gets his attention first and Hạ second, polite and closed. Hạ is easy and direct, amused by a customer who looks everywhere but at the flowers. No flirtatious lean, no lingering stare.
cinematic.focus: Use depth to keep lobby direction understandable while reserving visual warmth for the foreground shop.
cinematic.texture: Fresh cut stems, damp bucket rims and warm window reflections suggest a shop being worked in.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let the bell finish before her question becomes clear; keep scissors and water modest beneath it.
cinematic.rhythm: His route to the chosen chair is one unbroken purpose; her question lands as he sits; the deflecting answer closes the clip while her shears keep working.

clips.start_frame: At the wooden counter: Hạ wrapping a single white lily in paper, Sơn standing across from her, bare hands at his sides; a tall glass vase of water stands at the counter's edge on his side; the street visible through the window behind him.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ folds the paper around the lily as Sơn finally says who it is for, a faint, dry half-smile on his mouth, eyes on the flower. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): An unseen delivery boy outside knocks a bucket against the window; the tall vase at the counter edge tips, and Sơn's bare right hand catches it at the lip, water sloshing, Hạ's hands arriving a moment later. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): For one breath both hold the vase; Sơn lets go first and draws his hand back to his side, and Hạ, still holding it, looks at his hand, then his face, as she makes her observation.
clips.end_frame: Hạ holding the steadied vase at the counter edge with both hands, water still rocking inside; Sơn's bare hand withdrawn to his side; the paper-wrapped lily on the counter between them; Hạ's eyes on his face.

clips.lighting: Recent-past afternoon: warm sun through the front window as side key across the counter, soft bounce from petals and pale walls, cooler shade toward the back; no night grade.

cinematic.intent: Let the first connection grow from competent care rather than instant flirtation.
cinematic.composition: Frame the lily and existing vase between their hands, keeping both upper bodies in the medium shot.
cinematic.blocking: Counter between them, Hạ behind it at frame right, Sơn in front at frame left with the window behind him; the vase stands at the counter edge on his side. His right hand catches and releases; her two hands take over.
cinematic.performance: Sơn's reply is faintly self-mocking, a truth dressed as a joke; the catch is pure reflex and embarrasses him. Hạ registers the gap between the guarded man and his careful hands. No flirtation, no lingering touch.
cinematic.focus: Keep the vase lip and both hands readable, without a separate impact or reaction angle.
cinematic.texture: A trace of water rocks inside the saved vase; paper wrapping remains slightly damp at its edge.
cinematic.sound_detail: The disturbance outside is brief, then a small water slosh and his understated sentence fill the beat.
cinematic.rhythm: Quiet wrapping under his line, one sudden catch, then a release that comes sooner than romance would want; her look and remark take the remaining time.

cinematic.rhythm: Her move comes before he can speak; the teasing question lands in the middle; his short answer and her hidden smile close the clip without a further exchange.

clips.start_frame: At the counter: Sơn on the customer side beside the second wrapped lily, eyes fixed through the front window on the tower lobby across the road; Hạ behind the counter facing him and the window; afternoon light on the glass.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ notices where Sơn's eyes are fixed; her own gaze follows his line out through the front window to the tower lobby across the road and rests there briefly. clips.end_frame: Hạ behind the counter holding Sơn's look, waiting for an answer, hands resting beside the wrapped lilies; Sơn turned fully toward her, the tower lobby left soft behind the glass; window reflections drifting over the flower buckets.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Bên đó có gì mà hai chiều nay anh cứ ngó hoài vậy?

clips.lighting: Recent-past afternoon: warm sun through the front window as side key across the counter, soft bounce from petals and pale walls, cooler shade toward the back; no night grade.

cinematic.intent: Allow Hạ to notice the surveillance without turning the scene into an accusation.
cinematic.composition: Use the existing shoulder framing to follow her eyeline from Sơn toward the window and back.
cinematic.blocking: Over Sơn's shoulder toward Hạ behind the counter; the front window and the lobby across the road sit at the frame edge on Sơn's side. Her eyeline travels to the window and back; nobody moves their feet or touches anything.
cinematic.performance: Hạ is curious and a little worried, not accusing; she wants the truth and leaves him room to give it. Sơn's attention leaves the job reluctantly but completely. No suspicious frown, no guilty flinch.
cinematic.focus: Keep her eyes as the focus destination while the lobby remains only a contextual background shape.
cinematic.texture: Window reflections move softly across flower buckets; neither person touches a new object.
cinematic.sound_detail: After Hạ's one soft question, let distant street noise expose the silence between their shared looks.

clips.start_frame: Third afternoon at the counter: Sơn on the customer side holding a scuffed plastic flower bucket by its newly repaired handle; Hạ behind the counter looking from the bucket to him.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Sơn lifts the repaired bucket over the counter toward Hạ, the mended handle creaking lightly under its weight. clips.end_frame: Hạ behind the counter holding the repaired bucket against her apron, thumb on the mend, eyes on Sơn; Sơn on the customer side with empty hands at his sides, gaze on the bucket; afternoon light on the scuffed plastic.

dialogue.speaker: SON

clips.lighting: Recent-past afternoon: warm sun through the front window as side key across the counter, soft bounce from petals and pale walls, cooler shade toward the back; no night grade.

cinematic.intent: Finish the meeting on Sơn choosing to stay, a small change that will later cost him.
cinematic.composition: The slow push holds him at the open doorway, with Hạ's smile in the same shop depth.
cinematic.blocking: Door at frame left, counter at frame right in the same depth. Sơn's shoulder passes the door line, then he turns back toward Hạ within the doorway and stays there. The push-in travels straight toward him.
cinematic.performance: He meant to leave and chooses to stay, a small surrender he will pay for later; the softening reaches his eyes before his mouth. Hạ's laughter turns shy when she sees him listening. No instant grin, no swoon.
cinematic.focus: Favor his reaction while retaining enough of Hạ to show who caused it, no new reverse shot.
cinematic.texture: Door glass and flower wrapping carry late light; no new flower is exchanged here.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let her existing laughter trail into normal shop sound; his brief voice-over is the only speech, no on-screen dialogue fills the silence.
cinematic.rhythm: The departure begins at once; the halt is the event; the remaining seconds stay on his decision and her fading laugh, with no second step either way.

scenes.title: Sổ Đen Và Hạn Chót
scenes.purpose: Giới thiệu bằng chứng bị lấy và lịch giao hàng trong bảy ngày.
scenes.outgoing_audio: The meal container settling at the cabin door bridges to the flower-shop cash drawer. Do not replay the tin being closed.

clips.start_frame: Noon in the cabin: Sơn standing at the wooden table below the east window, the unzipped dark-olive backpack at the table's near edge with its mouth open toward him; daylight through the wall gaps; the cot behind him.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn reaches into the open backpack, lifts out the black leather ledger and sets it squarely on the bare table to his left. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His hand goes back in for the dented sealed tin and places it in the middle with clear wood on each side, then the small closed locked case goes down on the right. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He pulls the backpack's mouth wider, sees it is empty and lets the canvas fall slack, then stands over the three separate objects with both palms flat on the table edge, shoulders heavy, breath slowing.
clips.end_frame: Ledger, sealed tin and closed locked case lying apart on the bare table, the emptied backpack slumped open at the table's edge beside them; Sơn standing over them, palms on the table edge, shoulders heavy, eyes on the ledger; noon light striping the wood.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Sổ đen, hộp thiếc. Thứ Rắn Đen cần bịt lại, sớm muộn chúng sẽ lần tới đây.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: hard top light slicing through cabin plank gaps in thin bars, soft floor bounce as fill, cooler shadows in the corners; no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Replace the quiet romantic memory with objects that reveal why Sơn cannot simply rest.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium frame to read the open bag and three separate items without a montage.
cinematic.blocking: Table below the east window, backpack at its near edge. The objects go down left to right, ledger, tin, case, with clear wood between them. Sơn stays on the room side of the table, the cot behind him.
cinematic.performance: Orderly hands against tired shoulders: he handles the objects like evidence, not trophies, and their weight shows only after the bag is empty. No boastful display, no lingering reveal on any item.
cinematic.focus: Keep the tabletop and his lowered face at practical depth so the inventory remains one action.
cinematic.texture: Canvas creases, black leather and dented tin each have a different surface response to daylight.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let three modest set-down sounds define the objects, with wind continuing through the cabin gaps.
cinematic.rhythm: Three set-downs in a steady sequence without reveal pauses; the only held moment comes after the empty bag, with palms on the table and the breath slowing.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn's unzipped dark-olive canvas backpack sits at the edge of the wooden cabin table beside the evidence items.

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Tay anh trở vào lấy hộp thiếc móp còn niêm, đặt ở giữa, chừa khoảng gỗ trống hai bên; rồi đặt chiếc hộp khóa kín bên phải. clips.start_frame: On the cabin table: the black ledger lying open on its back cover, a small USB taped flat inside it; Sơn's bare fingertips at the tape's edge; noon light across the worn leather.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's fingernail lifts the corner of the worn tape and peels it back slowly, the old adhesive stretching away from the leather. dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Ổ nhớ giữ tài khoản ngầm. Kẹp dưới nó là phiếu điều vận của chúng.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: hard top light slicing through cabin plank gaps in thin bars, soft floor bounce as fill, cooler shadows in the corners; no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Reveal a second layer of evidence through a believable physical discovery, not a screen animation.
cinematic.composition: The detail shot holds the back cover, taped USB and receipt in a single usable plane.
cinematic.blocking: One detail plane: open ledger at frame left, cleared table at frame right. The USB travels from the cover to the table and the receipt follows to lie beside it. Only Sơn's two hands enter the frame.
cinematic.performance: Practiced fingers, then a small involuntary slowing when the paper appears: recognition before understanding. He keeps his breath even. No gasp, no dramatic freeze.
cinematic.focus: Hold the object plane steady; readable layout matters more than legible handwritten words or digits.
cinematic.texture: Worn adhesive stretches slightly, and the receipt retains the crease from being stored under the drive.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use tape lift and paper separation as small clear sounds; no electronic chime belongs to an unplugged USB.
cinematic.rhythm: Tape lift and removal move steadily; the receipt surfaces because the USB moves; the final seconds settle both items side by side for the continuation.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

Lời dẫn của Sơn bắt đầu từ 0.2s, phủ nhịp 1 và đầu nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (BLACK_BOOK, USB) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's index finger moves down to the first of the seven dated boxes and begins to slide along the row, pressing the curled paper flat as it goes. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The finger crosses the middle boxes at the same even pace, counting without hurry, while the free corner of the receipt curls up in the cabin breeze. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): It reaches the last box and stops beside the ship stamp, the fingertip pressing harder until the nail whitens, and stays there with a slight live tremor in the knuckle as wind lifts the paper's free edge.
clips.end_frame: Sơn's fingertip pressed on the last of the seven boxes beside the ship stamp, nail whitened; the receipt held flat beside the USB and the open ledger; its free corner lifting in the breeze; noon light on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Ô cuối có dấu tàu. Đêm ấy, chuyến hàng rời bến Hòn Sóng.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: hard top light slicing through cabin plank gaps in thin bars, soft floor bounce as fill, cooler shadows in the corners; no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Turn the receipt into an external deadline while keeping its printed content visually unobtrusive.
cinematic.composition: Keep the exact preceding detail setup, USB and receipt still sharing the same table orientation.
cinematic.blocking: Exact prior detail setup: receipt at center beside the USB, ledger at frame edge. The index finger travels left to right along the row of boxes and stops at the stamp; the other hand stays out of frame.
cinematic.performance: Controlled dread: the counting is steady, but the pressure at the last box gives him away. He is matching his private count to their written schedule. No prophetic stare, no trembling hand.
cinematic.focus: Retain the same focus plane as the receipt reveal, with the final box and stamp readable as shapes.
cinematic.texture: A curled paper corner shifts in the cabin breeze while his finger keeps the relevant area flat.
cinematic.sound_detail: One fingertip drag under the sentence, no added ticking or departing ship sound to overstate the clue.
cinematic.rhythm: An even count along the row with no taps or repeats; the line rides the travelling finger, and the stop at the stamp is held after it, the fingertip still live.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

clips.start_frame: On the cabin table: the dented tin open, lid propped back, three sealed fictional Tê vials in their fitted slots with caps intact; Sơn's bare hands resting on either side of it.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's right index finger passes over the three caps one after another without touching the glass, checking each seal by eye. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His left hand tilts the tin slightly toward the light so the fitted lining shows, confirming no slot is empty, and no vial leaves its place. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He closes the lid with a single firm press, the soft click quieter than the wind, and both hands rest flat on the closed tin for a breath before drawing back.
clips.end_frame: The dented tin closed on the table, three vials accounted for inside, Sơn's bare hands just lifting from its lid; noon light across the dents, dust drifting in the beam.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Ba ống Tê còn nguyên niêm. Bọn Dũng dùng thứ này để bắt sống người.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: hard top light slicing through cabin plank gaps in thin bars, soft floor bounce as fill, cooler shadows in the corners; no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Introduce the sealed substance as evidence of a larger system, without fetishizing its use.
cinematic.composition: Use the detail composition to show all three fitted slots and the intact vial caps together.
cinematic.blocking: One detail plane with the tin centered and Sơn's hands entering from both sides. The right index finger moves across the caps; the left hand steadies and tilts the tin. The lid closes toward the camera.
cinematic.performance: Familiarity without appetite: he knows these objects and wants nothing to do with them. Counting is a duty, closing is a decision. No curiosity, no lingering over the glass.
cinematic.focus: Keep seals and tin edge crisp, avoiding a macro liquid view that suggests an instructional demonstration.
cinematic.texture: The dented lid and fitted lining look handled, while the sealed glass stays clean and ordinary.
cinematic.sound_detail: Small glass restraint and a single lid click should be softer than the surrounding wind.
cinematic.rhythm: A short count by eye, a brief check of the lining, then the final close; nothing reopens, and the hands lift slowly at the end.

clips.start_frame: Noon in the cabin: Sơn standing beneath the exposed roof beam near the table, the closed locked case held in both hands at chest height; the open backpack at the table's edge behind him; daylight through the wall gaps.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn lifts the closed case overhead and slides it onto the top of the beam, pushing it back into the shadowed recess until it disappears from below. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His fingertips press along the beam's edge, checking that the case sits flat and cannot slide, and a little pale dust sifts down past his face. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He lowers both hands and lets them hang open at his sides where they can be seen, and stands under the beam a moment, shoulders heavier than before, until the breath goes out of him.
clips.end_frame: The case hidden above the beam, nothing visible from below; Sơn standing under it with both empty hands open at his sides, dust settling in the light; the open backpack at the table's edge behind him.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Lần này, tôi phải cứu người bằng chứng cứ, không bằng bạo lực.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: hard top light slicing through cabin plank gaps in thin bars, soft floor bounce as fill, cooler shadows in the corners; no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Show Sơn separating himself from violence while not pretending the past has vanished.
cinematic.composition: The medium setup keeps his empty hands and the beam recess within the same physical frame.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn stands under the beam at frame center, the table and open backpack behind him at frame left. The case travels from his hands up into the recess and stays out of sight; his hands come down open, palms visible.
cinematic.performance: He separates himself from violence without pretending the past is gone; he checks the hiding place from old habit and seems heavier once his hands are empty. No triumphant resolve, no long look upward.
cinematic.focus: Keep enough depth to understand the recess, without exposing hidden contents or a new weapons insert.
cinematic.texture: Old timber, worn case leather and pale dust belong to the existing cabin, not an armory display.
cinematic.sound_detail: A restrained case-to-wood contact and his exhale are sufficient; never add a weapon-cocking sound.
cinematic.rhythm: The lift and slide are quick and practiced, the check is brief, and the emptiness of his hands is held to the end.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn's unzipped dark-olive canvas backpack sits at the edge of the wooden cabin table beside the evidence items.

clips.start_frame: Noon in the cabin: Bảy at the open porch doorway holding a covered meal container on a plastic tray, cloth over his shoulder; Sơn at the table deeper inside, the open black ledger and closed tin before him, the empty backpack at the table's edge.

Beat 2 (3.5–6.5s): Bảy stops at the threshold without stepping into the room and bends to set the tray with the steaming container on the floorboards just inside the door. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He straightens, wiping his hands on the cloth; Sơn, one hand still on the backpack, thanks him in a few words, relief and discomfort crossing his face, and Bảy nods and stays where he is, steam rising between them.
clips.end_frame: The covered meal on its tray just inside the doorway, steam rising; Bảy at the threshold wiping his hands on the cloth, not stepping in; Sơn at the table farther inside, one hand resting on the backpack that hides the ledger and tin.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Cơm trưa nè chú. Sáng nay chú đỡ tui cái thùng, tui trả lễ.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Cảm ơn chú. Để đó giùm tôi.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: hard top light slicing through cabin plank gaps in thin bars, soft floor bounce as fill, cooler shadows in the corners; no fluorescent source.

cinematic.intent: Make hospitality interrupt concealment, binding Bảy's later help to an earned ordinary kindness.
cinematic.composition: Frame the threshold and covered ledger with clear distance, Bảy outside the private room's deeper space.
cinematic.blocking: Doorway at frame left with Bảy on the threshold, table at frame right deeper in the room with Sơn. The tray goes down just inside the door; Bảy never crosses the room. The backpack is drawn over the ledger and tin.
cinematic.performance: Bảy's kindness is practical and he respects the boundary without being told. Sơn's relief at that stop is mixed with discomfort at being cared for while hiding something. No suspicious glances, no sentimental thanks.
cinematic.focus: Keep the two people readable without shifting focus into the concealed book or forcing Bảy to notice it.
cinematic.texture: Meal-container steam and the existing cloth cover bring warmth into the otherwise sparse room.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft container landing and Bảy's unforced voice replace the tin's hard click, with no new musical comfort cue.
cinematic.rhythm: The cover happens under Bảy's first words; setting the tray down is the centre; the clip ends on two men holding their places across the room, steam keeping it alive.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Lời Mời Về Biển
scenes.purpose: Hạ đặt giới hạn rồi tặng đồng hồ như một lời hẹn.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Let the kettle hiss finish. Cut to the next morning doorframe and its second tally, daylight replacing the warm room.

clips.start_frame: Night in the flower shop's back room: Hạ at the small wooden table counting the day's cash into its open drawer, the kettle steaming beside her; Sơn standing near the rear doorway in his black suit and black gloves, jacket closed.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ folds a stack of notes into the open drawer as Sơn rests a gloved hand on the doorframe; the movement swings his jacket open and the dark closed holster under his arm shows in the bulb light. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Hạ's eyes catch it mid-count; her hand stops on the notes, the rustle of cash cutting off, and she looks from the holster to his face as she asks. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn sees her stopped hand before he understands why; his hand drops from the doorframe and the jacket falls closed, too late, and neither moves while the kettle hisses in the gap.
clips.end_frame: Hạ at the small table, her hand resting still on the open cash drawer, eyes on Sơn; Sơn by the rear doorway, gloved hands at his sides, jacket fallen closed over the holster; the table and a stretch of floor between them; kettle steam rising.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Cái gì dưới áo anh vậy? Rốt cuộc anh làm nghề gì?

clips.lighting: Recent-past night: warm back-room bulb overhead as key, soft cool street spill from the doorway behind, kettle steam catching the bulb light.

cinematic.intent: Make Hạ's discovery interrupt an ordinary task before she has language for what she has seen.
cinematic.composition: Keep both upper bodies and the cash drawer inside the locked medium composition, door behind Sơn.
cinematic.blocking: Small table with the cash drawer at frame right, Hạ behind it; rear doorway at frame left behind Sơn. His raised hand on the doorframe swings the jacket open on the side facing her. Nobody steps closer.
cinematic.performance: Hạ's alarm is contained; she stops before she has words for what she saw, and she wants an honest answer. Sơn reads the stopped hand first and knows the evening has changed. No gasp, no backing away, no glamorous weapon reveal.
cinematic.focus: Hold the same practical plane across her face and his jacket edge, not a separate glamorous weapon reveal.
cinematic.texture: Paper money and the drawer's worn edge remain domestic details beside the dark closed holster.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt and concealed underarm holster; left black glove on, right hand bare until he takes the right glove back from the small table at the end of this shot. Hạ wears her cream linen dress, forest-green florist apron with pocket shears, intact pale-blue silk scarf around her neck, and silver hair clip pinned at the back of her hair.
clips.lighting: Recent-past night: warm back-room bulb overhead as key, soft cool street spill from the doorway behind, kettle steam catching the bulb light.

cinematic.intent: Finish on an imperfect intention rather than treating the gift as instant transformation.
cinematic.composition: Maintain the prior medium frame and focus; the watch travels only from his palm to his pocket.
cinematic.blocking: Same locked setup across the small table: the watch goes from his right fist into his jacket pocket; Hạ turns to the kettle behind her at frame right; his bare right hand travels back to the glove on the table.
cinematic.performance: His promise is sincere and already compromised; reaching for the glove carries shame he cannot hide. Hạ sees the contradiction and chooses not to name it. No reproachful look, no second farewell.
cinematic.focus: Keep the same face-and-table readability, allowing the hand's return to be seen without a sudden close-up.
cinematic.texture: The pocket takes the watch's weight, leather stays matte, and the kettle steam begins thinning naturally.
cinematic.sound_detail: The kettle switch ends the hiss after his line; do not use the watch as an unnaturally loud metronome.
cinematic.rhythm: The promise rides the pocketing; the kettle switch drops the room into quiet; a short gap, then the hand's return ends the scene on contradiction.

scenes.title: Mây Gõ Cửa
scenes.purpose: Mây tìm thấy giấy giả và chọn theo dõi người truy tìm Sơn.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Introduce garage ventilation hum before the flashback cut away from the station radio and folder.

clips.start_frame: One pale tally mark cut into the weathered cabin doorframe; Sơn's bare right hand holds the small carving tool with its blade set against the wood beside it; a narrow shelf below; cool morning light across the grain.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): The blade bites and draws the second short stroke beside the first, pale shavings curling off the old wood under steady fingers. Beat 2 (3.5–6.5s): A motorcycle engine climbs the hill outside and cuts out near the porch; the hand stops for half a breath at the sound, then carries the stroke clean to its end. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The fingers brush the last shavings from the fresh cut, lower the tool and lay it on the shelf below; the hand lingers there, knuckles loose, as pine wind takes over from the silenced engine.
clips.end_frame: Two pale tally marks side by side on the doorframe; the carving tool lying on the shelf beneath them, Sơn's bare right hand just lifting away from it; a few shavings still drifting down; outside, the engine silent and pine wind moving.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Sáng ngày thứ hai. Vạch thứ hai chưa khắc xong, xe công an đã lên tới hiên.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: soft daylight through the east-facing cabin window as side key, open sky fill on the porch; neutral window side light inside the station.

cinematic.intent: Make the daily count vulnerable to an interruption from outside Sơn's control.
cinematic.composition: Keep the detail angle on one existing tally and the tool beginning a second, with wood orientation consistent.
cinematic.blocking: Doorframe at chest height fills the frame, first mark left, second cut to its right, shelf directly below. Only Sơn's right hand works; it carves, then sets the tool down. The motorcycle stays off screen, heard from the porch side.
cinematic.performance: The count matters to him, so the hand stays careful and steady. The engine pulls his attention outward for half a breath; he chooses to finish rather than rush, hiding alertness inside routine. No startled jerk, no dramatic freeze.
cinematic.focus: Keep the wood surface and exact mark count clear; do not reveal the rider through a new angle.
cinematic.texture: Two pale cuts in old wood distinguish new days without generated numerals, labels or extra scratches.
cinematic.sound_detail: The scrape is interrupted by a believable engine stop, followed by quieter pine wind rather than a sting.
cinematic.rhythm: A steady cut, a half-breath catch at the engine stop, the stroke completed instead of abandoned, then the tool laid down without haste; the clip closes on hand and wood, not on a reaction.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong căn chòi gỗ một gian trên đồi dương (D2 morning) · Góc máy: Đặc tả đạo cụ (85mm Insert) — khóa nét vào bàn tay và vật dụng mấu chốt. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (MARKS).

Nhịp 2 (3.5–6.5s): Tiếng xe máy leo dốc rồi tắt máy sát hiên; bàn tay khựng nửa nhịp thở rồi kéo nốt nét khắc cho trọn. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Ngón tay phủi phoi khỏi vết khắc mới, hạ dụng cụ đặt lên kệ bên dưới; bàn tay còn nán lại, khớp ngón thả lỏng, gió thông thế chỗ tiếng máy vừa tắt. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy từ 0.2s qua nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.

clips.start_frame: Sơn inside the open cabin doorway, right hand holding the door wide; Mây on the porch boards one pace outside the threshold, notebook closed in her left hand, duty pouch across her body; the two facing each other in morning light.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Mây stays where she is outside the threshold, right hand visible and still, and greets Sơn by name, waiting until he gives one short nod from the doorway. Beat 2 (2.5–6.0s): With that permission she asks to see his identity card; Sơn's eyes flick once past her toward the dune path before his left hand goes into his jacket and draws out a plastic card, and he answers in a few flat words. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): He holds the card out across the threshold at full arm's length, fingers stiff on its edge; Mây's right hand rises to take it without her feet moving, her eyes staying on his face.
clips.end_frame: Mây outside the threshold, Sơn inside the doorway with his right hand still on the door; the card held between his left fingers and hers above the threshold line; her notebook closed in her left hand; both faces level, sea wind stirring her sleeve.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Chào anh Sơn. Tôi kiểm tra tạm trú, anh cho tôi xem căn cước.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Thẻ đây. Cô cứ xem.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: soft daylight through the east-facing cabin window as side key, open sky fill on the porch; neutral window side light inside the station.

cinematic.intent: Show Mây's lawful courtesy making evasion harder than a forceful entrance would.
cinematic.composition: The medium porch setup keeps the open threshold as a visible boundary between visitor and renter.
cinematic.blocking: The threshold splits the frame: Sơn inside on screen left, right hand on the door; Mây on the porch screen right. The card travels from his jacket in his left hand across the line at chest height; neither of them crosses it.
cinematic.performance: Mây is courteous on purpose, because waiting makes refusal harder than force would; she wants to see how he hands it over. Sơn hides unease by overcontrolling a simple gesture, arm too straight. No smirk, no glare.
cinematic.focus: Hold faces and the passing card in practical shared depth, with no readable official details required.
cinematic.texture: Doorframe weathering and the card's ordinary plastic surface keep the encounter mundane and credible.
cinematic.sound_detail: A light knock or threshold step already motivated by arrival may sit under her line; no threatening percussion.
cinematic.rhythm: A greeting and a held beat for his nod, the request, a small hesitation while he decides, then one clean extended handover still in motion as the clip ends.

clips.start_frame: Sơn in the near foreground beside the table, two paces inside the door, hands empty at his sides; Mây on the threshold facing him, his identity card in her right hand, her small black notebook open on her left palm, pen clipped to its cover.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây raises the card beside his face and compares the two, her eyes moving from the small photo to Sơn and back, as she asks how long he plans to stay in Hòn Sóng. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): Still on the threshold, she unclips the pen and copies the card number into her open notebook in a few short strokes, glancing up between them; Sơn holds still by the table, jaw set, offering nothing. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): She holds the card out; Sơn steps forward and takes it back, sliding it into his jacket, while her notebook stays open on her palm and her eyes wait on him for an answer.
clips.end_frame: Sơn one pace inside the door, the card just tucked into his jacket; Mây still on the threshold, notebook open on her left palm, pen in her right hand, eyes on his face, waiting; bright porch boards and morning light behind her.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Căn cước này tôi ghi lại. Anh tính ở Hòn Sóng tới chừng nào?

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: soft daylight through the east-facing cabin window as side key, open sky fill on the porch; neutral window side light inside the station.

cinematic.intent: Make Mây compare a person to a document without performing instant guilt detection.
cinematic.composition: Use the specified shoulder view to retain Sơn by the table and Mây at the doorway with the card.
cinematic.blocking: Mây never crosses the threshold; Sơn stands one pace inside by the table, nearest to us, back half turned. The card goes from her right hand to his and into his jacket; the notebook stays on her left palm throughout.
cinematic.performance: Mây's question is open, not an accusation; she compares a document to a man and lets silence do the pressing. Sơn's stillness invites the scrutiny he wants to avoid; calculation hides behind a flat face. No villain stare, no nervous blinking.
cinematic.focus: Keep Mây's speaking face readable past Sơn's near edge, with card detail secondary rather than legible text.
cinematic.texture: Window light grazes the card and notebook paper, while the interior beyond remains modest and spare.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her paper and card handling stays soft below the question, with the outside motorcycle now quiet.
cinematic.rhythm: Comparison and question come first, then a practical writing interval while the silence grows, and the card goes back before any answer can begin; the clip closes on her open notebook and waiting eyes.
