clips.start_frame: Sơn beside the inner side of the doorframe, the two fresh tally marks at his shoulder; Mây on the threshold an arm's length away, notebook open on her left palm, pen in her right hand, eyes on his face.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Instead of meeting her eyes, Sơn lets his gaze slide to the two pale marks on the doorframe beside him and gives his short answer to the wood rather than to her. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Mây's pen stops above the page; her eyes follow his to the doorframe and settle on the two cuts, and she answers him evenly, voice low and firm. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn's eyes come back to her and find she is no longer looking at him; she keeps studying the marks, pen still raised over the unwritten page, while he holds a breath a moment too long.
clips.end_frame: Mây on the threshold, eyeline fixed on the two marks in the doorframe, pen raised over her open notebook; Sơn beside the frame looking at her, hands at his sides, chest settling after a held breath; daylight steady across the pale cuts.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Hết tuần này. Xong việc là tôi đi.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh đếm ngày hả? Tôi không chờ tới hết tuần đâu.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: soft daylight through the east-facing cabin window as side key, open sky fill on the porch; neutral window side light inside the station.

cinematic.intent: Tie Sơn's evasive answer to the visible count so Mây gains a behavioral fact.
cinematic.composition: The medium composition holds Sơn beside the two fresh marks and Mây's reaction in the same space.
cinematic.blocking: The doorframe with its two marks stands between them at shoulder height, Sơn inside on its left, Mây on the threshold on its right. Feet stay planted; only eyelines travel: his to the marks, hers after his, his back to her.
cinematic.performance: Sơn withholds by looking away, not by lying, and the look gives more away than words. Mây registers the link between his answer and the count, chooses not to press, and keeps it as a fact. No smirk, no theatrical squint.
cinematic.focus: Keep his glance and her receiving eyeline clear, avoiding a new insert that would repeat the carving shot.
cinematic.texture: Fresh wood remains pale against the old frame, with daylight holding the same direction as the visit.
cinematic.sound_detail: A brief pause before his short answer should be heard as reluctance, not filled by a ticking cue.
cinematic.rhythm: His evasive glance and answer open the clip, her reply lands only after she has followed his eyes, then a quiet held ending on her attention resting on the count, breath and pen still alive.

clips.start_frame: Thành's fingers on the worn keyboard of the old station computer, the monitor's pale glow on the keys; an old printer at the desk's right edge; Mây's hand resting on the back of his chair behind him.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Thành's index finger taps the last key and presses enter; the screen glow on the keys shifts as the record check comes back, and his fingers stop dead while he tells Mây, off screen, that the number matches no record. Beat 2 (2.5–6.0s): Mây's hand tightens on the chair back; his hand moves to the mouse and clicks, and the printer beside the desk wakes with a roller grind. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): One page feeds out, curling slightly at its leading edge; Mây's hand comes down and takes it by the edge, drawing it clear of the rollers as they slow.
clips.end_frame: The printer's rollers slowing, one printed page half drawn out of the tray between Mây's thumb and fingers, its content only layout shapes; Thành's hand still on the mouse; the monitor glow steady on the worn keys.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Chị Mây, số thẻ này không khớp hồ sơ nào hết. Giấy giả rồi.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: soft daylight through the east-facing cabin window as side key, open sky fill on the porch; neutral window side light inside the station.

cinematic.intent: Let verification produce the first clear discrepancy without a melodramatic computer reveal.
cinematic.composition: Use the detail setup on printer output, keyboard edge and the hands receiving the page.
cinematic.blocking: Keyboard lower left, printer at the right edge of the desk, Mây's hand entering from above right. Thành's right hand moves from keyboard to mouse; Mây's hand moves from the chair back to the page. No faces in frame.
cinematic.performance: The mismatch registers through hands: Thành's fingers freeze, then work more deliberately; Mây's grip tightens before she reaches. Both treat it as serious because it is so ordinary. No slammed keys, no gasp, no shocked faces.
cinematic.focus: Keep the result as layout and photograph shapes, not readable personal data or a glowing error graphic.
cinematic.texture: Old plastic keys and lightly curled paper make the modest station tools feel used and practical.
cinematic.sound_detail: Printer rollers and a single page feed support Thành's off-screen finding; no digital alarm is necessary.
cinematic.rhythm: The result arrives early and is spoken plainly; printing runs at ordinary speed so the fact can settle; the page is still being taken when the clip ends.

clips.start_frame: Station desk under the ceiling fan: Thành's open leather evidence folder holding Sơn's rental note and the fresh printout, Mây's palm flat on the page; Mây standing over the desk on the left, Thành on the right with his radio handset at his belt.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây smooths the printout flat beside the rental note and, without looking up, tells Thành they will not arrest yet, because whoever comes looking for Sơn is the real lead. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She lifts her eyes to him and assigns one quiet watcher and a log of strange vehicles; Thành nods and answers that he will have the crossroad post note city plates. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He unclips the radio handset and raises it to his mouth, thumb finding the key, while Mây turns back to the open folder and squares its edge against the desk.
clips.end_frame: Folder open on the desk with the printed result beside Sơn's rental note, Mây's fingertips on its squared edge; Thành at her right with the radio handset at his mouth, thumb on the key, about to speak; ceiling fan turning above them.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Chưa bắt. Ai tìm anh ta mới là đầu mối. Cho người canh kín, ghi xe lạ.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Dạ, em báo chốt ngã ba ghi biển số xe thành phố.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: soft daylight through the east-facing cabin window as side key, open sky fill on the porch; neutral window side light inside the station.

cinematic.intent: Show Mây choosing a method of investigation, keeping suspicion separate from proof.
cinematic.composition: Frame both officers with folder in the lower medium space and support radio already available.
cinematic.blocking: Desk across the lower frame, folder open toward Mây. Mây stands over it on the left, Thành on the right. The radio handset moves from Thành's belt to his mouth; the printout stays in the folder.
cinematic.performance: Mây is purposeful, separating suspicion from proof; she wants the hunters more than the hunted and says so once. Thành's quick readiness makes this coordinated work, not a favour. No conspiratorial glances, no raised voice.
cinematic.focus: Keep her face and the open folder readable, with the radio work secondary in the same setup.
cinematic.texture: Plain paper and the rental note give the inquiry physical continuity instead of another screen display.
cinematic.sound_detail: The support channel opens quietly beneath her instruction, maintaining a working-station bed after the paper reveal.
cinematic.rhythm: One quiet instruction and one acknowledgement, never repeated; the scene closes on the radio coming up and the folder squared, a working moment still in motion.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Đêm Bị Gài
scenes.purpose: Sơn bị gài với bằng chứng giả và đồng hồ hỏng khi thoát.
scenes.outgoing_audio: City rain falls away, the arriving black car establishes present-day afternoon. Do not replay the garage escape.

clips.start_frame: Underground car park at night: Sơn in his black suit and gloves pressed to the shadow side of a concrete pillar, hands empty; far along the pillar row a white car idles beside the closed lift doors on the east wall; a round convex mirror on the next pillar.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn eases to the pillar's edge just far enough to read the lift doors in the convex mirror on the next pillar, the white car's exhaust drifting under the amber lights. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His right hand rises toward the holster under his jacket, stops short, and settles flat over the pocket where the closed watch rides; he leaves the gun where it is and keeps his breathing even. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): A soft chime sounds; in the mirror the lift doors begin to part, and Sơn draws back fully behind the pillar, shoulder blades to the concrete, eyes still on the reflection.
clips.end_frame: Sơn hidden behind the pillar, back to the concrete, right hand flat over his jacket pocket, eyes on the convex mirror where the lift doors stand half open with no one yet visible; the white car idling, exhaust drifting under amber light.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Một tháng trước, hợp đồng cuối cùng. Việc của tôi chỉ là chờ thang máy mở.

clips.lighting: Recent-past car park at night: overhead amber fluorescent tubes as top key, moving search beams raking the pillars from the ramp side, deep shadow between; no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Create anticipation by letting the expected lift and white car occupy space before the wrong man appears.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide garage view to connect Sơn's pillar, reflective surface, lift and waiting white car.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn's pillar near left, lift and white car deep right along the row, the mirror on the next pillar between them. He moves only from shadow edge to full cover; the gun stays holstered, his right hand ends on the watch pocket.
cinematic.performance: Professional patience over a private nerve: he expects a routine handover and wants it over. The hand that passes the gun for the watch shows what he is protecting. Unease arrives only with the chime. No frightened face, no gun pose.
cinematic.focus: Retain readable route depth; the reflection should be plausible at this angle, not a magical close-up inside a mirror.
cinematic.texture: Concrete bands and restrained yellow practicals organize the garage, with a faint wet sheen near the ramp.
cinematic.sound_detail: Ventilation hum, distant tire resonance and the actual lift movement build the pause without a score ramp.
cinematic.rhythm: A long controlled wait carried by small adjustments, the hand's choice in the middle, and the doors starting to open only in the last seconds, with nobody revealed yet.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt, and concealed underarm holster; black leather gloves worn on night jobs or tucked in pocket at the flower shop.

Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Một tiếng chuông khẽ vang; trong gương, cửa thang máy bắt đầu mở, Sơn lùi hẳn ra sau cột, bả vai áp bê tông, mắt vẫn bám hình phản chiếu. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy từ 0.2s qua nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.

clips.start_frame: Lift doors open on the east wall; Dũng alone in the doorway, one boot over the sill, heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his torso; Sơn out of cover a few strides from the lift beside the nearest pillar, gloved hands at his sides; the white car idling nearby.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Dũng steps clear of the lift, pulls a thick document envelope from his work bag and drops it on the concrete without breaking stride, telling Sơn that Má has changed the handover. Beat 2 (3.0–5.5s): With the side of his boot he slides the envelope across the floor; it skids to a stop halfway between them, and he jerks his chin at it, telling Sơn to pick up his retirement reward. Beat 3 (5.5–10.0s): Dũng plants himself square in front of the open lift; Sơn does not move toward the envelope and answers him flatly, eyes on Dũng's hands rather than the paper.
clips.end_frame: Envelope lying on the concrete midway between them; Dũng square in front of the open lift doors, arms loose, work bag across his chest; Sơn by the pillar, weight on his back foot, gloved hands empty, eyes on Dũng; lift light spilling across the floor.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Má đổi chỗ giao rồi. Nhặt lên mà coi phần thưởng giải nghệ của mày.

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.text: Mày đâu phải người tao chờ.

clips.lighting: Recent-past car park at night: overhead amber fluorescent tubes as top key, moving search beams raking the pillars from the ramp side, deep shadow between; no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Make Dũng's familiar presence feel wrong through his handling of the envelope and blocked exit.
cinematic.composition: The medium setup keeps Dũng's speaking face, shoe and floor envelope in a readable vertical relationship.
cinematic.blocking: Lift doors center right with Dũng ending in front of them; Sơn on the left by the nearest pillar. The envelope goes from Dũng's bag to the floor and slides left toward Sơn, stopping midway. Nobody else steps out.
cinematic.performance: Dũng plays casual and it sounds rehearsed; he enjoys finally giving Sơn orders. Sơn reads that the wrong man came out and keeps his body contained, refusing the bait. No sneer contest, no lunge.
cinematic.focus: Hold Dũng's mouth and the envelope landing area readable, without an extra low-angle insert.
cinematic.texture: Scuffed shoe leather drags over concrete, while the envelope looks ordinary enough to be plausible work.
cinematic.sound_detail: A dry paper scrape ends before the line's final word, lift ambience continuing behind his voice.
cinematic.rhythm: The drop and the slide are quick and dismissive; the closing seconds hold the standoff so Sơn's refusal and the blocked lift both register.

Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder.

clips.start_frame: The document envelope open on the concrete, flap folded back, a photograph's corner and a hard dark shape showing inside; Sơn's black-gloved right hand hovering just above it; the toes of Dũng's boots at the top edge, still.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Two gloved fingers lift the flap wider; a photograph slides half out, Sơn's own face and black suit in it, and beside it a heavy carved seal rolls into view. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): The fingers stop in midair above both items, the glove leather creasing as they flex, while Sơn's voice off screen names what they are for. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): Without touching either object, the hand draws slowly back from the envelope, fingers curling into a loose fist as it rises out of the light.
clips.end_frame: The open envelope on the concrete with the photograph and the carved seal half out of it, untouched; Sơn's gloved hand rising away above them, fingers curled loosely; Dũng's boot toes still at the top edge; amber light on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.text: Ảnh tao với con dấu của Kiên. Tụi mày dựng sẵn để đổ tội cho tao.

clips.lighting: Recent-past car park at night: overhead amber fluorescent tubes as top key, moving search beams raking the pillars from the ramp side, deep shadow between; no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Let recognition of the planted evidence change the meaning of the meeting before the chase begins.
cinematic.composition: Use the detail frame on the open envelope, gloved hand and two incriminating items together.
cinematic.blocking: Envelope centered on the floor, flap toward us; the gloved right hand enters from the top and leaves the same way. The photo slides left, the seal settles beside it. Dũng's boots stay planted at the top edge.
cinematic.performance: Recognition lives in the fingers: they stop, then retreat with care instead of snatching. He understands he is being made to own this package; anger stays inside the slow withdrawal. No trembling, no slammed hand.
cinematic.focus: Keep both items recognizable as shapes, with no legible legal text or inexplicably sharp hidden document.
cinematic.texture: Worn photograph edges and the seal's hard outline contrast with the soft envelope flap and black glove.
cinematic.sound_detail: Only paper movement and his low off-screen sentence break the garage hum; do not add a camera shutter effect.
cinematic.rhythm: A fraction of reading time for the photo and seal, an arrested pause while the line lands, then a slow deliberate withdrawal still moving at the cut.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt, and concealed underarm holster; black leather gloves worn on night jobs or tucked in pocket at the flower shop.

clips.start_frame: Sơn behind the concrete pillar in his black suit and gloves, the closed watch in his jacket pocket; white search beams sliding across the floor toward the pillar; a parked car two strides to his left.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): An alarm starts wailing as the beams reach the pillar's edge; Sơn breaks from cover, low, and crosses the two strides to the parked car in a crouching run. Beat 2 (2.5–5.0s): He folds down behind its rear bumper; the closed watch swings out of his jacket pocket on its chain and strikes the concrete with one dull knock. Beat 3 (5.0–10.0s): Back pressed to the car, he pins the chain taut with his gloved right hand to stop the watch swinging, breath narrowed and shallow, then forced slower as the beams slide over the roof above him; the handheld stays on his side of the car.
clips.end_frame: Sơn crouched behind the parked car's rear bumper, back against it, gloved right hand holding the chain taut from his pocket to the closed watch on the concrete; search beams crossing the car roof; alarm wailing; his chest rising and falling hard.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Giữa tiếng còi hú, tôi chỉ nghe một tiếng cạch khô trên nền xi măng. Đồng hồ của Hạ.

clips.lighting: Recent-past car park at night: overhead amber fluorescent tubes as top key, moving search beams raking the pillars from the ramp side, deep shadow between; no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Turn the trap into immediate physical pressure and damage the watch without making it an action trophy.
cinematic.composition: Keep the handheld medium-wide on the pillar, nearby parked car and Sơn's crouching path from one side.
cinematic.blocking: Pillar screen right, parked car screen left, two strides apart; Sơn moves right to left and ends crouched behind the rear bumper. Beams sweep in from deep right. The chain runs from his jacket pocket to the floor at his right hip.
cinematic.performance: Fear shows as a sudden narrowed breath and a tight crouch; the knock pulls his eyes to the watch for an instant before he masters his breathing. He wants to vanish, not fight. No posing, no drawn gun, no wide-eyed panic.
cinematic.focus: Keep his whole defensive movement readable, not a separate slow-motion watch impact or disorienting lens change.
cinematic.texture: Search beams move across existing concrete and car paint, leaving the concealed space readable at the end.
cinematic.sound_detail: One dull metal knock is swallowed by alarm and footsteps; no firearm discharge or impact on a body is added.
cinematic.rhythm: The run and the duck are quick; the concealed breathing that follows is long and alive; the taut chain and the wailing alarm close the clip as consequence, not climax.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt, and concealed underarm holster; black leather gloves worn on night jobs or tucked in pocket at the flower shop.

clips.start_frame: Sơn crouched at the low steel maintenance door in the car park's west wall, suit jacket buttoned, the closed watch clenched in his gloved left fist with its chain wrapped round it, gloved right hand on the push bar; door shut; alarm wailing behind.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn shoves the bar and ducks through the low door into rain-cold air, elbow tight so his jacket and the fist holding the watch clear the frame. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): On the wet steps outside he turns and pulls the heavy door back against its frame until the latch catches with a hard click, muffling the alarm. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He straightens with his shoulders to the shut door, gloves still on, and lets out the breath he has been holding as rain darkens his shoulders; the tracking move carries with him from the door onto the steps toward the sheltered lane.
clips.end_frame: Sơn on the wet steps with his back to the closed maintenance door, both black gloves on, the closed watch in his left fist, suit dark with rain at the shoulders, chest heaving with a first full breath; the sheltered rear lane ahead; the alarm faint behind steel.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Cửa kỹ thuật phía tây. Người của Dũng tới chậm hơn tôi một nhịp.

clips.lighting: Recent-past car park at night: overhead amber fluorescent tubes as top key, moving search beams raking the pillars from the ramp side, deep shadow between; no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Make escape depend on taking a reachable maintenance exit, preserving the clothes and object continuity.
cinematic.composition: Track laterally with Sơn through the existing low door and into the sheltered lane, retaining the established direction.
cinematic.blocking: Movement runs left to right: door on the left, steps and lane to the right. The right hand works the bar and pulls the door; the left fist keeps the watch close to his chest. Gloves stay on throughout.
cinematic.performance: Economical and physically taxed: no wasted motion, but the delayed exhale after the latch shows the cost. He feels relief and refuses to trust it. No triumphant look back, no collapse against the door.
cinematic.focus: Keep his jacket, door edge and exiting body readable, without changing to an impossible interior view mid-shot.
cinematic.texture: Rain-darkened door paint and his damp suit carry the garage into the lane without adding a costume reset.
cinematic.sound_detail: Door latch and receding garage alarm connect the spaces, his footfalls changing surface naturally.
cinematic.rhythm: Out through the door without pause, a firm deliberate close, then the first safe breath given real time; rain and breathing continue to the last frame.

clips.start_frame: Sơn under the rear awning of a city lane at night, rain dripping off its edge; black gloves on; the closed silver watch with its fresh dent held in his left hand at chest height, chain trailing; across the road beyond the corner, the flower shop's faint warm lights.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn lifts the closed watch to his ear and tilts his head, eyes unfocused, listening through the rain for its tick. Beat 2 (3.5–6.5s): Nothing comes; his gloved thumb passes over the dent in the lid without opening it, his jaw sets, and he lowers the watch to his chest. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): His eyes find the warm lights of the flower shop past the corner across the road; concentration gives way to alarm as his face turns fully toward them and his weight leans that way, while the push-in closes slowly on him.
clips.end_frame: Sơn under the dripping awning, face turned toward the distant flower-shop lights, eyes fixed, weight leaning into a first step; the closed, dented watch pressed to his chest in his gloved left hand; rain running off the awning edge.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Đêm đó, thứ đầu tiên tôi mất là tiếng tích tắc trong đồng hồ của Hạ. Điều thứ hai, tôi chưa dám nghĩ tới.

clips.lighting: Recent-past car park at night: overhead amber fluorescent tubes as top key, moving search beams raking the pillars from the ramp side, deep shadow between; no gunfire.

cinematic.intent: Let the silent watch create a private loss before Sơn discovers a greater one at the flower shop.
cinematic.composition: The restrained push holds his closed watch near his face and the distant shop-light direction beyond.
cinematic.blocking: Awning and Sơn on the left third, the corner and the far flower-shop glow on the right. The watch travels from chest to ear and back to chest in his left hand; he turns head and shoulders right, feet not yet moving.
cinematic.performance: Concentration while he listens, then a private loss when no tick comes, which he refuses to show; alarm takes over as the shop lights pull at him. The voice is retrospective, the face present. No grief performance, no tears.
cinematic.focus: Favor his face and closed case at a sensible reading distance, leaving the shop as a distant light cue.
cinematic.texture: Wet lapel edges and muted silver retain the night's wear, with no inner watch face exposed.
cinematic.sound_detail: Suppress any ticking completely; rain drips and his breathing remain under the narration and distant city bed.
cinematic.rhythm: A real listening interval, a small closing gesture on the silent lid, then the turn toward the lights arrives late and carries forward into the absence of the next scene.

scenes.title: Hai Người Lạ
scenes.purpose: Bảy và Thành tạo mạng quan sát, kẻ truy tìm để lại dấu.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Introduce wind through the damaged shop door before cutting from the company inquiry to the torn scarf trace.

clips.start_frame: Bright afternoon on Hòn Sóng's main street: a dusty black car pulled in at the curb beside Bảy's coffee stall, engine idling, doors still shut; Bảy behind his counter under the green awning, wiping a glass with the checkered cloth; sea wall beyond.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Both front doors open and two men in city clothes step out onto the bright road; the nearer one already holds a printed photograph and starts asking as he walks to the counter. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He leaves his door hanging open and holds the photograph up across the counter, tapping the face in it, while his partner waits by the fender scanning the street. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Bảy keeps turning the glass in his cloth, unhurried, eyes going from the photograph to the man's face; the photo stays held out toward him, waiting.
clips.end_frame: The printed photograph of Sơn's face held out across the counter toward Bảy; Bảy behind the counter with a half-wiped glass and the checkered cloth, eyes on the visitor; the black car at the curb with its driver's door open, the second man by the fender; awning cloth stirring.

dialogue.speaker: EXTRA
dialogue.text: Tụi tôi từ thành phố xuống tìm người quen. Chú coi giùm, người này có cái sẹo ngang sống mũi, có ghé đây không?

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon: hard sun from the west on the road, faces in cooler shade under the stall awning and market roof with soft bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Make the same ordinary stall feel exposed when strangers use a photograph as a demand.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide street setup to keep the black car, open door and Bảy's counter position related.
cinematic.blocking: Car at the curb screen left, counter and awning screen right, sea wall behind. The nearer man crosses left to right to the counter; his partner stays by the car. The open door stays in frame; Sơn exists only in the printed photo.
cinematic.performance: The visitors are businesslike and entitled, their politeness a form of pressure. Bảy hides alarm inside routine and reads the men before he gives anything. No cartoon thug swagger, no flinch.
cinematic.focus: Keep the offered photograph as a printed face, never placing Sơn physically beside the visitors.
cinematic.texture: Dust on the car and the stall's everyday clutter distinguish outside money from a working seafront.
cinematic.sound_detail: The arriving engine settles to idle, one door remains open, and the short question cuts through normal stall noise.
cinematic.rhythm: The arrival fills the opening seconds, the question comes on the walk, and the end holds on the photograph extended and still unanswered.

clips.wardrobe_note: Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

clips.start_frame: Bảy behind his counter under the green awning, the visitors' photograph in his right hand at arm's length, squinting at it; his phone lying on the counter by his left hand; checkered cloth over his shoulder; the visitors off screen across the counter.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bảy pushes the photograph farther from his eyes like an old man fighting his sight and starts a rambling answer, friendly and vague. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Still talking, eyes never leaving the visitors, his left hand draws the phone off the counter and lowers it below the edge out of sight. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He finishes with an easy shrug and a short laugh, tilting the photograph back toward the visitors without letting it go, his hidden hand steady below the counter.
clips.end_frame: Bảy behind the counter, the photograph still in his right hand tilted toward the visitors off screen; his left hand below the counter edge holding the hidden phone; an easy half-smile, eyes level and watchful; awning cloth moving in the sea wind.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Quán tui ngày mấy trăm khách, mấy chú ơi. Người giống người nhiều lắm, tui mắt mờ, nhớ đâu nổi.

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon: hard sun from the west on the road, faces in cooler shade under the stall awning and market roof with soft bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Show Bảy deciding to protect a person through a small lie he must manage in real time.
cinematic.composition: The medium view favors his face and counter edge, with the offered photograph still in his hand.
cinematic.blocking: Bảy center behind the counter, visitors implied off screen right. The photo stays in his right hand at arm's length; the phone goes from the counter top to below its edge in his left hand. He does not step back.
cinematic.performance: Bảy chooses to protect a stranger and manages the lie in real time; folksy warmth is his cover. He wants the visitors bored and gone. No wink, no clever grin, no glance down at the hidden hand.
cinematic.focus: Hold his face and photograph at useful depth, allowing the phone to disappear without a separate secretive insert.
cinematic.texture: His moustache, worn counter and ordinary glass reflections should stay grounded, with no sudden stylized shadow shift.
cinematic.sound_detail: Normal street sound continues; any phone handling stays quieter than his deliberately unremarkable sentence.
cinematic.rhythm: The answer runs easy and continuous so the small hand movement hides inside it; the clip ends on the photo offered back and the hand already still.

clips.wardrobe_note: Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Quán cà phê cóc của Ông Bảy bên bờ kè biển (D2 afternoon) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bảy đẩy tấm ảnh ra xa mắt như ông già mắt kém, bắt đầu trả lời lan man, xởi lởi mà mơ hồ. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Vẫn nói, mắt không rời hai người khách, tay trái ông kéo chiếc điện thoại khỏi mặt quầy, hạ xuống dưới mép quầy cho khuất. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Ông kết câu bằng cái nhún vai và tiếng cười ngắn, nghiêng tấm ảnh về phía khách mà không buông, bàn tay giấu dưới quầy nằm yên. Bảy nói suốt nhịp 1–2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (COFFEE_TRAY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: COFFEE_TRAY.

clips.start_frame: Sơn half hidden behind a stack of wet fish crates at the market's street edge, shoulder to the stack, eye at a gap between crates; through the gap, down the sunlit street, the black car and the two visitors at Bảy's stall.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn watches through the gap without moving, eyes fixed on the nearer visitor as the man gestures toward Bảy's counter. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The man's sleeve rides up and a dock worker's wristband shows on his wrist; Sơn's eyes narrow on it and his breath stops for a moment. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He eases half a step back so the crate edge covers his face, one hand flat on the wet crate, staying hidden while the wristband stays in view through the gap, jaw tight against the urge to go closer.
clips.end_frame: Sơn concealed behind the crate stack, one eye at the gap, hand flat on the wet crate; through the gap the visitor's wrist with the dock wristband, small and distant in the sun; market shade and dripping water around him.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Vòng tay bến cảng. Dũng đã cử người xuống. Tôi chỉ còn cách đứng im.

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon: hard sun from the west on the road, faces in cooler shade under the stall awning and market roof with soft bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Give Sơn a usable observation while showing that remaining hidden costs him access to the exchange.
cinematic.composition: The shoulder view from his shelter retains the crate gap and distant black-car side in plausible alignment.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn in the near left behind the crates, his shoulder at the edge of the gap; the black car and visitors deep right down the street. He shifts only half a step back; nobody passes between him and the gap.
cinematic.performance: Disciplined impatience: he wants to walk over and ask, and stays because being seen ends everything. The recognition is cold, not surprised. No leaning out for a better look, no muttering.
cinematic.focus: Use enough depth for the wristband shape and cover relationship, without an impossible readable emblem close-up.
cinematic.texture: Wet crate edges and muted market shade partially interrupt the view, preserving a believable obstructed sightline.
cinematic.sound_detail: Nearby water and market work soften the distant voices, so the clue comes visually rather than from perfect eavesdropping.
cinematic.rhythm: A steady watch, one clear glimpse of the wristband, then a held, hidden stillness that costs him; the reveal is never repeated.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong chợ cá Hòn Sóng (D2 afternoon) · Góc máy: Qua vai / Điểm nhìn (50mm Over-shoulder/POV) — khóa trục ánh nhìn đối diện. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn nhìn qua khe giữa hai chồng thùng, không nhúc nhích, mắt dán vào người khách đứng gần đang chỉ tay về quầy ông Bảy. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Tay áo hắn kéo lên, lộ chiếc vòng tay công nhân bến cảng; mắt Sơn nheo lại, hơi thở ngưng một nhịp. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Anh lùi nửa bước để mép thùng che mặt, một tay áp lên thùng ướt, vẫn nấp kín trong khi chiếc vòng còn hiện qua khe, quai hàm siết lại để kìm ý muốn tiến tới. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy từ 0.2s qua nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Qua vai / Điểm nhìn (50mm Over-shoulder/POV) — khóa trục ánh nhìn đối diện · Đạo cụ khóa: Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người.

clips.start_frame: Thành's small notebook open on the seat of his parked motorcycle, half covered by his left forearm; his right hand holding a pen above a blank line; afternoon sun across the scratched seat and tank.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The pen sketches a plate-shaped box on the first line, small quick strokes filling it with shapes rather than letters, the forearm keeping the page half covered. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The pen drops to a fresh line and outlines the dock company's emblem in a few simple strokes, pausing midway with the hand poised, then finishing it. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): His fingers ease the page flat under the forearm; the pen clicks shut and comes to rest in the notebook's crease, the hand staying still and careful against the seat.
clips.end_frame: The open notebook on the motorcycle seat with a plate sketch on one line and the company emblem outline on the line below, both unreadable shapes; Thành's forearm half covering the page, the closed pen resting in the crease; sun glinting on the tank.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Xe lạ như chị Mây dặn. Biển số một dòng, biểu tượng công ty cảng một dòng.

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon: hard sun from the west on the road, faces in cooler shade under the stall awning and market roof with soft bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Let Thành's quiet competence contribute a second independent clue rather than another heroic confrontation.
cinematic.composition: Use the fixed detail angle on his partly hidden notebook and writing hand beside the parked motorcycle.
cinematic.blocking: Notebook center on the seat, forearm entering from the left, pen hand from the right. Plate sketch on the upper line, emblem on the line below; the page never turns toward us. The black car stays out of frame.
cinematic.performance: Quiet competence: careful because concealment matters, steady because he knows exactly what to record. Pride shows only in neat strokes. No trembling pen, no comic nerves.
cinematic.focus: Keep paper and hand clear, with the observed vehicle remaining contextual rather than forcing two sharp distant planes.
cinematic.texture: Notebook creases, pencil pressure and the scratched motorcycle surface reinforce practical field work.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use faint writing and small page friction beneath the continuing road bed, not a fake camera shutter.
cinematic.rhythm: Two distinct notations, each finished cleanly, with a short watchful pause between; the clip ends with the hand settled rather than on another glance.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Các đạo cụ trên bàn và hiện trường giữ nguyên vị trí liên tục từ cú máy trước.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Trục đường chính thị trấn biển Hòn Sóng (D2 afternoon) · Góc máy: Đặc tả đạo cụ (85mm Insert) — khóa nét vào bàn tay và vật dụng mấu chốt. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Ngòi bút phác một khung hình biển số ở dòng đầu, nét nhỏ nhanh chỉ là hình chứ không thành chữ, cẳng tay trái che nửa trang. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Bút xuống dòng mới, phác biểu tượng công ty cảng bằng vài nét đơn giản, dừng giữa chừng một chút rồi vẽ nốt. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mấy ngón tay vuốt trang giấy phẳng dưới cẳng tay; bút bấm đóng lại, nằm vào gáy sổ, bàn tay giữ yên trên yên xe. Thành lẩm bẩm ngoài khung trong nhịp 1–2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Đặc tả đạo cụ (85mm Insert) — khóa nét vào bàn tay và vật dụng mấu chốt · Đạo cụ khóa: Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người.

clips.start_frame: Bảy behind his counter under the green awning, a glass and the checkered cloth in his hands; the two visitors turning from the counter toward their black car at the curb, its driver's door still open; the street reflected in the counter mirror.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): As he turns away, the nearer visitor flicks a small contact card onto the counter, and Bảy calls a friendly promise after them without touching it. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The men climb in, the doors thud shut, and the black car pulls away down the street; Bảy keeps wiping the glass, watching it shrink in the counter mirror. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Only when the road is empty does he set the glass down squarely on the card, pinning it against the sea wind, and let his shoulders drop as he breathes out.
clips.end_frame: The contact card flat on the counter under Bảy's glass; Bảy's hand just leaving the glass, shoulders easing; the road outside clear and bright, the car gone from the counter mirror; awning cloth snapping in the wind.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Danh thiếp tui giữ đây. Có gặp thì tui gọi liền nghen mấy chú.

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon: hard sun from the west on the road, faces in cooler shade under the stall awning and market roof with soft bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Let the visitors leave a future route into the investigation while Bảy waits until immediate danger passes.
cinematic.composition: Keep counter, departing men and black car inside the established wide stall-to-road relationship.
cinematic.blocking: Counter screen right, curb and car screen left; the car exits left down the street. The card lands near Bảy's right hand and stays there; the glass goes from his hands onto the card only after the car leaves frame.
cinematic.performance: Bảy plays the agreeable old man to the end; the promise is cover, not consent. Composure eases only after the car is gone, as a breath, never a grin. He wants them convinced he is harmless. No victory smile.
cinematic.focus: Maintain readable positions and the card's final place under his glass, not a legible phone-number insert.
cinematic.texture: The small card lies flat beneath an ordinary glass, its edges carrying more significance than printed text.
cinematic.sound_detail: Footsteps and engine departure recede naturally, leaving the awning and sea audible again.
cinematic.rhythm: The card drop and his promise come quickly, the departure gets its full ordinary time, and the small decisive gesture waits until the street is truly clear.

clips.wardrobe_note: Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly, tay thao tác với khay ly cà phê hoặc thùng nhựa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Quán cà phê cóc của Ông Bảy bên bờ kè biển (D2 afternoon) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Vừa quay lưng, người khách đứng gần búng tấm danh thiếp nhỏ lên mặt quầy; Bảy nói với theo một lời hứa xởi lởi mà không chạm vào nó. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Hai người lên xe, cửa đóng sập, chiếc xe đen chạy đi theo con đường; Bảy vẫn lau ly, nhìn chiếc xe nhỏ dần trong tấm gương quầy. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Chỉ khi đường đã trống, ông mới đặt chiếc ly đè ngay lên tấm danh thiếp cho gió biển khỏi thổi bay, vai hạ xuống theo hơi thở ra. Bảy nói trong nhịp 1.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (COFFEE_TRAY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo · Đạo cụ khóa: COFFEE_TRAY.

clips.start_frame: Station desk under the ceiling fan: Thành's open notebook with the plate and emblem sketches lying beside Bảy's contact card; Thành standing at the desk's right, leather folder under his arm; Mây seated at the left with her own notebook open, pen in hand.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây leans in and sets her pen beside the emblem sketch and the card, then names the shipping dispatch company it belongs to, her finger tracing the outline. Beat 2 (3.5–6.5s): She looks up at Thành and turns the hunt around: they will trace the freight route and need the plate checked; Thành answers that he will send it to the province right away. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây picks up her pen, writes the company name in her open notebook and underlines it; Thành opens his leather folder on his forearm and starts filling in the request, pen moving.
clips.end_frame: Mây at the desk underlining the company name in her open notebook beside the emblem sketch and Bảy's card; Thành standing at her right, leather folder open on his forearm, writing the request, radio handset at his belt; the ceiling fan turning.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Biểu tượng của công ty điều vận tàu biển. Họ tìm người, mình lần đường hàng. Tra giùm chị.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Em gửi biển số lên tỉnh liền.

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon at the station: daylight through the front windows as soft side key, neutral ceiling practicals as fill, slow ceiling-fan shadows.

cinematic.intent: Convert scattered observations into a direction of inquiry, giving Mây a discovery instead of instant certainty.
cinematic.composition: Frame the two officers and table evidence in the medium setup, each source visibly separate.
cinematic.blocking: Desk across the lower frame: card and Thành's sketch page center, Mây's notebook on the left under her hand, Thành standing right. Each source stays in its own place on the desk; nothing is stacked or swapped.
cinematic.performance: Mây's confidence comes from connecting sources, not intuition, and she turns the hunt around in one breath. Thành listens to learn the next task, eager rather than admiring. No triumphant smile, no lecture.
cinematic.focus: Keep faces and the small comparison zone readable without turning company marks into legible generated lettering.
cinematic.texture: Paper from street notes and the cleaner contact card retain different textures and origins.
cinematic.sound_detail: A modest paper slide and quiet support-channel activity sit beneath Mây's concise thought.
cinematic.rhythm: A short pause on the match before she names it, one clear decision, then both already working as the clip ends.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính gọng tròn ngay ngắn, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Đồn công an thị trấn Hòn Sóng (D2 afternoon) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây nghiêng người, đặt bút cạnh hình phác biểu tượng và tấm danh thiếp, gọi tên công ty điều vận tàu biển, ngón tay lần theo đường viền. Nhịp 2 (3.5–6.5s): Cô ngước lên nói với Thành hướng làm mới: lần theo đường hàng, cần tra biển số; Thành đáp sẽ gửi lên tỉnh liền. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây cầm bút ghi tên công ty vào sổ rồi gạch dưới; Thành mở bìa hồ sơ da trên cẳng tay, bắt đầu điền phiếu yêu cầu. Mây nói ở nhịp 1–2, Thành đáp cuối nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Bảy che được Sơn bao lâu trước khi người lạ hiểu thị trấn này?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Lời hỏi người trở thành manh mối về tuyến vận chuyển.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Hai người tìm cùng một sẹo, Bảy vẫn giữ nhịp lau quán.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Vòng tay công ty, biển số và danh thiếp hợp thành ba nguồn đối chiếu thay vì đoán.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Dấu Vết Còn Lại
scenes.purpose: Sơn nhặt một mảnh khăn và lấy sổ từ kho mình biết.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Match the closed bag clasp to the sealed tin latch in the lamplit cabin. No second theft or opening of the tin.

clips.start_frame: Dawn after rain at Hạ's flower shop: the glass door forced and hanging ajar, shards on the threshold, buckets overturned and stems scattered inside; a short pale-blue strip snagged on the door's broken latch; Sơn on the wet pavement outside in his black suit and gloves.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn eases the broken door inward with two gloved fingers and steps over the glass on the threshold, setting each shoe down where it will not crunch. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Just inside he stops and lets his eyes travel the wreck: overturned buckets, trampled stems, the empty counter, his breathing shallow and held. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): His gaze drops to the door's broken latch beside his hand, where the pale-blue strip hangs; his body slows and turns square to it, gloved hand hovering an inch away, not touching.
clips.end_frame: Sơn just inside the broken door, facing the latch, the short pale-blue strip still snagged on it an inch from his hovering gloved hand; glass and scattered flowers around his shoes; pale window light; the strip's frayed end stirring in the draft.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Rạng sáng, tôi quay lại tiệm hoa. Cửa bị cạy, và Hạ không còn ở đó.

clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain: pale cool window light from the street side as soft key, one dim warm practical in the stockroom, wet reflections.

cinematic.intent: Make absence tangible through a small deliberate trace within a damaged familiar space.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide shop view to retain broken glass, displaced flowers and the pale-blue strip at the latch together.
cinematic.blocking: Door and latch screen left, the wrecked shop opening to the right. Sơn enters left to right, stops one pace inside, then turns back left to face the latch. His gloved hands touch only the door.
cinematic.performance: Recognition slows his whole body; the shock stays inward. He needs the strip to mean Hạ chose to leave a sign, and is afraid to believe it. No kneeling, no cry, no hand to the mouth.
cinematic.focus: Allow the strip to be findable within the room, without an artificial spotlight or a sudden detail cut.
cinematic.texture: Damaged paper sleeves and damp flower stems echo the living shop without adding evidence of unseen graphic harm.
cinematic.sound_detail: Muted wind through the broken door and a cautious footstep replace the former welcoming bell.
cinematic.rhythm: A careful entry, a searching look that lets the audience search with him, then a stop on the strip that holds without freezing.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, still damp from the night's rain, open-collar white shirt and concealed underarm holster; both black leather gloves are still on from the night job when he reaches the flower shop.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn (một tháng trước) mặc bộ vest đen lịch lãm còn ẩm mưa từ đêm qua, sơ mi trắng mở cổ, bao da đeo ẩn dưới nách áo, đi giày da đen; hai tay vẫn mang đôi găng tay da đen từ phi vụ đêm qua khi tới tiệm hoa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Tiệm hoa tươi của Hạ tại thành phố (PAST one month earlier dawn) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (SCARF_FRAGMENT).

clips.start_frame: Sơn's black-gloved right hand raised beside the door's broken latch, the short pale-blue strip snagged on the bent metal, its frayed end trembling in the draft; his gloved left hand at the frame edge.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): His left hand pinches the fingertips of the right glove and draws it off; the bare right hand flexes in the cold air. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The left hand tucks the glove into his jacket pocket while bare right fingertips reach the strip and work its frayed end free of the bent latch, gently, taking only the small torn piece. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The strip comes loose and settles across his open palm; his fingers half close around it without crushing it, the thumb resting on the torn edge.
clips.end_frame: Sơn's bare right hand open beside the empty broken latch, the short pale-blue scarf fragment lying across his palm under his thumb, frayed edge lifting in the draft; his gloved left hand lowered at the frame edge.

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.text: Khăn của Hạ. Cô ấy cố ý móc lại đây, bị đưa ra lối này.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt and concealed underarm holster; both black leather gloves are on at the start, and in this shot he removes only the right glove and tucks it into his jacket pocket; the left glove stays on.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain: pale cool window light from the street side as soft key, one dim warm practical in the stockroom, wet reflections.

cinematic.intent: Distinguish the recovered short fragment from the larger scarf so the later threat has physical meaning.
cinematic.composition: Hold the detail frame on latch, right glove and the small attached strip, preserving their scale.
cinematic.blocking: Latch upper center, right hand entering from the right. The left hand removes the right glove and stores it in the jacket pocket; only the short strip leaves the latch and ends in the bare right palm.
cinematic.performance: Bare fingertips turn tentative where the glove was sure; touching her trace is not a job. The spoken recognition is almost involuntary, a man reading a hope he does not trust yet. No tremor for effect, no kissing the cloth.
cinematic.focus: Keep the torn edge and hand sharp, not an insert of Hạ's face or the watch interior.
cinematic.texture: Blue fibers catch on the already damaged latch; slight fraying matters more than a dramatic tear effect.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft fabric release and his off-screen name for the trace carry the beat, with room wind uninterrupted.
cinematic.rhythm: The glove comes off without hurry, the freeing takes the time it needs, and the last seconds rest on the small piece in his palm with the draft still moving it.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn (một tháng trước) mặc bộ vest đen lịch lãm, sơ mi trắng mở cổ, bao da đeo ẩn dưới nách áo, đi giày da đen; đầu clip hai tay còn mang găng da đen, trong clip anh chỉ tháo chiếc găng phải nhét vào túi áo, găng trái vẫn đeo.

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Tay trái nhét chiếc găng vào túi áo vest trong khi đầu ngón tay phải trần chạm tới mảnh vải, nhẹ nhàng gỡ mép tưa khỏi cái chốt cong, chỉ lấy đúng mẩu rách nhỏ. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mảnh vải rời ra, nằm ngang lòng bàn tay mở; các ngón tay khép hờ quanh nó mà không vò, ngón cái đặt lên mép rách. Sơn nói ngoài khung trong nhịp 1–2.

clips.start_frame: Sơn standing just inside the shop's broken doorway, head turned toward the street side where an unseen neighbour stands outside the frame; right hand bare, left still gloved; wet pavement and faint tire tracks beyond the threshold.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn holds still in the doorway, eyes toward the neighbour's voice off screen, as the neighbour describes a black car and three men before dawn. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): At the three men his jaw locks; when the voice says Hạ looked back at the latch, his eyes flick to it and back, and his bare right hand closes. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): The voice stops; his gaze leaves the neighbour and drops to the wet pavement beyond the threshold, following the tire tracks that curve away toward the road, breath held.
clips.end_frame: Sơn in the broken doorway, face turned down and out toward the tire tracks curving away across the wet pavement; bare right hand closed at his side, gloved left hand on the door edge; flower debris at his feet; pale dawn light.

dialogue.speaker: EXTRA
dialogue.text: Gần sáng có chiếc xe đen, ba người đàn ông. Họ đưa cổ đi. Cổ còn ngoái lại nhìn cái chốt cửa.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt and concealed underarm holster; his right glove is tucked in his jacket pocket since 10.2, so the right hand is bare; the left black leather glove is still on.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain: pale cool window light from the street side as soft key, one dim warm practical in the stockroom, wet reflections.

cinematic.intent: Let the witness offer facts while Sơn supplies the fear, preserving uncertainty about Hạ's fate.
cinematic.composition: The medium setup stays on Sơn at the damaged doorway, neighbor speaking from the established off-screen side.
cinematic.blocking: The doorway frames Sơn at center; the neighbour is off screen right on the pavement, and the tire tracks lead away to the left. He does not step outside; only his head and eyes turn from right to left.
cinematic.performance: He listens to facts and supplies his own fear; the detail of her looking back gives him a fragile, unwanted hope. He wants the direction, not comfort. No relief, no certainty, no thank-you nod.
cinematic.focus: Hold his listening face and doorway relationship; do not invent a new neighbor portrait or readable tire-code close-up.
cinematic.texture: Moist pavement beyond the door provides a plausible trace direction while flower debris remains near his feet.
cinematic.sound_detail: Keep the witness voice slightly outside and local, with no processed threatening effect or reconstructed abduction screams.
cinematic.rhythm: The neighbour's account runs uninterrupted, one small reaction lands on the detail that matters, and only after the voice ends do his eyes travel to the tracks.

clips.start_frame: Sơn inside the wrecked shop by the broken door, rain still on his suit collar; a phone buzzing inside his jacket against his chest; bare right hand at his side, left still gloved; eyes on the broken latch.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): His bare right hand draws the phone from inside his jacket and lifts it to his ear without a glance at the screen. Beat 2 (2.5–7.0s): Bà Hai's soft voice comes through; Sơn listens without a word, eyes fixed on the broken latch, nostrils tightening when she says Hạ has left, the rest of his face held still. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): As her last warm phrase ends, his thumb cuts the call; he lowers the phone to his side, and the bare hand holding it settles and goes steady.
clips.end_frame: Sơn by the broken door, phone lowered at his side in his bare right hand, screen dark, hand steady; eyes still on the latch, jaw set, breathing slowly through the nose; rain drying on his collar; gloved left hand at his hip.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Con nhỏ bán hoa biết chuyện của con nên bỏ đi rồi. Về tiệm lụa đi, má còn chừa chỗ cho con.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt and concealed underarm holster; his right glove is tucked in his jacket pocket since 10.2, so the right hand is bare; the left black leather glove is still on.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain: pale cool window light from the street side as soft key, one dim warm practical in the stockroom, wet reflections.

cinematic.intent: Make Bà Hai's familiar reassurance sound like a trap when Sơn can no longer accept it.
cinematic.composition: Use the close-up to hold his face and phone edge without displaying the caller or an animated screen portrait.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn center, the door and latch off his left shoulder. The phone travels from his inside jacket pocket to his right ear and down to his right side; he neither turns nor steps. The caller is never seen.
cinematic.performance: Bà Hai's warmth is a leash and he hears it as one; anger is real and fully contained, and ending the call is his whole answer. He hides the sting of the lie about Hạ. No shout, no rage tremor, no thrown phone.
cinematic.focus: Favor his eyes and the phone at a natural distance; keep any screen content unreadable and secondary.
cinematic.texture: Rain still clings to his suit edge, contrasting with the dry composure returning to his face.
cinematic.sound_detail: The filtered familiar voice stays soft, then cuts cleanly to the damaged shop's real ambience.
cinematic.rhythm: A quick answer to the buzz, her sweetness given room to finish, then the cut-off and a stillness afterward that carries the decision.

Nhịp 3 (7.0–10.0s): Câu ngọt cuối vừa dứt, ngón cái anh ngắt máy; anh hạ điện thoại xuống bên hông, bàn tay trần đang cầm nó lặng đi và vững lại. Giọng Bà Hai qua điện thoại từ nhịp 1 tới hết nhịp 2.

clips.start_frame: The silk shop's rear stockroom door, shut and locked before opening hours; Sơn one pace from it in his black suit, backpack on his left shoulder with his left hand on the strap, the old key ready in his right hand.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn steps to the door, fits the old key into the lock without hunting for the keyhole and turns it; the latch gives with one restrained click. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He slips inside and pushes the door to behind him, pocketing the key as he moves, the lateral move carrying with him into the dim stockroom. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He crosses the room without searching, straight past the silk bolts to the shelf beside the loading door, and stops there; on the shelf, the black ledger and the dented tin sit in the dim practical light.
clips.end_frame: Sơn beside the stock shelf near the loading door, backpack on his left shoulder, right hand empty at his side, eyes on the black ledger and dented tin resting on the shelf; the rear door shut behind him; dust turning in the dim light.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Bà Hai nói dối. Tôi không về nhận lệnh. Tôi dùng chìa cũ, vào kho sau tiệm lụa.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn carries his dark-olive canvas backpack over his left shoulder to pack the ledger, USB, receipt and sealed tin.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain: pale cool window light from the street side as soft key, one dim warm practical in the stockroom, wet reflections.

cinematic.intent: Make taking evidence a conscious alternative to obeying Bà Hai's invitation, using a place Sơn knows.
cinematic.composition: Track along the rear stockroom entry toward the familiar shelf, keeping the route in one direction.
cinematic.blocking: One direction throughout, left to right: rear door on the left, shelf and loading door on the right. The key goes from his right hand into the lock and then his jacket pocket; the backpack never leaves his left shoulder.
cinematic.performance: Purposeful, not excited: familiarity means no searching, which makes the choice deliberate. He knows Bà Hai will call it betrayal and does it anyway. No thief's crouch, no nervous glances.
cinematic.focus: Keep Sơn and the target shelf readable as he enters, rather than cutting to an unexplained object location.
cinematic.texture: Old latch wear and dust patterns indicate routine access, without adding a new hidden compartment or password cue.
cinematic.sound_detail: One restrained latch sound gives way to morning city noise outside and his quiet steps inside.
cinematic.rhythm: A short plain unlock, a continuous entry, and a direct walk to the shelf; the clip ends as he arrives, before anything is taken.

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Anh lách vào, khép cửa sau lưng, vừa đi vừa cất chìa vào túi áo; máy lia ngang theo anh vào gian kho mờ tối. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Anh băng qua phòng không chút tìm kiếm, đi thẳng qua các cây lụa tới kệ cạnh cửa bốc hàng và dừng lại; trên kệ, cuốn sổ đen và hộp thiếc móp nằm dưới ánh đèn mờ. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy từ 0.2s qua nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (BACKPACK) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Máy trượt ngang (35mm Tracking) — bám sát bước chân và nhịp di chuyển nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: BACKPACK.

clips.start_frame: Black leather ledger on the stockroom shelf, a folded receipt edge showing under its back cover, the dented tin beside it; Sơn in front of the shelf with the backpack on his left shoulder; dim practical light.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn swings the backpack off his shoulder onto the shelf's edge and runs the brass zipper open. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He slides the black ledger off the shelf, back cover held shut so the receipt and USB stay inside, and lowers it into the bag; then he lifts the dented tin level and sets it in beside the ledger, unopened. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He draws the zipper closed and rests his hand on the bag, eyes lingering on the two clean rectangles left in the dust where they lay.
clips.end_frame: The backpack zipped shut on the shelf's edge, its brass pull at the top under Sơn's right hand, his left hand on the strap; two clean empty rectangles in the shelf dust where the ledger and tin lay; his eyes on them, breath slow.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Sổ đen, phiếu tàu, hộp Tê. Đủ để mặc cả, không đủ để đem Hạ về.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn carries his dark-olive canvas backpack over his left shoulder to pack the ledger, USB, receipt and sealed tin.
clips.lighting: Recent-past dawn after rain: pale cool window light from the street side as soft key, one dim warm practical in the stockroom, wet reflections.

cinematic.intent: Pay off the origin of the evidence while letting Sơn admit that it cannot replace the missing person.
cinematic.composition: The medium composition keeps ledger, receipt, sealed tin and open bag together at the known shelf.
cinematic.blocking: Shelf across mid-frame, backpack on its edge at left, ledger and tin to the right. The objects move right to left into the bag; the bag stays on the shelf edge at the end, right hand on it, left hand on the strap.
cinematic.performance: Disciplined hands carry a man who knows evidence is not rescue; regret, not pride, sits in the pause over the empty spots. He wants leverage and hates that it is all he has. No triumphant zip, no smile.
cinematic.focus: Keep the difference between emptied shelf positions and packed objects understandable without individual hero inserts.
cinematic.texture: Black ledger leather, folded receipt and dented tin retain their distinct textures inside the plain canvas bag.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use subdued object contacts and one final clasp, with no triumph cue or unshown alarm effect.
cinematic.rhythm: Packing is one continuous, unshowy sequence with no object reintroduced; the closing seconds rest on the closed bag and the empty dust, ready to match into the tin.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Hạ để lại dấu hay chỉ để lại thứ Sơn muốn tin?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Một mảnh khăn cho thấy bị đưa đi; Sơn chọn lấy chứng cứ thay vì trở về nhận lệnh.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Cả tiệm hỏng nhưng một mảnh xanh mắc đúng vị trí.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Mảnh ngắn chưa là khăn đầy đủ; nguồn sổ và tin được trả lời để không xuất hiện thần kỳ.

scenes.title: Bảy Ngày Không Chạy
scenes.purpose: Mây nhìn thấy nguy cơ, Sơn chấp nhận để lại một đường liên lạc.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Carry pine wind across the night-to-morning cut, with a clear daylight change. The third mark is a new action.

clips.start_frame: Night, the cabin table under the warm lamp: the dispatch receipt lying flat, its seven dated boxes and ship stamp only shapes, the dented tin closed beside it; Sơn's bare right hand holding a pencil just above the paper.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The pencil tip travels along the row of boxes and stops at the last one beside the ship stamp, his left fingertips pinning the receipt's corner. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He presses one short firm stroke into that final box, harder than any earlier tracing, the graphite squeaking, then lifts the pencil and lays it aside. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): His left hand slides the sealed tin onto the curling corner of the receipt to hold it flat and rests on the lid a moment without opening it, then draws back, leaving the paper weighted.
clips.end_frame: The dispatch receipt weighted flat by the closed dented tin on its corner, a fresh pencil stroke in the last box beside the ship stamp, the pencil lying alongside; Sơn's bare left hand just withdrawing; warm lamplight on the paper, night wind faint at the window.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Ô cuối trên tờ phiếu. Tàu đi rồi thì dấu vết của Hạ cũng đi theo. Lần này tôi không chạy.

clips.lighting: Present-day night: warm cabin lamp as low key from the table inside; cool moonlight from above backlighting the pines and figures outside.

cinematic.intent: Revisit the shipping date as a decision to act on it, not a repeated explanation of the same clue.
cinematic.composition: Match the bag-clasp geometry into the existing sealed tin and receipt under the cabin lamp.
cinematic.blocking: Receipt across the lower frame, ship stamp at its right end; the tin enters from the left onto the right-hand corner. The right hand marks and sets the pencil down; the left hand moves the tin, which never opens.
cinematic.performance: Commitment, not discovery: the pressure of the stroke says he has decided to act on this date. Resting on the tin is restraint, a reminder of what he will not use. No hesitation over the box, no lingering caress.
cinematic.focus: Keep pencil, final box and tin edge at the same stable detail depth; handwritten words stay unreadable.
cinematic.texture: Warm lamplight catches the paper crease while the closed tin remains a dull, practical weight.
cinematic.sound_detail: Pencil drag and tin settling replace the earlier USB tape sounds, with night pine wind underneath.
cinematic.rhythm: A short travel to the last box, one decisive mark, then the slower deliberate placing of the weight; nothing dwells on all seven boxes.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần.

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Anh ấn một nét ngắn, chắc vào ô cuối, mạnh hơn mọi lần dò trước đó, chì rít khẽ, rồi nhấc bút đặt sang bên. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Tay trái đẩy hộp thiếc niêm phong đè lên góc giấy đang cong cho phẳng, đặt yên trên nắp một thoáng mà không mở, rồi rút về. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy từ 0.2s qua nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (TIN, RECEIPT) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: Sơn seated at the lamplit cabin table holding a loose wallet photograph of Hạ in both hands, thumbs on its white border; his worn wallet open on the table; the dark window to his right.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's eyes rest on Hạ's face in the photograph, softened, while far below the dune a motorcycle engine idles and then cuts out. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): His eyes lift before his hands move; then he lays the photograph face down on the table and keeps his palm flat on its back, protective. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): His head turns toward the dark window, shoulders still, listening; his breathing goes shallow and quiet while his palm stays on the hidden picture.
clips.end_frame: Hạ's loose photograph face down on the table under Sơn's flat right palm beside the open wallet; Sơn seated, head turned toward the dark window, eyes searching the night, breath shallow; lamplight along his cheek.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Có người dừng xe dưới đồi. Ai nhìn tôi cũng được, nhưng không được thấy mặt Hạ.

clips.lighting: Present-day night: warm cabin lamp as low key from the table inside; cool moonlight from above backlighting the pines and figures outside.

cinematic.intent: Show Sơn guarding a private attachment when he suspects observation, without revealing the watch early.
cinematic.composition: The medium view holds his face, loose wallet portrait and cabin window within the same quiet arrangement.
cinematic.blocking: Table across the lower frame, Sơn seated center, window on screen right. The photo moves from both hands to face down on the table under his right palm; he does not stand or approach the window.
cinematic.performance: Protective and a little ashamed: he hides her face, not evidence. His expression changes at the engine before his hands react. He wants whoever is out there never to learn she exists. No frantic snatch, no theatrical glare.
cinematic.focus: Keep the loose photograph clearly outside any watch, with his eyeline toward the window readable.
cinematic.texture: The portrait's thin paper edge and worn wallet distinguish it from the heavy closed silver case.
cinematic.sound_detail: A faint paper touch follows the distant engine settling; the silent present-day watch adds no tick.
cinematic.rhythm: A soft held look, the engine stop as the turning point, one decisive concealment, then a long listening stillness that keeps breathing.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong căn chòi gỗ một gian trên đồi dương (D2 night) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (PHOTO).

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.0s): Mắt anh ngước lên trước khi tay động; rồi anh úp tấm ảnh xuống mặt bàn, lòng bàn tay áp phẳng lên lưng ảnh như che chở. Nhịp 3 (6.0–10.0s): Đầu anh quay về ô cửa sổ tối, vai bất động, lắng nghe; hơi thở nông và khẽ, bàn tay vẫn đặt trên tấm ảnh úp. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy từ 0.2s qua nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.
