clips.start_frame: Night on the dune: Mây half behind a pine trunk, binoculars raised to her eyes and aimed up the slope at the cabin's lit window; duty pouch across her body; pine needles stirring in the foreground.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây holds the binoculars steady on the lit window, adjusting her grip as pine branches sway across her view. Beat 2 (3.5–6.5s): The binoculars stop on one point: inside, at the roof beam, the dark edge of a case shows in a recess, and she holds her breath to steady the view. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She lowers the binoculars to her chest, takes her small notebook and pen from the duty pouch and writes a short note, eyes moving from page to window and back.
clips.end_frame: Mây behind the pine with the binoculars lowered against her chest, writing in her open notebook, pen moving, eyes lifting to the lit cabin window up the slope; wind in the needles.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Có góc hộp màu tối trên xà nhà. Chưa biết bên trong là gì. Ghi lại, chưa kết luận.

clips.lighting: Present-day night: warm cabin lamp as low key from the table inside; cool moonlight from above backlighting the pines and figures outside.

cinematic.intent: Make Mây's observation a plausible suspicion about a hiding place, preserving uncertainty and investigative discipline.
cinematic.composition: Use the shoulder perspective from behind the pine, with the cabin window occupying a small believable sightline.
cinematic.blocking: Mây near left behind the trunk, her shoulder in the foreground; the cabin window small and high on the right. She never steps out from the trunk; binoculars go from eyes to chest, and the notebook comes out of the pouch.
cinematic.performance: Disciplined suspicion: she sees an edge, not contents, and knows the difference. Her face admits the picture is incomplete as she writes. She wants proof, not a story. No gasp, no knowing smile.
cinematic.focus: Keep Mây and her sightline coherent, not a magical sharp zoom from distant tree to concealed interior.
cinematic.texture: Pine bark and needles interrupt the foreground; warm cabin light reaches only the parts actually exposed.
cinematic.sound_detail: Keep near wind and the quiet notebook movement, with no distant interior sound magically audible to her.
cinematic.rhythm: A patient scan, a held breath on the single detail, then the observation written down; the clip ends on recording, not on a conclusion.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Triền đồi cát trắng dưới rặng dương liễu (D2 night) · Góc máy: Qua vai / Điểm nhìn (50mm Over-shoulder/POV) — khóa trục ánh nhìn đối diện. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây giữ ống nhòm yên trên ô cửa sổ sáng đèn, chỉnh lại tay cầm khi cành thông đung đưa ngang tầm nhìn. Nhịp 2 (3.5–6.5s): Ống nhòm dừng ở một điểm: bên trong, nơi xà mái, mép tối của một chiếc hộp lộ ra trong khe xà; cô nín thở cho khung nhìn đứng yên. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Cô hạ ống nhòm xuống ngực, lấy sổ tay nhỏ và bút trong túi công tác, ghi một dòng ngắn, mắt đi từ trang giấy lên cửa sổ rồi trở lại. Lời dẫn của Mây chạy từ 0.2s qua nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Qua vai / Điểm nhìn (50mm Over-shoulder/POV) — khóa trục ánh nhìn đối diện · Đạo cụ khóa: DUTY_POUCH.

clips.start_frame: Below the dune ridge at night: Mây crouched behind the crest, notebook in hand; Thành climbing the last stretch of sand toward her, leather folder under his arm; the lit cabin window small behind them up the slope.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Thành drops into a crouch beside Mây and slips a sheet from his leather folder, telling her low that the province has answered about the black car. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She takes the sheet without turning toward the cabin and tilts it to catch the faint glow, eyes running down to one line; her jaw sets as she answers him in a near whisper. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She folds the sheet along its crease and keeps it in her hand; both stay low behind the crest, Thành watching her face, the cabin light steady behind them.
clips.end_frame: Mây and Thành crouched side by side below the ridge, the folded company report in Mây's hand, Thành's leather folder under his arm, faces low and close; the lit cabin window steady behind them up the slope; wind moving the pine needles.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Tỉnh trả lời rồi chị. Xe đen đứng tên công ty điều vận đó.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Vậy người tìm Sơn dính tới tàu hàng. Lớn hơn giấy giả rồi.

clips.lighting: Present-day night: warm cabin lamp as low key from the table inside; cool moonlight from above backlighting the pines and figures outside.

cinematic.intent: Use Thành's report to tighten the connection between the visitors and shipping evidence, without another revelation speech.
cinematic.composition: Frame both below the ridge, keeping the cabin light in the background as a steady reference.
cinematic.blocking: Both crouched below the crest, Mây left, Thành right, the cabin window above and between them in the background. The sheet passes from Thành's folder to Mây's right hand; neither rises above the ridge line.
cinematic.performance: Thành delivers the finding efficiently, a little proud. Mây's response is a silent recalibration: the fake papers were the small problem. She keeps the worry from showing to Thành. No astonishment, no glance back at the cabin.
cinematic.focus: Hold their faces and paper handover at shared depth, avoiding a new company-logo insert.
cinematic.texture: Paper edges catch the cabin glow; pine shadow remains irregular and natural around their shoulders.
cinematic.sound_detail: Their restrained voices sit close under the pine wind, with no phone chime announcing the report.
cinematic.rhythm: The handover is clean and early, the processing pause in the middle short and real, and the end leaves the light behind them unresolved.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính gọng tròn ngay ngắn, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.

screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Thành khom người ngồi xuống cạnh Mây, rút một tờ giấy từ bìa hồ sơ da, nói khẽ là tỉnh đã trả lời về chiếc xe đen. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Mây nhận tờ giấy mà không quay về phía căn chòi, nghiêng nó đón chút ánh sáng, mắt dò xuống một dòng; quai hàm cô siết lại khi đáp gần như thì thầm. clips.start_frame: Sơn standing at the cabin window at night with the lamp behind him; the closed silver watch in his right hand at chest height, chain running to his jacket pocket; his eyes on the dark pine line outside; the porch beyond still unlit.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's eyes stop on one dark pine trunk down the slope and stay there; he knows someone is watching and begins to speak quietly, as if to that tree. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): Still speaking, his left hand finds the switch on the wall beside the window and flicks it; warm porch light spills over the boards outside and across his shoulder. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): He steps back from the glass into the lit middle of the room, still in the window's view, the closed watch held at his chest, and stands still, breathing evenly, letting himself be seen.
clips.end_frame: Porch lit outside the window; Sơn a step back from the glass in the middle of the lamplit room, still visible through the window, the closed watch in his right hand at his chest, face calm toward the dark slope, breath steady.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Cô cứ nhìn. Tôi vẫn ở đây, không trốn đâu hết. Sáng mai ta nói chuyện.

clips.lighting: Present-day night: warm cabin lamp as low key from the table inside; cool moonlight from above backlighting the pines and figures outside.

cinematic.intent: Make Sơn's response to being watched an offer to be seen rather than another attempt to hide.
cinematic.composition: Use the close-up from the established window side, keeping the closed watch and his face related.
cinematic.blocking: Window and switch on screen left, Sơn's face right of center. The left hand works the switch; the right holds the closed watch and never opens it. He moves one step back, staying inside the window's sightline.
cinematic.performance: An offer, not a boast: he chooses to be watched rather than hide, and under it is the tiredness of running. He wants the watcher to see a man who stays. No smirk of superior awareness, no scanning the tree line.
cinematic.focus: Favor his face and closed lid, allowing the new porch glow to change the background rather than the lens.
cinematic.texture: Warm light finds the weathered frame and jacket shoulder while the watch interior remains concealed.
cinematic.sound_detail: A small switch click and ordinary porch-fixture sound accompany his quietly visible sentence, then pine wind persists.
cinematic.rhythm: Recognition, the quiet sentence with the switch inside it, then a single step back and a still, breathing wait that is the real answer.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong căn chòi gỗ một gian trên đồi dương (D2 night) · Góc máy: Cận cảnh (85mm Close-up) — bắt trọn ánh mắt, cơ mặt và nhịp thoại dứt khoát. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (WATCH).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mắt Sơn dừng ở một gốc thông tối dưới dốc và đứng yên ở đó; anh biết có người đang nhìn, bắt đầu nói khẽ như nói với gốc cây ấy. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.0s): Vẫn nói, tay trái anh tìm công tắc trên tường cạnh cửa sổ, bật lên; ánh đèn hiên vàng ấm tràn trên sàn gỗ ngoài hiên và qua vai anh. Nhịp 3 (6.0–10.0s): Anh lùi khỏi ô kính vào giữa căn phòng sáng đèn, vẫn trong tầm nhìn qua cửa sổ, đồng hồ đóng nắp giữ trước ngực, đứng yên, thở đều, để mình được nhìn thấy. Sơn nói trong hình ở nhịp 1–2.

clips.start_frame: Mây and Thành standing among the pines below the cabin, the porch now lit warm above them; Mây's notebook open in her hand, Thành at her shoulder with his leather folder; the dune path running down behind them.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây watches the lit porch a moment, then shuts her notebook with one hand and tells Thành they will ask him straight in the morning and keep townspeople away. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Thành nods and answers that he will close the trail early, tucking the folder tighter under his arm. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây turns first and leads down the dune path; Thành falls in a step behind her, sand sliding under their shoes, the warm porch light staying above and behind them.
clips.end_frame: Mây and Thành walking down the dune path away from the cabin, Mây a step ahead with the closed notebook in her hand, Thành behind with the folder under his arm; sand sliding at their heels; the lit porch small and steady up the slope behind them.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh ta muốn mình thấy. Sáng mai mình lên hỏi thẳng, đừng để dân tới gần.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Dạ, em chặn lối mòn từ sớm.

clips.lighting: Present-day night: warm cabin lamp as low key from the table inside; cool moonlight from above backlighting the pines and figures outside.

cinematic.intent: Let Mây respond to the offered visibility by choosing timing and public safety, not an impulsive raid.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide view below the porch to hold both officers and the now-lit cabin in a single geography.
cinematic.blocking: Cabin and lit porch high on screen right, the path descending toward lower left. Both start below the porch and exit down the path to the left, Mây leading. The notebook closes in her hand and stays closed.
cinematic.performance: Mây's restraint is an active choice: the lit porch reads as an invitation she will take on her own terms. Thành follows without a second question. No raid energy, no doubtful glance back up the slope.
cinematic.focus: Keep moving figures and porch light readable without an extra long-lens view through the cabin window.
cinematic.texture: Night sand and pine shadows make their safe descent tangible, with the cabin remaining a steady fixed point.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her line stays low but clear over footsteps shifting on sand; no tactical radio burst is invented.
cinematic.rhythm: A short look at the light, one instruction and its acknowledgement, then the descent carries them out while the porch light remains as the last presence.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính gọng tròn ngay ngắn, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Triền đồi cát trắng dưới rặng dương liễu (D2 night) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây nhìn hiên nhà vừa sáng đèn một thoáng, rồi gập sổ bằng một tay, dặn Thành sáng mai lên hỏi thẳng và đừng để dân tới gần. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Thành gật đầu đáp sẽ chặn lối mòn từ sớm, kẹp chặt bìa hồ sơ dưới nách. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây quay đi trước, dẫn xuống lối mòn đồi cát; Thành theo sau một bước, cát trượt dưới giày, ánh đèn hiên ấm vẫn ở trên cao phía sau họ. Mây nói ở nhịp 1, Thành đáp ở nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo · Đạo cụ khóa: DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Mây đang nhìn kẻ bỏ trốn hay người cố để mình được thấy?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Sơn bật đèn cho người quan sát thấy anh không bỏ đi.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Bức ảnh bị úp nhưng chiếc đồng hồ vẫn đóng.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Ánh đèn được dùng như hành vi chấp nhận giám sát, không giả làm tín hiệu bí mật mới.

scenes.title: Rừng Dương
scenes.purpose: Sơn chống phục kích, cứu người sau khi thuốc gây bất động.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Carry the fallen man breathing under the cut to the clinic. No replay of the fall or stretcher arrival.

clips.start_frame: Two pale tally marks on the cabin's entry doorframe, first morning sun just reaching the wood; Sơn's bare right hand holds the carving tool with its blade set beside them; a narrow shelf below; across the room behind, the rear door.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The blade cuts the third short stroke beside the other two, pale shavings curling off in the raking light, as boots begin to creak on the porch boards outside. Beat 2 (3.0–5.5s): The hand finishes the stroke without slowing, lays the tool on the shelf below in one economical move and leaves the wood. Beat 3 (5.5–10.0s): Beyond the doorframe, across the room, the rear door swings open on the pines and pulls shut behind a passing shoulder, still moving on its hinge, while three clean marks catch the sun.
clips.end_frame: Three pale marks on the doorframe in raking morning light, fresh shavings on the shelf beside the tool; across the room the rear door swinging nearly shut, pine light flickering through the closing gap; footsteps on the porch outside.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Ngày thứ ba. Lần này, hai kẻ lạ lên đồi không gõ cửa.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: low sun from the east raking between the pines in hard shafts and moving shadow bars, white-sand bounce lifting the faces.

cinematic.intent: Turn the familiar morning tally into an alarmed departure without replaying earlier carving beats.
cinematic.composition: The detail setup holds two existing marks and the fresh third, with rear-door direction at the frame edge.
cinematic.blocking: Doorframe and marks fill the near right, shelf below; the rear door sits deep left across the room. Sơn's right hand cuts and sets the tool down, then his figure crosses the background to the rear door, small and brief.
cinematic.performance: Practiced awareness: no panic, only economy. He finishes what he started because the count matters, then takes the exit he planned. No startled look over his shoulder, no fumbling.
cinematic.focus: Keep the count exact and readable as cuts in wood, without showing pursuers in a second angle.
cinematic.texture: Fresh shavings catch raking light while the rear door moves naturally in the pine breeze.
cinematic.sound_detail: Footsteps arrive over the last short scrape, then the rear latch and retreating step change the sound direction.
cinematic.rhythm: The cut and the first footsteps overlap; nothing lingers on the wood after the threat; the clip ends on the completed mark and a door still moving.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong căn chòi gỗ một gian trên đồi dương (D3 morning) · Góc máy: Đặc tả đạo cụ (85mm Insert) — khóa nét vào bàn tay và vật dụng mấu chốt. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (MARKS).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Lưỡi dao khắc nét thứ ba cạnh hai vạch cũ, phoi gỗ trắng cong lên trong nắng xiên, tiếng giày bắt đầu kẽo kẹt trên sàn hiên bên ngoài. Nhịp 2 (3.0–5.5s): Bàn tay khắc nốt nét không chậm lại, đặt dụng cụ lên kệ bên dưới gọn một động tác rồi rời mặt gỗ. Nhịp 3 (5.5–10.0s): Phía sau khung cửa, bên kia phòng, cửa sau mở ra phía rừng thông rồi khép lại sau một bờ vai vừa lướt qua, cánh cửa còn đung đưa trên bản lề, ba vạch sạch bắt nắng. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy từ 0.2s qua nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (MARKS) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Đặc tả đạo cụ (85mm Insert) — khóa nét vào bàn tay và vật dụng mấu chốt · Đạo cụ khóa: MARKS.

clips.start_frame: Empty one-room cabin in morning light: rumpled blanket on the cot by the west wall, fresh sandy footprints across the boards to the rear door; the front door swung inward, two unnamed men in dark city clothes on the threshold.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): The two men step in one behind the other, eyes sweeping the single room; the first crosses straight to the cot and throws the blanket back. Beat 2 (2.5–5.5s): His palm presses the sheet and finds it still warm while his partner's eyes drop to the sandy prints on the boards, and the first man barks what they have found. Beat 3 (5.5–10.0s): Both turn toward the rear door at the back of the room, the second already stepping after the prints, the front door still swinging behind them.
clips.end_frame: Both intruders turning toward the rear door, the second a step ahead along the sandy footprints, the first rising from the cot with the blanket thrown back; the cabin otherwise empty; the front door swaying open behind them, wind coming in.

dialogue.speaker: EXTRA
dialogue.text: Giường còn ấm. Nó vừa chạy ra cửa sau, theo dấu giày!

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: low sun from the east raking between the pines in hard shafts and moving shadow bars, white-sand bounce lifting the faces.

cinematic.intent: Let the intruders arrive a beat too late, making the empty cabin itself the suspenseful subject.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide interior setup with front entrance, bed and rear exit all spatially readable.
cinematic.blocking: Front door screen left, cot along the left wall, rear door deep right. The men enter left; one goes to the cot; both end facing right toward the rear door. No one else is in the room and nothing new is placed.
cinematic.performance: Wary, impatient professionals a beat too late, not clowns. The warm sheet tells them how close they are, and it angers them. No ransacking, no drawn weapons.
cinematic.focus: Keep the room geography clear, with only enough footprint detail to explain their turn.
cinematic.texture: Rumpled empty bedding and disturbed sand are existing traces, not added weapons, photographs or hidden traps.
cinematic.sound_detail: Front door movement, bed fabric and their short line sit above the wind through the open exit.
cinematic.rhythm: A short entry and one decisive check of the bed; the prints turn them at once; the clip ends on movement toward the back, not a pause.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Các đạo cụ trên bàn và hiện trường giữ nguyên vị trí liên tục từ cú máy trước.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong căn chòi gỗ một gian trên đồi dương (D3 morning) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–2.5s): Hai gã lần lượt bước vào, mắt quét căn phòng một gian; gã đi đầu đi thẳng tới giường, hất tung tấm chăn. Nhịp 2 (2.5–5.5s): Bàn tay hắn ấn xuống tấm ga thấy còn ấm trong khi mắt gã kia hạ xuống những dấu giày dính cát trên sàn, và gã đầu quát lên điều chúng vừa thấy. Nhịp 3 (5.5–10.0s): Cả hai quay về phía cửa sau cuối phòng, gã thứ hai đã bước theo dấu giày, cửa trước còn đung đưa sau lưng chúng. Gã đi đầu nói ở nhịp 1–2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo · Đạo cụ khóa: Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người.

clips.start_frame: Pine slope behind the cabin in raking morning light: Sơn pressed against the far side of a thick pine trunk, bare hands ready; one pursuer stepping around the trunk toward him, his weapon hand leading; loose sand underfoot.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): As the pursuer rounds the trunk, Sơn catches the leading wrist in both hands and turns it away from both their faces, ordering him to drop it. Beat 2 (2.5–6.0s): He drives his hip in and takes the man's balance; the pursuer's feet go and he drops onto the sand, back sliding down the trunk, head clear of the bark, as Sơn demands where Dũng is holding Hạ. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): Sơn sinks to one knee at his side, both hands pinning the wrist to the sand at arm's length while the man strains and twists, and Sơn breathes hard through his teeth, holding him there; the handheld keeps to one side of the struggle.
clips.end_frame: Pursuer seated in the sand with his back against the pine trunk at center, straining; Sơn on one knee at his side, screen left, both hands pinning the man's outstretched weapon wrist to the sand at arm's length, away from both faces; both breathing hard; the open slope empty behind Sơn's back.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Bỏ cái đó xuống. Nói, Dũng giấu Hạ ở đâu?

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: low sun from the east raking between the pines in hard shafts and moving shadow bars, white-sand bounce lifting the faces.

cinematic.intent: Show Sơn choosing control over injury, while retaining the physical difficulty of stopping a pursuer.
cinematic.composition: The restrained handheld medium-wide keeps pine trunk, both bodies and the weapon hand readable together.
cinematic.blocking: Trunk at center; Sơn starts on its far side and ends kneeling screen left of the seated man. The weapon wrist travels from chest height down to the sand at screen left. Neither head touches the trunk.
cinematic.performance: Effort and restraint at once: he chooses control over injury and it costs him breath. The anger is in his voice, not his hands; the pursuer resists for real. No flourish, no strike, no satisfied look.
cinematic.focus: Hold the full defensive relation from one side, with no close-up describing a damaging joint technique.
cinematic.texture: Sand shifts under their feet and rough bark catches clothing, grounding weight without graphic injury.
cinematic.sound_detail: Short breaths, fabric tension and sand displacement replace exaggerated impact booms under his instruction.
cinematic.rhythm: Contact and the controlled drop happen in one short struggle; the hold that follows is long, effortful and alive, never a frozen pose.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Triền đồi cát trắng dưới rặng dương liễu (D3 morning) · Góc máy: Máy cầm tay linh hoạt (35mm Handheld) — tạo xung lực hành động và đối kháng. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–2.5s): Kẻ đuổi theo vừa vòng qua thân cây, Sơn chộp cổ tay đang cầm vũ khí bằng cả hai tay, bẻ hướng ra xa mặt cả hai, quát hắn bỏ xuống. Nhịp 2 (2.5–6.0s): Anh thúc hông, cướp trọng tâm; hắn hụt chân ngồi phịch xuống cát, lưng trượt dọc thân thông, đầu không chạm vỏ cây, Sơn gằn hỏi Dũng giấu Hạ ở đâu. Nhịp 3 (6.0–10.0s): Sơn quỳ một gối bên cạnh, hai tay ghì cổ tay hắn duỗi thẳng xuống cát trong khi hắn vặn người chống cự, Sơn thở dồn qua kẽ răng, giữ chặt; máy cầm tay đứng một phía trục. Sơn nói ở nhịp 1–2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Máy cầm tay linh hoạt (35mm Handheld) — tạo xung lực hành động và đối kháng · Đạo cụ khóa: Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): From the open slope behind Sơn's back, a second pursuer rushes in and lunges at him, a small capped Tê applicator in his fist. Beat 2 (2.5–5.5s): Sơn hears the sand hiss, releases one hand from the wrist and twists; his forearm knocks the lunging arm wide, and the overcommitted man pitches past him, as Sơn spits out what the device is. Beat 3 (5.5–10.0s): The second man sprawls into the sand beyond the trunk, the applicator flying from his grip and landing out of reach; Sơn, still on one knee, keeps one hand on the first man's wrist, eyes darting between the two, chest heaving; the handheld holds the same side.
clips.end_frame: Second man sprawled on hands and knees in the sand right of the trunk, the capped applicator lying out of his reach farther right; Sơn on one knee at left, one hand still pinning the first man's wrist, the other raised open; the first man seated against the trunk; all breathing hard.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Ống Tê! Tụi mày định đánh lén sau lưng hả?

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: low sun from the east raking between the pines in hard shafts and moving shadow bars, white-sand bounce lifting the faces.

cinematic.intent: Escalate from a controlled restraint to an unpredictable second threat, not a display of effortless mastery.
cinematic.composition: Preserve the same handheld setup, axis and existing body positions at the seam as the second man enters.
cinematic.blocking: Same axis as the previous shot: trunk center, Sơn screen left. The second man enters from behind Sơn on the left, is deflected and falls past to the right of the trunk; the applicator lands far right in the sand.
cinematic.performance: Surprise lives in his breath and shoulders; he is not a master, only quick enough. The second man overcommits out of eagerness. No slow-motion dodge, no smug delivery of the line.
cinematic.focus: Retain the preceding useful depth and whole-arm readability, without a new device-application close-up or rack.
cinematic.texture: Loose sand and suitless field-jacket fabric carry the abrupt loss of balance through ordinary materials.
cinematic.sound_detail: A scuff, strained exhale and small object landing should dominate; no supernatural pulse announces Tê.
cinematic.rhythm: The lunge breaks the held control abruptly, the deflection is a single motion, and the stumble and searching eyes fill the end without a second takedown.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần.

screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–2.5s): Từ con dốc trống sau lưng Sơn, kẻ đuổi thứ hai lao vào vồ tới, trong nắm tay là một ống Tê nhỏ có nắp. Nhịp 2 (2.5–5.5s): Nghe cát rít, Sơn buông một tay khỏi cổ tay gã kia, xoay người; cẳng tay anh gạt cánh tay đang lao tới văng ra, gã thứ hai lỡ đà chúi qua người anh, Sơn gằn giọng gọi đúng tên món đồ. Nhịp 3 (5.5–10.0s): Gã thứ hai sấp xuống cát phía bên kia thân cây, ống Tê văng khỏi tay rơi ra xa; Sơn vẫn quỳ một gối, một tay ghì cổ tay gã thứ nhất, mắt đảo giữa hai người, ngực phập phồng; máy cầm tay giữ nguyên phía trục. clips.start_frame: Under the pines: the second man lying motionless on his side in the sand, chest visibly rising and falling; the capped applicator a pace away; the first man seated, conscious, against the trunk; Sơn crouched between them, phone in his jacket.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Sơn kneels beside the motionless man and watches his chest until it lifts in a slow breath, his right hand already drawing the phone from his jacket. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): Phone at his ear, he turns his face down the slope toward the road and calls for a doctor, giving the place and that the man is still breathing. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Still on the line, he shifts his knee to keep himself between the first man and the dropped applicator, his free hand raised toward the seated man to keep him there, his eyes returning to the breathing chest.
clips.end_frame: Sơn kneeling beside the breathing man, phone at his ear, free hand raised toward the first man seated against the trunk; the capped applicator untouched in the sand a pace away; the fallen man's chest rising slowly; pine shadows moving over them.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Đồi dương, sau chòi gỗ. Có người dính thuốc của chính hắn, còn thở. Cần bác sĩ ngay.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: low sun from the east raking between the pines in hard shafts and moving shadow bars, white-sand bounce lifting the faces.

cinematic.intent: Make the decisive moral action a call for help after the opponent has become vulnerable.
cinematic.composition: The medium view includes Sơn kneeling, the fallen man's breathing torso and the conscious man kept separate.
cinematic.blocking: Fallen man in the lower foreground, Sơn kneeling at his head, the first man seated at the trunk screen right. Sơn stays between the seated man and the applicator; the phone goes from jacket to ear in his right hand.
cinematic.performance: Practical concern, not performed guilt: the man who hunted him is now a patient. Urgency sits in the clear voice and quick eyes; he wants help here and nobody else hurt. No admiring look at the result, no hero pose.
cinematic.focus: Keep Sơn's mouth and the breathing patient readable, without graphic medical inspection or instructional detail.
cinematic.texture: Sand clings to clothing and the pine shadows continue moving, preventing the fallen figure from reading as dead.
cinematic.sound_detail: His clear request is close above breath and wind; no pulse monitor or clinic equipment is heard here.
cinematic.rhythm: A real beat of watching for breath before he speaks, then a clear call, the end still watching the chest and the seated man; nothing settles into stillness.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

clips.start_frame: Pine tree line in morning sun: Mây and Thành arriving with a folded stretcher carried between them; Sơn kneeling by the breathing man in the sand, phone lowered; the first man seated against a trunk; cuffs at Mây's belt.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây and Thành come through the tree line with the stretcher; Sơn rises from beside the fallen man and steps back, empty hands open at his sides, as Mây tells him to keep them there. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Thành lowers the stretcher beside the breathing man; Mây moves between the two attackers, one hand on the cuffs at her belt, motioning the seated man to stay down, while Sơn answers that the patient goes to the clinic first and she will get the evidence. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây steps to the stretcher's side and looks to Sơn, who stays a few paces off in her full sightline, breath slowing, hands loose.
clips.end_frame: Mây standing by the stretcher at the breathing man's side, one hand on the cuffs at her belt, eyes on Sơn; Thành kneeling at the stretcher's head; the first man seated against the trunk; Sơn three paces off, empty hands at his sides, in her full sightline; pine shadows moving.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh Sơn, để tay yên đó. Anh ở lại đây, tôi cần nghe hết.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Đưa người này đi phòng khám trước. Bằng chứng tôi giao cô.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: low sun from the east raking between the pines in hard shafts and moving shadow bars, white-sand bounce lifting the faces.

cinematic.intent: End the action on Sơn accepting scrutiny, making cooperation a cost he consciously pays.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide tree-line view to connect stretcher arrival, the two attackers and Sơn's empty hands.
cinematic.blocking: Tree line on the left, the attackers center, Sơn right. Mây and Thành enter left with the stretcher; Sơn backs off to the right and stays visible. Mây ends between the stretcher and the seated man; the cuffs stay on her belt.
cinematic.performance: Mây is firm, not triumphant; she needs control first and his story after. Sơn obeys by choice and makes his one condition about the patient, not himself. No defiant stare, no glance toward the trees.
cinematic.focus: Hold the whole rescue arrangement clear, with no cut to a face that loses the patient positions.
cinematic.texture: Stretcher fabric, sand and field clothing stay practical; the morning sun does not become emergency-colored lighting.
cinematic.sound_detail: Approaching steps and stretcher handling merge with Mây's line, with the breathing thread ready for the clinic cut.
cinematic.rhythm: The arrival and his step back overlap, two short lines trade while the rescue work keeps moving, and he becomes still by choice as the clip ends, with no group tableau.

scenes.title: Phòng Khám
scenes.purpose: Bác sĩ xác định dấu hiệu Tê, Mây có vật chứng thay vì đoán bằng mặt.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Station radio fades into porch wind. Cut to Mây joining the waiting Sơn and placing her cuffs once.

clips.start_frame: Clinic ward at noon: the immobile attacker lies flat on the near steel bed with Linh at its head; the conscious attacker sits up on the far bed, Thành standing beside him with his folder; Mây at the near bed's foot, notebook open, pen ready.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Linh lays two fingers against the immobile man's neck and watches his chest rise and fall; Mây's pen waits above her page. Beat 2 (3.0–7.0s): Without lifting his eyes from the patient, Linh reports that the man breathes but cannot move yet and must stay watched; Mây writes the time in one short line, her jaw easing as the urge to question him passes. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): She answers that the questioning will wait and asks him to keep the man alive, lowering the notebook to her side; across the room Thành shifts half a step nearer the far bed, eyes on the conscious man.
clips.end_frame: Linh still at the near bedside, two fingers at the patient's neck, eyes on his slow breathing; Mây by the bed's foot, notebook lowered at her side; Thành half a step nearer the far bed, watching the conscious attacker sitting up there; the green curtain edge stirring.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Còn thở đều, nhưng cơ chưa nhúc nhích được. Đừng ai rời mắt khỏi hắn.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Vậy cháu chưa hỏi cung. Bác giữ mạng hắn giúp cháu.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: soft clinic window light from one side as key, neutral ceiling practicals as fill, green curtains tinting the shadows slightly.

cinematic.intent: Make care precede interrogation so the clinic scene changes the meaning of the preceding violence.
cinematic.composition: The wide view distinguishes two beds, Linh at the immobile man and Thành watching the conscious one.
cinematic.blocking: Near bed screen left with Linh at its head and Mây at its foot; far bed screen right with Thành at its side. Mây holds the notebook in her left hand, pen in her right; the aisle between beds stays clear.
cinematic.performance: Linh is practiced calm, facts without comfort. Mây arrives wanting answers, then swallows the urge and lets patience show as stillness; she wants Linh to keep her witness alive. No hovering, no dramatic relief.
cinematic.focus: Keep both patient positions and the observing people legible, without an invented monitor display or intrusive medical close-up.
cinematic.texture: Green curtain folds and worn steel beds give the room lived-in restraint, not a glossy emergency ward.
cinematic.sound_detail: Continue the breathing thread from the dune into quiet ventilation and Linh's measured voice.
cinematic.rhythm: A quiet check carries the opening, the doctor's line lands while care continues, Mây's shorter answer comes late; the final seconds hold watchful stillness across both beds instead of a verdict.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset. Bác sĩ Linh wears his worn white medical coat with stethoscope around his neck, keeping his canvas emergency medical bag and breathing-support kit at hand.

clips.start_frame: A steel tray on the clinic counter: the seized applicator sealed in clear evidence wrap, its unusual cap turned up; Linh's hand beside it holding a small worn case photograph face down; Mây's fingertips resting on the tray's far rim.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Linh turns the case photograph face up and lays it beside the sealed applicator, sliding it until the photographed cap sits level with the real one. Beat 2 (2.5–7.0s): His forefinger traces the ridged cap in the photo, then hovers over the wrapped device without touching the seal, moving between the two shapes as his voice, off frame, places the earlier case he once examined. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): The finger stops in the gap between the two caps and lifts away; his hand settles flat on the tray edge, and Mây's fingertips stay still on the far rim, neither of them touching the device.
clips.end_frame: Sealed applicator and the small case photograph side by side on the steel tray, the two cap shapes matching in line; Linh's hand flat on the near tray edge, Mây's fingertips on the far rim; the seal unbroken, window light shifting faintly across the plastic wrap.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Loại Tê này tôi gặp rồi. Cùng kiểu nắp khóa, vụ bắt cóc đường thủy năm ngoái.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: soft clinic window light from one side as key, neutral ceiling practicals as fill, green curtains tinting the shadows slightly.

cinematic.intent: Make recognition of Tê depend on a remembered physical match, not instant laboratory omniscience.
cinematic.composition: Use the locked detail setup to show sealed device, reference photograph and comparing hand together.
cinematic.blocking: Tray centered on a steel counter away from the beds; the photograph lies right of the applicator, caps aligned. Linh's right hand works the photo; Mây's left fingertips stay on the far rim.
cinematic.performance: Linh's recognition is cautious, a memory being checked rather than a verdict: his finger slows at the cap and does not linger. Mây keeps her hand still to let him work. No triumphant tap, no lab theatrics.
cinematic.focus: Keep the two relevant shapes in one clear plane, the patient outside this object-comparison frame.
cinematic.texture: Transparent evidence wrapping slightly dulls the device surface, distinguishing a secured exhibit from something ready to use.
cinematic.sound_detail: A tray touch and photograph scrape sit under the off-screen line; no microscope, scanner or chemical reaction is introduced.
cinematic.rhythm: The photo goes down at once, the comparison fills the middle with the line riding over it, and the last seconds hold two matching shapes beside a sealed, untouched device.

clips.start_frame: Beside the closed green treatment curtain: Mây facing Linh an arm's length away, notebook open in her left hand with a time estimate jotted on the page, pen in her right; Linh facing her, stethoscope at his neck, medical bag closed at his feet.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Mây tilts the open notebook toward Linh and taps her pen beside the time she has written; Linh glances at it and his mouth tightens. Beat 2 (2.5–7.0s): He tells her the drug only holds a person still and that waking depends on the body, so no one can promise a minute, his open hand turning down in a small tired gesture; Mây listens, pen motionless above the page. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): She draws one firm line through her estimate and answers with what the gang must be using it for, lifting her eyes back to Linh as the curtain beside them sways in the ventilation draft.
clips.end_frame: Mây beside the curtain, notebook open with the estimate struck through by a single line, pen resting on the page, eyes on Linh; Linh facing her, hands loose at his coat pockets; the curtain hem still swaying in the draft.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Nó chỉ giữ người ta bất động. Tỉnh lúc nào tùy người, đừng tin ai hẹn đúng phút.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Vậy chúng dùng nó đưa con tin lên tàu.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: soft clinic window light from one side as key, neutral ceiling practicals as fill, green curtains tinting the shadows slightly.

cinematic.intent: Protect future suspense by refusing an exact recovery clock while keeping the doctor useful.
cinematic.composition: Frame Mây and Linh beside the closed curtain, with her note-taking hand visible in the medium shot.
cinematic.blocking: Two-shot beside the closed curtain: Linh screen left, Mây screen right, an arm's length apart. Notebook in Mây's left hand, pen in her right; Linh's medical bag stays closed at his feet.
cinematic.performance: Linh speaks from weary experience, not a lecture; he wants her to stop counting minutes. Mây accepts the limit, then turns it into purpose. No raised finger, no medical demonstration, no grim frown.
cinematic.focus: Keep their faces at the same readable depth; the crossed-out note remains a shape rather than an exposed medical number.
cinematic.texture: The green curtain shifts gently beside them while steady practical light keeps skin tones neutral.
cinematic.sound_detail: His measured voice sits over the ordinary clinic bed; do not add a countdown or rising pulse effect.
cinematic.rhythm: The glance at her note opens the exchange, the warning gets room to land, and the decision comes at the end with her single crossing-out stroke and short reply.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Bác sĩ Linh wears his worn white medical coat with stethoscope around his neck, keeping his canvas emergency medical bag and breathing-support kit at hand.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Bác sĩ Linh khoác áo blouse trắng sờn vai, cổ đeo ống nghe y tế, tay xách túi cấp cứu vải bố có sẵn bình trợ thở.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Phòng khám đa khoa thị trấn Hòn Sóng (D3 noon) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, MED_BAG).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–2.5s): Mây nghiêng cuốn sổ về phía Linh, gõ bút cạnh mốc giờ cô đã ghi; Linh liếc qua, khóe miệng mím lại. Nhịp 2 (2.5–7.0s): Linh giải thích thuốc chỉ làm người ta bất động, tỉnh lúc nào tùy cơ thể, không ai hứa được phút nào, bàn tay ngửa ra rồi úp xuống mệt mỏi; Mây lắng nghe, ngòi bút đứng yên. Nhịp 3 (7.0–10.0s): Mây gạch một nét dứt khoát lên mốc giờ dự đoán, nói ra mục đích bọn chúng dùng thuốc, ngẩng lên nhìn Linh; tấm rèm bên cạnh lay nhẹ trong luồng gió máy. Linh nói ở nhịp 2, Mây đáp ở nhịp 3.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, MED_BAG) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: DUTY_POUCH, MED_BAG.

clips.start_frame: Far bed by the window: the conscious attacker sitting on its edge, Thành standing at his shoulder with folder and pen; Mây at the bed's foot holding a sealed evidence bag low in her right hand, the shipping emblem visible through the plastic.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây raises the sealed bag to the seated man's eyeline, emblem facing him, and tells him to look at it, her left hand resting on her duty pouch. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She asks him plainly who sent the two of them up the pine hill with the drug to find Sơn; his eyes catch on the emblem, his breath stops short and his mouth presses into a hard line. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He turns his face to the wall and stays silent; Mây keeps the bag where it is, unhurried, while Thành writes one short line in his folder without taking his eyes off the man.
clips.end_frame: The conscious attacker on the bed edge, face turned to the wall, mouth shut tight; Mây at the bed's foot with the sealed bag still raised near his eyeline; Thành at his shoulder, pen on the folder page, watching his profile; window light on the crumpled sheet.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh nhìn biểu tượng công ty này đi. Ai sai tụi anh mang Tê lên đồi dương tìm Sơn?

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: soft clinic window light from one side as key, neutral ceiling practicals as fill, green curtains tinting the shadows slightly.

cinematic.intent: Let a suspect's silence become evidence of recognition without pretending it is a full confession.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium framing to retain Mây's speaking face, Thành and the conscious attacker within supervised space.
cinematic.blocking: Bed screen right, the man seated on its edge facing screen left; Mây at the foot, screen left, an arm's reach away; Thành standing behind the man's right shoulder. Bag in Mây's right hand, folder and pen with Thành.
cinematic.performance: Mây asks without threat, wanting a reaction more than a confession, and reads his silence as an answer. The man hides recognition behind a tightened mouth. Thành stays quiet and exact. No villain smirk, no slammed hands.
cinematic.focus: Keep the questioner and the turning face readable, with the emblem secondary and never legibly lettered.
cinematic.texture: The sealed bag catches plain window light; sheets remain disturbed from treatment, not staged like an interrogation set.
cinematic.sound_detail: A slight wrapping rustle leads into the question, after which the man's withheld answer is allowed to be silent.
cinematic.rhythm: The bag comes up at once, the question is short, and the silence after it is the payoff; the last seconds belong to the turned face and Thành's pen.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây nâng túi vật chứng niêm phong lên ngang tầm mắt gã đang ngồi, mặt có biểu tượng quay về phía hắn, bảo hắn nhìn cho kỹ. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Cô hỏi thẳng ai sai bọn chúng mang thuốc lên đồi dương tìm Sơn; mắt gã vướng vào biểu tượng, hơi thở khựng lại, môi mím chặt. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Gã quay mặt vào tường, im bặt; Mây vẫn giữ túi ở đó, không vội, Thành ghi một dòng ngắn vào bìa hồ sơ, mắt không rời gã. Mây nói ở nhịp 1–2, gã không trả lời.

clips.start_frame: Mây standing near the far bed, face turned toward the off-screen attacker, her thin investigation folder open and held low at her waist in both hands; lips closed, eyes steady.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây listens toward the bed without moving as the conscious man's weak voice comes from off frame; her eyes sharpen at the nickname, but she does not interrupt. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): She lets him finish, lips closed, her gaze drifting a fraction past him as Dũng's name and the order to take Bóng Ma alive sink in; a slow breath lifts her shoulders. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Only then does she close the folder with one firm press and draw it flat against her chest, her face narrowing into a decision, eyes coming back to the man.
clips.end_frame: Mây with the closed folder pressed flat against her chest under both hands, eyes back on the off-screen man, face set and quiet; a strand of her white-streaked hair stirring in the ventilation draft.

dialogue.speaker: EXTRA
dialogue.text: Thằng Bóng Ma cuỗm cuốn sổ đen. Đại ca Dũng biểu bắt sống, đem về thành phố trước ngày tàu chạy.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: soft clinic window light from one side as key, neutral ceiling practicals as fill, green curtains tinting the shadows slightly.

cinematic.intent: Let an off-screen slip of the nickname redirect Mây toward the person with the ledger.
cinematic.composition: The close-up stays on Mây listening, folder held low enough that its closure is visible.
cinematic.blocking: Mây stands at the foot of the off-screen bed, body angled screen left toward the suspect. The folder starts low in both hands and ends flat against her chest. No one else enters the frame.
cinematic.performance: She hides how much the slip matters, keeping her listening neutral so he keeps talking. Inside, suspicion of Sơn becomes a plan to find him. She never mouths his words. No gasp, no widened eyes.
cinematic.focus: Hold the existing close-up plane on her eyes and speaking-rest mouth, with no reaction insert of the suspect.
cinematic.texture: Plain folder paper and her sun-lined face remain unadorned under the clinic's ordinary light.
cinematic.sound_detail: The suspect's off-screen voice is weak but intelligible, then a single folder closure settles the information.
cinematic.rhythm: The off-screen voice owns the first half, a held listening breath follows, and the folder closure lands late as the decision, leaving her settled gaze to finish the clip.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt.

clips.start_frame: Noon at the police post: Thành seated at the public desk with the support radio handset in his right hand, his folder open; Mây just inside the doorway, her closed investigation folder under her left arm.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.5s): Mây crosses to the desk and, standing over Thành, tells him to keep the two men at the clinic and the drug under guard, to ask the district for a team, and that she is going up the hill to meet Bóng Ma. Beat 2 (4.5–7.0s): Thành presses the call key and listens; a short crackle answers, and he ticks a line on his page with a small nod. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): He tells Mây the district has it and asks her to be careful; she gives a short nod, turns with the folder under her arm and walks out the door toward the hill.
clips.end_frame: Mây passing out through the open doorway into the noon light, folder under her left arm, heading uphill; Thành at the desk with the radio handset lowered, pen on his page, watching her go; the ceiling fan turning above him.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Giữ hai người bên phòng khám với ống Tê. Xin huyện một tổ. Chị lên đồi gặp Bóng Ma.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Dạ, huyện nhận rồi. Chị đi cẩn thận.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon at the station: daylight through the front windows as soft side key, neutral ceiling practicals as fill, slow ceiling-fan shadows.

cinematic.intent: Show that seeking Sơn does not mean abandoning the people and evidence already in custody.
cinematic.composition: Frame Mây, Thành, support radio and the departing route in the same medium station setup.
cinematic.blocking: Desk center frame with Thành seated behind it; Mây enters from the door at screen right, stops at the desk's near corner, then exits the same way. Folder under her left arm; radio handset in Thành's right hand.
cinematic.performance: Mây's authority is workmanlike, custody first and herself second, with impatience to reach Sơn underneath. Thành is competent and calm, wanting her to trust the town to him. No anxious hovering, no salute.
cinematic.focus: Keep her mouth and Thành's radio hand readable, without cutting to an unseen superior or adding another officer portrait.
cinematic.texture: Daylight across the desk and used folder edges retain continuity with this modest station's earlier checks.
cinematic.sound_detail: A quiet radio confirmation follows her assignment, never competing as a second full spoken exchange.
cinematic.rhythm: Instructions fill the opening, the radio exchange passes without words in the middle, and the clip ends on her exit already in motion, the delegation completed before she leaves.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Mây có thể tin điều nào giữa lời đồn Bóng Ma và người còn thở?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Một nghi ngờ về thuốc thành vật chứng, một biệt danh thành người giữ sổ.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Chưa hỏi cung vội khi một bệnh nhân vẫn bất động.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Linh loại bỏ giờ tỉnh chính xác, Mây tách quan sát khỏi kết luận và giữ chứng cứ.

scenes.title: Còng Và Bằng Chứng
scenes.purpose: Sơn đưa bằng chứng kiểm chứng được, Mây nhận ra Hạ qua ảnh rời.
scenes.outgoing_audio: A ferry horn enters while Mây waits for an answer. Cut to Hạ alive at the city pier, not to a second photo reveal.

clips.start_frame: Porch in late afternoon sun: two tea glasses on the table, Sơn already seated on one stool, hands flat beside his glass, his closed backpack at his elbow; Mây standing by the empty stool opposite, folder and notebook in her left hand, cuffs at her belt.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Mây pulls the empty stool out and sits opposite Sơn, laying the folder down at her right with the notebook on top. Beat 2 (2.5–6.0s): She unclips the cuffs from her belt and sets them on the wood beside the notebook, between the two glasses, with a small dull knock, telling him the choice is his; Sơn's eyes drop to the steel and come back to her face. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): She asks whether he is the one Dũng's people call Bóng Ma; he admits it in a few words, hands flat, and neither of them reaches for the cuffs or the tea, its thin steam bending in the sea wind.
clips.end_frame: Sơn and Mây seated opposite each other at the porch table, the steel cuffs lying between the two tea glasses beside her notebook and folder, his closed backpack at his elbow; all four hands resting away from the cuffs, eyes level on each other; thin tea steam bending in the wind.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Còng để đây, anh tự chọn. Anh là người bọn Dũng gọi là Bóng Ma?

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Phải. Cái tên đó tôi muốn bỏ.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon: low sun from the west skimming across the porch table and faces from the side, soft cool fill from the sea, long warm shadows.

cinematic.intent: Make the negotiation's moral boundary visible before either person asks for trust.
cinematic.composition: The medium table setup holds two tea glasses and space where Mây's cuffs enter between them.
cinematic.blocking: Table across the frame: Sơn on the far stool facing camera, Mây on the near stool in three-quarter back. Folder and notebook at her right hand; the cuffs sit center, between the glasses, an equal reach from both.
cinematic.performance: Mây sets terms before trust, direct but not provocative, watching whether he flinches. Sơn hides nothing in his posture and owns the name as a weight, not a boast. No smug half-smile, no staring contest.
cinematic.focus: Keep their faces and the object boundary at readable shared depth, with no need for a separate symbolic insert.
cinematic.texture: The cuffs' dull metal and tea-glass warmth coexist on weathered porch wood under the same late sun.
cinematic.sound_detail: The modest cuff contact should be clear but not amplified like a weapon being cocked.
cinematic.rhythm: Sitting down is quick, the cuffs land as the first real beat, the question and short answer share the second half, and the final second leaves the untouched cuffs to speak.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands. Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần. Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Hiên gỗ hướng biển phía nam căn chòi (D3 afternoon) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CUFFS).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–2.5s): Mây kéo ghế ngồi đối diện Sơn, đặt bìa hồ sơ bên tay phải, cuốn sổ nằm trên. Nhịp 2 (2.5–6.0s): Cô tháo còng ở thắt lưng, đặt xuống mặt gỗ giữa hai ly trà, một tiếng cạch khẽ, bảo anh tự chọn; mắt Sơn nhìn xuống chiếc còng rồi trở lại gương mặt cô. clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon: low sun from the west skimming across the porch table and faces from the side, soft cool fill from the sea, long warm shadows.

cinematic.intent: Let Sơn offer something independently checkable, shifting from evasion toward responsibility.
cinematic.composition: The detail shot keeps his bag, Mây's folder and the arriving ledger and USB physically separate.
cinematic.blocking: Backpack screen left near Sơn, folder screen right near Mây; ledger and drive land in the middle third, closer to her. Sơn uses both bare hands, then withdraws them to the left edge.

cinematic.texture: Canvas, worn leather and evidence-folder paper have distinct surfaces that preserve each object's origin.
cinematic.sound_detail: Two restrained set-down sounds precede his low line; porch wind continues without a revelation sting.
cinematic.rhythm: The bag opens quickly, the two set-downs are distinct and unhurried, and the line arrives over empty hands, ending on the gap between his fingers and the evidence.

dialogue.text: Khớp công ty trong báo cáo xe. Trang này tôi chụp lại, báo lên trên.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon: low sun from the west skimming across the porch table and faces from the side, soft cool fill from the sea, long warm shadows.

cinematic.blocking: Ledger open in front of Mây with the report on its right; Sơn across the table at screen left, hands flat. Phone in Mây's right hand above the page; her left hand pins the report.
cinematic.performance: Mây allows herself one small professional satisfaction and keeps it procedural; she wants the fact on record before anything personal. Sơn neither charms nor hurries her. No smile of triumph, no leaning in.
cinematic.focus: Keep face and page area readable, no legible company name required, and keep the phone screen secondary.
cinematic.texture: Late light across paper grain and the black cover contrasts with the cooler shade under her arm.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft phone shutter may follow the actual photograph, while her voice remains the clearest sound.
cinematic.rhythm: Searching takes the opening, the match lands in the middle on a held breath, and the photograph with her short line closes the clip, phone still raised.

dialogue.text: Người đó là ai mà anh liều tới đây?

cinematic.texture: The open bag no longer shields the book, creating a subtle material difference from earlier concealment.

cinematic.performance: Recognition arrives through her fingers before her voice: a firming grip, a held breath. Sơn gives the photo away without watching her, bracing for it. Quiet, not a shout. No dramatic snatch, no trembling.
cinematic.focus: Keep the printed face and holding fingertips at one plane, never spawning Hạ physically beside the table.
cinematic.texture: The portrait's worn white border and matte surface distinguish it from a glowing phone or watch interior.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper drag stops abruptly enough to register, then the short name lands against continuous sea wind.
cinematic.rhythm: The slide is slow and even, the stop is sudden enough to register, the breath after it is held, and the name comes late and soft.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Hạ đang ở đâu, anh Sơn? Kể tôi nghe từ đầu.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon: low sun from the west skimming across the porch table and faces from the side, soft cool fill from the sea, long warm shadows.

cinematic.intent: Turn professional cooperation into personal accountability without letting either person escape the moment.

cinematic.performance: Under the professional question is a friend's hurt and fear; she wants the truth more than an apology. Sơn knows silence would be cowardice and refuses to look away. No tears, no trembling lip.
cinematic.focus: Keep Mây's eyes and mouth clear, with no sudden rack to the portrait or a second close-up of Sơn.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Đường Về
scenes.purpose: Hạ gieo kiến thức hải đăng và mục tiêu mở sạp hoa.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Retain the city ferry horn briefly over the coastal lighthouse entrance, then change to local wind.

clips.start_frame: City pier at dusk: Hạ and Sơn walking side by side along the wide walkway from screen right to left, the glass-paneled rail and river behind them; warm pier lamps lit; a ferry light small and far out on the water.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): They walk at an easy evening pace, the ends of Hạ's scarf lifting in the breeze, Sơn's gloved hands loose at his sides. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Hạ's eyes catch the distant ferry light and she stops at the rail, turning to the water with both hands on it, and names her home town with a warmth that softens her whole face. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn stops a step late because she did and turns to the rail beside her; his gaze leaves the ferry and settles on her profile as he answers with a short remark about the light in her eyes.
clips.end_frame: Hạ and Sơn side by side at the pier rail, facing the water; her hands on the rail, his gloved hands at his sides, his face turned to her profile; the ferry light small and drifting far out on the river; warm lamps along the walkway behind them.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Thấy đèn phà là em nhớ Hòn Sóng. Nhà em ở đó.

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.text: Nhắc tới quê là mắt em sáng lên.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening on the city pier: last daylight over the river as soft backlight, warm pier lamps as side key on faces; no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ introduce her own home as a desired future, not simply information Sơn will later use.
cinematic.composition: The wide pier view gives both walkers and the distant ferry one shared direction across open water.
cinematic.blocking: The walkway runs across the frame; they enter mid-right walking left and stop just left of center at the rail, Hạ ending screen left of Sơn. No bags or props; his gloves stay on.
cinematic.performance: Hạ is warm and a little shy about home, wanting him to see it as a real place. Sơn's attention moves from the ferry to her face, surprised by his own interest. No romantic posing, no lingering stare.
cinematic.focus: Keep the two figures and ferry light readable at wide depth without a separate scenic insert.
cinematic.texture: Warm pier lamps meet the last daylight, leaving ordinary rail wear and water movement visible.
cinematic.sound_detail: A low ferry horn stays distant enough to support, not overwhelm, her simple naming of home.
cinematic.rhythm: Walking settles the first seconds, the stop and the name share the middle, and the end lingers on his turned gaze while the ferry keeps moving far out.

clips.start_frame: Hạ at the pier rail beside a fogged glass wind panel, right forefinger resting at the top of a rough round tower she has drawn in the condensation; Sơn at her side, gloved hands clasped in front of him, eyes on the drawing.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Hạ's fingertip draws a ring around the top of the tower for the lamp gallery, the moisture smearing under it. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): Telling him her father kept this lighthouse, she moves her finger just below the ring and draws a small square hatch, a little amused at her own precision; Sơn follows the finger. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Finishing that she has known every door since childhood, she leaves her fingertip on the hatch and turns her face half toward Sơn with a small smile; he looks from the sketch to her.
clips.end_frame: Hạ's fingertip resting on the small square hatch below the gallery ring of the misted tower sketch, her face turned half toward Sơn with a small smile; Sơn beside her, gloved hands clasped, eyes on her face; beads of moisture running at the sketch's edges.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Ba em giữ ngọn hải đăng này. Từ nhỏ em thuộc từng cửa, cả cửa kỹ thuật dưới hành lang.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening on the city pier: last daylight over the river as soft backlight, warm pier lamps as side key on faces; no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Make knowledge of the lighthouse arise from a child's familiarity with a parent's work.
cinematic.composition: The medium composition keeps Hạ's face and the existing misted glass panel within the same reach.
cinematic.blocking: Glass panel screen left, Hạ in front of it at center-left, Sơn at screen right half a step back. Her right forefinger draws while her left hand rests on the rail; his gloved hands stay clasped.
cinematic.performance: Hạ's ease is affectionate, a daughter proud of a small inherited expertise; she wants to share it, not brief him. Sơn listens with quiet respect and no tactical interest. No mysterious glance, no clue emphasis.
cinematic.focus: Keep the finger sketch and faces within useful medium depth, never changing to a revealing macro map.
cinematic.texture: Moisture smears under her fingertip, making the rough little hatch imperfect and temporary rather than diagrammatically precise.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft fingertip drag and open-air water bed support her voice, with no ominous clue emphasis.
cinematic.rhythm: Drawing and speech run together: the ring, then the hatch carrying the sentence, and the last seconds rest on her look to him rather than more lines on the glass.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Hạ lifts her fingertip from the glass, slips a small old photograph from her apron pocket and holds it up between them beside the sketch. Beat 2 (2.5–7.0s): Tapping the photographed tower, she tells him how as a child she ran after her father to pull the backup lamp lever below the last landing whenever the power cut, her voice light with memory. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Sơn leans in and asks whether her house looks out on the sea; she slides her fingertip from the tower down to the roofs along the shore and holds it there, eyes on him.
clips.end_frame: The small old lighthouse photograph held up between them in Hạ's left hand, her right fingertip on the shoreline roofs; Sơn leaning in, gloved hands clasped, eyes on the photo; the misted tower-and-hatch sketch still visible on the glass behind it.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Hồi nhỏ cúp điện là em chạy theo ba gạt đèn dự phòng dưới chiếu nghỉ cuối.

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.text: Nhà em nhìn ra biển hả?

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening on the city pier: last daylight over the river as soft backlight, warm pier lamps as side key on faces; no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Give the memory a real family object while keeping the future rescue knowledge secondary to intimacy.
cinematic.composition: Hold the exact medium setup and established glass-panel relation as the existing photograph enters the shared plane.
cinematic.blocking: The photo is held at chest height between them, just right of the glass sketch so both read together. Photo in Hạ's left hand, her right forefinger pointing; Sơn leans in from screen right without touching it.
cinematic.performance: Hạ remembers rather than foreshadows; the lever was a childhood game to her. Sơn's question shows him starting to picture her life, not a route. No ominous pause, no lingering on the hatch.
cinematic.focus: Retain the prior depth and face readability, letting the photo stay recognizable without a new sharp foreground rack.
cinematic.texture: The small photograph has worn edges and muted color, unlike the wet temporary finger sketch behind it.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper handling is slight beneath her line; the ferry and water remain at the same distance as before.
cinematic.rhythm: The photo enters quickly, the memory gets the long middle, and his short question with her answering gesture closes the clip, leaving her wish for the next one.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Hạ lowers the photograph and slides it back into her apron pocket beside the shears. Beat 2 (2.5–7.5s): She rests both empty hands on the rail, faces the water toward home and says out loud the life she wants, a small pleased smile growing as she describes the flower stall by the fish market. Beat 3 (7.5–10.0s): The words finished, she turns her head to Sơn; he meets her look and sets his gloved hand on the rail a hand's width from hers, not touching, while the breeze lifts her scarf end.
clips.end_frame: Hạ's empty hands resting on the rail, her face turned to Sơn with a small smile; Sơn beside her, gloved right hand on the rail a hand's width from hers, meeting her look; her loose scarf end stirring in the river breeze; the sketch fading on the glass.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Em để dành đủ vốn là về mở sạp hoa nhỏ, ngay đầu chợ cá. Sống cạnh biển thôi.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening on the city pier: last daylight over the river as soft backlight, warm pier lamps as side key on faces; no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ name a life she wants for herself, giving her more than a role as Sơn's escape fantasy.
cinematic.composition: Keep the same medium composition and focus plane while the photograph is put away within existing reach.
cinematic.blocking: Same rail positions, Hạ center-left and Sơn screen right. The photo goes into her apron's front pocket; both her hands then rest on the rail. Sơn's gloved right hand comes to the rail beside hers.
cinematic.performance: Hạ's wish is modest and practical, and saying it aloud gives her quiet pleasure; she wants him to picture himself in it. Sơn is moved and hides it in stillness. No sentimental swell, no hand-holding.
cinematic.focus: Maintain the same readable faces and hands, without a scenic cutaway illustrating a shop that does not yet exist.
cinematic.texture: Her pale scarf and worn rail catch soft light; the open hands replace the earlier information-bearing photo.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her sentence stays close against ordinary harbour sound, avoiding a sentimental swell that turns the wish into a prophecy.
cinematic.rhythm: The photo is put away quickly, the wish gets the longest stretch, and the clip ends on the turn of her head and his answering hand, without a word from him.

clips.start_frame: Hạ at the pier rail, her pale-blue silk scarf loose at her neck with one long end free over her shoulder; Sơn close at her side in his black suit, gloved hand near her shoulder.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): A gust lifts the free end of the scarf off her shoulder and out over the rail toward the dark water; Sơn's gloved hand closes on it in mid-air. Beat 2 (2.5–6.0s): He draws the silk back and lays it in her open hand, letting go straight away; she closes her fingers around it and thanks him softly, a breath of relief in her laugh. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): Sơn tells her to wrap it tighter against the cold night wind; she holds the end against her collarbone and looks up at him as his hand lowers to his side.
clips.end_frame: Hạ holding the caught scarf end against her collarbone, eyes on Sơn; Sơn's gloved hand lowering to his side; the silk stirring between her fingers in the river wind; warm lamp light on her face.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Cảm ơn anh. Suýt nữa gió lấy mất rồi.

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.text: Quấn lại đi. Gió sông về đêm lạnh lắm.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening on the city pier: last daylight over the river as soft backlight, warm pier lamps as side key on faces; no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: Make a small protective reflex intimate without confusing it with ownership of the scarf.
cinematic.composition: The close-up holds Hạ's face, the loose scarf end and Sơn's gloved hand within one plausible reach.
cinematic.blocking: Hạ center frame with rail and water behind her shoulder; Sơn's gloved right hand enters from screen right, catches the end above the rail, returns it to her left hand, then drops out low.
cinematic.performance: Sơn's reflex is protective, but he does not hold on; giving the silk back fast is the tenderness. Hạ is touched, not helpless, and her look thanks him more than the words. No lingering touch, no gasp.
cinematic.focus: Keep the caught fabric and faces at useful close-up depth, never making the water an impossible sharp insert.
cinematic.texture: Blue silk moves lightly against black glove, its intact edge clear before the later torn-fragment scenes.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use fabric movement over the steady pier wind, not a splash or dramatic catch sound that did not occur.
cinematic.rhythm: The catch is the quick start, the handback and thanks come unforced, and the second half is the quiet after he lets go, his short warning landing softly.

clips.start_frame: City pier at dusk: Hạ and Sơn standing side by side at the glass-paneled rail, facing the water; a ferry far out on the river; the walkway open behind them, warm lamps lit.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): As a ferry horn sounds across the water, Hạ pushes off the rail and starts walking back along the walkway, left to right. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Sơn stays a breath longer, head turning toward the ferry, then turns away from it and follows her, asking as he catches up whether her friend Mây still keeps a spot for her by the fish market. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Hạ answers over her shoulder, inviting him to come home with her when his work is done; he falls into step beside her, matching her pace, the open water behind them.
clips.end_frame: Hạ and Sơn walking side by side left to right along the pier walkway, mid-stride, his pace matched to hers; the rail and open dusk water behind them, the ferry small and far off; warm lamps along the walkway.

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.text: Bạn em, Mây, còn giữ chỗ cạnh chợ cá cho em không?

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Còn. Xong việc thì anh về cùng em.

clips.lighting: Recent-past evening on the city pier: last daylight over the river as soft backlight, warm pier lamps as side key on faces; no hard neon.

cinematic.intent: End the memory on Sơn following a person's chosen direction instead of the working route in front of him.
cinematic.composition: The wide pier setup keeps the rail, ferry direction and their left-to-right walking path easy to read.
cinematic.blocking: The rail runs across the background; they start center at the rail facing away, then walk screen left to right along the walkway. Hạ leads by two steps; Sơn closes the gap and ends on her near side.
cinematic.performance: Sơn's question carries a tentative, almost shy hope of belonging. Hạ's reply is easy and certain; she wants him to choose it. His hesitation is brief; the choice is the point. No grand romantic turn, no farewell pose.
cinematic.focus: Keep both moving figures in the established wide depth, preserving departure direction without an extra face insert.
cinematic.texture: Water remains open behind them as their bodies leave the rail, warm pier lamps staying consistent.
cinematic.sound_detail: The ferry horn begins at its real distance and can carry the edit, while footsteps remain light and ordinary.
cinematic.rhythm: Her departure opens the clip, his hesitation takes less time than his choice, and the clip ends on shared forward walking rather than another look back.
