scenes.title: Hải Đăng Và Một Câu Hỏi
scenes.purpose: Mây tìm chứng cứ sống và kiểm tra lối kỹ thuật trước cao trào.
scenes.outgoing_audio: The clipped service key settles, incoming station fan introduces the USB desk. Do not replay the backup-lamp test.

clips.start_frame: Lighthouse base in late afternoon: Mây at the closed lower iron door, her key in the lock under her right hand; Sơn two paces behind her on the path, hands empty; sea grass bending in the wind.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây turns the key, shoulders the heavy iron door inward with a grinding scrape and steps over the threshold; Sơn follows her in. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): At the foot of the spiral stair she stops and tips her head toward the narrow maintenance stair opening beside it, telling him Hạ grew up here and knows every hidden corner of the tower; Sơn's eyes follow the route. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây puts her hand on the rail and starts up the first steps as Sơn answers that Hạ once drew that north service way for him; he takes a last look at the opening and climbs after her.
clips.end_frame: Main iron door standing open behind them, late light spilling across the floor; Mây four steps up the spiral stair, hand on the rail; Sơn at the stair's foot, one boot on the first step, the narrow maintenance stair opening visible beside him.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Hạ lớn lên ở đây. Chỗ nào kín quanh tháp, nó đều biết.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Cô ấy từng vẽ cho tôi lối kỹ thuật phía bắc.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon at the sea cliff: fading sun from the west as warm side key, cool sky fill, cold shade inside the tower; the lamp lights only during its deliberate test.

cinematic.intent: Make returning to Hạ's real place shift the investigation from stories to physical geography.
cinematic.composition: The wide entrance view connects main door, first stair section and visible service route in one understandable arrangement.
cinematic.blocking: Door screen right, spiral stair center, the separate maintenance stair opening screen left of the stair base. Mây leads through the door and up; Sơn follows two paces behind. The key stays in Mây's right hand.
cinematic.performance: Mây moves with local familiarity, not as a guide; mentioning Hạ matter-of-factly hides her worry. Sơn is attentive and careful, recognizing what Hạ once described without claiming it. No nostalgia, no awe at the tower.
cinematic.focus: Keep both bodies and door relationships legible, without compressing the route into disconnected architectural inserts.
cinematic.texture: Rusted paint, worn stair edges and sea-blown grass mark a used public building, not a mystical ruin.
cinematic.sound_detail: Key and iron latch introduce the local wind; the sentence stays practical above the threshold sound.
cinematic.rhythm: The door opens at once, the pause at the stair foot carries her line, and his answer rides the start of the climb so the clip ends already moving upward.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands. Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần. Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Cổng vòm sắt chính dưới chân ngọn hải đăng cổ (D3 late afternoon) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH).

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Tới chân cầu thang xoắn, cô dừng, hất đầu về phía lối cầu thang kỹ thuật hẹp bên cạnh, nói Hạ lớn lên ở đây, thuộc từng chỗ kín; mắt Sơn dõi theo lối đi. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây đặt tay lên lan can bước lên mấy bậc đầu, Sơn đáp rằng Hạ từng vẽ lối kỹ thuật phía bắc cho anh; anh nhìn lối ấy lần cuối rồi bước lên theo. Mây nói ở nhịp 2, Sơn đáp ở nhịp 3.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: Lighthouse gallery in late afternoon: Mây and Sơn at the rail a pace apart, both facing the harbour houses below, Mây screen left, Sơn screen right, hands on the salt-worn rail; wind pressing their sleeves.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây's eyes search the roofs below and settle; she lifts her right arm and points down to one small house with closed shutters. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Keeping her arm out, she tells him it is Hạ's father's house, shut for nearly a month, her voice flat and factual; Sơn looks where she points, his hands tightening on the rail. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She adds that she assumed Hạ was busy selling flowers in the city and turns her head from the house to Sơn; he turns from the view to face her, jaw tight, saying nothing.
clips.end_frame: Mây at the rail, right arm still pointing down toward the shuttered house, her face turned to Sơn; Sơn turned from the view to face her, both hands on the rail, jaw tight; wind fluttering her sleeve and the white streak of her hair.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Nhà ba Hạ đó, đóng cửa gần tháng nay. Tôi cứ tưởng nó bận bán hoa trên thành phố.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon at the sea cliff: fading sun from the west as warm side key, cool sky fill, cold shade inside the tower; the lamp lights only during its deliberate test.

cinematic.intent: Let Mây place Hạ's absence inside a real home and a real friendship, not just Sơn's grief.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium gallery view to include both faces and her pointing direction toward the harbour houses.
cinematic.blocking: Both stay on their side of the rail a pace apart, Mây screen left and Sơn screen right. Her right arm extends down-frame toward the town; his hands remain on the rail.
cinematic.performance: Mây states facts to keep emotion out, but the closed house frightens her; she wants Sơn to see this is her town and her friend. Sơn does not claim to know the house better. No wistful gazing.
cinematic.focus: Keep faces primary and the house direction contextual, avoiding an impossible readable close-up of a distant address.
cinematic.texture: Salt-worn rail and low evening light hold the same coastal world, with no new memorial objects.
cinematic.sound_detail: Wind remains present but controlled under her short factual line, with distant harbour sound barely defined.
cinematic.rhythm: The pointing gesture establishes the fact quickly, her line spans the middle, and the last seconds pass to what the unanswered absence means between their two faces.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands. Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt.

screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mắt Mây lướt trên những mái nhà bên dưới rồi dừng lại; cô giơ tay phải chỉ xuống một căn nhà nhỏ cửa sổ đóng kín. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Vẫn giơ tay, cô nói đó là nhà ba Hạ, đóng cửa gần tháng nay, giọng phẳng như báo cáo; Sơn nhìn theo, tay siết lan can. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Cô nói thêm cứ tưởng Hạ bận bán hoa trên thành phố, rồi quay mặt từ căn nhà sang Sơn; anh quay khỏi khung cảnh, đối diện cô, quai hàm siết, không nói gì. Mây nói xuyên nhịp 2–3.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Mây's pointing arm lowers to the rail; her eyes stay on Sơn, waiting. Beat 2 (2.5–7.0s): Sơn draws a breath, his eyes drop to the rail for a moment, and he admits he has nothing but a threat and a torn strip of scarf, and that he believed she was dead, his voice low and reluctant. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): He lifts his eyes back to hers and lays both palms flat and empty on the weathered rail; Mây neither nods nor softens, her gaze direct, weighing what he said as the wind pulls at her hair.
clips.end_frame: Mây facing Sơn at the gallery rail, arm lowered, right hand back on the rail, eyes level on his; Sơn's empty palms flat on the rail, his eyes back on hers, shoulders heavy; wind moving their sleeves and her white-streaked hair.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi chỉ có một lời đe dọa với mảnh khăn rách. Tôi đã tưởng cô ấy chết rồi.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon at the sea cliff: fading sun from the west as warm side key, cool sky fill, cold shade inside the tower; the lamp lights only during its deliberate test.

cinematic.intent: Let Sơn state an assumption as his own fear rather than establishing Hạ's death as objective truth.
cinematic.composition: Preserve the preceding medium setup, gallery positions and focus while the pointing hand lowers naturally.
cinematic.blocking: Positions hold from the previous clip: Mây screen left, Sơn screen right, a pace apart. Her right arm returns to the rail; his hands open and flatten on it.
cinematic.performance: Sơn is ashamed of the assumption and of how little he has; he wants her to understand why he stopped hoping. Mây refuses to accept it as fact yet. No breakdown, no narrator's certainty in his voice.
cinematic.focus: Hold the same face-and-rail plane, keeping his unarmed hands readable without introducing a separate symbolic insert.
cinematic.texture: The rough rail presses into bare palms while wind moves the jacket, maintaining ordinary physical presence.
cinematic.sound_detail: Leave a breath before the admission and no graveyard-like musical punctuation after the word describing his fear.
cinematic.rhythm: A brief settle, then the admission slows everything; it ends unfinished on his empty hands so Mây's practical challenge can arrive in the next clip.

Nhịp 2 (2.5–7.0s): Sơn hít một hơi, mắt cụp xuống lan can một thoáng, thừa nhận anh chỉ có một lời đe dọa và một mảnh khăn rách, và đã tưởng cô ấy chết; giọng thấp, miễn cưỡng. clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây shakes her head slightly and tells him that without evidence she counts Hạ as alive, her right hand lifting off the rail. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She asks whether the number that called him is still there and holds out her open palm between them; Sơn's eyes go to her hand and his jaw works. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He takes his old phone from his jacket pocket, says it is still in there and lays it in her palm; her fingers close on it while his hand hesitates a moment, then lets go.
clips.end_frame: Mây holding Sơn's old phone in her closed hand between them at the rail, eyes on him; Sơn's hand just leaving it and lowering to the rail; both still facing each other; wind pressing their sleeves.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Chưa có chứng cứ, tôi coi như Hạ còn sống. Số đã gọi anh còn không? Đưa tôi.

dialogue.speaker: SON

cinematic.sound_detail: Her short sentence rises clearly above wind; a soft phone-to-palm contact closes the beat.
cinematic.rhythm: The refusal comes first and fast, the open palm holds a beat of decision, and the handover closes the clip as the consequence of his changed assumption.

Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây answers that every file opened goes into the record; Thành lays the sealed sleeve on his folder and rests his hand on the mouse, while Sơn stays where he is, waiting.
clips.end_frame: Original drive sealed in a clear evidence sleeve on Thành's folder, the working copy still plugged into the computer; Thành's hand on the mouse; Mây at his shoulder, eyes on the sleeve; Sơn a pace back, eyes on the screen; the ceiling fan turning above them.

cinematic.intent: Make the investigation's first digital step preserve trust in the evidence instead of treating a USB as magic.

cinematic.performance: Thành is quietly proud of doing it right; procedure is his confidence. Mây wants every step defensible later. Sơn holds back and lets someone else's expertise lead. No hacker flourish, no impatient leaning in.
cinematic.focus: Keep the small handover zone and three reactions legible without requiring readable filenames or desktop text.
cinematic.texture: An old fan and modest computer case keep the station practical, with evidence sleeve and drive visually distinct.
cinematic.sound_detail: Keyboard, sleeve movement and fan are enough; the first line should be ordinary work rather than a hacking triumph.
cinematic.rhythm: The copy starts at once, the sealing is precise in the middle with his line over it, and Mây's short rule closes the clip just before the accounts open.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Mây's eyes move from the highlighted screen to Sơn and stay there, waiting; Thành's hands go still on the keys. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): Sơn names Kiên as the man who paid for the ship and the factory and Bà Hai as the one who holds the route, his voice low, eyes on the pages rather than on either of them. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây splits the printed pages into two separate piles with both hands, one for each name, and says the two of them are now fighting over the ledger he took; Thành pulls his folder closer and starts writing.
clips.end_frame: Two separate piles of printed account pages on the desk, Mây's hands resting on them a hand-width apart; Sơn across the desk, eyes on the gap between the piles; Thành writing in his folder; monitor glow on all three, the fan turning overhead.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Vũ Kiên đứng tên trả tiền thuê tàu, thuê xưởng. Bà Hai giữ đường hàng.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Vậy hai kẻ đó đang giành nhau cuốn sổ anh lấy.

clips.lighting: Present-day night station: neutral desk lamp as low side key, cool monitor glow as fill on faces, dark windows; no daylight.

cinematic.intent: Separate Kiên's money from Bà Hai's logistics so the later conflict has identifiable interests.
cinematic.composition: The medium view retains Mây's questioning eyeline toward Sơn and Thành close enough to hear.
cinematic.blocking: Thành seated screen left at the keyboard, Mây standing center behind the pages, Sơn standing screen right across the desk. The two piles end to the left and right of the open ledger.
cinematic.performance: Sơn speaks as an insider confessing what he knows, not a detective explaining; each name costs him. Mây turns it into order on the desk, hiding unease at how deep this runs. No villain sneer at the names.
cinematic.focus: Keep the speaking face and two file positions readable without a new portrait or unreadable financial zoom.
cinematic.texture: Paper group edges and the black ledger maintain a concrete distinction between actors in the scheme.
cinematic.sound_detail: His low line is clear over the same fan bed; no new villain theme begins for a name already heard.
cinematic.rhythm: A waiting look opens, the names come briefly in the middle, and the physical split of the files completes the statement instead of a second explanation.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands. Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Đồn công an thị trấn Hòn Sóng (D3 night) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD).

clips.start_frame: The station desk at night: the monitor showing a padlocked folder icon beside an open weekly schedule grid, no readable text; below it Mây's paper copy of the dispatch receipt with its seven dated boxes, her pencil hovering; Thành's fingers on the keys.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Thành taps a key and the schedule grid steps to its last column; Mây's pencil travels along the dated boxes on the copy to the seventh. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): Thành's cursor clicks the padlocked folder and it stays shut, the lock icon unchanged; the pencil stops in the air as Mây's voice, off frame, fixes the last departure on the night of day seven. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): Her voice goes on to name what is still locked as the pencil draws one firm circle around the seventh box; Sơn's bare hand rests flat at the desk edge, still.
clips.end_frame: Pencil circle closed around the seventh dated box on Mây's paper copy, her pencil tip resting at its edge; the padlocked folder icon unchanged on the monitor beside the schedule; Thành's fingers lifted off the keys; Sơn's bare hand flat at the desk edge.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Tàu cuối rời bến đêm ngày bảy. Danh sách người còn khóa, phải mở trước hạn đó.

clips.lighting: Present-day night station: neutral desk lamp as low side key, cool monitor glow as fill on faces, dark windows; no daylight.

cinematic.intent: Make the locked dispatch detail a remaining obstacle, preserving the later proof of Hạ's transfer.
cinematic.composition: The detail setup holds the locked-folder shape beside the open weekly schedule and Mây's paper copy.
cinematic.blocking: Monitor edge across the top of frame, paper copy below center. Thành's right hand on the keys at screen left; Mây's pencil hand enters from screen right; Sơn's bare hand rests along the bottom edge.
cinematic.performance: Mây's pencil pause shows the limit of what they know; the circle is resolve, not certainty about Hạ. Thành's still fingers admit the lock beats him for now. No sigh, no frustrated slam.
cinematic.focus: Keep only the broad schedule and lock relationship clear; no readable passenger list or premature Hạ portrait belongs here.
cinematic.texture: A single pencil circle contrasts with the screen's inaccessible folder shape, grounding the unresolved information.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper and one key press sit beneath the off-screen line, with no countdown sound or false decryption chime.
cinematic.rhythm: The schedule moves first, the failed click lands in the middle as the deadline is spoken, and the single circle closes the clip on what still cannot be read.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands.

clips.start_frame: Night station desk: Sơn leaning toward the monitor, eyes fixed on a small token icon inside the locked folder; Mây beside him with her notebook; Thành seated at the keyboard, statement pad open on his folder, pen in hand.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Sơn's eyes narrow at the icon and he straightens slowly, a breath leaving him; Mây watches his face rather than the screen. Beat 2 (2.5–7.0s): He says the folder needs the hardware key, then pauses, jaw tightening, before naming where it is kept: beside the red ledger in the safe behind Bà Hai's screen. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Thành sketches the small key's shape on his statement pad in short pen strokes, glancing up as Sơn shows its size between finger and thumb; Mây looks from the sketch to Sơn.
clips.end_frame: Thành's pen finishing a small token outline on his statement pad; Sơn upright beside the desk, finger and thumb still held apart at its size, eyes on the sketch; Mây looking from the pad to Sơn's face; monitor glow on all three.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Phần đó cần khóa số. Nó nằm cạnh sổ đỏ, trong két sau bình phong của Bà Hai.

clips.lighting: Present-day night station: neutral desk lamp as low side key, cool monitor glow as fill on faces, dark windows; no daylight.

cinematic.intent: Turn the obstruction into a specific risky next step that depends on Sơn's past access.
cinematic.composition: Frame Sơn speaking with Mây and Thành in the same medium desk setup, screen remaining contextual.
cinematic.blocking: Thành seated screen left with the pad on his folder; Sơn standing center, leaning in then upright; Mây at screen right beside Sơn. Sơn's right hand shows the size; Thành draws with his right hand.
cinematic.performance: Sơn recognizes the icon with dread, because the answer means walking back into Bà Hai's house; naming the safe costs him a beat. Thành stays practical, wanting an accurate description. No heroic resolve, no map-drawing gestures.
cinematic.focus: Keep Sơn's mouth and the drawing hand readable, without adding a large readable token label or a fantasy map.
cinematic.texture: Plain pencil and paper make the small security object concrete before it is physically retrieved later.
cinematic.sound_detail: The line lands over restrained fan and pencil movement; no vault-opening sound should foreshadow success.
cinematic.rhythm: Recognition opens, the pause before naming the safe is the weight of the clip, and Thành's sketch finishes it with plain pen on paper.

clips.start_frame: Night station: Mây standing at the public desk with the station phone to her ear and a handwritten roster sheet in her other hand; Thành seated beside her with his folder and the printed copies; Sơn standing by the doorway.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.0s): Mây briefs the district over the phone in a low, steady voice, saying she is going to the city for the key and that Thành stays with their team to hold the town. Beat 2 (4.0–7.0s): She sets the phone back in its cradle and lays the roster sheet flat in front of Thành, tapping his line with two fingers. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Thành draws the roster toward him and acknowledges, naming the fish market and the clinic as his to watch; Sơn, at the doorway, watches Mây straighten and pick up her notebook.
clips.end_frame: The protection roster flat on the desk under Thành's hand, his pen at his own line; Mây upright beside him, phone back in its cradle, notebook in hand; Sơn by the doorway, watching her; the ceiling fan turning over the desk.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Tôi lên thành phố lấy khóa số. Thành ở lại với tổ huyện, giữ thị trấn.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Dạ. Chợ cá với phòng khám em canh kín.

clips.lighting: Present-day night station: neutral desk lamp as low side key, cool monitor glow as fill on faces, dark windows; no daylight.

cinematic.intent: End the investigation scene on an accountable choice to leave town with protection arranged, not on more exposition.
cinematic.composition: The wide setup includes station phone, copied evidence and roster with all three people in their working positions.
cinematic.blocking: Desk center with Thành seated behind it, Mây standing screen left of him, Sơn by the doorway at screen right. Phone and roster pass from Mây's hands to the desk; the folder stays with Thành.
cinematic.performance: Mây's worry for Hạ sits under strict professional control; she wants the town covered before she leaves it. Thành takes the post with steady pride. Sơn waits, aware why she goes. No comic protest, no lingering farewell.
cinematic.focus: Keep figures and document handover legible, with no extra remote superior face or screen call added.
cinematic.texture: The roster is plain work paper, not a dramatic operations board suddenly appearing for the trip.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use a low confirmation tone from the established channel beneath the instruction, without a second full conversation.
cinematic.rhythm: The call carries the opening, the roster lands in the middle as the real handover, and Thành's short acknowledgment closes the scene without new exposition.

scenes.title: Dũng Tới Biển
scenes.purpose: Dũng đe dọa bằng phần khăn còn lại, để lộ lệnh về thành phố.
scenes.outgoing_audio: The evidence-bag rustle bridges to two separated scarf pieces on the cabin table. Do not repeat Dũng laying it down.

clips.start_frame: Seafront street by Bảy's stall in morning sun: two black cars rolling to a stop at the curb; Bảy behind his counter under the green awning, a coffee glass in hand, checkered cloth over his shoulder; empty plastic tables and chairs seaward.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The lead car's door swings open and Dũng steps out, work bag strapped across his chest, while two of his men climb out of the second car and stay beside it. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): He crosses the pavement without slowing and sweeps one empty plastic chair aside with his boot; it clatters onto its side between the tables. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): Stopping at the edge of the awning shade, he demands of Bảy where the two men he sent yesterday are, chin jutting; behind the counter Bảy keeps the glass in his hand and meets his eyes.
clips.end_frame: Plastic chair lying on its side between the tables; Dũng at the awning's edge facing the counter, weight forward; Bảy behind the counter holding a coffee glass, cloth on his shoulder; Dũng's two men waiting by the cars; awning cloth flapping in the sea wind.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Hai thằng em tao gửi xuống hôm qua đâu rồi, ông già? Nói mau.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: coastal sun from the east on the street, faces in soft awning shade at the counter with bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Let Dũng's entitlement disturb the town's ordinary order through one clearly visible trespass.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide street composition to keep both black cars, empty chair and Bảy behind his counter related.
cinematic.blocking: Cars at the curb screen left, stall and counter screen right, tables between them. Dũng walks left to right through the tables; his men stay by the cars. Bảy holds his place behind the counter.
cinematic.performance: Dũng expects the town to yield before he speaks; the kicked chair is entitlement, not rage. Bảy is wary but stays put, hiding fear behind stillness. No swagger, no fearless posing from Bảy.
cinematic.focus: Keep the chair's path and standing bodies readable, avoiding a low-angle glorification of his size.
cinematic.texture: Dusty tires, scuffed chair legs and ordinary seafront light preserve the modest scale of the intrusion.
cinematic.sound_detail: A dry chair scrape briefly interrupts traffic and awning sounds, then his question takes the foreground.
cinematic.rhythm: The arrival is quick, the chair disturbance singular and short, and the demand lands last, the fallen chair left lying as a problem someone must answer.

clips.wardrobe_note: Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bảy sets the glass down on the tray without hurry, wipes his fingers on the cloth at his shoulder and looks up at Dũng. clips.end_frame: Bảy standing square in the counter's staff opening, one hand on the counter edge, eyes on Dũng; Dũng stopped in the public aisle an arm's length away, jaw set, bag strap across his chest; the coffee glass on the tray between them; awning cloth stirring.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Tụi nó nằm bên phòng khám, có công an canh. Muốn gặp thì chú qua đồn hỏi, đừng quậy quán tui nghen.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: coastal sun from the east on the street, faces in soft awning shade at the counter with bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Give Bảy a boundary he can hold without turning an elderly civilian into an action hero.
cinematic.composition: Frame the counter opening between Bảy's speaking face and Dũng's looming position in the public aisle.
cinematic.blocking: Counter across the frame with its staff opening at screen right; Bảy behind it, Dũng in the aisle at screen left. Bảy's pointing arm aims screen left down the street; he ends filling the opening.
cinematic.performance: Bảy is scared and does not show it; he defends his stall through plain ownership, wanting Dũng gone without a fight. Dũng is surprised an old man holds his ground. No shove, no heroic fists, no sneer.
cinematic.focus: Keep his face and the counter boundary in shared medium depth, leaving Dũng's size contextual rather than dominant.
cinematic.texture: The used counter edge and plain glass reinforce what Bảy is actually protecting, a working place.
cinematic.sound_detail: The glass landing precedes the line, then a short ordinary room pause keeps the threat human rather than musical.
cinematic.rhythm: The glass goes down slowly before he speaks, the answer spans the middle, and the step into the opening lands last; the held boundary closes the clip.

clips.start_frame: Seafront street by the stall: Mây and Thành walking toward Dũng from screen left, a support vehicle parked farther back; Dũng standing beside the overturned plastic chair; his two men by the black cars at screen right.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây and Thành come up the street and stop a few paces from Dũng and the fallen chair, Thành half a step behind her with his folder. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Mây tells Dũng by name to set the chair back and that questions here go through the law, then waits, hands loose; Dũng holds her stare. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): With a hard breath he bends, rights the chair with a sharp knock of its legs on the pavement and straightens, sneering that the station chief showed up fast and he only came with a message for Sơn; his men stay by their cars.
clips.end_frame: Plastic chair upright in its place; Dũng beside it, chin raised toward Mây; Mây facing him a few paces off, Thành at her shoulder with his folder; Dũng's two men waiting by the cars; the support vehicle parked farther back; awning cloth flapping.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Dựng ghế lại, anh Dũng. Muốn hỏi ai thì nói chuyện đúng luật.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Trưởng đồn ra mặt lẹ ha. Tao chỉ nhắn thằng Sơn một câu.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: coastal sun from the east on the street, faces in soft awning shade at the counter with bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Let Mây restore a small public rule before discussing a larger threat, making authority visible in action.
cinematic.composition: The wide view retains the fallen chair, Mây and Thành approaching, and the support vehicle farther back.
cinematic.blocking: Mây and Thành enter from screen left and stop left of center; Dũng and the chair right of center; his men by the cars at screen right; the support vehicle deep in the background left.
cinematic.performance: Mây's calm is non-negotiable; she wants compliance first and conversation after. Dũng obeys with visible resentment, keeping his menace in the eyes, never a clown. Thành stays steady. No hand on the cuffs.
cinematic.focus: Keep the chair and all three body positions legible, with no need for a new handcuff close-up.
cinematic.texture: Coastal daylight keeps the restored chair as ordinary furniture, not a newly heroic prop lit for a reveal.
cinematic.sound_detail: A second, different chair sound belongs only to its restoration, followed by her concise instruction.
cinematic.rhythm: The approach is short, the order and the wait take the middle so compliance matters, and the restored chair plus his jab finish the clip upright.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Dũng lowers his fist and lets the silk spill onto the counter, drawing it out along the grain. clips.end_frame: Long pale-blue scarf lying flat along the counter, its frayed torn end toward Mây; Dũng's hands withdrawn to the counter's near edge; Mây's hand still at the far end, fingers spread on the wood; the silk's edge lifting slightly in the breeze.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Đưa cái này tận tay thằng Bóng Ma. Nhìn vết rách, nó biết khăn của ai.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: coastal sun from the east on the street, faces in soft awning shade at the counter with bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Make the remaining scarf an intimate threat through its material match, without claiming it proves Hạ alive.
cinematic.composition: Use the detail shot on Dũng's hand, the long scarf and Mây's held distance at the counter edge.
cinematic.blocking: The counter fills the frame horizontally; Dũng's hands work from screen left, Mây's hand rests at screen right. The scarf runs left to right with the torn end nearest her.
cinematic.performance: Dũng's hands are dismissive and confident, enjoying the cloth as a threat. Mây's stillness is restraint: she wants it as evidence, not snatched from his grip. No trembling, no grab, no slap on the counter.
cinematic.focus: Keep the torn end clear at one scale, preserving that this is the long remainder, not Sơn's short fragment.
cinematic.texture: Frayed blue silk against rough counter wood echoes the latch trace without manufacturing a second scarf.
cinematic.sound_detail: The soft cloth slide contrasts with Dũng's rough voice; no heartbeat effect announces the connection.
cinematic.rhythm: The silk drops and spreads first, the hand-block is a short standoff in the middle, and the line comes over the flattened cloth once the torn end has settled.

clips.start_frame: Dũng beside the open rear door of his black car, phone buzzing in his right hand at chest height, eyes still turned toward the distant stall, silver earring catching the morning sun.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): He glances down at the vibrating phone, jaw working, and raises it to his ear. Beat 2 (2.5–7.0s): Bà Hai's filtered voice orders him back to the silk shop; his eyes narrow, his nostrils flare, and his gaze drops from the stall to the ground in front of his boots. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): He jabs the call off, shoves the phone into his pocket and ducks into the car, one hand gripping the door frame.
clips.end_frame: Dũng lowering himself into the car's rear seat, one hand gripping the door frame, head bent under the roof line, bag strap across his chest, face set hard; the stall distant behind him.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Đừng gây chuyện trước mặt công an nữa, Dũng. Về tiệm lụa ngay, đêm nay má có khách.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: coastal sun from the east on the street, faces in soft awning shade at the counter with bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Explain Dũng's later city presence while showing he also lives under someone else's control.
cinematic.composition: The close-up holds Dũng beside the open car door with the vibrating phone at a practical height.
cinematic.blocking: Dũng center frame with the open car door at screen left. The phone goes from his right hand at chest height to his ear, then into his right pocket; he drops into the car toward screen left.
cinematic.performance: Dũng resents being summoned more than he fears the police; obeying in front of the town humiliates him, and it shows in his jaw and nostrils. No shouting into the phone, no smashing it.
cinematic.focus: Keep his eyes and phone edge clear, screen unreadable and Bà Hai only a filtered voice.
cinematic.texture: A small earring glint and dusty door paint retain the same arrival world without a new costume or luxury insert.
cinematic.sound_detail: Phone vibration stops on answering; her familiar softness through compression precedes the car movement.
cinematic.rhythm: The phone interrupts quickly, the order takes the long middle on his face, and the sharp end of the call carries straight into getting in the car, with no second threat.

clips.start_frame: Stall counter in morning light, the road beyond now empty: Mây at the counter beside the long torn scarf lying flat on the wood, a clear evidence bag open in her left hand; Thành beside her with his folder.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây gathers the long scarf off the counter, folds it into the clear evidence bag and presses the seal shut. clips.end_frame: Thành walking away from the stall toward the patrol vehicle, folder under his arm; Mây at the counter with her hand on the closed duty pouch holding the bagged scarf, eyes on the empty road; the counter bare where the silk lay; awning cloth moving in the sea wind.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Hắn bị gọi về thành phố, chưa xong đâu. Giữ tuần tra phòng khám với đường cảng.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Dạ, em cho xe tuần liền.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: coastal sun from the east on the street, faces in soft awning shade at the counter with bounce from the pavement.

cinematic.intent: Show Mây treating the threat as evidence and a continuing risk, rather than celebrating the men's departure.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium stall view with the cleared road beyond, long scarf and her existing case bag close together.
cinematic.blocking: Counter screen left, the empty road deep in the background right. Mây stays at the counter center frame; Thành exits screen right toward the patrol vehicle. The bag goes from her left hand into the pouch at her hip.
cinematic.performance: Mây's relief is minimal; she treats the scarf as evidence and the departure as a warning, wanting the town watched. Thành moves promptly, no reassuring joke. No smile, no long look at the torn end.
cinematic.focus: Hold the evidence collection and speaking face readable, keeping the departing road secondary and not replayed.
cinematic.texture: The blue cloth entering the practical bag contrasts with the returned everyday counter, not a shrine-like display.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let engine sound recede beneath her instruction, then restore awning and sea without a victory cue.
cinematic.rhythm: Collection is efficient, the instruction takes the middle while her eyes check the road, and the clip ends on Thành already moving toward his duty.

scenes.title: Hai Mảnh Khăn

scenes.outgoing_audio: The phone vibration stops when answered. Cut wider for speaker mode, without a second ring or second answering gesture.

clips.start_frame: Two separate pale-blue cloth pieces lie flat on the bare cabin table: the short torn fragment at left, the long remainder at right, torn ends a hand-width apart. Sơn's bare hands rest on the near edge; Mây's khaki-sleeved hand lies still at the far edge.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Sơn's right fingertips slide the short fragment across the wood until its torn edge lies beside the torn end of the long remainder, as his off-screen voice starts naming whose scarf it is. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): His fingertips smooth the frayed threads flat and the pale-blue weave lines up thread for thread while his voice says what the cloth cannot prove; his index finger hovers a finger-width short of pressing the edges together. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He lifts both hands away, leaving a narrow strip of bare wood between the matched edges; his fingers curl back onto the table edge, a slow breath shifting his sleeve, while Mây's hand stays still.
clips.end_frame: The two pale-blue pieces lie side by side on the table, torn edges matched thread for thread but parted by a narrow strip of bare wood; Sơn's bare hands rest curled at the near edge; Mây's khaki-sleeved hand at the far edge; window light on the weave.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Khớp từng sợi. Khăn Hạ quấn cổ hôm bị bắt. Nhưng khăn đâu nói được cô ấy còn sống.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: daylight through the east cabin window as side key on the table; hard sun on the porch with faces in its shade.

cinematic.intent: Let matching torn edges create stronger evidence while preserving what the cloth cannot tell them.
cinematic.composition: Use the locked detail setup to compare two pieces at the same scale, edges separated by a visible narrow gap.
cinematic.blocking: Fixed tabletop plane: the short fragment travels left to right under Sơn's right fingertips while the long remainder never moves. His hands work from the near edge; Mây's hand stays at the far edge, outside the action.
cinematic.performance: Longing held inside procedure: he wants the edges to close and will not let them, so the hesitation lives in one hovering fingertip. Hope is weighed, not indulged. No trembling hands, no caressing the cloth, no tearful pause.
cinematic.focus: Keep the matching fibers and gap crisp, with no inserted image of the abduction or inner watch face.
cinematic.texture: Different folds show how each piece was carried, while matching pale-blue weave ties them to one object.
cinematic.sound_detail: Only cloth sliding over wood and his low off-screen sentence interrupt cabin wind.
cinematic.rhythm: A short purposeful slide, a held hover while his line lands, then a deliberate withdrawal; the gap stays in view for the last seconds while breath and window light keep the frame alive.

Giọng Sơn ngoài khung hình vang từ 0.2s qua hết nhịp hai.

clips.start_frame: Sơn stands at the cabin's marked entry frame, a small carving tool in his right hand; three pale tally cuts on the doorframe at shoulder height, the shelf beside it; Mây by the table a few paces behind him, hand resting on her duty pouch.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn sets the tool's edge beside the third mark and cuts the fourth line in one firm downward stroke, a curl of pale wood dropping to the floor. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His thumb brushes the fresh groove clean and his eyes travel across the four lines one by one, jaw set, breath slow through the nose, while behind him Mây's gaze lifts from her pouch to the count. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He lays the tool on the shelf, lets go of it, and turns from the frame toward the table, his weight already moving into a step.
clips.end_frame: Exactly four tally marks on the doorframe, the newest raw and pale beside three older cuts; the carving tool lying on the shelf; Sơn turned from the frame toward the table, mid-step; Mây by the table, hand on her duty pouch, eyes on the marks.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Vạch thứ tư. Chúng ném khăn của Hạ vào giữa thị trấn. Đó là lời thách.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: daylight through the east cabin window as side key on the table; hard sun on the porch with faces in its shade.

cinematic.intent: Let the fourth tally register a new day of pressure without turning counting into a repeated ritual montage.
cinematic.composition: The medium view keeps Sơn, three existing marks and the shelf where the tool returns in one setup.
cinematic.blocking: Doorframe at screen left with the shelf just right of it; Sơn works facing the frame, tool in his right hand, then turns screen right toward the table where Mây stands a few paces back.
cinematic.performance: Controlled resolve under a new day of pressure: the cut is firmer than on the first morning and the count is private arithmetic, not ritual. He hides the fear of running out of days. No anger at the wood, no theatrical stare.
cinematic.focus: Keep the total count readable alongside his body, avoiding another identical isolated carving close-up.
cinematic.texture: Fresh wood beside older pale cuts gives time a physical trace while noon light stays harsh and natural.
cinematic.sound_detail: One short scrape and shelf contact carry the action, with no recycled seven-day voice-over.
cinematic.rhythm: One clean stroke early, a short held count across the four lines, then the tool goes down and the turn carries straight into a step; no second cut and no dead tail.

clips.start_frame: Sơn and Mây face each other across the cabin table. Sơn holds the short pale-blue fragment above a plain open envelope; the long remainder lies flat between them; Mây holds an empty clear evidence sleeve open in both hands, duty pouch at her hip.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Sơn slides the short fragment into the envelope, folds the flap down and tucks it inside the left breast of his olive jacket, while Mây starts telling him what she will seal and what the tear proves. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): Mây lifts the long remainder into her evidence sleeve and runs her thumb along the seal until it closes, eyes on the cloth rather than on him, and Sơn answers as the seal shuts, looking at the blue cloth behind the plastic. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): His jaw stays tight on his last words; Mây gives a short nod and slides the sealed sleeve down into her open duty pouch.
clips.end_frame: Sơn and Mây face each other across the cleared table, both still breathing from the exchange; Sơn's bare hands hang empty, the envelope out of sight in his jacket; Mây's right hand is still inside her open duty pouch, the sealed remainder stowed.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Phần dài tôi niêm phong. Dũng mang tới, nghĩa là Hạ từng qua tay người Bà Hai.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Đưa được Hạ về, cô trả lại khăn cho cô ấy.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: daylight through the east cabin window as side key on the table; hard sun on the porch with faces in its shade.

cinematic.intent: Make evidence custody part of growing trust, while leaving Sơn a small private piece to carry.
cinematic.composition: Frame both at the table, distinct envelope and evidence bag in the lower medium space.
cinematic.blocking: Table between them at waist height, Sơn at screen left, Mây at screen right. His piece goes into a plain envelope and his jacket; hers goes into a clear sleeve and her duty pouch. The two pieces never cross the table centre.
cinematic.performance: Trust grows through procedure: neither lingers over the cloth, and the care is in precise hands and mutual permission. He asks a favour he cannot repay; she accepts it without warmth on display. No sentimental stroking, no lingering glances.
cinematic.focus: Keep the two destinations readable at the established table depth, so they cannot seem to merge into one new package.
cinematic.texture: Plain envelope paper and clear protective sleeve retain different functions and ownership.
cinematic.sound_detail: A modest envelope fold and sleeve closure sit beneath Mây's line, with no ceremonial sealing flourish.
cinematic.rhythm: She talks from the first second while his piece is stowed and hers is sealed; the decision lands on his reply and her nod, and the stowing is still finishing as the clip ends.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây's hand comes up out of the duty pouch with a folded roster sheet and opens it toward Sơn across the table, her finger tapping the signed lines as she tells him the town is covered. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Sơn's eyes move from the sheet to her face and stay there; she slips the roster into her shirt pocket and draws a folded dark-blue denim jacket from the travel bag at the end of the table, finishing her line. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She shakes the denim out and lays it flat beside the bag, smoothing the collar with her palm; Sơn gives a small nod, shoulders easing a fraction.
clips.end_frame: The dark-blue denim jacket lies flat on the table beside Mây's packed travel bag; Mây stands over it in her khaki shirt, one palm still on the collar, eyes on Sơn; Sơn faces her across the table, nodding slightly, weight settling.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Thành với đội huyện đã nhận ca giữ thị trấn. Tôi mặc thường phục, đi thành phố với anh.

clips.lighting: Present-day noon: daylight through the east cabin window as side key on the table; hard sun on the porch with faces in its shade.

cinematic.intent: Show Mây joining the risk by preparation, not by abandoning her responsibility or instantly changing clothes.
cinematic.composition: Maintain the exact preceding medium setup, focus and table positions through the continuation seam.
cinematic.blocking: Same table positions held from the seam: Mây screen right with her pouch at the hip and the travel bag at the table's right end, Sơn screen left. The roster ends in her shirt pocket; the denim stays on the table.
cinematic.performance: Practical resolve: she has covered her duty first and states the trip as a decision, not a request. Sơn's guard drops a notch at being joined and shows only in his shoulders. No gratitude speech, no smile.
cinematic.focus: Keep the same table-and-face plane, with the roster readable as confirmed work rather than legible official text.
cinematic.texture: Denim joins khaki and plain paper as a planned change, not an unexplained costume transformation during the shot.
cinematic.sound_detail: A soft jacket fold and paper movement support her brief statement, leaving wind and room tone intact.
cinematic.rhythm: The roster lands in the first seconds, the jacket comes out mid-clip, and the nod closes the decision; she does not put the jacket on here, and hands keep moving into the cut.

clips.start_frame: South porch at noon, in the roof's shade. Sơn stands by the porch table, his packed backpack upright on it under his left hand; Mây faces him from the top of the steps in her denim jacket, black daypack on both shoulders, the dune path behind her.

cinematic.intent: Make the caller's access to a personal detail unsettle Sơn while Mây preserves room for doubt.

cinematic.texture: Ordinary worn phone surfaces and porch wood contrast with the emotional weight of the voice.
cinematic.sound_detail: The filtered caller sounds human and controlled, not electronically monstrous; wind stays low beneath the private detail.
cinematic.rhythm: The two device actions are quick and practical in the first half; the private detail then lands and gets a held, breathing silence before the cut.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon: warm low sun from the west across the porch, cooling to dusk at the coach stop with soft sky fill only.

cinematic.intent: Expose the hope Sơn cannot suppress without letting it become certainty that Hạ is alive.
cinematic.composition: Use the close-up on his listening face, with Mây still in the established surrounding space.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn at screen centre, Mây's profile soft at screen right. His hands stay on the table edge below the frame line and never touch the phones; only his head and shoulders travel forward a few centimetres.
cinematic.performance: Hope he cannot suppress breaks through in the lean and the tightness of the question, a need he would rather hide from both the caller and Mây. No pleading tone, no wet eyes, no clenched-fist anger.
cinematic.focus: Hold the current facial plane, avoiding a rack to Mây or an invented inset of the hair clip.
cinematic.texture: Wind moves a lapel edge while his hands stay outside the device area, keeping vulnerability in the face.
cinematic.sound_detail: A short intake of breath precedes his line; the caller's channel remains present but does not overlap as a second sentence.
cinematic.rhythm: Reaction and first words land together, the question follows in the same breath, and an audible unanswered wait holds from mid-clip into the seam; the lean is the only large movement.

clips.start_frame: Sơn and Mây stand side by side over the porch table, the call still live on his speaker phone in front of him; Mây's fingertips rest on her recording phone at the right end, holding it steady; his backpack upright at the left end.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây leans in toward Sơn and lifts her free hand flat between him and the speaker phone, a small stopping gesture, as she starts speaking low. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She tells him who might be behind the voice and that it wants the two sides fighting, warning him to take no more conditions, while his eyes move from the phone to her face and his breathing slows. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He gives a slight nod; his right hand leaves the table edge, travels to his phone and stops a finger-width above the end-call key, hovering.
clips.end_frame: Sơn's right hand hovers a finger-width above the end-call key of his speaker phone, the call still live; Mây beside him, fingertips on her recording phone, free hand lowered, eyes on his hand; both leaning over the porch table.

dialogue.speaker: MAY_C
dialogue.text: Có thể là người của Kiên, mượn tay anh để hai phe cắn nhau. Đừng nhận thêm điều kiện.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon: warm low sun from the west across the porch, cooling to dusk at the coach stop with soft sky fill only.

cinematic.intent: Give Mây a visible intervention before Sơn can be drawn into a new bargain.
cinematic.composition: Return to the medium two-person setup with recorder steady and the listening phone separate.
cinematic.blocking: Two-shot at the table, Sơn screen left, Mây screen right. Her raised hand stays between him and his phone until he nods; her recorder never leaves the table. His right hand travels only to the end-call key.
cinematic.performance: Her tone is low and firm, a colleague setting a boundary rather than an officer barking an order; he hears the practical sense and lets it cool his hope. No finger-wagging, no exasperated sigh.
cinematic.focus: Keep her mouth and his hovering hand readable at one depth, without a new phone-screen close-up.
cinematic.texture: Two ordinary devices and the bag retain their fixed positions, preventing props from becoming a visual shell game.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her words sit cleanly above the line's quiet room noise; no suspense pulse needs to announce good judgment.
cinematic.rhythm: The warning fills the first two beats with no gap; the nod comes after her last word, and the hand's travel to the key is held for the seam with the decision not yet taken.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn carries his weathered dark-olive canvas travel backpack containing his folded black suit and gloves. Mây wears her dark-blue denim jacket over charcoal T-shirt and carries her compact black tactical daypack/backpack over her shoulders with evidence sleeves and phone recorder.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): With his hand still hovering, Sơn bends a little closer to the speaker and states his condition, level and low: proof that Hạ is alive before any talk of work. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): The moment his last word lands he presses the end-call key without waiting for a reply; the line goes dead and the speaker hiss stops. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): He straightens and takes his hand back to his side, leaving the dark phone where it lies, jaw tight through one long breath out, as Mây lifts her fingers off her recorder, eyes on him, and porch wind fills the quiet.
clips.end_frame: Both phones lie apart on the porch table, Sơn's screen dark after the ended call, Mây's recorder under her lifted hand; Sơn straightened beside the table, hand withdrawn, breathing out; Mây watching him; wind moving across the porch boards.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Cho tôi thấy Hạ còn sống đã. Chưa thấy cô ấy, tôi không bàn việc gì.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon: warm low sun from the west across the porch, cooling to dusk at the coach stop with soft sky fill only.

cinematic.intent: Let Sơn reclaim the terms by demanding evidence and ending contact himself.
cinematic.composition: Preserve the same medium setup and existing focus, phone positions and hand location from Mây's intervention.
cinematic.blocking: Same two-shot from the seam, Sơn screen left, Mây screen right. His right hand makes one short trip down to the end-call key and back; neither phone is moved or picked up.
cinematic.performance: The firmness costs him: he still wants the caller to be right, and ending the line feels like closing a door on Hạ. He does it anyway. No triumphant look, no slamming the phone, no glance for approval.
cinematic.focus: Keep his mouth and final button action readable without a change of lens or a new speakerphone graphic.
cinematic.texture: The phone remains an ordinary object after the line ends, not a glowing symbol under changed light.
cinematic.sound_detail: The channel cuts cleanly after his demand, restoring exposed porch wind rather than an electronic menace tone.
cinematic.rhythm: The condition is spoken from the first second, the cut-off lands decisively mid-clip, and a short living silence of breath and wind carries the end; no bargaining, no second warning.

clips.start_frame: Dusk at the coach stop on the sea-wall side of the main street: the coach rolling in from the left; Mây and Sơn waiting several paces apart at the curb, her daypack on, his backpack on his left shoulder; Thành across the road, folder under his arm.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The coach draws up to the curb and stops with a hiss of brakes, its door folding open in front of the two travelers. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Mây climbs aboard first with her daypack; a few paces behind, Sơn waits until she is inside, then steps up with his backpack without looking back at the road. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The door folds shut behind him and the engine note rises as the coach begins to roll, while across the road Thành stays on the town side, tucks the folder tighter under his arm and rests his hand on his radio handset, watching it go.
clips.end_frame: The coach door shut with Sơn and Mây aboard, the coach rolling away along the sea wall, engine rising; Thành alone across the road on the town side, folder under his left arm, right hand on his radio handset, watching it go in the dusk.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Chị Mây lên trước, ông Sơn lên sau. Còn Hòn Sóng, tôi giữ tới khi hai người về.

clips.lighting: Present-day late afternoon: warm low sun from the west across the porch, cooling to dusk at the coach stop with soft sky fill only.

cinematic.intent: Close the act on an already-chosen journey, preserving the cost of leaving Thành responsible for home.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide stop view to relate travelers, coach door and Thành across the road without shifting into the vehicle.
cinematic.blocking: The coach enters from screen left and stops at the sea-wall curb; Thành holds the far side of the road at screen right throughout. Mây boards first, Sơn second, each with their own bag; the coach pulls away toward screen right.
cinematic.performance: Purposeful departures, not romantic ones: two people boarding to work. Thành watches like a man taking over responsibility, worried but steady, not like someone seeing friends off on holiday. No waving, no backward glances held for effect.
cinematic.focus: Keep all positions readable at wide depth, with no new close-up farewell or invented passengers demanding attention.
cinematic.texture: Coach door wear, packed bags and ordinary road dust connect the departure to the opening arrival without copying it.
cinematic.sound_detail: Engine and door sounds come from the same coach, ready to continue into the on-board scene without restarting.
cinematic.rhythm: The arrival is quick, the two boardings follow one after the other without overlap, and the closing door hands the last seconds to Thành standing still while the engine climbs.

scenes.title: Xe Đò Đêm
scenes.purpose: Hai người vào thành phố với trạng thái trang phục rõ.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Coach-window rain becomes rain on the silk-shop rear awning. The city arrival is a time ellipsis, not another travel montage.

clips.start_frame: Night coach interior swaying through rain under low blue lights: Sơn in the left window seat near the rear, his closed backpack on his lap; Mây across the narrow aisle, her phone in her hand, screen dark; rain streaking the dark windows.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây's phone lights in her hand; she reads the incoming patrol message and tells Sơn across the aisle that the town posts are in place. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She thumbs a short acknowledgement and lowers the phone to her knee, eyes on Sơn, as he answers about changing at the rest stop and draws the brass zipper of the backpack on his lap open along the top. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He parts the canvas mouth and the folded black suit shows inside; his hands pause on the open edges, his eyes on the black cloth, not on her.
clips.end_frame: The coach sways in the rain; Sơn in the window seat with the open backpack on his lap, hands resting on its parted edges, the folded black suit visible inside; Mây across the aisle, acknowledged message on her lowered phone, watching him.

dialogue.speaker: MAY_C
dialogue.text: Thành báo các chốt ở Hòn Sóng vào vị trí rồi.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tốt. Tới trạm dừng tôi thay lại bộ đồ cũ, cho bọn gác hẻm khỏi nghi.

clips.lighting: Present-day night journey: dim blue coach ceiling practicals as soft top light, cool window spill on faces; neutral overhead lamps at the rest stop; no past amber timeline cue.

cinematic.intent: Place private dread beside Mây's still-active responsibility for the town.
cinematic.composition: Use the aisle as a narrow divider, bag low and her confirmation phone higher.
cinematic.blocking: The aisle is a divider: Sơn screen left by the window, Mây screen right across the aisle. Her phone stays high in her hand, his bag low on his lap; neither crosses the aisle or leaves their seat.
cinematic.performance: Mây reads with practised efficiency, then checks on him; Sơn treats the suit as a task and avoids asking her permission with his eyes. Under it sits dread of the old clothes. No sighing, no staring out of the window for effect.
cinematic.focus: Keep the suit reveal secondary until her patrol acknowledgement has registered.
cinematic.texture: Rain tracks outside, worn canvas and damp denim make this practical travel.
cinematic.sound_detail: Maintain steady engine, soft rain and one small bag-clasp sound, without a suspense sting.
cinematic.rhythm: The confirmation lands first and is closed off quickly, his reply rides the zip, and the reveal of the suit takes the back half; his pause on it is the held moment before the cut.

clips.start_frame: Sơn in the window seat with the folded black suit lying across his knees, black leather gloves tucked in its fold; the open backpack on the empty seat beside him; Mây across the aisle, turned toward him; rain streaking the window.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's right hand moves over the suit and his fingertips settle on the edge of the tucked gloves, feeling the leather without lifting it, as Mây asks, without accusation, whether these are the clothes from his Bóng Ma years under Bà Hai. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Her eyes stay on his face rather than the gloves; his breathing shortens and his throat moves in a controlled swallow, no answer coming. clips.end_frame: Sơn seated by the rain-streaked window, the folded black suit across his knees with the gloves still tucked in its fold, his right hand withdrawn flat on his knee; the open backpack on the seat beside him; Mây across the aisle, watching his face.

dialogue.speaker: MAY_C
dialogue.text: Bộ đồ với đôi găng đó, hồi anh còn làm Bóng Ma cho Bà Hai hả?

clips.lighting: Present-day night journey: dim blue coach ceiling practicals as soft top light, cool window spill on faces; neutral overhead lamps at the rest stop; no past amber timeline cue.

cinematic.intent: Make the gloves an invitation he is afraid to accept again.
cinematic.composition: Frame the folded suit across his knees with both faces readable above it.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn screen left with the suit across his knees and the open bag on the seat to his right; Mây screen right across the aisle. Only his right hand travels, from his knee to the glove edge and back.
cinematic.performance: The gloves pull at him like an old invitation he is afraid to accept. Mây asks gently and watches him rather than the leather; his answer stays locked in a swallow. No flinch, no shaking hand, no reply yet.
cinematic.focus: Keep both people and gloves readable in the existing medium shot, no rack to another angle.
cinematic.texture: The supple dark leather contrasts with her rain-marked denim and his rough canvas bag.
cinematic.sound_detail: His line must not compete with cloth movement or an artificially amplified heartbeat.
cinematic.rhythm: The touch and her question start together, his swallow answers in the middle, and the withdrawal ends the clip with the question left hanging over the swaying quiet.

clips.start_frame: Rain-dark rear alley of the silk shop at night; Sơn in the black suit faces the closed stockroom door under the shallow awning, an old brass key in his right hand; Mây a step behind his left shoulder, half-turned toward the empty alley, daypack on her shoulders.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn fits the brass key into the lock by touch, eyes on the wood, telling Mây how long he has kept it and where the door leads. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The key turns with no resistance and the old bolt clicks; his hand stays on it a moment, a small frown at the ease, while behind him Mây scans the empty alley and warns him low that it could be a trap. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He pushes the door inward with his left palm; it swings open on the dark stockroom and both step to the threshold, Mây giving the alley a last look over her shoulder.
clips.end_frame: The rear door stands open inward onto the dark stockroom; Sơn on the threshold, key still in the lock under his right hand, left palm on the door edge; Mây close behind his left shoulder, head turned back toward the empty rain-dark alley; rain dripping off the awning.

dialogue.text: Chìa đồng này tôi giữ hai mươi lăm năm. Mở là vào thẳng kho.

dialogue.text: Hẻm vắng bất thường. Cẩn thận, có thể là bẫy.

clips.lighting: Present-day rainy night: warm shop practicals as key from inside the doorway, cool blue alley spill and rain reflections as rim from behind.

cinematic.intent: Make the still-working key feel like permission whose price has not been disclosed.
cinematic.composition: Keep the closed rear door central and enough alley behind Mây to justify her lookout.
cinematic.blocking: Door at screen centre under the awning; Sơn faces it with his right hand on the key, Mây behind his left shoulder with the open alley behind her at screen left, clear of the inward door swing.
cinematic.performance: He knows the lock by touch, and the lack of resistance unsettles rather than reassures him: a house that waits for you is worse than a hard lock. Mây's alertness is professional, not jumpy. No smile at success.
cinematic.focus: The doorway and their faces share useful depth; no insert or extra close-up is needed.
cinematic.texture: Rain darkens old wood beneath the shallow awning, with no newly invented sign or lock.
cinematic.sound_detail: Give the old key turn a modest audible click beneath his short explanation.
cinematic.rhythm: No stretched unlocking: the key goes in and turns inside the first half, the doubt lands on her warning, and the opening door carries the end forward into the dark.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, both hands bare without gloves. Mây wears her dark-blue denim jacket over charcoal T-shirt and carries her compact black tactical daypack/backpack over her shoulders with evidence sleeves and phone recorder.

clips.start_frame: Inside the dim silk shop at night, warm lamps low; Sơn and Mây stand just inside, the rear stock door behind them at screen left; long racks of hanging silk lead toward screen right, where a carved wooden screen stands near the teak desk.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn moves off along the left-hand rack without searching, shoulder brushing the hanging silk, and tells Mây where the safe stands, the tracking move picking him up as he heads screen right. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Mây follows two paces, then stops at the end of the first rack with the rear door still in her eyeline and checks back toward it, while Sơn keeps going past the teak desk. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He reaches the carved screen, takes its edge in his right hand and draws it aside, revealing the closed steel safe at chest height; the move settles on him as he stands square to it, breath held.
clips.end_frame: The carved screen drawn aside, the closed steel safe at chest height in front of Sơn, his right hand still on the screen's edge; Mây back at the end of the first rack near the rear door, facing his way with the exit at her shoulder; silk still swaying.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Đi sát kệ lụa bên trái. Két nằm sau tấm bình phong, ngay sau bàn của bà.

clips.lighting: Present-day rainy night: warm shop practicals as key from inside the doorway, cool blue alley spill and rain reflections as rim from behind.

cinematic.intent: Show intimate knowledge of the shop turning into vulnerability for both travelers.
cinematic.composition: Track along their established aisle, silk racks framing the screened safe at the far end.
cinematic.blocking: Movement runs screen left to screen right: rear door at left, silk racks in the middle, desk and carved screen at right. Sơn travels the whole aisle; Mây stops early at the first rack to keep the exit behind her.
cinematic.performance: His certainty is habit and it makes him quick; her small checks back show she refuses to inherit that certainty. The familiarity should feel dangerous, not nostalgic. No lingering touch on the silk, no reminiscing glance.
cinematic.focus: Keep the safe screen readable ahead of him, not a sudden focus reveal behind their backs.
cinematic.texture: Silk brushes close to the frame, narrowing the path without becoming dreamlike curtains.
cinematic.sound_detail: Soft shoe steps, rain outside and a single cloth brush carry the intrusion.
cinematic.rhythm: Steady purposeful travel the whole way, with Mây's stop as a short counter-beat mid-clip; the screen coming aside is the arrival, held for one breath only.

clips.start_frame: The steel safe stands open; on its lower shelf a worn red cloth ledger lies flat with a small USB-shaped hardware token beside it; Sơn's bare hands rest on the safe's edge; far behind, Mây's soft silhouette waits by the rear door.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's right hand reaches in, closes around the token and lifts it out, turning it between thumb and forefinger to check its shape, while his off-screen voice names the two pieces. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His left hand slides under the red ledger and draws it out across the steel lip with a soft scrape of worn binding, bringing it in against his body. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He clamps the ledger under his left arm and closes his right fist around the token; both hands withdraw from the emptied shelf and the safe door hangs open, his breath audible.
clips.end_frame: The red cloth ledger clamped under Sơn's left arm against the black suit, the small token closed in his right fist; the safe standing open with its lower shelf empty; his bare hands drawn back from the steel edge; Mây's silhouette still by the rear door.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Sổ đỏ bản gốc với khóa số. Hai món này mở được danh sách tàu.

clips.lighting: Present-day rainy night: warm shop practicals as key from inside the doorway, cool blue alley spill and rain reflections as rim from behind.

cinematic.intent: Turn the search into a concrete gain before Bà Hai takes back the encounter.
cinematic.composition: Use one stable detail view that distinguishes red cloth ledger from the small metal token.
cinematic.blocking: Safe open at screen left with the shelf at hand height; the token leaves in his right hand, the ledger in his left, and nothing else is touched. Mây stays a distant soft shape by the rear door throughout.
cinematic.performance: Businesslike hands with one beat of verification on the token: he needs to be sure, and he hides the relief. No rummaging through other contents, no triumphant lift, no lingering on the ledger's cover.
cinematic.focus: Keep both acquired objects identifiable within the same focal plane and unchanged detail setup.
cinematic.texture: Steel safe edge, red cloth wear and token shape provide specific visual separation.
cinematic.sound_detail: An ordinary binding scrape and small token tap are enough; do not add a digital success chime.
cinematic.rhythm: The token comes first and is checked, the ledger follows in one pull, and the clip ends with both secured and the hands already moving away; no reset before the interruption.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, both hands bare without gloves.

clips.start_frame: The dark silk shop: Sơn at the open safe with the red ledger under his left arm, token in his right fist; a few paces away the unlit teak desk, a seated figure barely readable behind it; Mây by the rear door across the room in cool alley spill.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): A click: Bà Hai's left hand switches on the desk lamp, jade bracelet catching the light, and warm light finds her already seated behind the desk, holder between her right fingers, speaking softly to Sơn. Beat 2 (2.5–4.5s): Sơn turns from the safe toward her and goes still; by the rear door Mây turns too, a hand on her daypack strap, and neither advances as Bà Hai says she kept the old lock for him. Beat 3 (4.5–10.0s): Sơn answers flatly, asking whether she sat in the dark to call Dũng back; her face does not move, only her fingers turn the holder a quarter turn, while Mây shifts her weight toward the exit.
clips.end_frame: All three visible in warm lamp light: Bà Hai seated behind the teak desk, holder in her right fingers, left hand beside the lamp; Sơn standing between the open safe and the desk, ledger under his left arm; Mây by the rear door, turned toward the desk; the safe open behind Sơn.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Má biết con sẽ về bằng chìa cũ. Má để nguyên ổ khóa chờ con.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Má ngồi chờ trong tối, định gọi Dũng về sao?

clips.lighting: Present-day rainy night: warm shop practicals as key from inside the doorway, cool blue alley spill and rain reflections as rim from behind.

cinematic.intent: Reveal that their apparent intrusion has been an invitation controlled by Bà Hai.
cinematic.composition: Hold all three positions in the wide shot, safe behind Sơn and lit desk behind the turn.
cinematic.blocking: Open safe at screen right with Sơn before it, desk and lamp at centre, rear door with Mây at screen left. Both visitors turn toward the desk on the spot; nobody crosses the floor, and Mây stays in line with the exit.
cinematic.performance: Bà Hai is settled, almost tender, and that is the threat; the shock belongs to the visitors' delayed recognition. Sơn's reply is flat to hide that she still has power over him. No gasp, no drawn weapon, no villain smile.
cinematic.focus: The lamp and her face become readable together without an internal cut or artificial zoom.
cinematic.texture: Warm desk light lands on violet silk, while cool alley spill still outlines the escape route.
cinematic.sound_detail: Lamp switch first, then her voice; do not accompany the reveal with a generic sting.
cinematic.rhythm: The lamp click and her first soft words arrive together, recognition lands on the visitors' turn, his flat answer follows without a pause, and the unequal stillness then holds while only small hands move.

clips.start_frame: Lamp-lit teak desk set with three tea cups: Bà Hai seated behind it, both palms flat on the wood, holder between her right fingers; Sơn standing across from her, red ledger under his left arm, an empty visitor chair at his right; Mây beyond him by the rear exit.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bà Hai keeps both palms on the desk and makes no move toward the ledger, telling Sơn in a mother's voice to keep the book, her eyes resting on the red cover rather than his face. Beat 2 (3.0–5.0s): As she names her price, Kiên brought back to her, her eyes lift from the ledger to Sơn; his left arm tightens on the book and he does not step closer. Beat 3 (5.0–10.0s): From the rear exit Mây cuts in, level and firm, that this is bargaining over case evidence in front of police; Bà Hai's gaze travels to Mây without hurry, a closed smile that never reaches her eyes, while Sơn holds still.
clips.end_frame: Bà Hai seated with both palms flat on the desk, eyes on Mây, a closed smile; Sơn standing across the desk from her, red ledger pressed under his left arm, the empty visitor chair at his right; Mây by the rear exit, feet planted; three tea cups untouched.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Cứ cầm sổ đi con. Má chỉ cần con đem Vũ Kiên về đây cho má.

dialogue.speaker: MAY_C
dialogue.text: Bà mặc cả trước mặt công an. Sổ này là tang vật.

clips.lighting: Present-day rainy night: warm shop practicals as key from inside the doorway, cool blue alley spill and rain reflections as rim from behind.

cinematic.intent: Expose why she lets the ledger leave her hand: she wants a person delivered instead.
cinematic.composition: Frame Bà Hai's open palms with Sơn retaining the red ledger, Mây still near the exit.
cinematic.blocking: Desk across the lower frame: Bà Hai behind it at screen right, Sơn facing her at screen left with the chair at his right hip, Mây deeper at screen left by the exit. Nobody reaches across the desk.
cinematic.performance: Her offer sounds maternal on the surface and commercially exact underneath; she wants a person delivered, not the book. Sơn refuses by stillness, and Mây's interruption is procedural, not outraged. No looming over the desk, no raised voices.
cinematic.focus: Keep ledger and her eyes sufficiently readable to show where her interest has moved.
cinematic.texture: The polished desk separates her domestic hospitality from the safe standing open behind them.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let her low offer remain dry against the room tone, without swelling threat music.
cinematic.rhythm: The permission lands first, the price second with the lift of her eyes, and Mây's cut-in arrives without a gap; the last seconds hold the three-way stillness under the lamp.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Con không bắt người cho má nữa. Má nói thẳng đi, Hạ bị nhốt ở đâu?

clips.lighting: Present-day rainy night: warm shop practicals as key from inside the doorway, cool blue alley spill and rain reflections as rim from behind.

cinematic.intent: Make Sơn refuse her comfortable family arrangement through the chair he does not occupy.
cinematic.composition: Preserve the preceding medium lens, desk relation and three-person depth exactly.
cinematic.blocking: Same lens and depth from the seam: the chair swings a short arc toward screen left and the exit, and Sơn steps behind it, never into it. Mây keeps her place by the exit and ignores the spare seat.
cinematic.performance: The chair suggests he might accept her family arrangement; his question strips the courtesy away, and Bà Hai lets the empty seat do her rebuking. No slammed chair, no shout, no leaning over the desk.
cinematic.focus: Keep his face and the unused cup visible; do not cut to isolated furniture.
cinematic.texture: Chair feet catch lightly on the shop floor, three tea surfaces remain undisturbed.
cinematic.sound_detail: Allow a modest chair scrape before the question, with no duplicate cup-setting sounds.
cinematic.rhythm: The scrape sets up the expectation of sitting in the first beat, the question defeats it in the second, and her silence is held to the end with only breath and steam moving.

clips.start_frame: Lamp-lit teak desk with three untouched tea cups; the empty visitor chair angled toward the rear exit, Sơn standing beside it with the red ledger under his left arm; Bà Hai seated behind the desk, holder between her right fingers; Mây standing near the rear door.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bà Hai lifts one cup from its saucer with her left hand, jade bracelet sliding at her wrist, and holds it out across the desk toward Sơn, inviting them to drink against the cold night.
