clips.start_frame: Shade of the side-lane wall: Mây crouched at the corner, Sơn standing at her shoulder; both looking past the corner toward Bảy's stall, Sơn's eyes on its rear door down the lane; the bright open road beyond the wall's edge.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn's eyes go from the stall's rear door to the open road, and he lays out the split in a low voice, his right hand pointing to the road, then to the lane behind the stall. Beat 2 (3.5–6.5s): Mây looks at him for one beat, weighing it, then nods and gives her warning as she rises from her crouch, a hand on her duty pouch. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She slips away along the side lane toward the stall's rear, low against the wall; Sơn waits until she is clear, tugs his jacket straight with his right hand and steps out of the shade toward the bright road.
clips.end_frame: Mây moving low along the side lane toward the stall's rear, several paces away; Sơn stepping out of the wall's shade onto the edge of the bright road, right hand at his side, bandaged left wrist close to his body, face set toward the stall.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi ra kéo Dũng về phía chợ. Cô vòng cửa sau, đưa Thành với chú Bảy ra.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Giữ khoảng cách, đừng để hắn dồn vô góc.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: coastal sun filtered through half-raised shutters in bright slats, cooler market shade with soft bounce from wet concrete.

cinematic.intent: Make the plan a division of responsibility shaped by who is actually in danger.
cinematic.composition: Use the wall edge to keep both concealed and the rear stall route in shared view.
cinematic.blocking: Wall corner mid-frame; the side lane runs away at screen left toward the stall's rear, the open road lies at screen right. Mây exits left along the lane, Sơn exits right into the light; their paths split at the corner.
cinematic.performance: Sơn offers himself as bait plainly, without swagger, already accepting the risk; Mây accepts the role because it is useful, not because he ordered it, and her warning carries real worry. No heroic glance, no lingering goodbye.
cinematic.focus: Keep their eyelines tied to the two separate routes, no map insert required.
cinematic.texture: Rough wall shade and bright road create a clear boundary they are about to cross.
cinematic.sound_detail: The instruction stays low and quick against distant stall voices, no whispered exposition chorus.
cinematic.rhythm: One look at the routes, a quick allocation and answer, then two people moving in opposite directions; the clip ends in motion on the line between shade and light.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged. Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook and radio handset; her belt carries no handcuffs, both pairs having been used in the city.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần, cổ tay trái quấn băng trắng. Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen và bộ đàm; thắt lưng không có còng vì hai bộ còng đã dùng ở thành phố, còng mới chỉ nhận ở 35.1.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Trục đường chính thị trấn biển Hòn Sóng (D6 morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mắt Sơn đi từ cửa sau của quán ra con đường trống; anh nói khẽ cách chia việc, tay phải chỉ ra đường rồi chỉ con hẻm sau quán. Nhịp 2 (3.5–6.5s): Mây nhìn anh một nhịp, cân nhắc, rồi gật đầu và dặn lại, đứng dậy khỏi tư thế ngồi thụp, tay chạm túi công tác. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Cô men theo hẻm phụ về phía sau quán, người thấp sát tường; Sơn chờ cô đi khuất rồi kéo thẳng vạt áo bằng tay phải, bước khỏi bóng tường ra con đường sáng. Sơn nói ở nhịp 1, Mây đáp ở nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: DUTY_POUCH.

clips.start_frame: Sunlit main street: Sơn standing in the open road a dozen paces from the coffee stall, empty hands at his sides, bandaged left wrist visible; Dũng at the stall threshold under the green awning, work bag across his body; market entrance down the road behind Sơn.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn calls Dũng's name across the street and dares him to follow for the red ledger, both hands open and empty; Dũng's head snaps toward him. Beat 2 (3.5–6.5s): Without waiting, Sơn turns his back and walks toward the market entrance at an even pace; Dũng takes two steps off the threshold, glances back into the stall, then commits. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Dũng strides after him down the road, the cut cuff ring glinting at his right wrist, the gap between him and the stall opening wide; the stall entrance stands empty under the awning.
clips.end_frame: Sơn walking away toward the market entrance, empty hands at his sides; Dũng striding after him a dozen paces behind, work bag swinging, cut cuff ring at his right wrist; the coffee stall's entrance empty under its green awning behind them.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Dũng! Sổ đỏ của Bà Hai ở chỗ tao. Muốn lấy thì bỏ cái quán đó, theo tao vô chợ.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: coastal sun filtered through half-raised shutters in bright slats, cooler market shade with soft bounce from wet concrete.

cinematic.intent: Turn Sơn's visibility into bait that opens space for someone else rather than a heroic confrontation.
cinematic.composition: Keep him in the open road, Dũng at the stall threshold and market entrance ahead.
cinematic.blocking: Stall at screen left, market entrance at screen right down the road; Sơn moves left to right away from the stall and Dũng follows on the same line. Sơn's hands stay open and empty; he never turns to face Dũng.
cinematic.performance: His certainty is a performance aimed at Dũng's pride, while underneath he is counting steps and hoping Dũng bites. Dũng's hesitation is real for a moment, then greed wins. No swagger, no taunting gesture, no fighting stance.
cinematic.focus: Hold the widening gap between Dũng and stall, because that opening is the action's purpose.
cinematic.texture: Sunlit road and cool market mouth distinguish the exposed lure from the safer route.
cinematic.sound_detail: His call should carry across the street naturally, footsteps following without a chase sting.
cinematic.rhythm: The call lands at once, the turn and walk give Dũng a beat to choose, and the clip finishes after he commits, with the stall standing clear.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged. Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder, cut steel cuff ring hanging on his RIGHT wrist from the garage escape.

clips.start_frame: Covered rear lane at the stall's back door: Mây stepping in through the half-open door; Thành on a stool just inside, wrists tied, glasses bent; Bảy crouched by his chair; two civilians pressed against the counter end; Thành's folder on the map table by the door.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây drops to one knee at Thành's stool, takes a small cutter from her duty pouch and severs the ties at his wrists, telling him to get the people out with Bảy. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Thành's hands come apart; he drags in a full breath, pushes his bent glasses up and nods, eyes clearing, while Bảy hauls the rear door wide onto the lane. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Bảy waves the two civilians through, a hand on each back in turn; Thành gets up and takes his leather folder from the map table, and Mây rises, sliding the cutter back into her pouch, eyes toward the street side.
clips.end_frame: Thành on his feet by the rear door, freed wrists, leather folder in hand, bent glasses on; Bảy at the wide-open door ushering the second civilian out into the lane; Mây risen from her knee, hand at her duty pouch, eyes toward the street side.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Thành, đi với chú Bảy, đưa bà con ra lối sau đồn. Không ai đuổi theo Dũng.

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: coastal sun filtered through half-raised shutters in bright slats, cooler market shade with soft bounce from wet concrete.

cinematic.intent: Pay off the lure with released people, not another round of threats.
cinematic.composition: Frame rear doorway, Thành's chair and Bảy's exit path so the rescue is legible.
cinematic.blocking: Rear door at screen right opening onto the covered lane; Thành's stool centre, map table at screen left. Mây kneels at Thành's left side; Bảy moves from the chair to the door; civilians pass behind Thành and out to the right.
cinematic.performance: Thành gets his breath and composure back before he stands, embarrassed relief turning into duty; Mây keeps him on task with a level voice and no comfort. Bảy is practical, a host clearing his place. No hugs, no thanks, no celebration.
cinematic.focus: Keep the freed wrists and the open civilian route visible together without a separate cutting insert.
cinematic.texture: Bent glasses, chair legs and narrow threshold preserve the cramped physical setting.
cinematic.sound_detail: Tie release, moving chairs and her short instruction replace the louder street confrontation.
cinematic.rhythm: Thành is freed first in one clean motion, the door and civilians follow without a pause, and the clip ends with the rear route working and people already leaving.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook and radio handset; her belt carries no handcuffs, both pairs having been used in the city. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and round glasses knocked askew, their right arm bent from the stall struggle; his wrists are tied at the start, his leather evidence folder and police radio handset lying on the map table by the rear door. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

clips.start_frame: Landward fish-market entrance in morning shade: Sơn a step from the half-raised shutter, a wheeled cart parked beside it; Dũng several paces behind on the sunlit concrete, closing in; the narrow aisle dark and wet beyond the entrance.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Dũng shouts after him, gaining; Sơn does not look back and slips through the narrow gap between the shutter post and the cart into the aisle mouth. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): As he passes, his right hand catches the cart's handle and swings it behind him; the cart rolls across the gap on rattling wheels and jams against the shutter post, its crates shaking. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Dũng pulls up at the cart, slaps its edge and turns sideways to look for a way round; beyond it, Sơn is already moving deeper into the aisle, his back to the entrance.
clips.end_frame: Wheeled cart jammed across the entrance gap against the shutter post; Dũng on the sunlit side, one hand on its edge, turning to go around; Sơn beyond the cart in the shaded aisle mouth, moving away into the market.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Chui vô chợ là tự chui vô rọ đó Sơn! Đứng lại nộp sổ ra đây!

clips.lighting: Present-day morning: coastal sun filtered through half-raised shutters in bright slats, cooler market shade with soft bounce from wet concrete.

cinematic.intent: Let the market layout change the terms of pursuit before anyone throws another blow.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide entrance view with Sơn beyond the cart and Dũng still approaching it.
cinematic.blocking: Entrance at screen right; Sơn moves left to right through the gap between shutter post and cart into the aisle, and Dũng follows on the same line from the sunlit street at screen left. The cart ends across the gap between them.
cinematic.performance: Sơn's calm is a choice: he keeps moving and never gives Dũng the satisfaction of a look back. Dũng's frustration becomes a quick, thinking stop, not cartoon rage. No grin, no taunt over the shoulder.
cinematic.focus: Both sides of the obstruction remain readable, preserving the next aisle's screen direction.
cinematic.texture: Cart wheels, shutter edges and concrete show a practical market bottleneck.
cinematic.sound_detail: Wheel rattle and following boots continue into the next scene's aisle sound.
cinematic.rhythm: Dũng's shout and Sơn's slip through come together, the cart's swing is the single sharp accent, and the clip ends on the divided route with both men still in motion.

dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Thành bảo vệ lối dân trong khi bị giữ, không chỉ chờ người cứu.

scenes.title: Lối Qua Chợ Cá
scenes.purpose: Dân hỗ trợ thoát người, lực lượng hỗ trợ xử lý đám truy đuổi.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Let market noise end before establishing night lighthouse wind and Bà Hai already waiting. No second market confrontation.

clips.start_frame: Narrow fish-market aisle in morning shade: Sơn just past the entry cart, moving deeper between crate stacks on wet concrete; two pursuers in dark clothes entering the aisle far behind him; an aisle junction ahead.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The tracking move runs level with Sơn as he walks at a hard pace down the wet aisle, right hand brushing the crate stacks, breath steady and audible. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He sidesteps around a tall stack of plastic crates that juts into the aisle, putting it between himself and the two pursuers; when they reach it they have to squeeze past one at a time and lose steps. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn reaches the junction where two aisles cross, slows half a step to read both ways and chooses one, his weight already turning into it as the move eases to a stop with him.
clips.end_frame: Sơn at the aisle junction, weight turning into the cross aisle, right hand on a crate edge, breathing steadily; behind him the tall crate stack narrows the aisle, the two pursuers squeezing past it single file several stacks back.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Lối chợ hẹp, tụi nó càng đông càng chậm. Mỗi chồng thùng tách Dũng khỏi đám tay chân thêm một bước.

clips.lighting: Same morning fish-market light as scene 29: top light through roof gaps, bright exits backlit for clear geography, cool shade in the aisles.

cinematic.intent: Keep pursuit suspense in distance and obstruction rather than multiplying attacks.
cinematic.composition: Track with Sơn in the established direction, crate stacks repeatedly separating the two lines.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn moves screen left to right along the aisle with the tracking move level beside him; pursuers enter at screen left in depth. The jutting crate stack sits between them; the junction opens at screen right.
cinematic.performance: Controlled urgency: pace and breath carry it, not panic. He trusts the layout instead of looking back, with the calculation of a man who used to do the chasing. No repeated head turns, no smirk.
cinematic.focus: Keep the next junction readable ahead, no zoom or rack reset to a trailing face.
cinematic.texture: Damp aisle concrete and ordinary stacked containers give his route friction and scale.
cinematic.sound_detail: Continuous footsteps and cart noise replace music-driven acceleration or invented impacts.
cinematic.rhythm: Steady hard walking, one change in distance when the crates choke the pursuers, then a short decision at the junction that keeps his body moving.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần, cổ tay trái quấn băng trắng.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong chợ cá Hòn Sóng (D6 morning) · Góc máy: Máy trượt ngang (35mm Tracking) — bám sát bước chân và nhịp di chuyển nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Máy lướt ngang song song với Sơn khi anh đi rảo bước dọc lối chợ ướt, tay phải quệt qua các chồng thùng, hơi thở đều và nghe rõ. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Anh né vòng qua một chồng thùng nhựa cao chìa ra lối đi, đặt nó giữa mình và hai kẻ đuổi phía sau; tới đó chúng phải lách qua từng người một, mất mấy bước. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn tới ngã tư lối chợ, chậm nửa bước nhìn hai phía rồi chọn một lối, trọng tâm đã xoay vào đó, máy dừng lại cùng anh. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy qua nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Máy trượt ngang (35mm Tracking) — bám sát bước chân và nhịp di chuyển nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người.

clips.start_frame: Wet market aisle beside a side door: Bảy and two fish sellers by a loaded wheeled ice cart against the near wall, Bảy's checkered cloth on his shoulder, the metal side door open behind them; Sơn approaching down the empty aisle.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bảy points Sơn toward the rear exit and tells him the cart is theirs to handle; Sơn passes the cart without breaking stride. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The moment he clears it, Bảy and the two sellers shove the ice cart off the wall and it swings across the aisle on scraping wet wheels, ice sliding in the tubs; a few steps on, Sơn thanks Bảy over his shoulder and tells him to get inside. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The cart wedges wall to wall; the sellers hurry through the side door, Bảy last, pulling the metal door shut behind him, while beyond the cart Sơn walks on toward the bright rear exit.
clips.end_frame: Ice cart wedged wall to wall across the empty aisle, meltwater dripping from its tubs; the metal side door shut with Bảy and the sellers behind it; Sơn far down the aisle toward the bright rear exit, still walking.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Chú Sơn, chạy thẳng ra cửa sau, trống trơn hà. Xe đá để tui với bà con lo.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Cảm ơn chú. Vô trong đóng cửa liền đi.

clips.lighting: Same morning fish-market light as scene 29: top light through roof gaps, bright exits backlit for clear geography, cool shade in the aisles.

cinematic.intent: Make the townspeople useful by closing a route after a person escapes, then protecting themselves.
cinematic.composition: Frame Bảy's side door, Sơn passing and the empty aisle the cart will block.
cinematic.blocking: Side door in the near wall at screen left; Sơn travels screen left to right toward the rear exit. The cart starts against the near wall beside the door and swings across the aisle behind him; Bảy and the sellers end inside the door.
cinematic.performance: Bảy's people are practical and brave without wanting a fight: quick nods, firm hands on the cart, no cheering. Sơn's thanks is short and real, his worry for them sharper than for himself. No heroic posing.
cinematic.focus: Keep cart clearance and the closing civilian door in the same wide view.
cinematic.texture: Melting ice, wet wheels and door metal ground the improvised barrier in daily work.
cinematic.sound_detail: Bảy's direction stays short above wheel scrape, then the door closes the civilian sound away.
cinematic.rhythm: The order is everything: Sơn through, cart across, door shut; each step follows the last without a gap, and the clip ends on a blocked aisle and safe civilians.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần, cổ tay trái quấn băng trắng. Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly, tay thao tác với khay ly cà phê hoặc thùng nhựa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong chợ cá Hòn Sóng (D6 morning) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Ông Bảy chỉ Sơn ra cửa sau, nói xe đá để ông và bà con lo; Sơn lướt qua chiếc xe không chậm bước. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Sơn vừa qua khỏi, ông Bảy cùng hai người bán cá đẩy xe đá rời vách, bánh xe ướt rít lên, xe xoay ngang lối đi, đá trượt trong thùng; Sơn đi thêm mấy bước, ngoái nửa người cảm ơn và giục ông vào trong. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Xe đá chèn kín từ vách này sang vách kia; hai người bán cá vội vào cửa hông, ông Bảy vào sau cùng, kéo cánh cửa sắt đóng lại; phía bên kia xe, Sơn đi tiếp về phía cửa sau sáng rõ. Ông Bảy nói ở nhịp 1, Sơn đáp ở nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (COFFEE_TRAY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo · Đạo cụ khóa: COFFEE_TRAY.

clips.start_frame: Rear market exit onto a quiet residential lane, morning light: Mây and Thành standing at the exit's edge, Thành holding his folder and radio, taped glasses on; two support officers coming up the lane behind them; the market's dim rear passage ahead.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Two separated pursuers burst out of the market's rear passage and pull up short at the sight of Mây and Thành on the line; Mây gives her orders, planted at the exit's edge with one arm out to keep the lane behind her clear. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The two support officers step past her, take the men by the arms, turn them to the wall and cuff them with their own cuffs; the men do not resist. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Thành moves to the mouth of the residential lane and stands aside to keep it open, radio raised; Mây looks down the empty lane, then back at the arrest, her shoulders easing a fraction.
clips.end_frame: Two pursuers facing the wall, cuffed and held by the support officers; Thành at the mouth of the residential lane, radio raised, keeping it open; Mây at the exit's edge looking from the clear lane to the arrest; the lane behind them empty.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Hai tên đó để tổ hỗ trợ còng. Thành, giữ hẻm sau thông, đừng để dân kẹt lại.

clips.lighting: Same morning fish-market light as scene 29: top light through roof gaps, bright exits backlit for clear geography, cool shade in the aisles.

cinematic.intent: Show support arriving where evacuation needs it rather than materializing to win a fight.
cinematic.composition: Use the rear-exit wide view to separate civilian escape from restrained pursuers.
cinematic.blocking: Market rear passage at screen left, residential lane running away at screen right. Mây holds the line between them; the officers take the two men against the wall at centre; Thành moves right to the lane mouth. The lane stays clear.
cinematic.performance: Mây's priority shows in her eyes: the lane first, the arrest second. Thành, still shaken and squinting through taped glasses, chooses to be useful. Both keep their authority quiet. No shouting, no rough handling, no victory look.
cinematic.focus: Keep the protected lane open in frame, not filled by an unnecessary crowd.
cinematic.texture: Plain work clothing and repaired glasses retain consequences from the stall rescue.
cinematic.sound_detail: Commands and cuff handling remain local and measured, with no crowd battle layer.
cinematic.rhythm: The pursuers' arrival and her order land together, the custody is economical, and the clip ends on the open, protected lane as the real gain.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook and radio handset; her belt carries no handcuffs, both pairs having been used in the city. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and round glasses, their bent right arm now held with white tape, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen và bộ đàm; thắt lưng không có còng vì hai bộ còng đã dùng ở thành phố, còng mới chỉ nhận ở 35.1. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính tròn có gọng phải cong đã quấn băng keo trắng sau lúc bảo vệ dân ở quán nước, tay kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Lối thoát hiểm phía sau chợ cá thông ra khu dân cư (D6 morning) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hai kẻ đuổi theo bị tách lẻ lao ra khỏi lối sau chợ rồi khựng lại khi thấy Mây và Thành chặn đường; Mây ra lệnh, đứng vững ở mép cửa, một tay giang ngang giữ con hẻm phía sau. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Hai cán bộ hỗ trợ bước qua cô, nắm tay hai gã, xoay mặt chúng vào tường và còng bằng còng của tổ; hai gã không chống cự. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Thành đi tới miệng hẻm dân cư, đứng nép sang một bên giữ lối thông, bộ đàm giơ lên; Mây nhìn dọc con hẻm trống rồi nhìn lại vụ bắt, vai hơi chùng xuống. Mây nói ở nhịp 1.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo · Đạo cụ khóa: DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD.

clips.start_frame: Inside the blocked aisle: the wedged ice cart between them; Dũng on the near side, breathing hard, phone in his left hand, work bag across his body; Sơn a few paces beyond the cart facing him, empty hands at his sides.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Dũng stops testing the cart and raises his phone instead, holding its screen out toward Sơn, a ship schedule glowing as plain rows, as he taunts him for hiding while Hạ's ship waits. Beat 2 (3.5–6.5s): Sơn's eyes go to the screen and stay; his jaw tightens and his breath catches, then he answers flatly that Bà Hai should come and talk to him herself, his empty hands unmoving. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Dũng holds his stare a moment longer and lowers the phone slowly to his thigh without stepping closer; meltwater drips off the cart between them, and neither man moves.
clips.end_frame: Dũng on his side of the wedged ice cart, phone lowered to his thigh with its schedule still lit, eyes on Sơn; Sơn beyond the cart, empty hands at his sides, jaw set; meltwater dripping between them.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Cứ núp sau dân chợ đi Sơn. Trốn thêm một ngày nữa là con Hạ lên tàu.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Muốn sổ thì bảo Bà Hai ra mặt nói với tao.

clips.lighting: Same morning fish-market light as scene 29: top light through roof gaps, bright exits backlit for clear geography, cool shade in the aisles.

cinematic.intent: Let Dũng recover pressure through time after losing immediate control of the aisle.
cinematic.composition: Keep the obstruction between him and Sơn visible in the medium framing.
cinematic.blocking: The ice cart sits across frame centre as the barrier; Dũng at screen left on the near side, Sơn at screen right beyond it, each about two arm's lengths away. Phone in Dũng's left hand; nobody crosses or climbs the cart.
cinematic.performance: Dũng swaps force for time: he is calm because the deadline does his work, and that stillness is the threat. Sơn takes the hit in his breath and answers by pushing the fight up to Bà Hai. No lunge, no snarl, no clenched fists.
cinematic.focus: The phone is evidence of leverage, not readable text requiring a screen insert.
cinematic.texture: Cold reflected light from wet crates contrasts with his exposed arms and heavy posture.
cinematic.sound_detail: His plain threat interrupts market movement, no ominous device buzz added afterward.
cinematic.rhythm: The phone comes up with the threat, Sơn's reaction and answer take the middle, and the slow lowering of the phone closes a deadlock that is now about time, not distance.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged. Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder, cut steel cuff ring hanging on his RIGHT wrist from the garage escape.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần, cổ tay trái quấn băng trắng. Dũng mặc áo thun đen sát nách, tai TRÁI đeo khuyên bạc hình chiếc đinh, đeo chéo túi vải bố đen dày đựng đồ nghề qua ngực, trên cổ tay PHẢI còn lủng lẳng chiếc vòng còng sắt bị cắt đứt xích từ hầm xe.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong chợ cá Hòn Sóng (D6 morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (TOOL_BAG).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Dũng thôi thử đẩy xe đá, giơ điện thoại chìa màn hình về phía Sơn, lịch tàu sáng lên thành những hàng khối, vừa mỉa Sơn cứ núp trong khi tàu chờ Hạ. Nhịp 2 (3.5–6.5s): Mắt Sơn dừng trên màn hình; quai hàm siết, hơi thở khựng lại, rồi anh đáp gọn rằng muốn sổ thì bảo Bà Hai ra mặt, hai tay trống vẫn buông yên. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Dũng nhìn trừng thêm một nhịp rồi hạ điện thoại chậm xuống đùi, không bước lên; nước đá tan nhỏ giọt từ xe giữa hai người, không ai nhúc nhích. Dũng nói ở nhịp 1, Sơn trả lời ở nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (TOOL_BAG) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: TOOL_BAG.

clips.start_frame: Landward market entrance seen from its shade: Sơn standing just inside beside the jammed cart; out on the sunlit road, Dũng and two of his men backing toward the black car, its rear door open; road dust in the light.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Walking backward toward the car, Dũng points at Sơn across the road and names the place and time, his two men flanking him, while Sơn stays where he is in the shade. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): Dũng finishes with the condition, the book and no company, then turns his back and drops into the rear seat; his men climb in after him and the doors slam. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): The engine catches and the black car reverses away down the road, tyres crunching grit, dust lifting; Sơn holds his place inside the entrance, right hand on the cart's handle, eyes following the car.
clips.end_frame: The black car reversing away down the sunlit road, dust hanging behind it; Sơn standing inside the shaded market entrance beside the jammed cart, right hand on its handle, bandaged left wrist at his side, eyes following the car.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Tối nay Bà Hai chờ mày trên hải đăng. Muốn cứu con Hạ thì đem sổ, đi một mình.

clips.lighting: Same morning fish-market light as scene 29: top light through roof gaps, bright exits backlit for clear geography, cool shade in the aisles.

cinematic.intent: Move the story from chase to dangerous negotiation through Dũng's withdrawal.
cinematic.composition: Keep the market entrance, retreating men and car relationship clear in the wide shot.
cinematic.blocking: Market entrance in the foreground at screen left with Sơn in its shade; road and black car at screen right in depth. Dũng backs away from the entrance toward the car; Sơn never steps out into the light.
cinematic.performance: Dũng gives the order like a man who still holds the cards, not a beaten one; his contempt is calm. Sơn listens without a flicker and lets him go, already weighing the invitation. No snarl, no chase.
cinematic.focus: Hold enough street depth to show departure without a new car-start close-up.
cinematic.texture: Road dust and dark car surfaces contrast with the wet interior from which Sơn watches.
cinematic.sound_detail: Engine and tire movement begin only as the car withdraws, under the meeting instruction.
cinematic.rhythm: The instruction comes while Dũng is already withdrawing, the car doors close the exchange, and the departure carries the last seconds with Sơn still and watching.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged. Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder, cut steel cuff ring hanging on his RIGHT wrist from the garage escape.

screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Cổng vào chợ cá Hòn Sóng phía đất liền (D6 morning) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (TOOL_BAG).

clips.start_frame: Rear market exit in morning light: Thành seated on an upturned crate by the doorway, leather folder on his knees, glasses with one bent arm held by tape; Mây standing before him, notebook open in her hand; Sơn a few steps back against the wall.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.0s): Mây looks straight at Thành and, in a low voice, owns what her absence cost the town; she writes a short list on a notebook page as she says she will keep enough people here until tomorrow night. Beat 2 (4.0–7.0s): She tears the page out and holds it to him; Thành pushes his taped glasses up, takes the page and answers with a small, tired nod. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Thành slides the roster into his leather folder and starts to rise from the crate, radio in his other hand; Mây steps aside to let him up, and behind them Sơn looks down the lane toward the reopening market.
clips.end_frame: Thành rising from the crate, the roster tucked in his leather folder, radio in his other hand, taped glasses on; Mây half a step aside, notebook closing; Sơn against the wall behind them, looking down the lane toward the market as it reopens.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Chị đi vắng, thị trấn gánh thay. Từ giờ tới tối mai, chị giữ đủ người ở đây.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Kính dán lại vẫn thấy rõ chị. Em nhận ca.

clips.lighting: Same morning fish-market light as scene 29: top light through roof gaps, bright exits backlit for clear geography, cool shade in the aisles.

cinematic.intent: Make restoring protection an acknowledgement of cost instead of another empty tactical assurance.
cinematic.composition: Frame Thành seated safely, damaged glasses visible, Sơn present but not the center of the apology.
cinematic.blocking: Rear exit doorway at screen left; Thành seated on a crate beside it, Mây standing facing him at centre, Sơn against the wall at screen right in the background. The page passes from Mây's right hand to Thành's right hand.
cinematic.performance: Mây owns the cost plainly, without asking to be forgiven; her guilt shows only in how steady she keeps her voice. Thành, still shaky, chooses duty over complaint and gives her no reassurance. No apology speech, no salute.
cinematic.focus: Keep her look toward him and the practical roster visible together, no reaction insert.
cinematic.texture: The bent glasses and temporary rear-exit seat keep the consequences materially present.
cinematic.sound_detail: The market begins ordinary work at a distance, leaving the line without heroic scoring.
cinematic.rhythm: Her admission gets a clear, unhurried beat, the handover is simple, and the clip ends on Thành getting up to do the job as ordinary market sound returns.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged. Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook and radio handset; her belt carries no handcuffs, both pairs having been used in the city. scenes.title: Bà Hai Ở Hải Đăng
scenes.purpose: Bà Hai muốn lấy lại Sơn, anh đặt điều kiện gặp trực tiếp Hạ.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Introduce clinic room tone over footsteps leaving the tower. The clinic meeting remains the same night.

clips.start_frame: Night on the lighthouse gallery: Bà Hai near the sea rail, unlit holder in her right fingers; Dũng a pace to her left, work bag across his chest; Sơn in the open stair door, one copied ledger page in his right hand.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn steps out of the stair door and stops four paces short of Dũng, outside his reach, as Bà Hai turns to him and calls him home in a soft, familiar voice; Dũng's weight rocks forward and settles. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Sơn's shoulders draw in a fraction, the old reflex of obeying her, then square; without moving his feet he answers, lifting the thin copied page slightly in his right hand. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Bà Hai's eyes drop to the page and her holder stills; Dũng's gaze follows; Sơn holds his spot, wind snapping at his jacket, the stairway open at his back.
clips.end_frame: Sơn just outside the stair door, copied page in his right hand, stair route clear behind him; Bà Hai by the sea rail, holder still in her right fingers, eyes on the page; Dũng a pace from her, hands loose, watching it too; violet silk and jacket hems moving in the wind.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Gió trên này lạnh lắm con. Về nhà với má đi.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Con không về. Con tới để má coi cái này.

clips.lighting: Present-day lighthouse night in wind: one practical lamp as hard side key, cool moonlit sea as rim from the south rail; no daylight.

cinematic.intent: Let the invitation home compete with the visible fact that Dũng can block the stairs.
cinematic.composition: Keep Bà Hai, Dũng and the stair emergence in the same wind-exposed wide frame.
cinematic.blocking: Stair door screen right, sea rail and lamp screen left. Bà Hai at the rail, Dũng a pace to her left, Sơn holding at the door about four paces from Dũng. Copy in Sơn's right hand; Dũng's bag across his chest.
cinematic.performance: Bà Hai offers home, not a summons: warmth with ownership underneath. Sơn wants her to see he came on his own terms; the pull to obey shows only in his shoulders. No villain smirk, no defiant pose.
cinematic.focus: Keep the paper unmistakably thin, not the red original ledger suddenly appearing in his hands.
cinematic.texture: Violet silk and rough iron rail move differently in the wind, making shelter conspicuously absent.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her soft voice stays close despite the gale, without a supernatural whisper treatment.
cinematic.rhythm: Arrival and invitation overlap from the first second; his short reply follows without a gap; the last seconds hold all three reading the page in the wind, the stair route still open.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged. Bà Hai wears her deep-violet silk áo bà ba, green jade bracelet on her LEFT wrist, holding her unlit black cigarette holder between her right fingers. Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder, cut steel cuff ring hanging on his RIGHT wrist from the garage escape.

clips.start_frame: Bà Hai and Sơn face each other across three metres of gallery, sea rail behind her, open stair door behind him; her unlit holder in her right fingers, his copied page lowered in his right hand.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bà Hai promises to wipe out his old debts, her voice almost bored with how often she has made such promises, the holder turning slowly in her fingers. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She adds that she will get the girl back for him, and on the last part, bringing Kiên into her hands, the holder stops and her eyes sharpen. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn does not step into the gap she leaves; he breathes out through his nose, gaze steady on her face, his right hand holding the page still against the wind.
clips.end_frame: Bà Hai and Sơn still three metres apart across the gallery, her holder motionless at her waist, eyes fixed on him; Sơn square to her, page in his lowered right hand, weight on his heels, breathing slow and even; stair door open behind him.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Nợ cũ má xóa hết. Con nhỏ đó má đòi về cho con. Chỉ cần dắt thằng Kiên tới tay má.

clips.lighting: Present-day lighthouse night in wind: one practical lamp as hard side key, cool moonlit sea as rim from the south rail; no daylight.

cinematic.intent: Expose her need for Kiên while she continues to present control as motherly protection.
cinematic.composition: Hold the established gallery relation, with the gap between them as important as their faces.
cinematic.blocking: Same gallery line as the wide: Bà Hai screen left by the sea rail, Sơn screen right near the stair door, the gap between them unchanged. Holder in her right fingers, copy in his right hand.
cinematic.performance: She offers rescue as routine, a mother settling accounts, then lets the real price harden on Kiên's name. Sơn hides how much the word debts tempts him and gives her nothing to read. No sneer, no pleading eyes.
cinematic.focus: Keep attention on whether he moves, not a decorative push toward the sea.
cinematic.texture: Her composed clothing remains ordered against the wind, his ordinary jacket less protected.
cinematic.sound_detail: Wind stays consistent under the offer, with no fresh threat motif or distant invented vehicle.
cinematic.rhythm: The promise unrolls first and gets its persuasive beat; the condition lands late and sharp; the last stretch belongs to his refusal to move, held as a living stillness.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged. Bà Hai wears her deep-violet silk áo bà ba, green jade bracelet on her LEFT wrist, holding her unlit black cigarette holder between her right fingers.

screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bà Hai hứa xóa hết nợ cũ cho Sơn, giọng như đã hứa câu này nhiều lần, cây tẩu xoay chậm giữa các ngón tay. clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.0s): Sơn asks whether she even knows where Hạ is now, saying Hạ's name plainly and calling her má with a tired, disappointed edge, his chin lifting a little on the question. Beat 2 (4.0–7.0s): Bà Hai holds her ground and her gaze, but her lips part and close without a word and her thumb presses the holder against her fingers; only the wind fills the gap. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Sơn reads the silence, a muscle in his jaw tightening; his eyes leave her and travel to the open stair door as his weight eases onto his rear foot.
clips.end_frame: Bà Hai silent by the sea rail, gaze held level past Sơn, holder pressed in her right fingers; Sơn turned half toward the open stair door, page low in his right hand, weight on his rear foot, jacket stirring in the wind.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Má bán Hạ cho hắn. Giờ Hạ ở đâu, má có biết không?

clips.lighting: Present-day lighthouse night in wind: one practical lamp as hard side key, cool moonlit sea as rim from the south rail; no daylight.

cinematic.intent: Make the question expose the limit of her supposed maternal knowledge.
cinematic.composition: Retain precisely the preceding medium composition and distance rather than switching to a revealing close-up.
cinematic.blocking: Nobody changes ground: Bà Hai stays screen left at the rail, Sơn screen right; only his head and shoulders turn toward the stair door behind him. The copy stays low in his right hand.
cinematic.performance: Sơn's question carries disappointed recognition: he suspects the answer and hates being right. Bà Hai hides that she does not know, letting pride stand in for an answer. No guilty flinch, no triumphant look.
cinematic.focus: Keep both faces readable so the missing answer belongs to her, not narration.
cinematic.texture: Wind touches her sleeve and his jacket while neither uses weather as a performance distraction.
cinematic.sound_detail: Let the question finish cleanly, then leave only the already-established wind for her silence.
cinematic.rhythm: The question is short and clean; the unanswered silence is the scene's new fact and is held; his turn toward the stairs grows slowly out of it.

screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–4.0s): Sơn hỏi bà có biết Hạ đang ở đâu không, gọi tên Hạ rõ ràng, tiếng má mang giọng mệt mỏi và thất vọng, cằm hơi ngẩng lên. Nhịp 2 (4.0–7.0s): Bà Hai đứng vững, giữ ánh nhìn, môi hé ra rồi khép lại không thành lời, ngón cái ấn cây tẩu vào các ngón; chỉ còn tiếng gió lấp khoảng trống. clips.start_frame: Sơn's bare right hand holds one copied ledger page open at chest height, signature shapes facing outward, one corner fluttering; the iron gallery rail and black sea lie below; his bandaged left wrist rests at the frame edge.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): His right thumb pins the fluttering corner so the handwritten signature shapes stand still in the lamp light, the page held out toward Bà Hai as his voice, off frame, begins. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): While he finishes, his left hand, bandage at the wrist, comes up and folds the page into quarters, pressing each crease hard with the thumbnail. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The right hand slides the folded square into the inner pocket of his olive jacket, flattens the cloth over it and drops away, leaving only the rail and the wind-blown dark below.
clips.end_frame: The folded copy hidden in the inner pocket of Sơn's olive jacket, his bare right hand lowering at his side, bandaged left wrist at the frame edge; no paper or book left in view, only the iron rail and the dark sea moving below.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Chữ ký này má nhận ra mà. Bản gốc không ở trên người tôi, đụng tôi cũng vô ích.

clips.lighting: Present-day lighthouse night in wind: one practical lamp as hard side key, cool moonlit sea as rim from the south rail; no daylight.

cinematic.intent: Show that he keeps the evidence boundary even while still emotionally caught by her.
cinematic.composition: Use one detail plane for copied paper, signature shapes, pocket and gallery rail below.
cinematic.blocking: Page held at chest height facing Bà Hai, who is off frame left; rail and sea below the hands. Right hand shows and stows, left hand folds; the inner pocket sits on the left side of his jacket.
cinematic.performance: Measured hands: the fold is his refusal to leave anything within her reach. He shows just enough to be believed and not a second more. No trembling, no flourish, no slapping the page.
cinematic.focus: Keep the copy thin and original absent, with no legible names generated on paper.
cinematic.texture: The light page catches wind against dark jacket cloth, demanding a steady grip.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper creases and his off-screen explanation remain clear without an artificial threatening bass.
cinematic.rhythm: The showing is short and steady under his first words; the fold takes its time as he finishes; the last seconds settle on the empty hand and the secured pocket.

clips.start_frame: Bà Hai near the sea rail, Dũng half a pace ahead of her left shoulder, weight already tipped toward Sơn; Sơn by the open stair door, empty hands at his sides; her unlit holder in her right fingers.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Dũng takes one heavy step toward Sơn, the cut cuff ring swinging on his right wrist; Bà Hai's left hand rises, palm out, jade bracelet sliding down, and stops him as she tells him to stay put. Beat 2 (2.5–7.0s): Without looking at Dũng she agrees to come to the harbour tomorrow and orders Sơn to keep his word, a shade too firmly; Sơn answers at once with his condition: open ground, Hạ standing in front of him. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Dũng's jaw works but his boots stay planted behind her hand; Bà Hai's eyes narrow, weighing Sơn; Sơn stays by the stair door, breathing evenly.
clips.end_frame: Dũng halted behind Bà Hai's raised left hand, breathing hard through his nose; Bà Hai between them, eyes on Sơn; Sơn by the open stair door, hands at his sides; wind moving his jacket and her violet sleeve.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Dũng, đứng yên đó. Mai má ra cảng. Con nhớ giữ lời.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Giữa bãi cảng, chỗ trống. Hạ phải đứng trước mặt tôi.

clips.lighting: Present-day lighthouse night in wind: one practical lamp as hard side key, cool moonlit sea as rim from the south rail; no daylight.

cinematic.intent: Reveal that her remaining power depends on stopping Dũng, not simply ordering Sơn.
cinematic.composition: Frame raised hand, Dũng's halted step and Sơn's stair position in the same medium setup.
cinematic.blocking: Dũng starts a pace left of Bà Hai and gets no farther than her raised left hand, well short of halfway; Sơn keeps his place by the stair door screen right, the usable gap intact.
cinematic.performance: Bà Hai needs this deal more than she shows: the order to Dũng is calm, the instruction to Sơn a touch too absolute. Dũng resents the leash but obeys. Sơn bargains coldly. No shouting, no snarl.
cinematic.focus: Keep the spatial stop visible rather than substituting a tight bracelet insert.
cinematic.texture: The left jade bracelet remains on the raised wrist, sleeves lifting naturally in the gallery wind.
cinematic.sound_detail: One halted footstep and her short acceptance carry the power change, no added ring or chime.
cinematic.rhythm: The step, the check and her order come together at the top; acceptance and his condition trade without a pause; the end holds the new balance of power in silence.

clips.start_frame: Night at the foot of the lighthouse: Mây waiting beside the open iron entrance, radio handset at her belt, eyes on the spiral stair inside; the main path leads away past the motorcycle space.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn comes down the last turn of the spiral stair and out through the iron doorway, steady on his feet, and as Mây falls in beside him he starts his report: Bà Hai will come to the harbour. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): Eyes forward, he adds that Kiên must bring Hạ, and Mây answers with the next stop, the clinic and Doctor Linh, as they turn onto the main path. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): They lengthen their stride side by side down the path, their footsteps taking over from the tower wind, neither of them looking back at the lighthouse.
clips.end_frame: Sơn and Mây side by side on the main path, walking away from the lighthouse, the iron entrance open and empty behind them; grass bending in the night wind, their pace even.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Bà ấy sẽ ra cảng. Kiên muốn sổ thì phải dắt Hạ theo.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Về phòng khám. Bàn với bác sĩ Linh trước đã.

clips.lighting: Present-day lighthouse night in wind: one practical lamp as hard side key, cool moonlit sea as rim from the south rail; no daylight.

cinematic.intent: Return the solitary family confrontation to the shared rescue responsibility below.
cinematic.composition: Use the base-wide frame to show Mây waiting and the same main path leading away.
cinematic.blocking: Iron entrance screen left, main path running to screen right past the motorcycle space. Sơn exits toward Mây and both leave along that same path, Mây on his left.
cinematic.performance: Sơn reports only facts and keeps the wound of the meeting to himself. Mây hears what he leaves out and does not ask. No sigh of relief, no lingering look back at the tower.
cinematic.focus: Keep both figures and the open exit readable, no return to Bà Hai inside this clip.
cinematic.texture: Cool night stone and moving grass contrast with the gallery's intimate bargaining.
cinematic.sound_detail: Their footsteps take over from tower wind as the next clinic room tone approaches.
cinematic.rhythm: A quick exit straight into a two-line report on the move, a one-line answer, then a clean departure that carries the scene away from the tower.

scenes.title: Đường Rút Cho Người Sống
scenes.purpose: Kế hoạch cứu người có hỗ trợ, Tê không phải mẹo giả chết.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Flower-shop shutter sound introduces the memory after the current radio check. No repeated medical explanation.

clips.start_frame: Clinic at night: Linh standing at the desk beside the open sample cupboard, the sealed sample carton in both hands; his canvas medical bag and emergency note on the desk; Mây across the desk by the hand-drawn harbour sketch; Sơn by a green curtain.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Linh turns the sealed carton under the overhead light, thumb tracing the unbroken seal, and sets it on the cupboard shelf as Mây, palms flat on the desk, tells him to stand by in the lane behind the market. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He shuts the cupboard and turns the key while she finishes, never out onto the open harbour; pocketing the key, Linh answers that his breathing kit is ready. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He rests his left hand on the canvas medical bag and holds Mây's eyes as he finishes; Sơn, by the curtain, shifts his weight, arms loose.
clips.end_frame: Sample cupboard locked, key in Linh's coat pocket; Linh standing at the desk, left hand on his canvas medical bag, emergency note and pen before him, eyes on Mây; Mây across the desk beside the harbour sketch; Sơn by the green curtain, arms loose, breathing evenly.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Bác sĩ trực ở hẻm sau chợ. Tuyệt đối không ra giữa bãi cảng.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Đồ trợ thở tôi mang sẵn. Ai được đưa ra, tôi lo.

clips.lighting: Present-day clinic night: neutral overhead practicals as soft top key, cooler shadows at the curtains, dark windows.

cinematic.intent: Turn knowledge of Tê into a duty to prepare care rather than a clever method to exploit.
cinematic.composition: Keep Linh, sealed carton and Mây in the same medium clinic arrangement.
cinematic.blocking: Desk and locked cupboard screen left with Linh; Mây center across the desk with the sketch; Sơn screen right at the green curtain. Carton path: Linh's hands to the shelf at his left; the key ends in his coat pocket.
cinematic.performance: Linh is attentive and a little wary of how the substance could be used, never eager. Mây draws the line between his care and the danger zone with plain firmness. No conspiratorial glances, no lab-coat theatrics.
cinematic.focus: Keep the seal readable as intact; do not reveal contents or invented preparation details.
cinematic.texture: Green curtain and worn white coat provide the ordinary clinic context for a frightening substance.
cinematic.sound_detail: Cupboard latch and neutral ventilation under a clear sentence are enough, without a medical alarm cue.
cinematic.rhythm: The carton goes out of reach while she gives the order; the lock clicks on her last words; his calm reply ends the clip on readiness rather than drama.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn, from his place by the curtain, says that Dũng always carries Tê and takes people alive to make them talk, his voice dry and low, eyes dropping to the floor tiles for a moment. scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Một Lời Hứa Chưa Xong
scenes.purpose: Hạ đòi lời nói thật, bông hoa chỉ thuộc đêm quá khứ.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Match the closed shutter lines to the cabin frame at dawn, then carve the seventh tally once.

clips.start_frame: Night inside the flower shop: the front shutter fully raised over the rainy street; Hạ just inside it, both hands on the shutter's bottom bar above her head; Sơn by the open glass door, both black gloves on, right hand on its handle, watching the rain.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–1.5s): Hạ pulls the shutter down to waist height and lets go; the slats rattle and settle. Beat 2 (1.5–5.5s): Turning from the shutter toward him, she asks whether he will come back tomorrow, her voice direct and tired, and leaves the gap onto the wet pavement open. Beat 3 (5.5–10.0s): She walks back past the bucket rows to the counter and waits with her palms flat on it, not filling the silence; Sơn stays on the inside edge of the gap, rain behind him, and his eyes come slowly back from the street to her.
clips.end_frame: Shutter half lowered behind Sơn, the gap open onto the wet street; Sơn on its inside edge, right gloved hand on the open glass door's handle, eyes on Hạ; Hạ at the counter, palms flat, waiting; rain glittering in the street light.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Anh đứng nhìn mưa lâu vậy. Mai anh còn quay lại đây không?

clips.lighting: Recent-past flower-shop night: warm bulbs inside as key through the doorway, cool street-lamp spill and wet-pavement reflections outside.

cinematic.intent: Give Hạ the power to leave an opening while asking for honesty instead of reassurance.
cinematic.composition: Use the shutter gap and counter in the wide composition, Sơn still on the inside edge.
cinematic.blocking: Shutter and glass door screen left, counter screen right, bucket rows between them. Hạ's path runs from the shutter back to the counter; Sơn stays by the door on the inside edge of the gap.
cinematic.performance: Hạ is tired of evasion and wants honesty, not comfort; she has no idea this night is different. Sơn is already half gone and caught by her question. No foreboding looks, no tragic faces.
cinematic.focus: Keep the unused opening visible alongside her face and his hesitation at the doorway.
cinematic.texture: Warm shop bulbs, wet pavement beyond and shutter slats make the possible departure tangible.
cinematic.sound_detail: Shutter rattle settles before the question, leaving the ordinary shop room tone.
cinematic.rhythm: The shutter comes down in one pull and quiets; her question comes straight off it; the remaining seconds hold the open gap as his choice while she waits at the counter.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn (past timeline) wears his tailored matte-black suit, open-collar white shirt, and concealed underarm holster; black leather gloves worn on night jobs or tucked in pocket at the flower shop. Hạ wears her cream linen dress, forest-green florist apron with pocket shears, intact pale-blue silk scarf around her neck, and silver hair clip pinned at the back of her hair.

clips.start_frame: Sơn just inside the half-lowered shutter, both black gloves on, right hand on the open glass door's handle, facing Hạ; Hạ behind the counter a few steps away, palms on its wood, pale-blue scarf at her neck.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn looks straight at Hạ and tells her tonight's job is dangerous and that he cannot promise, the words coming out unpracticed while his hand stays on the handle. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): His gloved hand lets go of the handle and drops to his side; after a breath he adds, more quietly, that he does not want to lie to her anymore. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): He does not soften it with a smile; Hạ stays where she is, thumb pressing the counter's edge, eyes searching his face as her breathing slows.
clips.end_frame: Hạ behind the counter, thumb on its edge, eyes on Sơn; Sơn a few steps away inside the half-lowered shutter, gloved hands empty at his sides, no longer touching the door; rain and street glow beyond the gap.

dialogue.speaker: SON_P
dialogue.text: Việc đêm nay nguy hiểm. Anh không hứa được. Anh không muốn nói dối em nữa.

clips.lighting: Recent-past flower-shop night: warm bulbs inside as key through the doorway, cool street-lamp spill and wet-pavement reflections outside.

cinematic.intent: Make an honest uncertain answer more intimate than another promise to return safely.
cinematic.composition: Hold both faces with Sơn still gloved and close to the established door position.
cinematic.blocking: Glass door and half shutter screen left with Sơn just inside them; Hạ screen right behind the counter. His right gloved hand leaves the handle; neither crosses the floor between them.
cinematic.performance: Sơn's honesty costs him more than a lie would; he lets her see uncertainty without asking forgiveness. Hạ hears the truth she asked for and decides nothing yet. No reassuring smile, no tears.
cinematic.focus: Keep his exposed expression primary while her listening remains readable, no sudden focus trick.
cinematic.texture: Black gloves and warm flower colors hold the tension between his work and her ordinary room.
cinematic.sound_detail: Speak over a low steady street bed, no score instructing the audience to forgive him.
cinematic.rhythm: The first admission gets full time to be heard; the refusal to lie comes as a smaller second breath; the end holds her listening, not a reply.

clips.start_frame: Hạ's bare hands hold a single white lily by its damp stem beside the breast pocket of Sơn's black suit jacket; his gloved right hand hangs at the lower frame edge.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ slides the lily stem into his breast pocket, easing it down between cloth and lining with practiced florist fingers, as her voice, off frame, tells him to hold still. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She straightens the bloom with one fingertip and presses the pocket flat so the stem stands upright, testing it with a small nudge. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Her hands withdraw out of frame; the lily stays upright against the black cloth, and his chest rises and falls beneath it with a slow breath.
clips.end_frame: One white lily upright in the breast pocket of Sơn's black jacket, petals still, Hạ's hands gone from frame; his chest rising with a slow breath, gloved right hand at the lower edge.

dialogue.text: Anh đứng yên chút. Cành ly này tươi được tới sáng.

clips.lighting: Recent-past flower-shop night: warm bulbs inside as key through the doorway, cool street-lamp spill and wet-pavement reflections outside.

cinematic.intent: Make the flower an ordinary act of care that does not excuse the dangerous job.
cinematic.composition: Use the stable detail view for one stem, his breast pocket and Hạ's hands.
cinematic.blocking: Breast pocket at center frame; Hạ's hands enter and leave from screen right at chest height. Sơn's gloved hand stays low and still; no second flower anywhere.
cinematic.performance: Florist's care, not a blessing: she fixes a stem as she would for any customer, and that ordinariness is the tenderness. His stillness lets it happen. No ceremonial slowness, no trembling fingers.
cinematic.focus: Keep stem and pocket in the same plane, without showing an extra flower or falling petals.
cinematic.texture: Cream petal against black cloth and the slightly damp stem give the gesture physical specificity.
cinematic.sound_detail: Cloth and stem touch lightly, shop room tone continuing without a romantic music cue.
cinematic.rhythm: The placement is quick and practiced under her few words, the check is small, and the last seconds hold the flower standing alone where her hands were.

clips.start_frame: Sơn and Hạ face to face near the half-lowered shutter, close enough to touch; the closed silver watch in Sơn's gloved right hand at chest height, chain over his fingers; one white lily upright in his breast pocket.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ rests two fingertips of her right hand on the closed lid, feeling the faint tick through the metal, and with her eyes on his asks for something small. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She finishes plainly, almost lightly: breakfast together when he is back, nothing more; her fingers leave the lid, and Sơn's lips part and close without an answer. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He slips the watch into the inside pocket of his jacket, his gloved hand coming to rest at the lapel, his eyes not leaving hers.
clips.end_frame: The watch out of sight inside Sơn's jacket, his gloved right hand resting at the lapel; Hạ half a step from him, hands lowered against her apron, eyes on his face; lily upright in his breast pocket, half-lowered shutter and rain behind them.

dialogue.speaker: HA
dialogue.text: Sáng mai anh về, mình ngồi ăn sáng như người ta. Vậy thôi.

clips.lighting: Recent-past flower-shop night: warm bulbs inside as key through the doorway, cool street-lamp spill and wet-pavement reflections outside.

cinematic.intent: Make the promised future small enough to feel possible and painful to postpone.
cinematic.composition: Frame the closed watch between their faces at chest height, both still near the doorway.
cinematic.blocking: Profiles facing each other, shutter gap behind them screen left. The watch sits between their chests in his right hand, then goes into his inside left pocket; Hạ touches it with her right hand only.
cinematic.performance: Hạ asks for an ordinary morning because a symbol would frighten her; the smallness is the ache. Sơn wants to promise and will not, and his silence is the honest answer. No prophetic tone, no lingering on the watch.
cinematic.focus: Keep eyes primary and the closed case readable, never reveal its inner photograph or dial.
cinematic.texture: Smooth metal and florist-worked fingertips contrast without glamour or exaggerated shine.
cinematic.sound_detail: A faint existing mechanical tick may remain beneath ordinary shop sound, no amplified heartbeat.
cinematic.rhythm: The touch and the request arrive together without buildup; his missing answer is the held beat; the end is spent on his wordless pocketing, still in motion.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn gives one small, honest nod, his hand leaving the lapel, and says quietly that he is going and that she should lock up well. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Hạ steps in and leans her forehead against his right shoulder, away from the lily, and he holds still, gloved hands hanging, not pulling her into an embrace; their breathing slows together. clips.end_frame: Hạ half a pace from Sơn, chin lifted, hands at her apron; Sơn facing her, weight beginning to turn toward the door, gloved hands at his sides, lily upright and undisturbed in his breast pocket; half-lowered shutter behind them, rain and street sound beyond.

dialogue.text: Anh đi đây. Em nhớ khóa cửa kỹ.

clips.lighting: Recent-past flower-shop night: warm bulbs inside as key through the doorway, cool street-lamp spill and wet-pavement reflections outside.

cinematic.intent: Allow a brief moment of mutual trust that rests on the honest answer just given.
cinematic.composition: Preserve the same medium frame, door relation and body distance from the closed-watch exchange.
cinematic.blocking: Same profiles and shutter gap as before. Her forehead meets his right shoulder so the lily on his left breast stays untouched; she ends half a pace back toward the counter.
cinematic.performance: The contact is brief, a little awkward and real; neither plays grief toward the moment. He hides how hard it is to leave inside a practical instruction; she answers with touch, not words. No embrace, no sob, no long farewell stare.
cinematic.focus: Keep both profiles and the small contact readable, with no new lens or rack reset.
cinematic.texture: His dark lapel and her scarf remain in their established positions, flower undisturbed.
cinematic.sound_detail: Breathing and distant wet-street traffic are enough after his few quiet words; no added sob or musical climax.
cinematic.rhythm: His quiet words come with the nod at the top; the lean that answers them lasts only a breath; she ends it herself before it can become a posed tableau.

clips.start_frame: Wet pavement outside the flower shop at night: Sơn just past the half-lowered shutter, turned toward the street; Hạ inside at the gap, both hands on the shutter's bottom bar at waist height; warm lamp light on the paving.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn walks away along the wet pavement toward screen right without looking back, his shape sliding out of the warm light. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Hạ holds the bar a moment, watching the empty stretch where he went, then pulls the shutter all the way down; the slats rattle and meet the ground, cutting off the shop's warm interior. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The rattle dies away; rain ticks on the closed metal and the empty paving, the street lamp's reflection trembling in the puddles.
clips.end_frame: Shutter closed to the ground, the shop dark behind it; empty wet pavement in warm street light, rain still falling, lamp reflections trembling in the puddles; the tower lobby lit across the road.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Đó là lần cuối tôi thấy Hạ còn bình yên.

clips.lighting: Recent-past flower-shop night: warm bulbs inside as key through the doorway, cool street-lamp spill and wet-pavement reflections outside.

cinematic.intent: Close the ordinary shop without pretending either character knows this is their last night.
cinematic.composition: Keep pavement, shutter and Sơn's departure direction in the same exterior wide frame.
cinematic.blocking: Shop front fills screen left; Sơn's path runs along the pavement to screen right and out of frame. Hạ stays inside behind the shutter, visible only until it closes.
cinematic.performance: Hạ's closing is ordinary end-of-day work; her only hesitation is the moment before she pulls. Sơn does not look back because he has decided. No wave, no last glance, no knowing sorrow.
cinematic.focus: Hold the closing boundary and then the empty pavement; do not chase his departing face.
cinematic.texture: Warm street reflection lies across wet paving as the shutter removes the shop's interior light.
cinematic.sound_detail: Metal slats rattle and settle, then rain and street bed remain for the coming dawn cut.
cinematic.rhythm: His exit is quick and clean; the pause before closing is the held moment; the shutter completes the action and the last seconds belong to the empty place.

scenes.title: Vạch Thứ Bảy
scenes.purpose: Bằng chứng giao nhận rõ, Sơn giữ bản sao cho cuộc trao đổi.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Radio confirmation yields to coffee-stall glass sounds before the morning safety briefing. Orders here assign new practical tasks.

clips.start_frame: Dawn light slanting across the cabin doorframe: exactly six carved tally marks in one row, the two newest paler; Sơn's bare right hand holding the small carving tool beside them; his bandaged left wrist braced against the frame.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The tool's tip sets into clean wood beside the sixth mark and cuts the seventh line in one steady stroke, pale shavings curling and dust drifting in the light. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The hand lifts the tool clear and holds still while the bandaged left wrist stays braced on the frame; seven marks now stand in one row, the new groove brightest. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The right hand lays the tool on the shelf below and withdraws, a fingertip brushing the last dust from the frame edge as the dawn light creeps along the grain.
clips.end_frame: Seven distinct tally marks in one row on the doorframe, the newest pale and fresh; the small carving tool resting on the shelf below; Sơn's bare right hand lowering out of frame, wood dust settling in the dawn light.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Ngày thứ bảy. Lần này tôi không chạy. Xong việc, tôi ở lại khai hết.

clips.lighting: Present-day dawn: soft light rising from the east through the cabin window, cool sea fill on the porch; neutral window side light in the station afterward.

cinematic.intent: Make the final tally a commitment to accountability rather than a threat against himself.
cinematic.composition: Use the stable detail composition to show six old grooves and room for exactly one new mark.
cinematic.blocking: Doorframe vertical in frame, the row of marks at center, shelf along the lower edge. Tool in Sơn's right hand, left wrist braced on the frame; the new mark goes to the right of the row.
cinematic.performance: The hand is steady with effort: this is a commitment to stay and answer for himself, not a threat against himself. No trembling, no gouging, no caressing the marks.
cinematic.focus: Keep count and new pale wood legible, without an imagined calendar overlay.
cinematic.texture: Fresh wood dust catches the first daylight, older marks staying darker in the same frame.
cinematic.sound_detail: One carving scrape, tool contact and the low narration replace any ticking countdown.
cinematic.rhythm: The single cut comes early and is over quickly; the count is held long enough to read seven; the tool goes down while the light keeps moving.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged.

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Bàn tay nhấc dụng cụ ra và giữ yên, cổ tay trái quấn băng vẫn tì vào khung; bảy vạch nằm thành một hàng, vạch mới sáng nhất. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Tay phải đặt dụng cụ lên kệ bên dưới rồi rút đi, đầu ngón phủi chút bụi cuối ở mép khung khi nắng sớm bò dọc thớ gỗ. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy từ nhịp 1.

clips.start_frame: Dawn in the cabin: Mây at the table with her evidence satchel open, the black ledger and the sleeved original USB inside; the red cloth ledger and the hardware token on the table before Sơn; a plain copy envelope lying apart at his edge of the table.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây lifts the black ledger and the sleeved USB out of the satchel and lays them side by side at the center of the table, saying she is sealing the originals to leave this morning and he carries only the copy. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Sơn slides the red ledger and the token across to sit beside them, both run their eyes over the four originals, and he answers that now they cannot destroy anything. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She packs all four into the satchel and presses its seal strip shut; Sơn's hands come to rest beside the lone copy envelope, his eyes on the sealed strip.
clips.end_frame: Mây's evidence satchel sealed on the table under her hand, all four originals inside; only the plain copy envelope left before Sơn, his bare hands resting beside it; dawn light across the table grain.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Bản gốc tôi niêm phong, sáng nay chuyển đi. Anh chỉ cầm bản sao.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Vậy tụi nó hết đường phi tang.

clips.lighting: Present-day dawn: soft light rising from the east through the cabin window, cool sea fill on the porch; neutral window side light in the station afterward.

cinematic.intent: Separate protected originals from the vulnerable person who will carry only an excerpt.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium table view to distinguish two bindings, USB sleeve, token and copy envelope.
cinematic.blocking: Table between them: Mây screen left with the satchel, Sơn screen right. Originals gather at center, then go into the satchel; the copy envelope stays untouched at Sơn's edge of the table.
cinematic.performance: Their checking feels like letting go: Sơn gives up his only leverage and knows it. Mây is exact and quietly respectful of what this costs him. No triumph, no display for the audience.
cinematic.focus: Keep black and red books distinct without requiring readable seals or paperwork text.
cinematic.texture: Cloth binding, leather, plain sleeves and used table grain make each item physically different.
cinematic.sound_detail: Small paper and seal sounds stay behind Mây's short line, no repeated upload chime.
cinematic.rhythm: Her line rides the laying out; his short reply lands as the set is complete; the sealing is one decisive press, and the end rests on the subtraction, only the copy left with him.

clips.start_frame: On the cabin table: Mây's small evidence bag open, the long scarf remainder already sealed in a clear sleeve inside; Mây's hands holding an empty clear sleeve open; Sơn's bare right hand above it with the short torn scarf fragment.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn lowers the short pale-blue fragment into the empty sleeve and opens his fingers, letting it settle without smoothing it, as Mây's voice, off frame, says she will keep both pieces. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She presses the sleeve's seal closed and slides it into the bag beside the long remainder, torn edges facing each other through the plastic but kept apart, finishing that she will hand the long piece back to Hạ herself. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Both pairs of hands withdraw; the two sleeves rest side by side in the open bag, frayed silk catching the dawn light.
clips.end_frame: Two clear sleeves side by side in Mây's open evidence bag, the short fragment and the long remainder kept separate, torn edges facing each other; both pairs of hands withdrawn, sleeve edges catching the dawn light on coarse cabin wood.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Hai mảnh này tôi giữ. Phần dài, tôi trả tận tay Hạ.

clips.lighting: Present-day dawn: soft light rising from the east through the cabin window, cool sea fill on the porch; neutral window side light in the station afterward.

cinematic.intent: Give the two scarf fragments a shared custody before they can later return to Hạ.
cinematic.composition: Frame the small fragment, separate long remainder and open evidence bag together.
cinematic.blocking: Bag at the center of the table; Sơn's hand enters from screen right, Mây's hands from screen left. The new sleeve lies to the right of the long one; the satchel of originals is not in this frame.
cinematic.performance: Deliberate care without sentiment: Sơn lets go of the fragment he has carried for a month, and his fingers do not linger. Mây handles it as evidence and as a promise. No stroking, no slow-motion tenderness.
cinematic.focus: Keep matching torn edges recognizable but separate, no magically repaired scarf or changed size.
cinematic.texture: Frayed blue silk contrasts with clear sleeves and coarse cabin wood.
cinematic.sound_detail: A subdued sleeve rustle and pine wind sit under Mây's brief off-frame words, making care visible rather than explained.
cinematic.rhythm: One handover under her first words, one seal as she finishes, then the hands leave and the two pieces sit together in shared custody.

clips.start_frame: Dawn on the cabin porch: Sơn by the table holding the closed silver watch and its chain in his right hand; Mây facing him at the top of the steps, duty pouch across her body, ready to leave by the dune path.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn holds the closed watch out between them and asks Mây to keep it for him, saying he will come and take it back himself, his tone ordinary, almost stubborn. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Mây looks at the dented lid, then at him, and answers briefly as she opens her right hand; he lays the watch and the whole chain in her palm, the last links sliding off his fingers. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Her fingers close over it; his empty hand lowers to his side, and the sea wind lifts the hair from her forehead as they hold each other's eyes.
clips.end_frame: Closed watch and coiled chain in Mây's closed right hand, nothing hanging from Sơn's jacket pocket; the two still facing each other at the top of the porch steps, Sơn's empty right hand at his side, dune path behind Mây, sea wind moving her hair.
