cinematic.intent: Make the watch handover a request to return for something, not a final bequest.
cinematic.composition: Keep both faces and the closed watch together on the porch, no inner-dial insert.
cinematic.blocking: Porch table screen right behind Sơn, steps and dune path screen left behind Mây. The watch passes from his right hand into her right hand at waist height; no chain is left on him.
cinematic.performance: Sơn asks the way someone plans to return, not the way someone writes a will. Mây accepts without pity and without promising what she cannot. No lingering on the watch, no solemn bow, no tears.
cinematic.focus: Keep the closed lid and her receiving hand readable while their eyes carry the request.
cinematic.texture: Dented metal and bare hands remain modest under dawn light, the case never opening.
cinematic.sound_detail: One small chain contact is enough beneath his line; no ticking from the stopped watch.
cinematic.rhythm: His request comes first and simply; her short reply and the complete handover share the middle; the end rests on custody rather than mourning.

clips.start_frame: Dawn at the police post's public desk: Mây with the sealed evidence satchel under her hand; an unnamed assigned officer opposite, ready to receive it; Thành at the desk end, leather folder open, pen in hand; front door open to the road.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây slides the sealed satchel across the desk and the assigned officer takes it in both hands, while Thành, ticking his list, tells her all four originals are there. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He turns the folder for Mây and the officer to sign the receipt, adding that the copies stay at the post, then keeps it flat under his palm. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The officer carries the satchel out through the open door to a waiting escort on the road, and Mây watches the doorway until it is empty.
clips.end_frame: Thành at the desk end holding his folder with the signed receipt; Mây beside the desk, eyes on the open front door; the doorway empty, the originals gone down the road; dust and morning light drifting in.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Đủ bốn món gốc rồi chị. Ký nhận xong, bản sao lưu lại đồn.

clips.lighting: Present-day dawn: soft light rising from the east through the cabin window, cool sea fill on the porch; neutral window side light in the station afterward.

cinematic.intent: Move the originals beyond the upcoming confrontation so the rescue cannot erase their evidence.
cinematic.composition: Use the station wide view to include Mây, Thành, the assigned officer and one departing route.
cinematic.blocking: Desk across the middle of frame, front door screen right. The officer receives on the door side and exits right; Thành at the left end with his folder and pen, Mây center.
cinematic.performance: They verify before letting go, aware the case is far from finished and the danger still ahead. Thành is precise, quietly proud of a small duty done right. No handshake, no congratulations.
cinematic.focus: Keep originals and retained receipt physically distinct, without legible official writing.
cinematic.texture: Plain sleeves, tired desk surfaces and morning light keep the transfer unglamorous.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper acknowledgement and ordinary departure footsteps replace a procedural success montage sound.
cinematic.rhythm: The handover and Thành's count go together; the signatures get their own steady beat; the originals physically leave before the end, making the transfer irreversible.

clips.start_frame: At the station desk: Thành seated with the harbour route map spread before him, radio handset in his left hand, pen in his right; Mây standing at his shoulder; the ceiling fan turning above.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Thành's radio crackles and the road team calls in with a flat, compressed voice; both lean toward it without a word. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): As the voice reports that both road ends into the harbour will be covered before the meeting, Thành marks two small ticks at the road ends on the map, his pen steady despite the taped glasses. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây gives a single nod, but her eyes drift from the ticks to the open pier on the map and stay there; she breathes out slowly through her nose.
clips.end_frame: Thành's pen resting beside two fresh ticks at the road ends on the map, radio lowered in his left hand; Mây at his shoulder, chin lowered from her nod, eyes still on the open pier on the map; the ceiling fan turning.

dialogue.speaker: RADIO
dialogue.text: Tổ đường bộ báo cáo. Hai đầu đường vào cảng, chúng tôi vào vị trí trước giờ hẹn.

clips.lighting: Present-day dawn: soft light rising from the east through the cabin window, cool sea fill on the porch; neutral window side light in the station afterward.

cinematic.intent: Confirm a real support presence while leaving the human exchange still uncertain.
cinematic.composition: Frame Mây beside Thành at the radio with the already-used route map visible.
cinematic.blocking: Map flat on the desk; Thành seated screen left with radio in his left hand and pen in his right, Mây standing screen right at his shoulder. Only the two road ends get marked; the pier stays blank.
cinematic.performance: Relief is rationed: the roads are covered, Hạ and the two leaders are not. Mây's nod acknowledges the work and refuses the comfort; Thành is focused and eager to be useful. No smiles, no fist bump.
cinematic.focus: Keep their listening and a small position mark readable, no cutaway to invented convoys.
cinematic.texture: Desk wear and ordinary radio casing preserve the local team's scale.
cinematic.sound_detail: The compressed confirmation sits over the station fan, with no additional operators talking over it.
cinematic.rhythm: The report comes in at once, the two marks follow its words, then a held breath on the uncovered pier carries into the next scene's sound.

clips.start_frame: Morning at the coffee stall: Mây at a plastic table with the harbour sketch spread out; Thành beside her holding two fresh pairs of handcuffs and his leather folder; Bảy across the table, wiping cloth on his shoulder, a tray of coffee glasses at his elbow.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Thành hands Mây the two fresh pairs of cuffs; she checks each ratchet with a click and clips both to her belt while telling Bảy the stalls close early this afternoon. Beat 2 (3.0–7.0s): She taps the back lane on the sketch for Bảy's van as she adds that no one goes down to the pier; Bảy answers that he has already told every stall. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Mây folds the sketch into her pouch and the three split up, Bảy toward the rear lane, Thành toward the market, Mây toward the harbour road, none of them looking back.
clips.end_frame: The three walking away from the table on separate routes: Bảy toward the rear lane with his cloth on his shoulder, Thành toward the market with his folder, Mây toward the harbour road with two fresh pairs of cuffs at her belt; coffee glasses left on the tray.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Chú Bảy, đầu giờ chiều bà con đóng sạp hết. Không ai được xuống cầu cảng.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Tui dặn từng sạp rồi, cô Mây yên tâm nghen.

clips.lighting: Present-day clear morning: coastal sun from the east, faces in soft shade with sky fill outdoors; warm lamp light inside the van and cabin.

cinematic.intent: Turn help from the town into bounded jobs, not a speech summoning a heroic crowd.
cinematic.composition: Keep three named people and the harbour sketch inside the wide coffee-stall frame.
cinematic.blocking: Table at center; counter landward screen left, sea wall screen right. Cuffs go from Thành's hands to Mây's belt. Exits: Bảy left toward the rear lane, Thành back toward the market, Mây right along the road.
cinematic.performance: Mây is firm about keeping civilians away and gives each man one job, not a speech. Bảy and Thành listen like workers who already know their tasks. No cheering, no salute, no heroic huddle.
cinematic.focus: Keep the handover readable enough to account for later cuffs without a dedicated equipment insert.
cinematic.texture: Everyday glasses, table stains and practical work clothing keep the briefing embedded in town life.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her one instruction sits over the opening-stall bed, no cheers or martial rhythm.
cinematic.rhythm: Equipment and instruction overlap at the top, Bảy's reply follows without a gap, then a clean three-way dispersal keeps moving to the cut.

clips.start_frame: Behind the market wall: Bảy's van parked with both rear doors open, the cargo floor bare except for one empty fish crate beside a clean mattress; Linh at the open doors with his canvas medical bag; a loose cart to the left.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bảy climbs onto the rear step, hauls out the last empty crate and stacks it against the market wall beside the cart, saying the van is clean and the lane is clear for a stretcher. Beat 2 (3.0–7.0s): Linh, kneeling on the van floor, cinches a strap across the mattress and wedges his medical bag against the side panel just inside the doors, answering that it is strapped and the bag sits by the door. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Bảy wipes his hands on his cloth and swings both rear doors wide toward the empty lane, leaving the approach open as Linh climbs down.
clips.end_frame: Van ready behind the market wall, both rear doors swung wide toward the empty safe lane; the clean mattress strapped down, Linh's medical bag inside by the door; Linh climbing down beside it, Bảy at the door edge with his cloth; the empty crate stacked against the wall.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Thùng xe sạch rồi bác sĩ. Hẻm sau trống, khiêng cáng vô là chạy.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Nệm chằng chắc rồi. Túi cấp cứu để ngay cửa.

clips.lighting: Present-day clear morning: coastal sun from the east, faces in soft shade with sky fill outdoors; warm lamp light inside the van and cabin.

cinematic.intent: Make the eventual rescue vehicle usable through visible ordinary preparation.
cinematic.composition: Use the van's parking position and the protected lane together in the wide setup.
cinematic.blocking: Van rear faces screen right toward the protected lane; market wall behind, loose cart screen left. The crate travels from the van to the wall at left; Linh works inside, Bảy outside.
cinematic.performance: Familiar competence: two men who know what the space is for and do not say it. Bảy keeps his voice light to keep his hands steady; Linh is meticulous. No jokes about danger, no frantic hurry.
cinematic.focus: Keep rear doors and clear approach route visible along with the ready mattress.
cinematic.texture: Washed metal, clean fabric and the empty crate space separate this use from hauling fish.
cinematic.sound_detail: A crate movement and door hardware sound remain practical under Bảy's short report.
cinematic.rhythm: Bảy's report rides the crate work, Linh's answer rides the strapping, and the doors open wide at the end on a space someone could be carried into.

clips.wardrobe_note: Bác sĩ Linh wears his worn white medical coat with stethoscope around his neck, keeping his canvas emergency medical bag and breathing-support kit at hand. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Bác sĩ Linh khoác áo blouse trắng sờn vai, cổ đeo ống nghe y tế, tay xách túi cấp cứu vải bố có sẵn bình trợ thở. Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly, tay thao tác với khay ly cà phê hoặc thùng nhựa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Khoảng sân sau cửa thùng xe tải cứu hộ (D7 morning) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (MED_BAG, COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bảy bước lên bậc sau xe, lôi thùng nhựa rỗng cuối cùng ra, chồng sát tường chợ cạnh chiếc xe đẩy, vừa làm vừa nói thùng xe đã sạch, hẻm sau trống cho cáng đi. Nhịp 2 (3.0–7.0s): Linh quỳ trên sàn xe, siết dây ngang tấm nệm, chèn túi cấp cứu vào vách ngay sau cửa, đáp nệm đã chằng chắc, túi để sát cửa. Nhịp 3 (7.0–10.0s): Bảy lau tay vào khăn, mở toang hai cánh cửa sau về phía con hẻm trống, lối tiếp cận để ngỏ, Linh trèo xuống. Bảy nói ở nhịp 1, Linh đáp ở nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (MED_BAG, COFFEE_TRAY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo · Đạo cụ khóa: MED_BAG, COFFEE_TRAY.

clips.start_frame: Morning on the low market roof: Thành crouched at the roof edge, taped glasses on, radio handset in his right hand, leather folder tucked under his left arm; the east and west harbour roads below and the uphill service path beyond.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Thành keys the radio and, sweeping his eyes from the east road to the west road, tells Mây he can see both roads down to the harbour. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His gaze climbs the narrow service path toward the lighthouse as he adds that he has that path too; a short squelch answers. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He clips the handset at his collar, pushes the taped glasses up his nose with a knuckle and settles lower on his heels, eyes back on the roads, the wind tugging at his shirt.
clips.end_frame: Thành crouched at the roof edge, radio clipped at his collar, folder under his left arm, eyes on the harbour roads below; wind tugging his light-blue shirt, the uphill service path visible beyond.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Chị Mây, em thấy rõ hai đường xuống cảng, cả lối mòn lên hải đăng.

clips.lighting: Present-day clear morning: coastal sun from the east, faces in soft shade with sky fill outdoors; warm lamp light inside the van and cabin.

cinematic.intent: Let Thành regain agency by checking what he can genuinely see from above.
cinematic.composition: Frame him with the existing roof edge and both approach roads readable below.
cinematic.blocking: Roof edge runs across the lower frame; Thành screen left facing screen right, both roads below him and the service path rising in the distance. Radio in his right hand, then clipped at his collar; folder stays under his left arm.
cinematic.performance: Thành wins back a little self-respect by checking what he can truly see; the taped glasses cost him a squint, nothing more. He hides yesterday's fear in concentration. No comic fumbling, no swagger.
cinematic.focus: Keep his eyeline linked to the roads without an internal point-of-view cut or floating map.
cinematic.texture: Tape on the glasses and wind against his shirt retain the previous day's consequences.
cinematic.sound_detail: Wind and a clean radio test carry the action, not a surveillance-machine sound effect.
cinematic.rhythm: His report rides two sweeping looks; the climb up the path and the squelch close it; then attention returns to the real view and stays there, still alive.

clips.wardrobe_note: Thành wears his light-blue shirt and round glasses whose right temple arm is held with tape after the stall struggle, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính tròn có gọng bên phải quấn băng keo trắng sau lúc bảo vệ dân ở quán nước, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Mái tôn thấp của chợ cá nhìn xuống toàn bộ bến cảng (D7 morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (CLIPBOARD).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Thành bấm bộ đàm, mắt quét từ đường phía đông sang đường phía tây, báo với Mây rằng anh thấy rõ hai đường xuống cảng. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Ánh mắt anh men lên lối mòn kỹ thuật dẫn tới hải đăng, nói thêm lối đó anh cũng thấy; bộ đàm rè ngắn đáp lại. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Anh kẹp máy lên cổ áo, dùng đốt ngón tay đẩy cặp kính dán băng keo lên sống mũi, ngồi thấp xuống trên gót, mắt trở về các con đường, gió kéo vạt áo sơ mi. Thành nói ở nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (CLIPBOARD) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: CLIPBOARD.

clips.start_frame: Morning in the cabin: Sơn in his black suit standing at the cot, the folded pair of black leather gloves in his bare hands; his dark-olive canvas backpack open on the cot; white bandage showing at his left cuff.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn lays the folded gloves inside the open backpack, presses them flat with his palm and takes his hand away without lingering. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He straightens, leaving the backpack open on the cot, and looks at his bare right hand, flexing the fingers and turning it over. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The hand closes and drops to his side; he turns from the cot toward the cabin door, weight moving into his first step, both hands bare.
clips.end_frame: Backpack open on the cot with the folded gloves inside; Sơn in his black suit turned toward the cabin door and stepping off, both hands bare, white bandage at his left wrist; morning light through the east window.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Bộ đồ đen, tôi mặc lại. Đôi găng, tôi để lại đây.

clips.lighting: Present-day clear morning: coastal sun from the east, faces in soft shade with sky fill outdoors; warm lamp light inside the van and cabin.

cinematic.intent: Show the present-day refusal of the gloves as a settled choice rather than a new costume reveal.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium cabin setup with the bag on the bed and bare hands in open view.
cinematic.blocking: Cot along the west wall screen left, door screen right. Sơn faces the cot, then turns right toward the door; the gloves end inside the open backpack, which stays on the cot.
cinematic.performance: A settled choice, not a ceremony: he keeps the suit and refuses the gloves. A flicker of memory in the flexed hand, then resolve. No admiring the leather, no second thoughts played out.
cinematic.focus: Keep both gloves accounted for without implying he hides one on his body.
cinematic.texture: Soft old leather against worn canvas differs from the fresh left wrist bandage.
cinematic.sound_detail: One quiet fold and bag rustle play over the cabin wind, with no narrator required.
cinematic.rhythm: The placement is quick and practical, the look at the bare hand is the held beat, and the turn to the door carries straight into motion.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, bare hands, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage. He folds the black leather gloves into his dark-olive canvas backpack and leaves the backpack open, unzipped, on the cabin cot.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn đã thay bộ vest đen, sơ mi trắng mở cổ, hai bàn tay để trần, cổ tay TRÁI quấn băng trắng y tế; anh xếp đôi găng tay da đen vào chiếc ba lô vải bố đang mở và để ba lô nằm nguyên trên giường gỗ, chưa kéo khóa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong căn chòi gỗ một gian trên đồi dương (D7 morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (BACKPACK).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn đặt đôi găng đã gấp vào trong ba lô đang mở, lòng bàn tay ấn phẳng rồi rút tay về, không nấn ná. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Anh đứng thẳng, để ba lô mở nguyên trên giường, nhìn bàn tay phải để trần, co duỗi các ngón, lật bàn tay lại. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Bàn tay nắm lại, buông xuống; anh quay khỏi giường về phía cửa chòi, dồn trọng tâm vào bước đầu tiên, hai tay để trần. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy từ nhịp 1.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (BACKPACK) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: BACKPACK.

clips.start_frame: Bright coastal morning at the foot of the hill path: Sơn in his black suit at the edge of the main street, bare hands at his sides; ahead, shopkeepers stand at half-lowered shutters along the road toward the market.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn steps off the hill path onto the main street and walks down its middle at an ordinary pace, the tracking move keeping level with his shoulder. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He passes a row of shutters as unnamed shopkeepers pull them down and padlock them; one glances at him and looks away, and his shoulders stay set while his eyes keep to the road. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The green awning of Bảy's stall comes up beside the sea wall; he angles toward the sea-facing table, and the move eases as his pace slows.
clips.end_frame: Sơn a few steps from the sea-facing table under the green awning, slowing, bare hands at his sides, bandaged left wrist visible; padlocked shutters behind him along the bright street, the sea open beyond the wall.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Cả phố đóng cửa sớm vì tôi. Lần này tôi đi giữa đường, không nép nữa.

clips.lighting: Present-day clear morning: coastal sun from the east, faces in soft shade with sky fill outdoors; warm lamp light inside the van and cabin.

cinematic.intent: Let walking openly register as exposure earned by the earlier decision to stay.
cinematic.composition: Track laterally in the established direction with secured shutters remaining part of his route.
cinematic.blocking: He walks screen left to screen right down the center of the street, never hugging the wall; shutters on the landward side, sea wall on the seaward side; the stall waits at frame right.
cinematic.performance: Composure over tension: he is choosing to be seen, and his set shoulders admit what it costs. No glances at unseen watchers, no hero stride, no smile.
cinematic.focus: Keep his bare hands and bandaged left wrist readable without pushing into an extra detail shot.
cinematic.texture: Closed shutters and bright coastal light make a public road feel newly unprotected.
cinematic.sound_detail: Footsteps and shutter work from the evacuation dominate, no slow-motion or anthem cue.
cinematic.rhythm: An uninterrupted walk with the shutters closing around him in the middle stretch; the pace eases only as the table arrives.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage, right hand uninjured and bare; no backpack on him, it stays on the cabin cot.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc bộ vest đen sơ mi trắng mở cổ, cổ tay TRÁI quấn băng trắng y tế, bàn tay phải lành lặn để trần; chiếc ba lô vải bố đã cất lại tại chòi gỗ từ cảnh 35.4.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Trục đường chính thị trấn biển Hòn Sóng (D7 morning) · Góc máy: Máy trượt ngang (35mm Tracking) — bám sát bước chân và nhịp di chuyển nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn bước từ lối dốc xuống đường chính, đi chính giữa với nhịp bình thường, máy lia ngang giữ ngang vai anh. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Anh đi qua dãy cửa cuốn đang được chủ tiệm kéo xuống, khóa lại; một người liếc anh rồi quay đi; vai anh vẫn giữ thế, mắt nhìn đường. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mái bạt xanh quán ông Bảy hiện ra cạnh kè biển; anh rẽ chéo về chiếc bàn hướng biển, chuyển động máy chậm lại theo bước chân. Lời dẫn của Sơn vào từ nhịp 1.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Máy trượt ngang (35mm Tracking) — bám sát bước chân và nhịp di chuyển nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người.

clips.start_frame: Under the green awning: Sơn seated at the sea-facing table, bare hands on the tabletop, the open sea before him; Bảy coming from the counter behind him with one glass of iced coffee, wiping cloth on his shoulder.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bảy sets the glass down at Sơn's right hand, ice clinking, announcing the coffee without stepping into his line of sight. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He steps back half a pace, wiping his fingers on the cloth, and finishes with quiet amusement that Sơn is finally sitting facing the sea, his own eyes going to the water. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn neither turns nor answers; his eyes stay on the sea, his right hand finds the cold glass, and the corner of his mouth eases a fraction as Bảy heads back to the counter.
clips.end_frame: Coffee glass under Sơn's right hand, beaded with cold; Sơn facing the sea, shoulders a little lower; Bảy walking back toward the counter behind him, cloth on his shoulder; sea wind stirring the awning.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Cà phê nè. Bữa nay chú chịu ngồi ngó ra biển rồi nghen.

clips.lighting: Present-day clear morning: coastal sun from the east, faces in soft shade with sky fill outdoors; warm lamp light inside the van and cabin.

cinematic.intent: Make facing the sea an emotional change that Bảy notices without explaining the whole arc.
cinematic.composition: Frame Sơn toward the water, Bảy entering with the single glass at his right.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn screen right at the table, facing the sea in frame depth; Bảy enters from the counter at screen left, places the glass at Sơn's right and retreats the way he came.
cinematic.performance: Bảy notices the change and names it lightly, out of care; Sơn receives it without needing to reply, his first unguarded moment in days. No big smile, no tearful gaze at the horizon.
cinematic.focus: Keep Sơn's face, glass and actual open sea related in the medium depth.
cinematic.texture: Sunlit glass rim and faded awning make the ordinary seat feel newly chosen.
cinematic.sound_detail: One glass touch gives way to sea wind, with no symbolic watch ticking under the moment.
cinematic.rhythm: The glass and his first words land together; the remark finishes as he steps away; the remaining seconds hold Sơn's new direction of attention, alive with wind.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage, right hand uninjured and bare; no backpack on him, it stays on the cabin cot. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc bộ vest đen sơ mi trắng mở cổ, cổ tay TRÁI quấn băng trắng y tế, bàn tay phải lành lặn để trần; chiếc ba lô vải bố đã cất lại tại chòi gỗ từ cảnh 35.4. Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly, tay thao tác với khay ly cà phê hoặc thùng nhựa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Quán cà phê cóc của Ông Bảy bên bờ kè biển (D7 morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bảy đặt ly cà phê bên tay phải Sơn, đá kêu lách cách, báo ly cà phê tới mà không bước vào tầm nhìn của anh. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Ông lùi nửa bước, lau tay vào khăn, nói nốt như trêu rằng bữa nay Sơn chịu ngồi ngó ra biển; mắt ông cũng nhìn ra mặt nước. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn không quay lại, không đáp; mắt vẫn nhìn biển, tay phải tìm tới ly cà phê lạnh, khóe miệng giãn ra rất nhẹ khi Bảy quay về quầy. Bảy nói ở nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (COFFEE_TRAY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Một thị trấn có thể giúp cứu người bằng việc bình thường nào?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Mỗi người làm một nhiệm vụ, Sơn để đôi găng lại rồi ngồi nhìn biển.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Nhận còng mới và dọn xe cho thấy kế hoạch thành công việc thật.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Cho thấy dân đã rút và đường cứu hộ có thể dùng, tránh đám đông làm phép cứu nguy.

scenes.title: Khách Hàng Áo Trắng
scenes.purpose: Đối mặt Kiên, buộc kẻ giữ người chứng minh Hạ có mặt.
scenes.outgoing_audio: White-car engine recedes under the rear-stall discussion. Keep the car gone and the confession folder with Mây.

clips.start_frame: Afternoon on the main street: Sơn seated at the sea-facing table under the green awning; across the street the white car halted at the curb, engine idling, all doors shut.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Kiên steps out of the front passenger door buttoning his white jacket, two unnamed guards getting out behind him and staying by the car; crossing to the stall, he calls ahead how relaxed Sơn looks and how hard he was to find. Beat 2 (3.5–7.5s): He stops across the table, his white suit blocking the sea; Sơn looks up without rising, hands flat on the table, and answers that he was not hiding but waiting for Kiên to bring her. Beat 3 (7.5–10.0s): Kiên's smile holds a beat too long and his eyes flick back to the car; Sơn's gaze stays on him as the engine idles across the street.
clips.end_frame: Kiên standing across the table from Sơn with his back to the sea wall, smile fixed, eyes flicking toward the car; Sơn seated facing him, hands flat on the table, eyes up; the white car idling across the street in the background, two guards beside it.

dialogue.speaker: KIEN
dialogue.text: Ngồi ngắm biển thảnh thơi quá ha. Anh làm tôi tìm muốn mệt.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Tôi không trốn. Tôi ngồi đây chờ anh dắt người tới.

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon: sun from the west on the street, soft green-awning shade on faces, cool reflected light inside the white car.

cinematic.intent: Let Kiên enter the ordinary place Sơn has only just learned to occupy peacefully.
cinematic.composition: Keep the white car, seated Sơn and Kiên's route between them together in the wide street frame.
cinematic.blocking: Car at the far curb in the background; Kiên's path runs from its front passenger door across the street and around to the seaward side of Sơn's table, facing him. Guards stay at the car; Sơn stays seated.
cinematic.performance: Kiên's ease is the intrusion: friendly, unhurried, owning the place. Sơn lets his newly found calm go cold without giving ground. No villain flourish, no theatrical pause, no glare.
cinematic.focus: Maintain the car in usable background view because Hạ is the immediate stake, not just transport.
cinematic.texture: White cloth and polished car surfaces catch harsh afternoon light against the humble awning.
cinematic.sound_detail: Incoming engine resolves into the same idling bed; his greeting has no musical punctuation.
cinematic.rhythm: Arrival and greeting run together from door to table; Sơn's reply lands as Kiên stops; the last beat is a held, idling standoff.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage, right hand uninjured and bare; no backpack on him, it stays on the cabin cot. Kiên wears his tailored white suit and polished shoes, luxury gold wristwatch glinting on his left wrist.

clips.start_frame: At the stall table: Kiên seated across from Sơn, one leg crossed, hands folded on his knee, no hand offered; Sơn upright opposite, both bare hands flat on the table, his jacket buttoned.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Kiên leans back and, as easily as discussing a late delivery, admits that last month's trap was meant to shut Sơn up for good. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): He shrugs that Sơn got away, then calls keeping Hạ the cheapest way to pull him back, his smile thinning on her name while his eyes watch for the effect. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Sơn's eyelids flicker at her name and his breath stops for a moment; his hands stay flat on the table, nowhere near his jacket, and he says nothing while Kiên waits.
clips.end_frame: Sơn listening across the table, hands flat, breathing shallow, jacket buttoned over the copy he does not offer; Kiên leaning back opposite with his smile half restored, waiting; awning shade on both faces, the car idling off frame.

dialogue.speaker: KIEN
dialogue.text: Tháng trước tôi gài để anh im luôn. Anh thoát được. Giữ Hạ là cách rẻ nhất kéo anh về.

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon: sun from the west on the street, soft green-awning shade on faces, cool reflected light inside the white car.

cinematic.intent: Make Kiên explain control as a business adjustment, while Sơn refuses to reward the explanation.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium table frame with an unoffered handshake space and car direction still understood.
cinematic.blocking: Kiên screen left, Sơn screen right, the table between them with an empty space where a handshake would be. Sơn's hands stay on the tabletop; the copy stays inside his jacket.
cinematic.performance: Kiên presents control as a business adjustment and enjoys the logic of it. Sơn hides the hit, but the smallest change in his attention shows the leverage works. No snarl, no clenched fist.
cinematic.focus: Keep faces and unused table space readable, no imagined flashback illustrating the first trap.
cinematic.texture: Tailored white sleeve and worn coffee table make the unequal resources visible without added jewelry details.
cinematic.sound_detail: His line sits over the subdued stall bed and car idle, without a phone effect.
cinematic.rhythm: The old trap is quick background; the pressure of Hạ lands last and is held, with the silence after it doing the work.

dialogue.speaker: HA_D
dialogue.text: Anh Sơn, đừng để hắn ép anh. Tới lúc, em tự bước ra.

clips.lighting: Present-day afternoon: sun from the west on the street, soft green-awning shade on faces, cool reflected light inside the white car.

cinematic.intent: Give Hạ an act of self-definition the instant she becomes physically visible again.
cinematic.composition: Frame from the established observer side through the lowered rear window, handle and her face both readable.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn's right shoulder fills the near foreground screen left; the car's open rear window sits center frame with Hạ behind it, Kiên outside at the door screen right. Hạ uses her right hand on the handle.
cinematic.performance: Hạ defines herself the moment she is visible: capable, not cargo, asking no one to carry her. Sơn holds back every impulse to move. Kiên's ease cracks slightly. No pleading, no tears, no lunge.
cinematic.focus: Keep her eyes and handle hand within useful depth; the glass edge must not obscure the gesture.
cinematic.texture: Grey dress and plain car upholstery contrast with Kiên's white sleeve at the window edge.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her voice remains natural through the open window, with only the established engine beneath it.
cinematic.rhythm: Recognition and her first words come together; the hand reaches the handle on her last words, unhurried and readable; the end leaves her assertion unanswered.

cinematic.rhythm: The window starts closing at once and finishes under Sơn's terms; Kiên's twist comes last, and the clip ends on Sơn holding his ground.

cinematic.intent: Leave the new demand physically behind after its owner removes himself.

cinematic.blocking: Car at the far curb screen left, leaving frame left toward the market and town; Sơn stays screen right at the stall with the folder on the table in front of him. Nobody follows the car.
cinematic.performance: Held urgency, not relief: Hạ is inside that car and he lets it go because the plan demands it. The effort shows in his stillness. No running step, no clenched fist, no sigh.
cinematic.focus: Keep the confession folder visible as the car loses size, no internal cut to departing faces.
cinematic.texture: Afternoon glare on white bodywork gives way to the darker awning over the abandoned paperwork.
cinematic.sound_detail: Car engine recedes under ordinary stall sound, with no second ignition or invented radio call.
cinematic.rhythm: The door shuts quickly, the departure is continuous, and the car fully clears the space before attention settles back on the folder left behind.

scenes.purpose: Mây và Sơn điều chỉnh kế theo điều kiện mới, không kể lại kế cũ.

clips.start_frame: Rear lane behind the stall under the canvas awning: Mây stands at the left end of the map table, Sơn at the right end facing her; the closed confession folder lies on the table edge between them; Sơn's bare hands hang empty at his sides.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.0s): Mây rests two fingers on the closed confession folder and turns it a quarter toward Sơn, eyes on his face, as she names the trap his hurry to save Hạ could walk him into. Beat 2 (4.0–7.0s): Sơn looks down at the folder; his bare right hand lifts an inch toward it, stops, and sinks back to his side, fingers opening; his jaw sets and he answers in a few low words. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Mây slides the folder off the table into her left hand and holds it flat against her hip; Sơn's empty hands stay loose, his gaze rising from the bare table to her as one long breath leaves him.
clips.end_frame: Mây holding the closed folder flat against her left hip, eyes on Sơn; Sơn at the right end of the table, bare hands empty and loose at his sides, gaze on her, breath easing out; the awning canvas stirring overhead.

cinematic.intent: Give Mây the uncomfortable task of naming what Sơn's urgency might make him accept.
cinematic.composition: Keep both partners behind the stall with the unopened folder occupying their shared table edge.
cinematic.blocking: Map table between them: Mây at its left end, Sơn at its right. The folder goes from the table edge into Mây's left hand and stays there; Sơn's hands remain at his sides and never cross the table.
cinematic.performance: Mây is direct without scolding, naming a price she suspects he would pay for Hạ. Sơn feels the pull of the shortcut, then refuses it; the cost shows only in his stillness. No lecture, no defiant glare.
cinematic.focus: Keep her face and the closed folder readable, avoiding an extra close-up of imagined written terms.
cinematic.texture: Awning shade removes the white car's glare, leaving ordinary paper between two tired people.
cinematic.sound_detail: The receding engine can fade under her line, then only canvas and distant stall activity remain.
cinematic.rhythm: Her warning opens the clip at once; the held moment is Sơn's aborted reach; the decision lands on his short answer, and the folder changing hands closes the clip without further explanation.

cinematic.intent: Separate the limited preview they will offer from the false admission they will never sign.
cinematic.composition: Use the detail frame to show the open copy envelope and closed confession folder apart.
cinematic.blocking: Envelope on the near half of the table; Mây's left hand keeps the folder at hip height on the far side. Only Sơn's right hand and Mây's right fingertip touch the pages; nothing passes between folder and envelope.
cinematic.performance: Their hands agree without ceremony: Sơn handles the pages with deliberate economy, Mây checks with a professional's count, both wanting the difference to be undeniable. No staged secret-agent flourish, no knowing glance.
cinematic.focus: Keep paper thickness and different containers legible, with no readable signatures or invented security marks.
cinematic.texture: Thin preview sheets and the heavier folder create a concrete visual distinction.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper edges moving against the table support Sơn's off-screen sentence, with no digital confirmation sound.
cinematic.rhythm: The pages come out at once, the count is short and exact, and the clip ends on the closed envelope lying apart from the folder, the difference left visible rather than explained.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây raises the handset close to her mouth and, eyes on the map, orders the remaining road officer to hold the main cliff-road turnoff, her left forefinger pressing that junction on the paper. clips.end_frame: Mây at the left end of the table, handset clipped to her pouch strap, left forefinger resting on the thin footpath below the wall; Sơn at the right end, turned to the map, eyes on that footpath, breath easing out; folder at her end, copy envelope beside the map.

cinematic.intent: Expose a specific spatial limitation so later escape feels like exploitation, not police forgetting a door.
cinematic.composition: Keep Mây and Sơn above the existing map, main road and thin service route both visible.
cinematic.blocking: Mây at the table's left end, handset in her right hand, left forefinger on the map; Sơn at the right end, first angled toward the harbour, then square to the table. Folder and envelope stay where they lie.
cinematic.performance: Mây includes the limit she cannot fix and says it plainly, wanting Sơn to know the plan's real edge. Sơn takes the gap in without comfort, filing it as risk to Hạ. No reassuring nod, no shrug.
cinematic.focus: Keep her indicating hand and the two routes legible without readable labels or animated overlays.
cinematic.texture: Creased paper and a narrow drawn path make resources feel finite rather than omniscient.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her short radio-facing instruction stays over muted town sound, no redundant chorus of confirmations.
cinematic.rhythm: The radio order is quick and clear; the slide of her finger to the footpath is the slow part; the clip ends held on the uncovered path, the unfinished edge left open.

cinematic.performance: Sơn agrees to a limit that fights his urge to run to Hạ; the promise costs him and leaks only through the checked lean. Mây wants his word, not his courage, and takes it without softening. No solemn vow face, no hand on shoulder.
cinematic.focus: Keep his face and her closing hand readable, without a rack or new camera angle.
cinematic.texture: The folder remains where it was, an unaccepted alternative at the edge of the practical plan.
cinematic.sound_detail: His line is low and even, with canvas movement audible after it ends.
cinematic.rhythm: A held breath first, the condition stated plainly through the middle, then the map closing as the quiet seal on it; nothing is rehearsed or said twice.

cinematic.intent: Plant the later rescue signal through one ordinary object placement that can be recognized instantly.
cinematic.composition: Keep the same medium setup as the closed-map agreement, envelope within the existing table area.
cinematic.blocking: Same table geography: Mây at the left end, Sơn at the right. The envelope goes from beside the folded map to the middle of the table in Mây's right hand; her half-step is straight back from the table. Sơn stays planted.
cinematic.performance: Mây is precise rather than ritualistic, teaching the one thing he must not get wrong. Sơn watches like a man whose life will hang on her timing, and answers with trust he does not decorate. No mirrored rehearsal, no nodding exchange.
cinematic.focus: Keep her release of the envelope visible, not a new close-up or slow-motion hand study.
cinematic.texture: The thin envelope lies flat on worn wood, without adding a symbol or readable mark.
cinematic.sound_detail: One paper contact punctuates the short instruction; existing ambience keeps the action natural.
cinematic.rhythm: The lift is quick, the release and half-step carry the instruction, and the clip settles on the envelope lying still while Sơn answers; the demonstration is not repeated.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's bare right fingers slide under the edge of the flat copy envelope and lift it cleanly from the wood. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His hand draws the envelope back across the table, passing the closed confession folder without touching it, while Mây's hand stays flat on the folder and pulls it a few centimetres toward her side; his voice comes unseen. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The envelope settles upright in his right hand as the hand lowers past the table edge to his side; the bandaged left hand hangs empty beside it, no weapon and nothing else in either hand.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S

cinematic.intent: Leave Sơn carrying only the preview and his own vulnerable body into the next phase.
cinematic.composition: Use the stable detail frame for his sound right hand, bandaged left side and separate folder.
cinematic.blocking: The envelope moves from the near half of the table to Sơn's right hand at his side; Mây's left hand keeps the folder on the far half. Their hands never touch the same object.
cinematic.performance: The hand is controlled, not trembling for effect: the choice was made earlier and this only carries it out, leaving the confession with someone he trusts. The bandage keeps the cost in view. No lingering grip, no symbolic pause over the folder.
cinematic.focus: Hold the actual handoff plane sharp, with faces outside the detail frame rather than forced in.
cinematic.texture: Used paper edges, bandage cloth and bare fingers distinguish him from the black-glove memory next.
cinematic.sound_detail: Small envelope lift and quiet cloth movement lead into the memory's rain, no new ticking.
cinematic.rhythm: A clean lift, an unhurried pass over the folder, and the clip ends with the envelope already off the table and hanging at his side, ready to match the empty palms that follow.

scenes.title: Quá Khứ: Đôi Găng Đầu Tiên
scenes.story_time: PAST twenty-five years earlier rainy evening
scenes.purpose: Ơn nuôi dưỡng biến thành quyền sở hữu qua một món quà.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Present-day bag zipper finishes under the cut to the harbour overview, then sea wind takes over. Gloves stay in the cabin.

clips.start_frame: Rainy evening in the narrow alley behind the silk shop: young Sơn stands in the rain just beyond the awning's edge, soaked dark shirt, bare palms empty at his sides; young Bà Hai stands dry in the lamplit stockroom doorway, facing him.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Rain runs off young Sơn's hair and down his empty hands while young Bà Hai, dry in the doorway, looks him over and asks why he is standing in the rain, offering hot rice. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): His eyes go from her face to the dry strip of ground under the awning and back; his shoulders hunch, and he answers that he has no money and only asks to stand under the roof. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): He takes two careful steps forward into the awning's cover and stops short of the threshold, water dripping from his sleeves; rain keeps falling behind him, and she stays in the doorway, watching.
clips.end_frame: Young Sơn under the shallow awning just short of the doorway, wet hair dripping, bare hands empty at his sides, eyes on her; rain falling behind him in the alley; young Bà Hai in the lamplit doorway, watching him.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC_Y
dialogue.text: Đứng ngoài mưa chi vậy con? Vô ăn chén cơm nóng đã.

dialogue.speaker: SON_Y
dialogue.text: Con không có tiền đâu cô. Cho con đứng nhờ thôi.

clips.lighting: Distant-past rainy evening: warm silk-shop lamps as key from the desk side, cooler rain light at the windows and door.

cinematic.intent: Make the remembered kindness believable enough that rejecting Bà Hai later will hurt.
cinematic.composition: Match the region of empty young palms into the wide awning view, young Bà Hai already sheltered.
cinematic.blocking: Doorway and awning screen left with young Bà Hai inside the frame of the door; young Sơn starts in the rain right of the awning and moves two paces left into cover, stopping before the threshold. Neither carries anything.
cinematic.performance: He is hungry and wary, ashamed to need anything and testing whether the kindness has a hook. She is practical and attentive, and wants him to come to her on his own. No pleading eyes, no knowing villain smile.
cinematic.focus: Keep palms and their relative shelter readable, no impossible morph between old and young faces.
cinematic.texture: Rain-dark cheap clothes and the dry awning establish the immediate value of what she gives.
cinematic.sound_detail: Rain remains outside the shelter, her invitation direct and unornamented beneath it.
cinematic.rhythm: Her invitation comes immediately; his hesitation is the held middle; the decision is two small steps into cover near the end, with rain still moving behind him.

clips.start_frame: Inside the lamplit silk shop: young Sơn sits at the table in damp sleeves, hands in his lap; a steaming bowl of rice with chopsticks sits mid-table, nearer young Bà Hai, who sits across from him.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Young Sơn keeps his hands in his lap, his eyes moving between the steaming bowl and her face, waiting to be refused. Beat 2 (2.5–7.0s): Young Bà Hai slides the bowl across the wood to just in front of him with her fingertips and draws both hands back into her lap, telling him to eat. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): He takes up the chopsticks, glances at her one more time, and lifts the first mouthful; steam drifts past his face, rain murmurs outside, and she stays still, leaving the food to him.
clips.end_frame: Young Sơn eating with the bowl close in front of him, chopsticks in his right hand, eyes lowered to the rice; young Bà Hai across the table, hands withdrawn in her lap, watching; steam rising between them.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC_Y
dialogue.text: Ăn đi con. Thành phố này, ngoài cô ra, đâu ai cho không ai cái gì.

clips.lighting: Distant-past rainy evening: warm silk-shop lamps as key from the desk side, cooler rain light at the windows and door.

cinematic.intent: Show the first permission to receive care before later gifts acquire obligations.
cinematic.composition: Keep the bowl and both young faces within the same medium table relation.
cinematic.blocking: Table between them, young Bà Hai on the far side, young Sơn on the near side. The bowl moves from mid-table to directly in front of him under her fingertips; her hands then rest in her lap.
cinematic.performance: He is starved yet wary, reading her face for the catch before he dares to eat. She enjoys being the one who gives and asks nothing yet, letting him feel safe. No sentimental tears, no oversized gratitude.
cinematic.focus: Keep food and eyes readable without a sentimental insert of starving hands or oversized portions.
cinematic.texture: Steam and ordinary ceramic stand against the dry silk-shop interior and his damp sleeves.
cinematic.sound_detail: A bowl scrape and modest eating sounds play against rain, no warm sentimental music swell.
cinematic.rhythm: The waiting is the longest part; the push of the bowl and her short line release it, and the first mouthful lands late, leaving steam and chewing alive at the end.

clips.start_frame: Weeks later, same teak table and lamplight: a length of silk lies half-folded where the bowl stood; young Sơn, in a dry tucked shirt, holds its edge; young Bà Hai sits across from him, her hands near his.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Young Bà Hai's hands guide his to square the silk's edge and press one straight crease as she tells him the fold must be straight. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): She lets go; he folds the next layer himself, smoothing it flat with his palm, then checks her face, eager, and she gives a small approving dip of the head. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): She tilts her head toward the shop's front door, where the brass bell hangs still, and gives him the rule of the house; he turns toward the door and listens, one palm still on the folded silk.
clips.end_frame: Neatly folded silk on the table between them; young Sơn turned toward the front door, listening, one palm resting on the fold; young Bà Hai across the table, watching him with quiet approval; lamplight steady, soft rain outside.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC_Y
dialogue.text: Gấp cho thẳng nếp. Tai để ý chuông cửa. Nhà này nghe cho hết, nói thật ít.

clips.time_ellipsis: several weeks after first shelter, same year
clips.lighting: Distant-past rainy evening: warm silk-shop lamps as key from the desk side, cooler rain light at the windows and door.

cinematic.intent: Let useful teaching become a route into belonging before it hardens into control.
cinematic.composition: Match the familiar table composition across the stated time ellipsis, bowl replaced by folded silk.
cinematic.blocking: Same table geography as the bowl scene: young Bà Hai on the far side, young Sơn on the near side. The silk stays on the table between them; only his eyeline travels, toward the front door out of frame.
cinematic.performance: He is eager to get it right and glows a little at her approval; she is warm, almost motherly, and wants a boy who listens. Only his listening stillness hints at what the rule will become. No cold stare.
cinematic.focus: Keep fold and listening faces readable in the same medium plane, no internal cut to the bell.
cinematic.texture: Dry work cloth and tidier shirt placement mark time passed without changing their identities.
cinematic.sound_detail: Silk movement settles before the familiar instruction, bell only within its established shop context.
cinematic.rhythm: The guided fold settles first, his own fold earns the small approval, and the clip ends on the spoken rule and his turned head, the lesson sounding ordinary before it sounds like a fence.

clips.start_frame: On the teak desk, a plain open box holds a new pair of black leather gloves; young Bà Hai's hands rest beside it, green jade bracelet on her left wrist; young Sơn's bare hands wait at the desk's edge.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Young Bà Hai's hands lift the pair of new black gloves out of the open box, the jade bracelet sliding on her left wrist. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Young Sơn's bare palms come up together, open and side by side; she lays both gloves across them and smooths the leather fingers flat with one touch, her voice beginning unseen. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): As her voice names his new duty, his fingers curl slightly around the leather without putting the gloves on, and her hands withdraw toward the empty box.
clips.end_frame: Both new black gloves resting across young Sơn's open bare palms, his fingers lightly curled around them, not worn; young Bà Hai's hands drawing back beside the empty box on the teak desk, jade bracelet on her left wrist.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC_Y
dialogue.text: Găng mới của con. Từ đêm nay con giữ cửa sau, đứa nào quỵt nợ, con lo cho má.

clips.time_ellipsis: later that season, first glove gift
clips.lighting: Distant-past rainy evening: warm silk-shop lamps as key from the desk side, cooler rain light at the windows and door.

cinematic.intent: Reveal the gloves as a gift whose condition is spoken at the same moment.
cinematic.composition: Use the single detail setup for open glove box, her hands and his bare palms.
cinematic.blocking: Box on the left of the desk, his palms entering from the right, her hands working between them. Both gloves stay together and visible, moving from the box to his palms only; no glove is put on.
cinematic.performance: He receives with care, honoured to be trusted and unaware of the price; she gives warmly and states the condition in the same breath, as if it were part of the gift. No ominous pause, no trembling hands.
cinematic.focus: Keep both gloves accounted for and fingertips clear, with no age drift in the young hands.
cinematic.texture: New leather contrasts with the older teak desk, modest packaging rather than luxury gift staging.
cinematic.sound_detail: Soft leather and a box edge sound beneath her off-screen instruction, no ominous flourish.
cinematic.rhythm: The gloves come out at once, the laying across his palms is the held centre, and the spoken duty arrives last so the gift changes meaning before the shot ends.

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Hai lòng bàn tay trần của Sơn trẻ đưa lên, mở ra cạnh nhau; bà đặt cả đôi găng nằm ngang trên đó, vuốt phẳng các ngón găng một cái, giọng bà bắt đầu vang từ ngoài khung hình. clips.start_frame: Lamplit silk shop at night: young Sơn stands by the rear stock door, beside a bare patch of floor where his sleeping mat used to lie; the stock door stands ajar, an iron padlock hanging open on its outer hasp; young Bà Hai sits at the teak desk.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Young Sơn looks down at the bare boards beside the stock door where his sleeping mat used to be, his empty hands hanging at his sides. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His eyes go through the gap of the ajar door, where his rolled mat now lies inside the stockroom among the silk bolts, then drop to the iron padlock hanging on the outside of the hasp; his breath stops for a moment and his shoulders draw in. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He glances back at young Bà Hai at the desk; she is already watching him, calm and unmoving; his eyes return to the padlock and stay there as the hope of approval drains from his face.
clips.end_frame: Young Sơn by the ajar stock door, eyes fixed on the open padlock on its outer hasp, shoulders drawn in, breathing shallowly; his rolled mat inside the stockroom; young Bà Hai at the teak desk, still, watching him.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Rồi một đêm, chiếu ngủ của tôi bị dời vào kho. Chỗ trú mưa đã thành chỗ tôi không được rời.

clips.lighting: Distant-past rainy evening: warm silk-shop lamps as key from the desk side, cooler rain light at the windows and door.

cinematic.intent: Make the cost of shelter emerge as a physical arrangement he cannot ignore.
cinematic.composition: Keep young Sơn at the rear door and Bà Hai at the desk in the medium setup.
cinematic.blocking: Young Sơn screen left at the rear stock door, young Bà Hai screen right at the teak desk, the width of the room between them. He never touches the door or the lock; only his eyeline moves, floor to lock to her and back.
cinematic.performance: His face moves from wanting her approval to recognising dependence, and he hides the hurt because he has nowhere else to go. She watches without guilt, measuring his reaction. No tears, no slammed lock, no villain smirk.
cinematic.focus: Keep his eyeline to the lock understandable without an insert or camera move revealing another room.
cinematic.texture: Teak, stockroom iron and the simple mat belong to the same practical place she first welcomed him.
cinematic.sound_detail: Shop room tone continues under the older narrator, no lock slam or invented threat voice.
cinematic.rhythm: The empty floor is noticed first, the mat and the outside lock are the held centre, and the realisation lands on his look back to her; the end stays on the lock, unspoken.

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Mắt cậu nhìn qua khe cửa kho khép hờ: chiếc chiếu cuộn của cậu giờ nằm bên trong, giữa các cây lụa; rồi mắt rơi xuống ổ khóa sắt treo ở khoen phía ngoài; hơi thở khựng lại, vai co vào. clips.start_frame: Present-day cabin, late sun: the dark-olive canvas backpack lies open on the cot, folded black leather gloves visible on top inside; Sơn's bare hands rest on the canvas either side of the opening, white bandage on the left wrist.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's bare hands stay still on the canvas beside the open bag for a moment, the folded gloves untouched inside, then his right hand moves to the brass zipper pull at one end. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His left hand holds the canvas flat while the right draws the zipper along its track in one steady pass, and the opening closes over the gloves. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Both bare hands lift off the closed backpack and withdraw upward out of view; the bag stays on the cot, straps slack, warm low sunlight sliding across the canvas.
clips.end_frame: The dark-olive backpack closed and zipped on the cot, gloves out of sight inside, brass pull at the end of its track; Sơn's bare hands leaving the frame; low warm sun and cool window shadow across the canvas.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Đôi găng đầu tiên biến ơn một chén cơm thành một đời giữ cửa cho người khác.

clips.lighting: Present-day day-seven late afternoon at the cabin: warm low sun through the porch doorway as side key, cool window shadow across the cot.

cinematic.intent: Make the present hand capable of leaving the gift behind rather than reenacting the first acceptance.
cinematic.composition: Match to the existing folded pair in the cabin bag, bare older hands positioned beside it.
cinematic.blocking: Backpack lies lengthwise on the cot, opening toward the top of frame. Left hand steadies the canvas, right hand runs the zipper; both hands exit upward. The gloves never leave the bag.
cinematic.performance: Calm and final: the decision was made this morning, and closing the bag only seals it. A trace of reluctance in the opening stillness, nothing more. No ceremonial rejection, no lingering caress of the leather.
cinematic.focus: Keep both gloves inside until the zip covers them, no spare pair or hand disappearing into a pocket.
cinematic.texture: Worn canvas and older leather replace the remembered new gift box under current-day light.
cinematic.sound_detail: Zipper sound finishes naturally, then cabin wind prepares the harbour cut.
cinematic.rhythm: A short still pause, a single steady zip, and the hands leaving early enough that the closed bag holds the last seconds on its own before the harbour.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage, both hands bare. The black leather gloves already lie folded inside his open dark-olive canvas backpack on the cabin cot; he zips the backpack shut and leaves it on the cot.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc bộ vest đen sơ mi trắng mở cổ, cổ tay TRÁI quấn băng trắng y tế, hai bàn tay để trần. Đôi găng da đen đã xếp sẵn trong chiếc ba lô vải bố đang mở trên giường gỗ; anh kéo khóa đồng và để ba lô nằm lại trên giường.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong căn chòi gỗ một gian trên đồi dương (D7 late afternoon) · Góc máy: Đặc tả đạo cụ (85mm Insert) — khóa nét vào bàn tay và vật dụng mấu chốt. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (BACKPACK).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hai bàn tay trần của Sơn đặt yên trên lớp vải bên miệng ba lô đang mở một thoáng, đôi găng gập sẵn nằm nguyên bên trong; rồi tay phải chuyển tới đầu khóa kéo bằng đồng. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Tay trái giữ phẳng miệng ba lô, tay phải kéo khóa một đường đều, miệng túi khép kín trên đôi găng. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Hai bàn tay trần nhấc khỏi chiếc ba lô đã đóng và rời khỏi khung hình; ba lô nằm lại trên giường, quai đeo buông lỏng, nắng chiều thấp trườn trên lớp vải. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy qua nhịp 1 và nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (BACKPACK) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
