dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Lòng biết ơn đã biến thành sự giam giữ từ lúc nào?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Tô cơm thành công việc, đôi găng thành nghĩa vụ giữ cửa, Sơn hiện tại chọn cất chúng.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Bàn tay trắng của Sơn trẻ đối diện bàn tay có bằng chứng của anh hôm nay.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Ký ức làm việc từ chối Bà Hai ở cảng có giá tình cảm, không thêm một thông tin hồ sơ.

scenes.title: Bản Đồ Lúc Hoàng Hôn
scenes.purpose: Thiết lập một lần địa lý và vị trí lực lượng cho toàn cao trào.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep the two approaching engines into the arrivals. The next shot shows parking, not a repeated approach from the road.

clips.start_frame: Sunset on the empty harbour: sea and pier to the south, the low market and its lane landward, the lighthouse service path climbing uphill in the west; Mây at the landward edge of the apron; Thành at the near end of the market roof, folder under his arm.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây crosses the landward edge of the empty apron toward the junction where the market lane meets the harbour roads, while Thành moves along the low market roof toward its seaward corner, radio in hand. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Mây stops at the junction, looks down the east road and then the west road, and lifts her radio to give Thành his post; Thành drops to a crouch at the roof's corner. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Thành answers into his handset that he is in place; Mây lowers her radio and turns back toward the apron, and the pier, market lane and uphill path lie open and empty in the low sun, mooring ropes swaying.
clips.end_frame: Mây at the landward junction, radio lowered, turning back toward the apron; Thành crouched at the market roof's seaward corner, handset near his mouth; the empty pier, market lane and uphill service path all laid out under the low western sun, ropes swaying at the bollards.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Thành, giữ mái chợ. Tôi chốt lại ngã ba phía đất liền.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Em vào vị trí rồi chị. Bộ đàm thông.

clips.lighting: Present-day sunset: one low sun in the west as warm side key, clear soft sky fill on faces, long shadows all pointing east; no impossible opposing sun shadows.

cinematic.intent: Give viewers enough geography to anticipate where protection ends and escape might begin.
cinematic.composition: Use the full harbour width with market landward and uphill service path west in the same view.
cinematic.blocking: Mây's route runs along the landward edge of the apron to the junction; Thành's runs along the market roof to its seaward corner. They never share a route; the pier stays empty and the uphill service path clear in the west.
cinematic.performance: Both work with focused economy rather than triumph: Mây checks instead of posing and wants every post confirmed, Thành answers with regained steadiness behind his taped glasses. No pointing tour of the harbour, no heroic stance.
cinematic.focus: Keep routes and distances legible through depth instead of cutting to map fragments.
cinematic.texture: Concrete apron, boat ropes and low market structures form a finite recognizable arena.
cinematic.sound_detail: Sea and work sounds persist without crowd noise, since evacuation is already underway.
cinematic.rhythm: Movement starts at once on two separate routes, the radio exchange fills the middle and end, and the last seconds let the whole arena read clearly while both figures are still moving.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and round glasses whose right temple arm is held with tape after the stall struggle, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính tròn có gọng bên phải quấn băng keo trắng sau lúc bảo vệ dân ở quán nước, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bãi bê tông cầu cảng cá Hòn Sóng (vạch sơn trắng phân ranh) (D7 sunset) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây đi dọc mép bãi phía đất liền về ngã ba nơi hẻm chợ gặp hai đường vào cảng, còn Thành men theo mái chợ thấp về góc phía biển, bộ đàm trong tay. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Mây dừng ở ngã ba, nhìn dọc đường phía đông rồi phía tây, đưa bộ đàm lên giao vị trí cho Thành; Thành hạ người ngồi thụp ở góc mái. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Thành đáp vào bộ đàm là đã vào vị trí; Mây hạ bộ đàm, quay về phía bãi; cầu tàu, hẻm chợ và lối dốc lên hải đăng hiện rõ, trống trải dưới nắng xế, dây neo đung đưa. Mây nói ở nhịp 2, Thành đáp ở nhịp 3.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo · Đạo cụ khóa: DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD.

clips.start_frame: Rear lane behind the market wall at sunset: Bảy's van parked with rear doors open toward the clinic route, clean mattress inside; Linh beside the doors with his canvas medical bag; Bảy holding one door, checkered cloth on his shoulder; Mây at the lane mouth.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây walks up to the open rear doors, eyes checking the clean mattress and Linh's canvas bag, and starts telling Bảy and Linh that the injured come in only through this lane. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She turns to look down the empty lane toward the clinic, her flat hand tracing the wall line as she finishes; Linh, one hand on the mattress edge, answers that the stretcher and breathing gear are ready at the doors. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây gives Bảy a short look and walks back out of the lane toward the pier; Bảy and Linh stay by the open doors, the lane in front of them clear.
clips.end_frame: Mây walking out of the lane mouth toward the pier, her back to the van; Bảy holding one rear door, checkered cloth on his shoulder; Linh beside the open doors, hand on his canvas bag; the lane to the clinic empty and clear in wall shadow.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Có lệnh thì đón người qua hẻm này. Đừng ai băng qua bãi trống.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Cáng với đồ trợ thở để sẵn ở cửa xe rồi.

clips.lighting: Present-day sunset: one low sun in the west as warm side key, clear soft sky fill on faces, long shadows all pointing east; no impossible opposing sun shadows.

cinematic.intent: Make the rescue route feel real by showing what must remain unobstructed.
cinematic.composition: Frame the van behind cover and the lane to clinic with Mây, Bảy and Linh inside that relation.
cinematic.blocking: Van rear doors face the clinic lane; Linh stands left of the doors, Bảy right, holding one door. Mây's path runs from the lane mouth to the doors and back out the same way toward the pier.
cinematic.performance: Mây's instruction carries care for what these two can safely do; she wants them ready, not brave. Linh answers with calm readiness, Bảy with steady presence. No spoken heroics, no salutes.
cinematic.focus: Keep rear-door opening and route width visible, no repeated inventory of the medical bag.
cinematic.texture: Wall shadow, clean mattress edge and ordinary van metal distinguish this space from the exposed apron.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her line passes over quiet van and distant harbour sound, no clinical monitor anticipation.
cinematic.rhythm: Her instruction starts as she arrives, the route check and Linh's answer fill the middle, and the clip ends on her leaving while they stay, the lane held open.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Bác sĩ Linh wears his worn white medical coat with stethoscope around his neck, keeping his canvas emergency medical bag and breathing-support kit at hand. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Bác sĩ Linh khoác áo blouse trắng sờn vai, cổ đeo ống nghe y tế, tay xách túi cấp cứu vải bố có sẵn bình trợ thở. Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly, tay thao tác với khay ly cà phê hoặc thùng nhựa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Tuyến hẻm an toàn sau bờ tường chợ cá (nơi đậu xe cứu thương) (D7 sunset) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, MED_BAG, COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây đi tới cửa sau xe đang mở, mắt kiểm tra tấm nệm sạch và túi cấp cứu của bác sĩ Linh, bắt đầu dặn chú Bảy và bác sĩ chỉ đón người qua hẻm này. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Cô quay nhìn dọc con hẻm trống về phía trạm xá, bàn tay lướt theo bờ tường chỉ đường khi nói nốt; Linh đặt tay lên mép nệm, đáp là cáng và đồ trợ thở đã sẵn ở cửa xe. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây nhìn chú Bảy một thoáng rồi đi ra khỏi hẻm về phía cầu tàu; Bảy và Linh ở lại bên cửa xe, con hẻm trước mặt trống trải. Mây nói ở nhịp 1 và nhịp 2, Linh đáp cuối nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, MED_BAG, COFFEE_TRAY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: DUTY_POUCH, MED_BAG, COFFEE_TRAY.

clips.start_frame: On the low market roof at sunset, Thành crouches at the roof edge facing the harbour, round glasses taped at the right temple, folder under his left arm, radio handset in his right hand; below, two officers wait half-hidden at the junction walls; the public pier beyond is empty.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Thành looks down the east road and finds the first officer tucked behind the junction wall; his eyes rest there a moment. Beat 2 (3.0–5.5s): His gaze crosses to the west road and the second officer, then travels along the empty pier and the shuttered stalls, where nobody moves. Beat 3 (5.5–10.0s): He lifts the handset and reports quietly to Mây that both roads are covered and the civilians are gone, pushing his taped glasses up with one knuckle of his left hand; wind rattles the roof metal around him.
clips.end_frame: Thành crouched at the roof edge, handset at his mouth, taped glasses pushed up, eyes on the junction; below, both officers concealed at the junction walls, the public pier empty and still; roof metal rattling in the wind.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Chị Mây, đường đông đường tây đều có người. Bến cá trống, dân rút hết.

clips.lighting: Present-day sunset: one low sun in the west as warm side key, clear soft sky fill on faces, long shadows all pointing east; no impossible opposing sun shadows.

cinematic.intent: Show what Thành can verify while leaving the exchange itself outside his control.
cinematic.composition: Use his established observation side with both road officers and the empty public pier below.
cinematic.blocking: Thành low at the roof's seaward edge, facing down toward the harbour: east road on his left, west road on his right, the empty pier beyond. Handset in his right hand, folder clamped under his left arm.
cinematic.performance: Steadier than yesterday yet aware of his limits; he wants to report something true, not something reassuring. The taped glasses are a quiet reminder. No sweeping binocular scan, no tense gasp.
cinematic.focus: Keep the roads readable rather than manufacturing sharp tiny faces through impossible binocular reflections.
cinematic.texture: Wind on roof metal and taped frames connect this post to the earlier preparation.
cinematic.sound_detail: Radio confirmation is brief, with wind remaining at its existing level rather than dropping for suspense.
cinematic.rhythm: Two short checks, one per road, then the empty pier; the brief report fills the last stretch, and the wind keeps its level so the waiting stays uneasy.

clips.wardrobe_note: Thành wears his light-blue shirt and round glasses whose right temple arm is held with tape after the stall struggle, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính tròn có gọng bên phải quấn băng keo trắng sau lúc bảo vệ dân ở quán nước, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Mái tôn thấp của chợ cá nhìn xuống toàn bộ bến cảng (D7 sunset) · Góc máy: Qua vai / Điểm nhìn (50mm Over-shoulder/POV) — khóa trục ánh nhìn đối diện. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (CLIPBOARD).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Thành nhìn xuống đường phía đông, thấy người cảnh sát thứ nhất nép sau tường ngã ba, mắt dừng lại một thoáng. Nhịp 2 (3.0–5.5s): Ánh mắt anh chuyển sang đường phía tây và người thứ hai, rồi lướt dọc cầu tàu trống và dãy sạp đã đóng, không ai cử động dưới đó. Nhịp 3 (5.5–10.0s): Anh đưa bộ đàm lên, báo khẽ với Mây là hai đầu đường đã có người và dân đã rút hết, lấy đốt ngón tay trái đẩy gọng kính dán băng; gió làm mái tôn kêu lạch cạch. Thành nói ở nhịp 3.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (CLIPBOARD) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Qua vai / Điểm nhìn (50mm Over-shoulder/POV) — khóa trục ánh nhìn đối diện · Đạo cụ khóa: CLIPBOARD.

clips.start_frame: Sunset, the market lane opening onto the empty concrete apron: Sơn stands at the lane mouth in his black suit, copy envelope held low in his bare right hand, bandaged left wrist at his side; the painted center seam ahead, sea beyond.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn walks out of the market lane onto the open concrete, envelope low in his right hand, left arm loose at his side, and the tracking move travels with him at his pace. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): He crosses the empty apron without slowing, eyes moving from the east road to the west road, footsteps measured, until the painted white seam is under his shoes. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): He stops squarely on the seam and turns to face the landward approaches, the sea at his back; one breath settles his shoulders and the wind moves his jacket as the move eases to rest beside him.
clips.end_frame: Sơn standing on the painted center seam, facing the landward roads, sea behind him, envelope low in his bare right hand, bandaged left wrist at his side, jacket moving in the wind; the landward retreat lane open toward the market.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Hai mươi lăm năm trước tôi xin đứng nhờ mái hiên. Hôm nay tôi tự chọn chỗ đứng.

clips.lighting: Present-day sunset: one low sun in the west as warm side key, clear soft sky fill on faces, long shadows all pointing east; no impossible opposing sun shadows.

cinematic.intent: Place Sơn as a willing exposed participant, not a returning gunfighter.
cinematic.composition: Track along his established entry from market side, keeping sea behind and retreat landward.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn enters from the market lane, crosses the apron seaward to the center seam, then turns to face landward, the east road on his right and the west road on his left. The envelope stays in his right hand.
cinematic.performance: He has chosen to be seen: the walk is willing exposure, not a gunfighter's return. Fear stays under a steady breath, and he gives the unseen watchers nothing to read. No swagger, no hero stop.
cinematic.focus: Keep the seam and both approach directions readable, avoiding an orbit that reverses the arena.
cinematic.texture: Black suit against plain concrete shows how visible he has chosen to become.
cinematic.sound_detail: Measured footsteps and envelope cloth contact sit over rope and sea ambience.
cinematic.rhythm: The walk runs unbroken from the first frame, the eyes do the checking while the feet keep going, and the stop on the seam lands late, so the position is set and never repeated.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage, right hand uninjured and bare; no backpack on him, it stays on the cabin cot.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc bộ vest đen sơ mi trắng mở cổ, cổ tay TRÁI quấn băng trắng y tế, bàn tay phải lành lặn để trần; chiếc ba lô vải bố đã cất lại tại chòi gỗ từ cảnh 35.4.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bãi bê tông cầu cảng cá Hòn Sóng (vạch sơn trắng phân ranh) (D7 sunset) · Góc máy: Máy trượt ngang (35mm Tracking) — bám sát bước chân và nhịp di chuyển nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (RED_COPY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Sơn bước ra khỏi hẻm chợ lên nền bê tông trống, phong bì cầm thấp trong tay phải, tay trái buông lỏng; máy lia theo đúng nhịp bước của anh. Nhịp 2 (3.5–7.0s): Anh băng qua bãi không chậm lại, mắt lướt từ đường phía đông sang đường phía tây, bước chân đều, cho tới khi vạch sơn trắng nằm dưới mũi giày. Nhịp 3 (7.0–10.0s): Anh dừng ngay trên vạch, quay mặt về hai ngả đường từ đất liền, biển sau lưng; một hơi thở làm vai lắng xuống, gió lay vạt áo vest, máy dừng êm bên cạnh. Lời dẫn của Sơn chạy suốt từ nhịp 1.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (RED_COPY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Máy trượt ngang (35mm Tracking) — bám sát bước chân và nhịp di chuyển nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: RED_COPY.

clips.start_frame: Sơn on the seam at sunset, wind moving his black lapel, eyes on the landward road; copy envelope in his bare right hand at waist height, white-bandaged left wrist beside it.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's eyes leave the road and slide toward the market wall corner where Mây is hidden; his head barely turns. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): His look rests there and the tightness around his eyes eases a fraction, not a smile; he brings his bandaged left wrist against the envelope hand at his waist and presses it still. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): His eyes return to the landward road, jaw settling, a slow breath leaving through his nose; both hands stay in view at his waist while the wind lifts the edge of his jacket.
clips.end_frame: Sơn on the seam, eyes back on the landward road, jaw set, breath slowing; bare right hand holding the envelope at his waist, bandaged left wrist resting against it; wind moving his lapel.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Sau bức tường chợ có Mây. Lần đầu tiên, có người chờ để kéo tôi về.

clips.lighting: Present-day sunset: one low sun in the west as warm side key, clear soft sky fill on faces, long shadows all pointing east; no impossible opposing sun shadows.

cinematic.intent: Let the quiet check of his ally expose dependence beneath outward composure.
cinematic.composition: Keep close on Sơn from the established landward camera side, both hands fitting the lower frame.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn square to the landward road; Mây's hidden corner lies off frame toward the market wall. His right hand holds the envelope at waist height; the bandaged left wrist comes to rest against it.
cinematic.performance: Relief at knowing Mây is there, smaller than a smile; beneath it, a dependence he is not used to admitting. Then his attention goes back to the road. No anxious glance loop, no wince at the wrist.
cinematic.focus: Hold his eyes, with the bandage readable but not isolated by a rack or cut.
cinematic.texture: Coastal wind moves the same black jacket, skin texture remains natural in the fading light.
cinematic.sound_detail: Breath and existing harbour bed are sufficient, no stopped-watch ticking or heartbeat added.
cinematic.rhythm: One look away, one held moment of contact, one return ahead; the breath at the end leaves him ready rather than waiting.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage, right hand uninjured and bare; no backpack on him, it stays on the cabin cot.

clips.start_frame: Sunset harbour: Sơn alone on the center seam, envelope low in his right hand, facing the two empty landward roads, east and west; last daylight on the concrete, sea behind him.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn stands still on the seam while two separate engine sounds grow from the east and west roads; his head stays level and only his eyes shift between them. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Headlights appear on the east road, then on the west road, the black car and the white car each coming down its own approach, as Thành's voice reports them over the radio channel. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Both cars roll on toward the junction at an ordinary pace, their lights brightening against the fading day; Sơn settles his weight evenly on both feet and does not step off the seam.
clips.end_frame: Sơn planted on the center seam, envelope low in his right hand, eyes moving between two sets of headlights; the black car on the east road and the white car on the west road both still rolling toward the junction, neither stopped; last light on the concrete.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Chú ý, xe đen vào từ hướng đông, xe trắng từ hướng tây.

clips.lighting: Present-day sunset: one low sun in the west as warm side key, clear soft sky fill on faces, long shadows all pointing east; no impossible opposing sun shadows.

cinematic.intent: Make incoming threat audible before the visible arena fills with the two sides.
cinematic.composition: Hold the wide harbour setup with Sơn in the established place and both roads readable.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn center, facing landward; the east road enters on his right, the west road on his left. Each car stays on its own road, and neither reaches the apron in this clip.
cinematic.performance: He holds the place he chose; attention splits between two threats without his body showing it, only a quicker breath underneath. He wants them to find him exactly here. No frantic head turns, no step forward to meet them.
cinematic.focus: Keep both approaches readable at once; do not cut between headlights or move into a drone view.
cinematic.texture: Last daylight still defines concrete edges while headlights gain contrast, not full night instantly.
cinematic.sound_detail: Two distinct but ordinary engines rise from their actual directions, without racing or tire squeals.
cinematic.rhythm: Sound comes first and builds, the lights answer it in the middle, and the end leaves both cars still moving so the parking belongs entirely to the next scene.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage, right hand uninjured and bare; no backpack on him, it stays on the cabin cot.

dramaturgy.turn_vi: Khán giả thấy đường chính được giữ, lối bộ là khe hở, Sơn đứng giữa hai xe đang tới.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Một toàn cảnh rõ cho người xem tự dự đoán nguy cơ trước nhân vật.

scenes.title: Hai Chiếc Xe
scenes.purpose: Hai phe tới một bãi trao đổi, Hạ có vị trí và hướng thoát rõ.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep both engines idling under the first new demand. Do not re-establish the same five positions again.

clips.start_frame: Dusk: Bà Hai a few paces east, unlit holder in her right fingers, watching Dũng pressed close against Sơn, Dũng's right fist on Sơn's sleeve and his left hand at the open flap of his work bag.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bà Hai watches the struggle; her eyes drop to Dũng's left hand as it comes out of the work bag closed around the slim, distinctive Tê applicator. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): Recognition hits: her breath catches, the sweetness leaves her face, and she snaps Dũng's name, then tries to recover command, ordering him to put it away. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): She takes one involuntary step forward and raises her left hand, the jade bracelet catching the light as the violet sleeve slides back, but she is still paces away; Dũng does not turn, his left fist half-hiding the device against the bag.
clips.end_frame: Bà Hai one step forward, left hand raised, holder in her right fingers, still paces from the two men; Dũng pressed against Sơn, back half-turned to her, the device half-hidden in his left fist against the work bag; Sơn straining beyond his shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Dũng! Má chỉ bảo giữ người thôi. Cất ống Tê đó lại!

clips.lighting: Dusk continuing: low blue skylight with faces readable through soft fill, car lamps from their established positions; harbour floodlight still off.

cinematic.intent: Let Bà Hai recognize a limit being crossed before Sơn loses his strength.
cinematic.composition: Frame her watching Dũng close to Sơn, keeping the partly obscured device a secondary edge detail.
cinematic.blocking: Bà Hai in the medium foreground, east of the two men; Dũng and Sơn locked together beyond her, Dũng's left hand low at his bag. Her single step closes only part of the distance.
cinematic.performance: Bà Hai's authority cracks for one breath: her own man is crossing a limit she set, and she fears for Sơn. Then she forces her voice back into command, wanting obedience more than mercy. No scream, no hand to the chest.
cinematic.focus: Favor Bà Hai's recognition, not the device mechanism; its distinctive shape need only be recognizable.
cinematic.texture: Left jade bracelet catches the remaining light as her sleeve lifts, no sudden age or outfit change.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her interrupted breath and one slipper step precede the command; leave device operation inaudible and undescribed.
cinematic.rhythm: The recognition is quick, the sharp name lands, and her step arrives a moment too late, ending unresolved with her hand still raised.

clips.start_frame: Dusk: Sơn's face braced against Dũng's shoulder, jaw clenched, eyes forward; Hạ a blurred figure beyond his shoulder, held to the west; low light on his skin.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn strains against Dũng, jaw clenched, as Hạ's warning about the thing in Dũng's hand comes from beyond his shoulder. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Something changes in his face: his brow knits in confusion, a blink comes late, his breath catches, and when he tries to plant his feet harder, the effort never reaches his shoulders. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): His eyes try to hold on Hạ and lose focus for a moment; his head tips a few degrees as his balance starts to go, and beyond him Hạ's blurred figure turns toward him while his breathing stays audible.
clips.end_frame: Sơn's head tipping a few degrees, eyes losing focus, lips parted, breath audible and uneven, balance going; Dũng's shoulder still against him; Hạ's blurred figure beyond, turned toward him.

dialogue.speaker: HA_D
dialogue.text: Anh Sơn, coi chừng cái ống trong tay Dũng!

clips.lighting: Dusk continuing: low blue skylight with faces readable through soft fill, car lamps from their established positions; harbour floodlight still off.

cinematic.intent: Hold the frightening moment when Sơn knows his body is no longer obeying him.
cinematic.composition: Keep a close-up on Sơn, Dũng's shoulder defining contact and Hạ blurred beyond his shoulder.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn centered, Dũng's shoulder pressing in from one side, Hạ soft in the background on the other. Sơn's head tilts slightly; no hands, device or point of contact in view.
cinematic.performance: Sơn fights to stay present; the fear is not pain but his body no longer obeying, and he keeps reaching for Hạ with his eyes. No seizure, no rolling eyes, no staged gasp.
cinematic.focus: Stay on his face through Hạ's off-frame call; no cutaway, orbit or artificial pupil effect.
cinematic.texture: Skin texture and sweat remain natural, collar tension softens instead of becoming instantly corpse-grey.
cinematic.sound_detail: His breath remains audible under Hạ's single call, with the harbour bed continuing unchanged.
cinematic.rhythm: The warning lands at once; the weakness arrives unevenly through the middle; the clip ends just as his balance goes, before any descent.

clips.start_frame: Dusk: Sơn's knees beginning to give on the center seam beside the copy envelope, Dũng gripping his jacket from the right, a mooring bollard just behind Sơn; Hạ held in the west background, straining toward him.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's knees give and he sinks toward the concrete beside the envelope; Dũng shifts both fists into his jacket and takes his weight. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Dũng steers the fall backward so Sơn's back meets the mooring bollard, lowering him rather than dropping him, cloth dragging against the iron, and Sơn comes to rest seated as Dũng tells him to sit still. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn sits slumped against the bollard, head tilted, hands open on the concrete, chest rising and falling visibly; Dũng crouches over him with one fist still in his collar, possessive, not concerned.
clips.end_frame: Sơn seated limp against the mooring bollard, head tilted, bare hands open on the concrete, chest visibly rising and falling; Dũng crouched over him, one fist in his collar; the envelope on the seam beside them; Hạ in the west background, straining.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Ngấm Tê rồi, Bóng Ma. Ngồi yên, mày phải còn nguyên cho má.

clips.lighting: Dusk continuing: low blue skylight with faces readable through soft fill, car lamps from their established positions; harbour floodlight still off.

cinematic.intent: Keep Sơn visibly alive and vulnerable, avoiding the visual language of a completed death.
cinematic.composition: Show bollard, center seam and both men's full balance in a stable wide from the same axis.
cinematic.blocking: Seen wide from the landward side: the bollard just seaward of the seam, Sơn lowered straight back against it, Dũng on his right. The envelope stays on the seam, untouched by either man. Hạ remains far west.
cinematic.performance: Sơn cannot stop the descent but keeps breathing, eyes half-open and aware. Dũng handles him like recovered property, careful only because damage would lower its value. No death pose, no tender cradling.
cinematic.focus: Retain chest movement and Dũng's supporting hold within the wide; do not seek a death-like eye insert.
cinematic.texture: Bollard and concrete retain their established surfaces, with no new blood, debris or shattered objects.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use cloth dragging against the bollard and one soft shoe shift, not a heavy body-impact effect.
cinematic.rhythm: The descent fills the first half and ends seated; the second half registers helplessness through breathing while Dũng claims him.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bà Hai reaches the bollard and looks down at Sơn's slack face and rising chest, knowing at once what this is, and names it flatly to Dũng. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She orders him back to give Sơn air and steps into the gap between them, her violet sleeve pushing his arm off the collar; Dũng gives a pace of ground, jaw working. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She lowers her left hand onto Sơn's shoulder, jade bracelet against the black suit, and stays standing over him, watching his breath; her face keeps its authority, the fear showing only in how still she holds.
clips.end_frame: Bà Hai standing between Sơn and Dũng, left hand on Sơn's shoulder, jade bracelet against the black suit, holder in her right fingers, eyes on his breathing; Sơn seated against the bollard, chest moving; Dũng a pace back beyond her shoulder, jaw tight.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Nó trúng Tê, còn thở. Lùi ra cho nó thở, Dũng. Cấm đụng vô nữa.

clips.lighting: Dusk continuing: low blue skylight with faces readable through soft fill, car lamps from their established positions; harbour floodlight still off.

cinematic.intent: Show that Bà Hai knows the drug and is forced to face what her own order enabled.
cinematic.composition: Keep Bà Hai beside the seated Sơn, Dũng beyond her shoulder, their separation readable in medium framing.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn seated at the bollard in the lower frame; Bà Hai comes in from the east and plants herself between him and Dũng, who yields a pace to the far side. Her left hand ends on Sơn's shoulder.
cinematic.performance: Factual first: she knows the drug and its owner, and that her own order made room for it. The maternal claim follows, still an assertion of ownership; concern never softens her command. No tears, no kneeling embrace.
cinematic.focus: Hold her face and Sơn's breathing shoulder together, with no rack to a symbolic tear.
cinematic.texture: Jade remains on LEFT wrist and violet sleeve lies against the black suit without wardrobe drift.
cinematic.sound_detail: Breathing is slightly clearer now, her words above it, with no heart monitor invented on the pier.
cinematic.rhythm: Recognition is instant, the order and her step follow without a pause, and the hand on his shoulder is the complicated last beat, held while his breathing goes on.

clips.lighting: Dusk continuing: low blue skylight with faces readable through soft fill, car lamps from their established positions; harbour floodlight still off.

cinematic.intent: Preserve Hạ's agency through resistance rather than an implausible trip to the center envelope.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide to keep Kiên and Hạ west, Bà Hai beside Sơn center, envelope still on its seam.
cinematic.blocking: Seen wide from the landward side: Kiên and Hạ west of center, pulling in opposite directions; Bà Hai and the seated Sơn at the bollard near center; the envelope on the seam between the groups. Nobody moves toward it.
cinematic.performance: Kiên demands both assets in a smooth voice that begins to clip; he needs a way out more than the copy. Hạ's refusal stays physical and silent, all in her planted feet. Bà Hai guards what she claims. No heroic quip, no tug-of-war comedy.
cinematic.focus: Keep the opposing body directions readable instead of hunting faces with focus changes.
cinematic.texture: Grey hem presses against her planted sandals, COPY envelope remains separate and untouched on concrete.
cinematic.sound_detail: A shoe scrape and taut fabric give her resistance weight under Kiên's single demand.
cinematic.rhythm: His demand opens the clip, the pull meets a clear stop in the middle, and the last beat holds the contested balance without another release attempt.

clips.start_frame: Preview envelope on the center seam. Sơn sits limp against the mooring bollard, breathing; Bà Hai stands at his side, left hand on his shoulder, holder in her right fingers; Dũng a pace behind her; Kiên west of center gripping Hạ's left upper arm.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Bà Hai straightens beside the bollard and squares her small body toward Kiên, left hand still on Sơn's shoulder, refusing him in a low, hard voice as her right fingers tighten on the holder. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Dũng stops at her shoulder, jaw working, breath loud through his nose; Bà Hai plants herself across Sơn's side, chin raised, violet silk stirring in the wind, while west of the seam Kiên draws Hạ in close against him.
clips.end_frame: Bà Hai standing across Sơn's side between him and the west, left hand clamped on Dũng's forearm, holder in her right fingers; Dũng at her shoulder breathing hard; Sơn limp against the bollard, chest rising; Kiên west of the seam holding Hạ close; envelope still on the seam.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Bên Kiên đứa nào bước qua vạch, tao không tha.

clips.lighting: Last blue dusk: soft cool skylight, car lamps in established positions, harbour floodlight still OFF. Do not switch it on in this shot.

cinematic.intent: Make Bà Hai's protection emotionally real while keeping its possessive language visible.
cinematic.composition: The wide retains the preview at center seam, Sơn at bollard, Kiên and Hạ west.
cinematic.blocking: Envelope on the center seam, Sơn at the bollard, Kiên and Hạ west. Bà Hai holds Sơn's west flank; Dũng's surge toward the hostage lane stops within one stride. Her LEFT hand moves from Sơn's shoulder to Dũng's forearm; holder stays in her RIGHT.
cinematic.performance: Protection and possession in one breath: she means the refusal, yet speaks of Sơn as something she owns and will not hand over twice. Dũng's loyalty curdles into threat. No softened mother glow, no tears, no absolution.
cinematic.focus: Keep enough depth that Sơn's inability to choose and Hạ's continuing restraint remain present together.
cinematic.texture: Violet silk moves in the same dusk wind; no halo-like new light or cleansing rain.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her slipper scrape and the idling engines remain ordinary, allowing the contradiction to carry the line.
cinematic.rhythm: The refusal lands inside the first seconds; Dũng's surge and her pull-back fill the middle; the last beat holds the new spacing alive and invites Kiên's answer, with no sentimental pause.

dialogue.speaker: KIEN
dialogue.text: Bà bán đứt cả hai đứa cho tôi rồi. Giờ giở giọng làm mẹ sao?

clips.lighting: Last blue dusk: soft cool skylight, car lamps in established positions, harbour floodlight still OFF. Do not switch it on in this shot.

cinematic.intent: Let Kiên puncture Bà Hai's self-justification while exploiting the opening she has left.
cinematic.composition: Frame Kiên and restrained Hạ medium, Bà Hai on his opposing eyeline, car west behind.
cinematic.blocking: Kiên west of the seam with the white car behind; his RIGHT hand stays on Hạ's LEFT upper arm, his empty LEFT hand gives the signal. Bà Hai holds the opposing eyeline. The guard crosses only at the frame edge toward center.
cinematic.performance: Irritation, not surprise: a buyer annoyed that sold goods are being reclaimed. His polish slips into contempt while his grip on Hạ never loosens. Hạ stays alert, measuring the guard. No sneering villain laugh.
cinematic.focus: Stay with his practiced face as the smile thins, with the guard's direction readable at the edge.
cinematic.texture: White jacket has the same creasing from the pull, grey dress remains unchanged and no weapon appears early.
cinematic.sound_detail: Use a soft shoe reposition and paper rustle already on the apron; no new offscreen gun sound.
cinematic.rhythm: The accusation is clipped and lands early; the signal is a small gesture in the middle; the backward step carries the threat toward the car and leaves the line hanging.

clips.start_frame: Blue dusk, harbour floodlight off. Mây at the edge of landward cover beside the floodlight switch, right hand near it, two officers crouched behind her; across the apron Sơn slumped against the bollard; black car east, white car west.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Mây throws the floodlight switch with her right hand; the relay clicks and the big lamp warms from dull orange to steady white across the concrete, blue dusk giving way without any flash. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): She steps out of cover into the light, left hand raised open, and calls the police order for everyone to stand still and let go of the people they hold, her voice cutting over the idling engines. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She advances along the painted safe line at a measured walk, eyes moving between the two cars, while the officers fan out behind her; across the apron Sơn's head stays slumped against the bollard, his chest rising under the new light.
clips.end_frame: Harbour lit steadily white; Mây a few paces along the safe line, left hand open at shoulder height, two officers spread behind her; Sơn slumped at the bollard across the apron, chest rising; both cars unmoved, engines idling.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Công an! Cả bãi đã bị bao vây. Đứng yên, buông người ra!

clips.lighting: Begins in blue dusk with harbour floodlight OFF. Mây switches it ON during the specified action; from then on it is a hard high key and stays on.

cinematic.intent: Change control of the space through a visible police action rather than a magical rescue arrival.
cinematic.composition: A wide reveals Mây emerging from landward cover, officers behind, both cars in fixed positions.
cinematic.blocking: Mây starts at the landward cover edge with the switch at her RIGHT hand, then walks the painted safe line toward center; two officers fan out a pace behind. Sơn stays at the bollard; both cars keep their east and west positions.
cinematic.performance: Command without triumph: her voice is clear and forceful, yet her eyes keep counting the armed people, aware any of them could still move. Relief stays hidden. No victory stride, no heroic slow walk.
cinematic.focus: Keep the lamp change readable across the full space, never whitening the frame into a flash transition.
cinematic.texture: Blue dusk yields to the same floodlight on concrete, preserving skin detail and established shadow directions.
cinematic.sound_detail: One switch or relay click, followed by her command and controlled footfalls, no action-music reset.
cinematic.rhythm: A dim first beat ends on the click; the lamp settles before she speaks; the short order lands mid-shot; the remaining seconds are a steady advance that establishes the intervention without overreaching.

clips.start_frame: Thành crouched at the market roof edge, radio handset at his chest, evidence folder under his arm, looking down at the floodlit apron: the white car west, Kiên and Hạ beside its rear fender, his right hand on her left upper arm; the service stair dark beyond.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Below the roof edge, Kiên ducks behind the white car's rear fender and drags Hạ down with him by her left upper arm, both slipping out of the floodlight into the car's shadow. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The car body hides them; Thành leans out over the roof edge, glasses catching the floodlight, raises the handset to his mouth and starts reporting to Mây as his eyes track along the car toward the west. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The pair reappear past the car's far end, Hạ dragging her steps as Kiên steers her toward the foot of the dark service stair; Thành finishes his report naming the route, his free hand pressing the folder flat against his chest.
clips.end_frame: Thành at the roof edge, handset at his mouth, folder pressed to his chest; below, Kiên and Hạ moving away from the white car's far end toward the foot of the service stair, his right hand on her left upper arm.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Chị Mây, hướng tây! Kiên núp sau xe trắng, đang lôi Hạ lên cầu thang kỹ thuật.

clips.lighting: Early night: harbour floodlight ON continuously as hard high key, car lamps unchanged, dark sea behind.

cinematic.intent: Give the audience a concrete route of escape at the moment Kiên exploits it.
cinematic.composition: Use Thành's roof-side observation angle, white car below and the western service stair beyond.
cinematic.blocking: Thành fixed at the roof edge above the apron. Below, Kiên and Hạ pass behind the white car from its rear fender to its far end, then head west for the service stair. Kiên's RIGHT hand keeps Hạ's LEFT upper arm throughout.
cinematic.performance: Thành reads geography before emotion: concentration, a flicker of alarm when the pair vanish, then disciplined clarity. Kiên moves low and hurried; Hạ resists only through dragged steps. No shouting, no panicked arm waving.
cinematic.focus: Favor the route and paired movement below; do not pull focus into an unnecessary full face of Thành.
cinematic.texture: Roof edge and car paint catch the new floodlight, service stair remains darker but legible.
cinematic.sound_detail: Radio compression carries the short report over shoes moving behind the idling car.
cinematic.rhythm: The duck behind the car is quick; the occlusion holds tension while Thành starts talking; the reveal at the far end resolves the route exactly as his report completes.

clips.start_frame: Floodlit apron by the bollard: Dũng crouched behind Sơn with both forearms hooked under his armpits, Sơn half lifted and limp, heels on the concrete; black car a few metres east; Mây two strides away on the landward side, an officer at her shoulder.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây closes the last two strides and clamps both hands on Dũng's right forearm above the cut cuff ring, levering it off Sơn's chest, while the officer slides in on Sơn's right and gets a shoulder under his arm. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Sơn's weight tips onto the officer, who braces him at the hip with a hand cradling the back of his head; Mây plants herself between them and Dũng, palm flat toward him, and orders Sơn's head kept up and Sơn stretchered to Linh's van. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Dũng backs off step by step, eyes still on Sơn, until his shoulder meets a fish crate beside the black car and he sinks behind it; the officer holds Sơn upright, bandaged left wrist hanging.
clips.end_frame: The officer standing with Sơn's right arm over his shoulders, a hand behind Sơn's head, Sơn's chest rising, bandaged left wrist hanging; Mây between them and the black car, palm toward Dũng; Dũng crouched behind a fish crate by the black car, watching.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Giữ đầu anh ấy! Lên cáng, đưa ra xe bác sĩ Linh sau chợ.

clips.lighting: Early night: harbour floodlight ON continuously as hard high key, car lamps unchanged, dark sea behind.

cinematic.intent: Make Sơn's extraction competent while showing why Mây cannot chase every threat at once.
cinematic.composition: Keep medium-wide handheld at bollard height, Mây and assisting officer approaching from landward side.
cinematic.blocking: Everyone at bollard height. Mây and the officer come in from landward; the officer takes Sơn's RIGHT side, Mây wedges between Sơn and Dũng. Dũng retreats east toward the black car and the crate already there.
cinematic.performance: Mây's urgency is practical: hands first, words short, eyes on Dũng. Dũng gives ground unwillingly, still hunting a way back to Sơn. Sơn shows only breath. No punches traded, no cheering officers.
cinematic.focus: Keep the support points and seated man's breath readable, not a montage of isolated fighting hands.
cinematic.texture: Sơn's LEFT bandage remains visible, the black car stays east and no fish crate becomes a body receptacle.
cinematic.sound_detail: Short commands, cloth shifting and supported steps replace heavy blows or a crowd cheer.
cinematic.rhythm: Separation fills the first beat; the weight transfer is the careful middle; Dũng's retreat stretches the final beat while the support holds steady, so the take ends in motion.

clips.start_frame: Foot of the narrow service stair behind the west apron: lower iron gate open, a loose cart standing beside it on the harbour side; Kiên in the gateway, right hand on Hạ's left upper arm; Hạ facing the stair; floodlight glow behind them.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Kiên pushes Hạ through the lower gate onto the first step and follows her in, his right hand never leaving her arm, shoulders hunched, the white jacket creasing across his back. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He reaches back through the gateway with his free left hand, hooks the cart's edge and hauls it over; it crashes onto its side across the gateway, wheels spinning, its loose securing rope snagging around the gate bars. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He turns and drives Hạ upward with a clipped order to climb ahead of him; she climbs, eyes running up the narrowing turns of the stair, thin sandals slipping on the metal treads as the clang fades under their steps.
clips.end_frame: Cart lying on its side across the lower gateway, rope snagged in the bars, one wheel still turning; above it Kiên and Hạ two steps up the narrow stair, his right hand on her left upper arm, Hạ looking up at the turns ahead.

dialogue.speaker: KIEN
dialogue.text: Lên! Đi trước tao. Cổng chặn rồi, không ai theo kịp đâu.

clips.lighting: Early night: harbour floodlight ON continuously as hard high key, car lamps unchanged, dark sea behind.

cinematic.intent: Turn the escape into an obstacle that will cost the rescuers real time.
cinematic.composition: Frame the lower service gate and first stair together, keeping harbour direction behind them.
cinematic.blocking: Gate at frame center, stair rising behind it; the cart starts beside the gate on the harbour side. Kiên keeps his RIGHT hand on Hạ's LEFT upper arm and works the cart with his LEFT. The pair end on the stair above the gate.
cinematic.performance: Kiên's polish cracks into hurried physical effort; he is buying distance and knows it. Hạ refuses to collapse, quietly memorizing every turn of the narrowing route. No screaming, no struggling theatrics.
cinematic.focus: Keep the cart obstruction and departing pair sharp enough to understand in one wide setup.
cinematic.texture: Metal gate and cart wheels remain the same objects, no new padlock or unexplained barrier.
cinematic.sound_detail: Cart wheel scrape and gate clang are brief, then shoes climb into the thinner stair echo.
cinematic.rhythm: Passing the gate is quick, the cart's fall is the single loud event, then the climb begins and stays in motion to the cut as the clang settles under footsteps.

scenes.purpose: Kiên lên tháp qua lối phụ, tuyến cứu Sơn và truy bắt tách rõ.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep Sơn breathing unchanged across the cut to Linh beside him. Hạ route returns only in its next dedicated shot.

clips.start_frame: Floodlit apron in early night: officers posted at the black car east and the white car west, the public pier empty of civilians; Mây on the safe line at center, Thành beside her with his radio handset and folder.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây turns from the secured cars to the west and points her right arm at the blocked service gate beyond the white car, giving Thành the first team and the gate, her left hand resting on the radio at her pouch. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Thành tucks the folder under his arm and runs west with two officers; Mây pivots toward the black car and sweeps her open hand east, sending the second team to hold Bà Hai's people and everyone left on the apron. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She stays planted on the safe line, eyes following both routes; in the far background the gate team reaches the toppled cart at the lower gate and bends to grip its frame, while the officers at the cars hold position.
clips.end_frame: Mây on the safe line at center, radio in hand, watching the west; officers holding both cars; the second team moving east; in the far background Thành's team crouched at the toppled cart in the lower gateway, hands on its frame, starting to lift.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Thành, dẫn tổ một mở cổng phụ lên tháp. Tổ hai giữ Bà Hai và mọi người trên bãi.

clips.lighting: Early night: established harbour floodlight as high key outside, warm van lamp inside, dim lighthouse work practicals on the stairs.

cinematic.intent: Show the intervention narrowing to distinct tasks instead of an undefined harbour brawl.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide to separate secured cars, the public pier and the team at the service gate.
cinematic.blocking: Mây holds center on the safe line. Thành's team runs west past the white car to the lower service gate in the background; the second team goes east past the black car. Officers stay at both cars; no civilians anywhere in frame.
cinematic.performance: Focused authority: Mây splits her force with economy, already weighing the minutes Kiên is gaining. Thành answers with movement, not words. Tension shows in her fixed stance and quick eyes. No barking drill-sergeant delivery, no chorus of replies.
cinematic.focus: Keep all task routes in one readable depth, with Mây not blocking the view of their departure.
cinematic.texture: Floodlight remains steady on cleared concrete and parked cars, no new smoke or chaos dressing.
cinematic.sound_detail: Order, restrained radio-squelch and measured boots form the rhythm; do not add scattered shots, extra reply lines or shouting crowds.
cinematic.rhythm: Two short assignments set the pace; each team leaves on its own route at once; the last beat holds Mây still while both routes stay in motion behind her, with no restaged rush.

clips.start_frame: Rear lane behind the market wall: Bảy's van with rear doors open, warm lamp over a clean mattress inside; Sơn half-upright on a wheeled stretcher at the doors, eyes half-open; Linh at the stretcher's head, Bảy at its foot, checkered cloth on his shoulder.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Linh walks at the stretcher's head with two fingers on Sơn's neck and his eyes on the rise of Sơn's chest, quietly telling him his breathing is holding; Bảy rolls the foot end up to the open rear doors, checking the clearance over his shoulder. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): At the doors Bảy asks Linh to take the head; Linh cradles the back of Sơn's skull while the two of them lift and slide him off the stretcher onto the clean mattress in one careful move. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Linh climbs in and kneels at Sơn's right, sets the canvas medical bag beside him and lays a palm on his chest to count breaths; Bảy steps back to the rear door, wiping his hands on the checkered cloth.
clips.end_frame: Sơn on his back on the clean mattress inside the van, chest rising, eyes half-open; Linh kneeling at his right side, palm on his chest, medical bag beside him; Bảy standing at the open rear door, checkered cloth in his hands.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Anh Sơn, nhịp thở còn đều. Vào xe rồi tôi theo dõi tiếp.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Bác sĩ đỡ đầu nghen, cửa sau tui mở sẵn rồi.

clips.lighting: Early night: established harbour floodlight as high key outside, warm van lamp inside, dim lighthouse work practicals on the stairs.

cinematic.intent: Keep the audience connected to Sơn's physical condition while the pursuit moves elsewhere.
cinematic.composition: Frame Linh beside the supported stretcher, van rear doors and Bảy's guiding position clearly visible.
cinematic.blocking: The stretcher comes up the lane to the open rear doors, Linh at the head, Bảy at the foot. The transfer happens at the doors; Linh ends inside at Sơn's RIGHT side, Bảy outside at the rear door. LEFT bandage stays visible.
cinematic.performance: Linh's calm is deliberate, aimed at the patient as much as the task; Bảy's whole attention is on the doorway and on not jolting Sơn. Sơn only breathes. No comic fuss, no frantic medical shouting.
cinematic.focus: Hold the supported body and guiding hands in the same medium depth, not a diagnostic insert.
cinematic.texture: Clean mattress contrasts with worn van metal; bandage LEFT and black suit remain identical to the pier.
cinematic.sound_detail: Stretcher wheels and a restrained latch sound carry the move, with breathing above the distant harbour commands.
cinematic.rhythm: A steady approach, one careful transfer at the centre of the take, then quiet settling with breath audible; no second lift and no repeated exterior arrival.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage, right hand uninjured and bare; no backpack on him, it stays on the cabin cot. Bác sĩ Linh wears his worn white medical coat with stethoscope around his neck, keeping his canvas emergency medical bag and breathing-support kit at hand. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

clips.start_frame: Top of the narrow service stair below the gallery, dim work light: Hạ on the last steps facing the old iron hatch with its rusted wheel; Kiên one step below and behind her, right hand on her left upper arm, handgun low in his left hand.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ climbs the last two steps and slows at the old iron hatch, letting Kiên's pull go slack, and tells him over her left shoulder that this route only reaches the lamp deck, not the road. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Kiên snaps at her to stop stalling and open it, the handgun still pointed low at the steps; Hạ rests her free right hand on the cold rim of the hatch, her eyes sliding across the rusted wheel to the small inner latch. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): A metal clang echoes up from far below; Kiên's head turns down the stairwell, listening, his grip easing a fraction, while Hạ keeps her eyes on the latch and breathes slowly through her nose.
clips.end_frame: Hạ at the head of the stair beside the old iron hatch, free right hand on its rim, eyes on the small inner latch; Kiên one step below, right hand on her left upper arm, head turned down the stairwell, listening, handgun low in his left hand.

dialogue.speaker: HA_D
dialogue.text: Lối này chỉ lên sàn đèn thôi, không ra đường lớn đâu ông.

dialogue.speaker: KIEN
dialogue.text: Đừng câu giờ. Mở cái nắp đó ra.

clips.lighting: Early night: established harbour floodlight as high key outside, warm van lamp inside, dim lighthouse work practicals on the stairs.

cinematic.intent: Make Hạ use familiarity with the tower before she can reach any physical advantage.
cinematic.composition: The wide includes the hatch, Hạ ahead and Kiên immediately behind with handgun LOW in LEFT hand.
cinematic.blocking: The narrow stair rises to the hatch at frame center. Hạ leads, Kiên one step below and behind; his RIGHT hand on her LEFT upper arm, handgun LOW in his LEFT, muzzle toward the steps. She never turns toward the gun side.
cinematic.performance: Hạ performs harmless practicality while her mind works the latch; fear stays under her breathing. Kiên is impatient, half his attention on pursuit. No glamour close-up energy, no visible scheming smile.
cinematic.focus: Keep hatch and the two body positions readable, avoiding a glamour close-up that hides the gun hand.
cinematic.texture: Grey cotton brushes old painted metal, Kiên's white suit begins catching dust from the confined route.
cinematic.sound_detail: Old metal complaining under a hand and thin stair echo under her line, no magical lock mechanism.
cinematic.rhythm: Her slowing is small and early; the exchange is short and clipped; the distant clang turns his head in the last beat and hands her the stolen look at the latch.

clips.wardrobe_note: Hạ wears her plain grey cotton dress and thin sandals, scarf absent from neck, silver hair clip still pinned at the back of her hair. Kiên wears his white suit rumpled and damp with sea mist, luxury gold wristwatch glinting on his left wrist.

clips.start_frame: Landward side of the lower service gate: the cart on its side jammed across the gateway, its rope knotted around the bars; an officer crouched at the knot; Thành standing beside him, radio handset in hand, folder under his arm.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): The officer cuts at the rope where it binds a cart wheel to the gate bars while Thành braces the cart frame with his free hand, glancing up the dark stair beyond the gate. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): Thành lifts the handset and reports the blocked gate and the knotted rope to Mây; the last strand parts and the rope drops slack against the concrete. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The two of them take the cart frame and heave it a hand's width off the gateway, wheels scraping, and a narrow gap opens at the gate post as Thành shoulders the weight, eyes already on the stair.
clips.end_frame: Cart lifted a hand's width and angled off the gateway, cut rope slack on the concrete; a narrow gap open at the gate post; Thành and the officer straining on the frame, Thành's eyes on the dark stair above.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Chị Mây, cổng phụ bị xe đẩy chặn, dây quấn chặt. Tụi em đang cắt.

clips.lighting: Early night: established harbour floodlight as high key outside, warm van lamp inside, dim lighthouse work practicals on the stairs.

cinematic.intent: Make the delay measurable by progress on the exact obstruction already shown.
cinematic.composition: Frame Thành and an officer at the same cart and lower gate from its landward side.
cinematic.blocking: Thành and the officer work from the landward side of the gate. The officer crouches at the knot by the bars; Thành stands beside him, handset in one hand, folder under his arm. The gap opens at the gate post.
cinematic.performance: Thành keeps his voice functional; frustration leaks only through one quick glance up the stair and the set of his jaw. The officer works silently. No shouting at the knot, no panic.
cinematic.focus: Favor the opening gap and real clearance gained, not an instructional close-up of cutting technique.
cinematic.texture: Cart wheels stay planted until slack allows a partial lift, with no unexplained extra chains.
cinematic.sound_detail: Rope strain, cart scrape and compressed report distinguish the work from an arbitrary clock sound.
cinematic.rhythm: The work starts fully blocked; the report and the rope parting land together mid-shot; the last seconds gain only a narrow gap, leaving the passage itself for later.

clips.wardrobe_note: Thành wears his light-blue shirt and round glasses whose right temple arm is held with tape after the stall struggle, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

clips.start_frame: Dũng crouched behind a fish crate at the wall end of the rear lane, watching Bảy's van ahead: rear doors open on the lit mattress, Linh kneeling beside Sơn, the empty stretcher by the doors; Mây at the far end of the lane, facing the pier.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Dũng rises from behind the crate and steps onto the route the stretcher just took, hugging the market wall, his eyes locked on the lit van doors where Linh bends over Sơn. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He moves in a low, heavy walk from crate to wall shadow, pressing the work bag against his hip so it cannot swing; at the far end of the lane Mây turns back from the pier and asks her radio where Dũng is. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mid-sentence her head turns down the lane; her eyes find his shape against the wall and she starts toward the van, one hand on her radio, while Dũng keeps advancing, unaware he has been seen.
clips.end_frame: Dũng halfway along the market wall, crouched low, bag pressed to his hip, eyes on the open van; Linh inside beside Sơn under the lamp; Mây at the far end of the lane walking toward the van, eyes on Dũng, hand on her radio.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Tổ hai, Dũng đâu rồi? Soát sau dãy thùng cá.

clips.lighting: Early night: established harbour floodlight as high key outside, warm van lamp inside, dim lighthouse work practicals on the stairs.

cinematic.intent: Establish how Dũng finds the van so his return feels earned and threatening.
cinematic.composition: Observe from behind his established crate, van path ahead and Mây turning from the pier.
cinematic.blocking: Dũng starts behind the crate and moves along the market wall toward the van, staying on the wall side of the lane. The van waits ahead with open rear doors; Mây turns at the far end and heads for the van.
cinematic.performance: Dũng is fixated, a loyal dog tracking what belongs to his mistress; caution slows him without calming him. Mây is controlled, recognition showing only as a sharpened look. No stealth-movie crouch theatrics.
cinematic.focus: Keep the path and both endpoints legible instead of obscuring everything in shallow darkness.
cinematic.texture: Crate edge stays a foreground boundary, floodlight spill fades naturally toward the protected rear lane.
cinematic.sound_detail: His boots soften near the wall, van sounds provide the direction he follows, no stealth-music cue.
cinematic.rhythm: Dũng commits to the route at the start and never stops moving; Mây's question arrives mid-shot; recognition lands late, leaving the confrontation for its own shot.

screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Tuyến hẻm an toàn sau bờ tường chợ cá (nơi đậu xe cứu thương) (D7 early night) · Góc máy: Qua vai / Điểm nhìn (50mm Over-shoulder/POV) — khóa trục ánh nhìn đối diện. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, TOOL_BAG, MED_BAG).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Dũng đứng dậy sau thùng cá, bước vào đúng lối cáng vừa đi qua, men sát tường chợ, mắt dán vào khoang xe sáng đèn nơi Linh cúi bên Sơn. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Đang nói dở, Mây quay đầu nhìn dọc hẻm, mắt bắt được bóng hắn sát tường, cô đi về phía xe, tay đặt trên bộ đàm; Dũng vẫn tiến tới, không biết mình đã bị thấy. Mây nói từ nhịp 2 sang nhịp 3.

clips.start_frame: Sơn lying on the van mattress, eyes open, warm lamp beside his face; his bandaged left hand resting palm down on the mattress at his side; Linh's white sleeve just beyond his right shoulder.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): A muffled radio voice drifts in from outside; Sơn's eyes shift toward the open rear doors and narrow as he listens, his breath rising shallow under the black collar. Beat 2 (3.0–7.0s): He gathers himself and sends everything into his bandaged left hand: the fingers tremble and curl a few millimetres against the mattress, tendons tightening under the bandage, but the hand does not leave the cloth. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): The fingers uncurl and settle where they began; his jaw sets, his eyes stay open and fixed on the van roof, and his chest keeps rising and falling under the lamp.
clips.end_frame: Sơn on his back on the mattress, eyes open toward the van roof, jaw set, chest rising and falling; bandaged left hand flat on the mattress where it began; warm lamp steady beside his face; Linh's white sleeve beyond his right shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi nghe hết. Hạ đang bị lôi lên tháp. Còn tay tôi, nhấc không nổi.

clips.lighting: Early night: established harbour floodlight as high key outside, warm van lamp inside, dim lighthouse work practicals on the stairs.

cinematic.intent: Make helpless awareness replace the old fantasy that Sơn controls every situation.
cinematic.composition: Close on his face at mattress level, his bandaged LEFT fingers only at the lower edge if naturally framed.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn flat on the mattress, face toward the van roof; bandaged LEFT hand palm down at his side. Only the left fingers move; head, shoulders and right hand stay where they lie. Linh's sleeve stays beyond his right shoulder.
cinematic.performance: Helpless awareness: the mind is back while the body refuses, frustration burning behind still eyes. He hides fear even from himself. Lips stay at rest under the narration. No grimacing strain, no tears.
cinematic.focus: Keep face and the nearest finger movement plausibly within the same shallow plane, no impossible eye reflection.
cinematic.texture: Warm van lamp reveals tired skin without corpse colouring, black collar retains the same damp creases.
cinematic.sound_detail: Breathing and low radio murmur support the single internal line, with no heartbeat countdown.
cinematic.rhythm: Listening fills the opening; the single real attempt takes the long middle; recognition of failure settles in the last seconds with breath still moving, and no repeated finger tests.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage, right hand uninjured and bare; no backpack on him, it stays on the cabin cot. Bác sĩ Linh wears his worn white medical coat with stethoscope around his neck, keeping his canvas emergency medical bag and breathing-support kit at hand.

screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Tiếng bộ đàm nghèn nghẹt lọt vào từ bên ngoài; mắt Sơn đảo về phía cửa sau, nheo lại khi lắng nghe, hơi thở nông dưới cổ áo đen. Nhịp 2 (3.0–7.0s): Anh gom hết sức dồn vào bàn tay trái quấn băng: các ngón run, co lại vài li trên nệm, gân căng dưới lớp băng, nhưng bàn tay không rời tấm vải. Lời dẫn nội tâm của Sơn chạy từ nhịp 1 đến nhịp 3, môi không cử động.

scenes.purpose: Dựng song song chăm sóc Sơn và Hạ trì hoãn Kiên.

clips.start_frame: Inside the van under the warm lamp: Sơn on his back on the mattress, eyes open; Linh kneeling at his right side, medical bag by his knee, one hand resting near Sơn's head.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): The cords of Sơn's neck tighten as he strains to lift his head off the mattress; Linh slides a palm under the back of his skull and eases it down, unhurried. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): Keeping that hand in place, Linh leans close and tells Sơn not to fight it, that nobody can promise a time, only to breathe with him, and he draws one slow audible breath himself to lead. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn's next breath comes slower and deeper, though his eyes stay hard and searching; Linh withdraws his hand, sits back on his heels beside the mattress and keeps watching the rise of Sơn's chest under the steady lamp.
clips.end_frame: Linh sitting back on his heels at Sơn's right side, hands on his knees, eyes on Sơn's chest; Sơn on his back, eyes open and searching, breathing slower; medical bag beside Linh; warm lamp steady.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Đừng gồng cổ ngồi dậy, anh Sơn. Không ai hẹn được giờ. Cứ thở theo tôi.

clips.lighting: Night: steady warm van lamp as low key inside, existing lighthouse work lights as cool top light on the stairs; no emergency strobe montage.

cinematic.intent: Put care and uncertainty on screen without inventing a medical countdown or miracle intervention.
cinematic.composition: Use a stable medium two-shot of Linh at Sơn's RIGHT side and the supported head.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn on his back on the mattress, Linh kneeling at his RIGHT side with the medical bag by his knee. Linh's palm goes under Sơn's head and back to his own knee. The lamp stays fixed above them.
cinematic.performance: Linh's calm is a tool: steady voice, sustained attention, worry kept off his face. Sơn's frustration yields to the instruction without surrendering his alertness. No alarm acting, no miracle relief, no medical jargon.
cinematic.focus: Stay on patient and caregiver together, not an unintroduced monitor, vial or diagnostic display.
cinematic.texture: Lamp remains warm and constant, clean bedding and worn van panels keep the improvised setting honest.
cinematic.sound_detail: Linh's voice sits close to breathing, distant radio remains low, no new beeps or resuscitation effects.
cinematic.rhythm: A short struggle opens; the instruction lands in the middle with one guided breath; the remaining seconds are watchful stillness that never pretends the danger is over.

clips.start_frame: Head of the service stair under a dim work light: Hạ against the wall beside the rusted iron hatch; Kiên one step below her, right hand on her left upper arm, handgun low in his left hand, eyes on the hatch wheel.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Kiên steps up so his body fills the stair behind Hạ, lets go of her arm and wrenches at the rusted hatch wheel with his right hand, the handgun still low in his left; the wheel refuses to turn. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Her back to the wall, Hạ gives him only the next step, telling him the lower catch has to go first, the way her father did it, her voice level and practical. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Kiên orders her to stay against the wall and bends to the wheel, shoulder braced, right hand working its lower edge as the rust creaks; boxed in beside him, Hạ lets her free right hand drift up past her shoulder until her fingertips rest below the silver clip in her hair.
clips.end_frame: Kiên braced at the hatch, right hand working the lower edge of the rusted wheel, handgun low in his left, body blocking the stair; Hạ boxed against the wall beside him, free right hand raised near the silver clip in her hair, eyes on his hands.

dialogue.speaker: HA_D
dialogue.text: Nắp rỉ rồi. Ông xoay chốt dưới trước, ba tôi hay làm vậy.

dialogue.speaker: KIEN
dialogue.text: Đứng sát vô tường. Đừng nhúc nhích.

clips.lighting: Night: steady warm van lamp as low key inside, existing lighthouse work lights as cool top light on the stairs; no emergency strobe montage.

cinematic.intent: Show Hạ buying seconds through selective knowledge, with Kiên focused on the wrong problem.
cinematic.composition: Frame hatch wheel and both faces medium, Kiên's LEFT-hand weapon kept low and clear of her body.
cinematic.blocking: Hatch at the stair head; Hạ against the wall beside it, Kiên below and beside her, his body filling the stair. His RIGHT hand moves from Hạ's LEFT upper arm to the wheel; handgun LOW in his LEFT, aimed at the floor.
cinematic.performance: Hạ's practical tone hides calculation; she offers exactly enough truth to keep him busy. Kiên resents taking instruction from the woman he controls and covers it with menace. No knowing glance at camera, no triumphant smirk.
cinematic.focus: Keep their faces and the wheel relation readable, without shifting into a mechanical how-to insert.
cinematic.texture: Old hatch paint and white jacket sleeves show contact with the confined space, not new wounds.
cinematic.sound_detail: Wheel resistance and a brief metal creak punctuate her measured words, letting silence buy more time.
cinematic.rhythm: The failed wrench opens; the instruction and his clipped order trade in the middle; the long last beat lets his effort occupy him while her hand travels, the hatch still unsolved.

clips.wardrobe_note: Hạ wears her plain grey cotton dress and thin sandals, scarf absent from neck, silver hair clip still pinned at the back of her hair. Kiên wears his white suit rumpled and damp with sea mist, luxury gold wristwatch glinting on his left wrist.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Hạ mặc váy vải cotton màu xám giản dị và đôi dép mỏng, cổ trống không còn khăn lụa, phía sau mái tóc vẫn cài chiếc kẹp tóc bằng bạc. Vũ Kiên mặc bộ vest trắng đã xộc xệch và ướt sương gió biển khi tháo chạy lên tháp, cổ tay trái đeo đồng hồ vàng mặt sáng.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Cầu thang bảo trì hẹp và cửa nắp sắt dưới sàn đài đèn (D7 night continuous) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Kiên bước lên, thân hắn chắn kín lối cầu thang sau lưng Hạ, buông bắp tay cô, dùng tay phải giật bánh xoay rỉ sét của cửa nắp, khẩu súng vẫn chúc thấp trong tay trái; bánh xoay không nhúc nhích. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Lưng áp tường, Hạ chỉ cho hắn đúng một bước tiếp theo, viện cách ba cô từng làm, giọng đều và thực tế. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Kiên gắt bắt cô đứng sát tường rồi cúi vào bánh xoay, tì vai, tay phải vặn mép dưới, kim loại rỉ kẽo kẹt; bị kẹp sát bên hắn, Hạ để bàn tay phải tự do trượt lên qua vai, đầu ngón tay dừng ngay dưới chiếc kẹp bạc trên tóc. Hạ nói ở nhịp 2, Kiên nói ở nhịp 3.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): The two officers climb in single file, hands on the rail, their boots ringing from concrete onto metal; Thành steps through the gateway behind them with one glance at the displaced cart. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): He stops on the bottom step, lifts the handset and sends their position, asking Mây to keep Kiên talking, his eyes tracking the officers up to the first turn. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The officers vanish above the first turn; Thành clips the handset at his collar, tightens the folder under his arm and climbs after them, one hand on the rail.
clips.end_frame: The open lower gate with the cart against the wall; the officers out of sight above the first stair turn; Thành three steps up, one hand on the rail, folder under his arm, handset clipped at his collar, climbing toward the turn.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Cổng phụ thông rồi, tổ một đang lên. Chị Mây giữ Kiên nói chuyện giùm em.

clips.lighting: Night: steady warm van lamp as low key inside, existing lighthouse work lights as cool top light on the stairs; no emergency strobe montage.

cinematic.intent: Pay off clearance of the lower barrier while preserving the remaining distance to Hạ.
cinematic.composition: The wide starts at the same gate now open, stair route rising from the frame.
cinematic.blocking: The open lower gate with the stair rising behind it. The officers go up first in single file; Thành follows through the gateway and up the same rail side. The cart stays against the wall where it was shoved.
cinematic.performance: Disciplined urgency: Thành's report is concise and sounds like progress, not victory. His eyes stay on the stair, measuring the distance still left to Hạ. No triumphant fist, no premature rescue tone.
cinematic.focus: Keep the first stair turn visible so forward movement has a destination and does not vanish offscreen aimlessly.
cinematic.texture: The displaced cart stays beside the gate, no longer magically in its original blocking position.
cinematic.sound_detail: Boots change from concrete to metal, radio compression carrying only the actual clearance update.
cinematic.rhythm: The climb starts at once; the report sits in the middle on the bottom step; the last beat sends him after his team so the route keeps moving upward at the cut.

clips.wardrobe_note: Thành wears his light-blue shirt and round glasses whose right temple arm is held with tape after the stall struggle, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính tròn có gọng bên phải quấn băng keo trắng sau lúc bảo vệ dân ở quán nước, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Cổng sắt cầu thang kỹ thuật dưới chân hải đăng (D7 night continuous) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (CLIPBOARD).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–2.5s): Hai cảnh sát nối nhau leo lên, tay vịn lan can, tiếng giày chuyển từ bê tông sang kim loại; Thành bước qua cổng theo sau, liếc chiếc xe đẩy đã bị dẹp sang bên. Nhịp 2 (2.5–6.5s): Anh dừng ở bậc dưới cùng, đưa bộ đàm lên báo vị trí, nhờ Mây giữ Kiên nói chuyện, mắt dõi theo hai đồng đội tới khúc quanh đầu tiên. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Hai cảnh sát khuất sau khúc quanh; Thành gài bộ đàm lên cổ áo, kẹp chặt bìa hồ sơ dưới nách, vịn lan can leo theo. Thành báo qua bộ đàm ở nhịp 2.
