clips.start_frame: At the inner latch of the rusted hatch: Hạ's right hand low beside it, the silver hair clip hidden in her palm; above, Kiên's right hand flat on the hatch plate, his left hand holding the handgun low.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Kiên's right hand shoves against the hatch plate and the rusted door grinds open on its hinge, while his left hand keeps the handgun pointed at the floor. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Under cover of the creak, Hạ's right hand turns over; her fingertips slide the silver clip into the gap of the inner latch and press it flat against the chipped paint, a tiny metal tick lost under the hinge noise. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Her empty hand withdraws into the grey cotton of her dress; the hatch swings back on its own weight behind them, the latch meets the hidden clip and stops a finger's width short of seating, a thin dark gap staying open along the edge.
clips.end_frame: The rusted hatch resting a finger's width short of closed, its latch stopped on the hidden silver clip, a thin dark gap along the edge; the hands gone from the latch, the hatch still trembling faintly on its hinge.

dialogue.speaker: HA_D
dialogue.text: Cửa này không được khép hẳn. Thế nào cũng có người lên tìm tôi.

clips.lighting: Night: steady warm van lamp as low key inside, existing lighthouse work lights as cool top light on the stairs; no emergency strobe montage.

cinematic.intent: Give Hạ a small decisive action the captor does not notice and the audience can remember.
cinematic.composition: Use the locked detail on her free RIGHT palm and the inner latch, not her whole body.
cinematic.blocking: Everything happens at the inner latch. Kiên's RIGHT hand on the hatch plate above, handgun LOW in his LEFT; Hạ's free RIGHT hand below at the latch. The clip moves from her palm into the latch gap only.
cinematic.performance: Precision under fear: her hand moves small and sure, as casual as smoothing her dress, with no flourish. Kiên's hands show only effort and impatience. No pause to admire the trick, no look to camera.
cinematic.focus: Hold the clip and latch in one sensible focal plane; no magnified diagram or new lock part.
cinematic.texture: A little chipped paint defines the gap, the clip retains the same silver finish seen in the video.
cinematic.sound_detail: A tiny metal tick is almost lost beneath the hatch creak, without an explanatory music accent.
cinematic.rhythm: His push opens the shot; the concealed placement sits inside the creak in the middle; the hatch's return and its failure to seat close the take with the gap still visible, never a second attempt.

clips.start_frame: Inside the van under the warm lamp: Sơn on his back on the mattress, eyes open, right hand palm up at his side; Linh kneeling at his right shoulder; Mây crouched in the open rear doorway, duty pouch at her hip.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây leans in through the rear doorway, opens her duty pouch and draws out the closed silver watch by its chain, telling Sơn that Thành has opened the lower gate and her people are climbing. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She kneels in at his right hip beside Linh, lays the closed watch in Sơn's open right palm with the engraved lid up and coils the chain beside it, telling him to keep hold of it. clips.end_frame: Mây planted in front of the van's one open rear door, the other door shut, hands open and low; loose cart by the wall at her left; Dũng three strides away in the lane, chest heaving, weight forward; the clinic lane open behind her.

dialogue.speaker: MAY

cinematic.intent: Make Mây choose the threatened doorway before Dũng can reach the patient again.

cinematic.performance: Mây is economical and balanced, choosing the doorway over pursuit; fear stays out of her voice. Dũng's loyalty has curdled into ownership, and he believes he is rescuing someone. No snarling, no martial-arts stance.
cinematic.focus: Keep both opponents and the protected doorway readable, rather than cutting to reaction shots within the take.
cinematic.texture: Van metal and the same loose cart remain practical obstacles, no fresh weapon or defensive equipment appears.

clips.start_frame: Lane behind the van: Mây planted before the one open rear door, hands open and low; the loose cart by the wall at her left; Dũng three strides away in the lane, weight forward, heavy bag strapped across his chest.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Dũng breaks into a charge straight at the open door, boots slapping the concrete; Mây's left hand drops onto the handle of the loose cart beside her. Beat 2 (2.5–6.0s): With one turn of her hips she swings the cart out across his line, telling him he is taking no one anywhere now; the wheels skip over the concrete and the frame catches Dũng at the thighs, folding him forward over its rim. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): He braces both palms on the rim to hold himself up and sneers that a cart will not stop him; Mây stays at the handle, knees bent, eyes on his hands, the cart rocking between them as he hunts for his balance.
clips.end_frame: Cart angled across the lane between them, still rocking; Mây at its handle, left hand gripping it, knees bent; Dũng bent forward over the far rim, both palms braced on it, off balance, bag swinging at his chest, cut cuff ring on his right wrist; one van door open behind Mây.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh không đưa ai đi đâu nữa, Dũng.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Mày tưởng cái xe đẩy cản nổi tao hả?

clips.lighting: Same night: warm van lamp spilling from the open rear into the lane as side key, distant harbour floodlight as cool rim.

cinematic.intent: Turn the established cart into a simple barrier, not an extravagant winning stunt.
cinematic.composition: Keep restrained medium-wide from one side of the lane, van behind Mây and cart to her left.
cinematic.blocking: The van door is behind Mây, the cart at her LEFT by the wall, Dũng approaching straight down the lane. She swings the cart out with her LEFT hand; it ends angled across his path, rim toward him.
cinematic.performance: Mây's refusal comes from concentration, not triumph; her body does the arguing. Dũng is surprised for one beat, then humiliated into bravado. No triumphant taunt, no movie stunt flourish.
cinematic.focus: Retain feet, cart and doorway in view so the collision of intentions stays readable.
cinematic.texture: Cart wheels skip lightly on concrete, old cut cuff remains on Dũng's RIGHT wrist at this point.
cinematic.sound_detail: A wheel rattle and sharp shoe stop support the line, without a heavy punch or metallic explosion effect.
cinematic.rhythm: The charge is instant; the cart swings into it mid-shot with one impact; the last beat keeps both alive and unsettled, the countermove still unperformed.

cinematic.intent: Show Mây accepting support rather than insisting on a solitary victory.
cinematic.composition: Continue the exact handheld setup and focal range from the cart obstruction, no new angle at the seam.

cinematic.performance: Mây accepts help without ego, one quick glance confirming the officer's position. Dũng's anger meets arithmetic: two bodies now, not one, and he knows it. No victory smile, no snarling standoff.
cinematic.focus: Do not reset focus to a new face; let the existing medium-wide hold cart, steps and officer arrival.
cinematic.texture: The moved cart stays at the side reached by the shove, no reset to its prior diagonal position.
cinematic.sound_detail: Wheels scrape continuously through the seam, followed by controlled boots, no new score beat.
cinematic.rhythm: The shove continues straight from the previous stop; Mây's call comes as she gives ground; the boundary forms in the final beat and the shot ends before any hands go on.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Dũng lunges into the gap between them toward the door; Mây catches his right wrist above the cut ring and the officer seizes his left arm at the elbow, both turning with his momentum. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): They walk his weight sideways and press his chest against the van's side panel with a dull thud, the bag strap crushed under him, as Mây tells the officer to hold the arms, pin him to the van and keep clear of his head. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Dũng strains against the hold, then his shoulders sag as the leverage goes; Mây and the officer keep both his arms behind him, his cheek turned away from the metal, his breath loud and ragged.
clips.end_frame: Dũng standing pressed chest-first against the van's side panel, both arms held behind his back, Mây gripping his right wrist and the officer his left arm; his head turned clear of the metal, shoulders heaving; bag strap twisted across his back.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Giữ tay hắn, ép vào thành xe. Không đánh vào đầu!

clips.lighting: Same night: warm van lamp spilling from the open rear into the lane as side key, distant harbour floodlight as cool rim.

cinematic.intent: Make the restraint a result of cooperation, preserving both the patient boundary and Mây's role.
cinematic.composition: Keep the same handheld axis and distance as the preceding continuous shot.
cinematic.blocking: Lane geometry unchanged. Mây takes Dũng's RIGHT arm, the officer his LEFT; together they turn him onto the van's side panel beside the rear doors. His head stays clear of the metal throughout.
cinematic.performance: Cooperation, not fury: Mây is intent and controlled, giving one practical instruction. Dũng's resistance drains as leverage disappears, pride turning to sullen stillness. No head strike, no neck-cracking theatrics, no gloating.
cinematic.focus: Hold bodies and contact points together, with no technical wrist insert or hidden impact cut.
cinematic.texture: The van side flexes only slightly under ordinary weight, no new dent or blood appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: Cloth strain, short exertion and one dull panel contact carry the action, never a neck-cracking sound.
cinematic.rhythm: His lunge and the catch happen together at the start; the move to the van side is one controlled arc; the final beat lets resistance ebb into a standing hold and stops before any cuff appears.

Dũng wears his black sleeveless shirt, silver nail earring in LEFT ear, and heavy black canvas work bag strapped across his shoulder, cut steel cuff ring hanging on his RIGHT wrist from the garage escape.

clips.start_frame: Behind Dũng's back against the van side: his wrists held together by the officer's grip, the old cut steel ring hanging on his right wrist; Mây's hands just above them holding a fresh intact pair of steel handcuffs, rings open.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây's hands bring the fresh steel cuffs down, the intact chain catching the van lamp, and close the first ring around Dũng's left wrist where the officer holds it behind his back. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She draws his right wrist across, the old cut ring hanging loose on it, and closes the second fresh ring below it, steering the new steel clear of the old. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Her fingers check the fit at both wrists, then release; the officer's hand takes hold of the new chain, Mây's unseen voice tells him to lead Dũng away and seal the old ring separately, and the cuffed wrists start to move away.
clips.end_frame: Dũng's wrists locked behind his back in the fresh intact cuffs, the old cut ring still hanging separately on his right wrist; the officer's hand gripping the new chain, leading off; Mây's empty hands withdrawing.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Dẫn hắn đi. Chiếc vòng cũ trên tay phải, tháo ra niêm phong riêng.

clips.lighting: Same night: warm van lamp spilling from the open rear into the lane as side key, distant harbour floodlight as cool rim.

cinematic.intent: Distinguish the new lawful restraint from the broken cuff Dũng has carried back.
cinematic.composition: Lock the detail on Mây's fresh cuffs and Dũng's controlled wrists, existing officer maintaining position.
cinematic.blocking: Hands at waist height behind Dũng's back against the van side. The officer steadies Dũng's LEFT wrist; Mây's hands close both new rings. The old cut ring stays on his RIGHT wrist, apart from the new chain.
cinematic.performance: Hands work with calm efficiency, no flourish; this is procedure, not revenge. Dũng's wrists stop resisting, the fight gone out of them. No victory pat, no cruel over-tightening, no repeated ratcheting.
cinematic.focus: Keep fresh intact chain and old cut component visually distinct, no sudden usable loose cuff end.
cinematic.texture: Steel is worn but clean, RIGHT-wrist old ring condition stays consistent with the earlier cut chain.
cinematic.sound_detail: One concise cuff closure and her off-frame instruction, not repeated ratcheting for dramatic emphasis.
cinematic.rhythm: First ring in the opening beat, second ring and separation in the middle, then a clean handover so the shot ends on the escort beginning to move.

clips.wardrobe_note: Detail on hands only: Mây's rolled khaki sleeves and one fresh intact pair of steel handcuffs taken from her belt. Dũng's bare forearms behind his back, the old cut steel cuff ring still hanging on his RIGHT wrist from the garage escape.

clips.start_frame: Inside the van under the warm lamp: Sơn on his back on the mattress, closed silver watch lying in his open right palm, bandaged left hand on the mattress; Linh kneeling at his right shoulder, medical bag at his knee.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's right fingers twitch, then curl slowly over the closed watch until they grip it; his eyes drop to his hand and his breath catches at the small success. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): In a rough low voice he tells Linh he can move and to help him up because Hạ is with Kiên; Linh slides an arm behind his shoulders and raises him partway, taking most of the weight himself. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Linh settles Sơn's back against the van's side wall and keeps a flat palm on his sternum, telling him to sit and not stand; Sơn's bandaged left hand slides off his lap and lies limp on the mattress while his right fist stays closed around the watch.
clips.end_frame: Sơn sitting half-upright against the van's side wall, right fist closed around the watch, bandaged left hand limp on the mattress beside him, chest rising; Linh kneeling at his right, palm resting on his sternum, eyes on his face.

dialogue.text: Ngồi tựa vào thành xe thôi, chưa được đứng.

cinematic.intent: Let returning movement feel incremental and uncertain instead of a switch back to action-hero strength.
cinematic.composition: Frame Sơn supported on the mattress with Linh close enough to prevent an impulsive rise.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn on the mattress with Linh at his RIGHT side; Linh's arm goes behind his shoulders and brings him up against the van's side wall. The watch stays in Sơn's RIGHT hand; the LEFT bandaged hand never takes weight.
cinematic.performance: Relief kept small and restrained by effort; urgency about Hạ pushes into his voice before his body is ready. Linh observes without celebrating, quietly firm about the limit. No triumphant swell, no sudden athletic posture.
cinematic.focus: Keep his face and supported torso readable, LEFT bandage still weak and not suddenly doing the lift.
cinematic.texture: Warm lamp and rumpled black shirt remain unchanged, no whitening skin or sudden athletic posture.
cinematic.sound_detail: A careful breath and mattress shift accompany his short line, no triumphant music swell.
cinematic.rhythm: One small success first; his request and the partial lift share the middle; the stop at sitting fills the end with breath still moving and nothing resembling standing.

clips.start_frame: Beside the van's rear in the lamp spill: Dũng standing in fresh handcuffs behind his back, bag gone, the officer gripping his upper arm; Mây a pace away with her radio handset raised; one van door open behind them.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): From inside the open van comes the low rasp of Sơn's voice; Dũng's head snaps toward the doorway and his weight pulls half a step that way before the officer's grip stops him. clips.end_frame: Dũng walking away under escort toward the custody vehicle, cuffed hands behind him, head lowered, the officer at his arm; Mây turned back toward the van's open rear door, handset lowered at her side, one foot stepping toward it.

cinematic.performance: Bitter recognition: Dũng understands Bà Hai's ownership has failed and that Sơn will speak. Anger gives way to weary emptiness. Mây's attention is already back on the patient. No new threat, no sequel promise, no sneer.

cinematic.texture: Fresh custody cuffs remain distinct, old cut ring is no longer being treated as a usable restraint.
cinematic.sound_detail: Escort footfalls and a faint cuff clink replace the earlier struggle; radio remains practical background.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Mây có giữ được người bệnh mà không biến thành người đánh đổi người?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Cô nhận hỗ trợ, khống chế Dũng đúng nhiệm vụ, Sơn bắt đầu cử động.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Dũng tới đúng vệt cáng vừa qua, không xuất hiện ngẫu nhiên.
dramaturgy.payoff_or_setup_vi: Trả hai còng mới35; kết thúc mối đe dọa tay sai trước đỉnh tháp.

scenes.title: Tỉnh Lại
scenes.purpose: Sơn chấp nhận đi cùng Mây trong vai trò hỗ trợ, không tự lao đi.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep the same motorcycle ignition after helmets are secured. Cut to the road with movement still left to right.

clips.start_frame: Inside the van under the warm lamp: Sơn sitting half-upright against the van's side wall, closed watch in his right fist, bandaged left hand on the mattress; Linh kneeling at his side; Mây kneeling in the open rear doorway, watching.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Linh asks Sơn to move his feet, one hand hovering at his shoulder; Sơn stares down at his shoes, and the right ankle flexes, then the left follows, slower and shaking. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): Linh guides Sơn's legs over the edge of the mattress while Sơn, jaw tight with concentration, answers that his head is clear and only his legs are slow, as both soles settle flat on the van floor. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): He stays seated on the mattress edge, right fist braced on the mattress around the watch, bandaged left hand resting on his thigh, breathing hard through his nose; Linh keeps a hand near his back while Mây watches from the doorway without stepping in.
clips.end_frame: Sơn seated on the mattress edge, both soles flat on the van floor, right fist around the watch braced on the mattress, bandaged left hand on his thigh, breathing hard; Linh crouched at his side, hand near his back; Mây kneeling in the rear doorway, notebook still in her pouch.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Từ từ. Co hai bàn chân cho tôi coi. Chưa chạy được đâu.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Đầu tôi tỉnh rồi. Chỉ có chân là chậm.

clips.lighting: Same night: van lamp and parked-vehicle practicals as warm side light, cool lane darkness; helmets visible before the engine starts.

cinematic.intent: Keep the cost of Tê visible just as the audience wants Sơn to get moving.
cinematic.composition: The medium holds seated Sơn, Linh beside him and Mây at the same van doorway.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn sits against the van wall, then on the mattress edge facing the rear doorway; Linh at his side within reach; Mây kneels in the doorway. The watch stays in his RIGHT fist, the LEFT bandaged hand on his thigh.
cinematic.performance: Sơn wants to hurry and resents his legs, yet concentrates like a patient student on a simple instruction. Linh stays matter-of-fact. Mây keeps her distance on purpose. No grimacing heroics, no announcement of a cure.
cinematic.focus: Hold all three at their existing depth, letting Sơn's effort be read through posture and eyes.
cinematic.texture: LEFT bandage remains visible against dark clothes, closed watch stays with his RIGHT hand.
cinematic.sound_detail: His breathing and feet reaching the van floor are audible under Linh's line, no recovery sting.
cinematic.rhythm: The small feet test opens the shot; the legs reach the floor in the middle; the last beat holds him seated, breath audible, with support still needed.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his matte-black suit over open-collar white shirt, LEFT wrist wrapped in white medical bandage, right hand uninjured and bare; no backpack on him, it stays on the cabin cot. Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Bác sĩ Linh wears his worn white medical coat with stethoscope around his neck, keeping his canvas emergency medical bag and breathing-support kit at hand.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc bộ vest đen sơ mi trắng mở cổ, cổ tay TRÁI quấn băng trắng y tế, bàn tay phải lành lặn để trần; chiếc ba lô vải bố đã cất lại tại chòi gỗ từ cảnh 35.4. Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Bác sĩ Linh khoác áo blouse trắng sờn vai, cổ đeo ống nghe y tế, tay xách túi cấp cứu vải bố có sẵn bình trợ thở.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong thùng xe tải cứu hộ lưu động của Ông Bảy (D7 night continuous) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, MED_BAG).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Linh bảo Sơn cử động hai bàn chân, một tay chực sẵn bên vai anh; Sơn nhìn xuống đôi giày, cổ chân phải gập lên, rồi chân trái theo sau, chậm và run. Nhịp 2 (3.5–7.0s): Linh đỡ hai chân anh qua mép nệm; quai hàm siết vì tập trung, Sơn đáp rằng đầu đã tỉnh, chỉ có chân là chậm, khi hai bàn chân đặt phẳng xuống sàn xe. Nhịp 3 (7.0–10.0s): Anh ngồi yên trên mép nệm, nắm tay phải giữ đồng hồ chống xuống nệm, bàn tay trái quấn băng đặt trên đùi, thở mạnh qua mũi; Linh để tay sát lưng anh, Mây nhìn từ cửa sau mà không bước vào. Linh nói ở nhịp 1, Sơn đáp ở nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, MED_BAG) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: DUTY_POUCH, MED_BAG.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.0s): Sơn lifts his eyes to Mây and, pausing for breath between phrases, tells her Hạ has known the tower since childhood and once showed him a hatch just below the gallery. Beat 2 (4.0–7.0s): Mây takes the small black notebook and pen from her pouch, flips it open on her knee and sketches the tower's outline, answering that it sits near the backup-light lever they tested before. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): She marks a small square under the gallery line and looks up to Sơn for confirmation; he gives a short nod, breath still labored, while Linh's hand stays near his back.
clips.end_frame: Mây kneeling in the rear doorway, black notebook open on her knee, pen resting on a small square drawn under the gallery line; Sơn seated on the mattress edge watching the sketch, right fist around the watch; Linh crouched at his side, hand near his back.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Hạ thuộc cái tháp từ nhỏ. Cô ấy chỉ tôi cửa nắp ngay dưới hành lang.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Gần cần đèn dự phòng mình thử hôm trước.

clips.lighting: Same night: van lamp and parked-vehicle practicals as warm side light, cool lane darkness; helmets visible before the engine starts.

cinematic.intent: Make Sơn contribute knowledge while accepting that someone else controls the rescue.
cinematic.composition: Continue the exact medium van composition, with Mây and Linh remaining where the preceding shot left them.
cinematic.blocking: Positions hold from the previous shot: Sơn on the mattress edge, Linh at his side, Mây kneeling in the doorway. Only Mây's hands travel, notebook and pen from pouch to knee. Sơn's LEFT wrist rests on his thigh.
cinematic.performance: Sơn offers precise knowledge with effort, contributing rather than demanding control. Mây receives it as data; their shared memory of the lever passes unspoken. No romantic reminiscing, no imagined voice of Hạ.
cinematic.focus: Keep the exchange and Mây's sketching hand readable without resetting the lens or inserting a map close-up.
cinematic.texture: Notepad remains the existing one, watch stays CLOSED and his LEFT wrist does not suddenly support his weight.
cinematic.sound_detail: Pencil movement and the continuing van bed accompany the short line, no imagined Hạ voice replay.
cinematic.rhythm: His fact arrives in short breaths at the start; her sketch takes the middle; the confirming nod closes the shot with the pen still moving.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): The radio on Mây's pouch gives a short squelch; she lifts the handset to her ear and listens, pen stopped on the sketch, eyes on Sơn. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): She clips the handset back on her pouch and tells Sơn the main door is open and she will lead up the main stair with him behind her; Sơn holds her gaze, and his shoulders lower a fraction. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He agrees that she does the talking and he stays behind; Mây closes the notebook over the sketch and slides it into her pouch, while Linh moves his hand to Sơn's elbow, ready to take weight.
clips.end_frame: Mây kneeling in the rear doorway, notebook closed in her pouch, handset clipped; Sơn seated on the mattress edge facing her, right fist around the watch; Linh at his side, hand at his elbow.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Cửa chính mở rồi. Tôi dẫn lên cầu thang chính, anh đi sau lưng tôi.

dialogue.speaker: SON_S
dialogue.text: Được. Cô nói chuyện, tôi đứng sau.

clips.lighting: Same night: van lamp and parked-vehicle practicals as warm side light, cool lane darkness; helmets visible before the engine starts.

cinematic.intent: Move leadership to Mây without making Sơn passive or repeating the whole tactical plan.
cinematic.composition: Stay in the same medium setup and focal range across the continuous seam.
cinematic.blocking: Positions unchanged across the seam. Mây stays kneeling in the doorway; the handset goes to her ear and back, the notebook closes into her pouch. Linh keeps contact at Sơn's side, moving to his elbow.
cinematic.performance: Mây's firmness is protective and professional, the decision made before she speaks. Sơn's acceptance costs him pride; it shows in a held breath and lowered shoulders, not argument. No defiance, no grateful smile.
cinematic.focus: Keep the listening faces in the established plane, no focus reset toward an invented radio display.
cinematic.texture: Notebook returns to her same pouch, lamp direction and Linh's supporting position remain unchanged.
cinematic.sound_detail: A brief radio-squelch click motivates the received update beneath the established instruction, without adding another spoken line.
cinematic.rhythm: The squelch and listening open the shot; the decision lands in the middle; his assent and the notebook closing end it cleanly, leaving the step down for the next shot.

clips.start_frame: Rear of the van in the lamp spill: Sơn seated on the van's rear edge, feet hanging just above the concrete, closed watch in his right fist; Mây standing in front of him at his right, hand under his elbow; Linh at his weaker left side.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): With Mây's hand under his right elbow and Linh at his left, Sơn slides off the rear edge and one shoe, then the other, meets the concrete; his knees dip under his own weight. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Instead of stepping away, he turns and leans his right shoulder against the open rear door, the closed watch still in his right fist; Linh warns him off the left hand, and the door gives a little on its hinge under him. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Sơn shifts his weight from one foot to the other, finding his balance, then lets out a long careful exhale and straightens a few centimetres off the door; Mây keeps her hand near his elbow without pulling, waiting.
clips.end_frame: Sơn standing on the concrete beside the open rear door, right shoulder just off it, closed watch in his right fist, bandaged left hand at his side; Mây at his right elbow, hand near but not gripping; Linh at his left side; the lane empty ahead.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Đừng chống tay trái. Tựa vai phải vào cửa.

clips.lighting: Same night: van lamp and parked-vehicle practicals as warm side light, cool lane darkness; helmets visible before the engine starts.

cinematic.intent: Make standing itself an obstacle so the next journey has physical stakes.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide to include van floor height, Linh on Sơn's weaker LEFT side and Mây beside him.
cinematic.blocking: Van rear with one door open. Mây on Sơn's RIGHT, Linh on his weaker LEFT. Sơn goes from the rear edge to the concrete and leans his RIGHT shoulder on the open door; the watch stays in his RIGHT fist.
cinematic.performance: Sơn hides embarrassment more than pain; the urge to run shows in his eyes, and he chooses balance instead. Mây waits without impatience; Linh is quietly vigilant. No stumble played for drama, no heroic straightening.
cinematic.focus: Keep all supporting contact and both feet visible so no edit conceals an impossible recovery.
cinematic.texture: CLOSED watch stays in his RIGHT hand, bandage never transfers sides and jacket remains the same black suit.
cinematic.sound_detail: A shoe reaches concrete, mattress creak recedes Linh's short instruction, then a careful exhale.
cinematic.rhythm: The step down happens at the start; the lean on the door is the long middle; the final beat spends itself on one genuine balance adjustment and ends upright with help still there.

clips.start_frame: Stationary motorcycle on the safe lane, engine off, two helmets resting on the seat; Sơn standing at its side, closed watch in his right fist, bandaged left hand at his side; Mây beside the handlebars.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn slips the closed watch into his inner jacket pocket with his right hand and presses it flat; Mây lifts both helmets off the seat and hands him one. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): They pull the helmets on; Mây clicks her strap in one move while Sơn fastens his buckle slowly with his right hand alone, and she checks it with a glance, telling him to tap her shoulder if he feels dizzy. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Mây swings onto the front seat and takes the bars; Sơn steps over carefully behind her, lowers himself onto the pillion and grips the rear rail with his right hand, answering that he is holding on and she can ride.

screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Cầu thang xoắn ốc bằng sắt bên trong thân hải đăng (D7 night continuous) · Góc máy: Máy trượt ngang (35mm Tracking) — bám sát bước chân và nhịp di chuyển nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Máy quay lên theo hai người dọc cầu thang xoắn, Mây đi trước một bậc, Sơn leo sau, tay phải trượt dọc lan can, từng bước đặt chắc, tiếng chân vang trong lòng tháp. Sơn nói ở nhịp 2, Mây nói ở nhịp 3.

clips.start_frame: Narrow landing just above the service hatch below the gallery, dim work light: Kiên turned back to the hatch, right hand on its latch, handgun low in his left; Hạ beside him facing the sea wall; the hatch resting a finger's width short of closed.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Kiên presses the hatch home with his right hand and drives the latch down; it clicks short and springs back a finger's width, the handgun still low in his left hand. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He peers at the rusted latch, sees nothing but old paint, and mutters that it will not close and to leave it; beside him Hạ keeps her face to the sea wall while her eyes slide sideways to the thin dark gap. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She remarks flatly that the hinge has been crooked for years; Kiên takes her left upper arm with his right hand and steers her up the last steps toward the gallery, the hatch staying ajar behind them.
clips.end_frame: The service hatch resting ajar a finger's width, its latch still blocked; Kiên and Hạ on the steps above it heading for the gallery, his right hand on her left upper arm, handgun low in his left; Hạ's last glance back on the gap.

dialogue.speaker: KIEN
dialogue.text: Chốt rỉ, đóng không khít. Kệ nó, ra hành lang.

dialogue.speaker: HA_D
dialogue.text: Bản lề lệch từ hồi xưa rồi. Ra ngoài gió lắm đó.

clips.lighting: Night road lit from the front by the motorcycle headlamp; lighthouse work lights as cool top light and low practicals inside.

cinematic.intent: Reward Hạ's concealed action by making the failed closure visible to her and the audience.
cinematic.composition: Frame Kiên testing the hatch medium, Hạ facing the inner sea wall within his control.
cinematic.blocking: Hatch behind and below them, the sea wall ahead of Hạ. Kiên works the latch with his RIGHT hand, handgun LOW in his LEFT; then his RIGHT hand returns to Hạ's LEFT upper arm and they climb toward the gallery.
cinematic.performance: Hạ hides satisfaction behind a flat voice and an averted face; hope is only a flicker in her eyes. Kiên reads the failure as old machinery and dismisses it, impatience mounting. No knowing smile, no lingering on the gap.
cinematic.focus: Keep the narrow persistent gap readable, avoiding a new macro mechanism or a miraculous opening by itself.
cinematic.texture: The same clip prevents the same latch seating, paint and garment dust remain as established.
cinematic.sound_detail: One incomplete metal click and Kiên's impatient breath explain the failure without a narrator.
cinematic.rhythm: One closure attempt opens; his dismissal lands mid-shot; her cover line and the climb fill the last beat, leaving the ajar hatch for the discovery that follows.

clips.wardrobe_note: Hạ wears her plain grey cotton dress and thin sandals, scarf absent from neck, silver hair clip removed and wedged into the service hatch latch at 45.4. Kiên wears his white suit rumpled and damp with sea mist, luxury gold wristwatch glinting on his left wrist.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Hạ mặc váy vải cotton màu xám giản dị và đôi dép mỏng, cổ trống không còn khăn lụa, đã rút chiếc kẹp tóc bạc cài vào khe chốt cửa sắt từ cảnh 45.4. Vũ Kiên mặc bộ vest trắng đã xộc xệch và ướt sương gió biển khi tháo chạy lên tháp, cổ tay trái đeo đồng hồ vàng mặt sáng.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Cầu thang bảo trì hẹp và cửa nắp sắt dưới sàn đài đèn (D7 night continuous) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Kiên dùng tay phải ép cửa nắp xuống và đè chốt; chốt kêu cụt rồi bật ngược ra cách khớp một ngón tay, khẩu súng vẫn chúc thấp trong tay trái. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Hắn soi cái chốt rỉ, chỉ thấy sơn cũ, lầm bầm đóng không được thì kệ nó; bên cạnh hắn, Hạ vẫn quay mặt vào bức tường phía biển, mắt liếc ngang về khe hở tối mảnh. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Cô nói giọng phẳng rằng bản lề lệch từ lâu rồi; Kiên dùng tay phải nắm lấy bắp tay trái cô, lùa cô lên mấy bậc cuối về phía hành lang đèn, cửa nắp vẫn hé sau lưng. Kiên nói ở nhịp 2, Hạ nói ở nhịp 3.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: The ajar service hatch above the narrow stair: the silver clip still wedged in its inner latch, a thin dark gap along the edge; an officer's hand raised just beneath the hatch; Thành's hand behind it holding the radio handset.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The officer's fingertips find the hatch edge and touch the silver clip wedged in the latch, pausing on it in recognition, then ease the hatch up and hold it open without dislodging the clip. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Dark sleeves and boots pass up through the gap one after another while the officer's hand keeps the hatch steady; behind them Thành's left hand brings the radio handset close and he begins a whispered report to Mây. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Once the gap is clear, Thành finishes the report while his right fingers work the silver clip out of the latch and close it into his right palm; he slips through the held opening after the others, the hatch still steady in the officer's grip.
clips.end_frame: The hatch held wide by the officer's hand, the latch gap now empty; the silver clip closed in Thành's right palm as he passes through the opening, radio handset in his left hand; boots of the team climbing beyond.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Chị Mây, con tin chèn kẹp tóc giữ cửa nắp cho mình. Tổ một đã qua.

clips.lighting: Night road lit from the front by the motorcycle headlamp; lighthouse work lights as cool top light and low practicals inside.

cinematic.intent: Make a tiny survival decision become an actual route for other people.
cinematic.composition: Hold the detail on the already ajar latch, an assisting hand reaching from below, Thành behind.
cinematic.blocking: The ajar hatch above the narrow stair. The officer's hand holds the hatch open from beneath; Thành behind him, radio in his LEFT hand, takes the clip with his RIGHT and follows through the same gap.
cinematic.performance: Quiet professionalism: the officer's touch on the clip is careful, almost respectful; Thành's report carries recognition, not praise. Their restraint contrasts with Kiên's earlier haste. No loud entry, no triumphant gesture with the clip.
cinematic.focus: Keep clip and latch legible in one plane, with background bodies only as spatial context.
cinematic.texture: No new tool opens the hatch; the recovered clip stays in Thành RIGHT palm, not simultaneously still in the latch.
cinematic.sound_detail: Careful metal contact and low radio compression replace loud entry sounds that would contradict their quiet approach.
cinematic.rhythm: Discovery and holding the hatch open come first; the team passes through in the middle while the report is whispered; the retrieval waits for a clear gap and ends the shot moving through.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Các đạo cụ trên bàn và hiện trường giữ nguyên vị trí liên tục từ cú máy trước.

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Những tay áo và đôi giày tối màu lần lượt lách qua khe trong khi tay viên cảnh sát giữ nắp vững; phía sau, tay trái Thành đưa bộ đàm sát miệng, bắt đầu khẽ báo cho Mây. Thành báo khẽ qua bộ đàm từ nhịp 2 sang nhịp 3.

clips.start_frame: Last corner of the main spiral stair, gallery light spilling down from above: Mây on the upper step with her back near the wall, Sơn one step lower behind her shoulder, his right hand on the rail.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Kiên's shoes scuff on the gallery above and the wind carries the sound down; Mây lifts a flat hand behind her to hold Sơn in place and draws one slow breath, eyes on the light above. Beat 2 (3.0–7.0s): Without stepping into view, she calls up the stairwell, naming herself as police, saying she is coming up to talk and asking him to move away from Hạ, her voice steady and carrying. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): She holds the corner with both hands open and visible at her sides, listening for an answer; a step below, Sơn stays behind her shoulder, jaw set, eyes up the stair, his breath slowing, making no move past her.
clips.end_frame: Mây holding the last stair corner, back near the wall, both hands open at her sides, face turned up toward the gallery light; Sơn one step lower behind her shoulder, right hand on the rail, eyes up the stair; wind moving through the stairwell.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Kiên, tôi là Mây, công an. Tôi lên nói chuyện. Anh lùi ra khỏi Hạ.

clips.lighting: Night road lit from the front by the motorcycle headlamp; lighthouse work lights as cool top light and low practicals inside.

cinematic.intent: Place Mây at the threshold of conversation while Sơn visibly remains behind her.
cinematic.composition: Use the medium at the last main-stair corner, gallery light above and Sơn one step lower.
cinematic.blocking: Last corner of the main spiral stair with the gallery light above. Mây stays on the upper step near the wall, not exposing herself to the gallery; Sơn one step lower behind her shoulder, RIGHT hand on the rail. Neither climbs further.
cinematic.performance: Mây's steadiness invites an answer: firm and unhurried, no threat in her tone. Sơn listens instead of speaking for her; fear for Hạ shows only in his fixed eyes. No shouting, no tactical crouch, no reassuring glance between them.
cinematic.focus: Keep Mây's mouth and Sơn's listening position readable, no cut to the off-screen captor during the line.
cinematic.texture: The main-stair rail and same practical light define the height already climbed, without a new tactical backdrop.
cinematic.sound_detail: Her voice travels up the existing stair echo, with wind and a restrained radio bed beneath it.
cinematic.rhythm: The arrival settles into a stop at the start; the announcement takes the middle; the final beat is held listening, turning movement into negotiation while breath and wind continue.

screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Tiếng giày Kiên lạo xạo trên hành lang phía trên theo gió vọng xuống; Mây giơ bàn tay phẳng ra sau giữ Sơn lại, hít một hơi chậm, mắt nhìn lên vệt sáng. dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Một hành động nhỏ của Hạ có đủ biến lối bị khóa thành lối vào?

scenes.title: Chiếc Vòng Ngọc
scenes.story_time: D7 night simultaneous with the climb
scenes.purpose: Bà Hai bị bắt bởi tổ dưới cảng, trả giá cho việc coi người là hàng.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Incoming gallery wind replaces pier custody sounds before returning to Mây at the main stair entrance.

clips.start_frame: Bà Hai seated upright on the stone bench under the harbour floodlight, unlit black holder between her right fingers, jade bracelet on her left wrist; one officer stands two paces in front of her; she faces the custody road off frame right.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bà Hai lifts the holder a few centimetres toward the custody road, the old summoning gesture, eyes narrowing at the people moving out there. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Nobody on the road turns to her; her raised hand hangs a beat, she murmurs her short line, then lowers the holder and lays it on the stone beside her hip with a small click. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Both hands come to rest on her knees, back still straight; breath leaves slowly through her nose while the officer shifts his weight, and her eyes stay on the road.
clips.end_frame: Bà Hai upright on the bench, both hands resting on her knees, jade bracelet on her left wrist, unlit holder lying on the stone at her right hip; the officer two paces in front; her gaze still on the custody road, breathing slowly.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Thôi. Hết người để sai rồi.

clips.lighting: Same night, simultaneous: steady harbour floodlight as hard high key on the stone bench, dark sea beyond.

cinematic.intent: Show Bà Hai's authority draining through the ordinary act of having nothing useful to order.
cinematic.composition: The wide isolates her on the established stone bench, an officer present and custody road off frame.
cinematic.blocking: Bench center under the floodlight, officer two paces in front of her and slightly frame left; custody road off frame right. The holder travels from her right fingers to the stone at her right hip.
cinematic.performance: Habit of command first, then the quiet discovery that no one is left to obey. She hides the loss behind posture and wants no witness to it. No trembling lip, no tears.
cinematic.focus: Let the distance around her be readable; do not push into a tear close-up in this establishing beat.
cinematic.texture: Violet silk and jade remain on her LEFT wrist, floodlight stays functional rather than reverential.
cinematic.sound_detail: Holder touching stone is a small clear sound amid distant custody footsteps, without mournful scoring.
cinematic.rhythm: A small raised gesture, a held moment of no response, one placement of the holder, then a still but breathing posture that registers defeat without freezing.

clips.wardrobe_note: Bà Hai wears her deep-violet silk áo bà ba, green jade bracelet on her LEFT wrist, holding her unlit black cigarette holder between her right fingers.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Bà Hai mặc bộ áo bà ba lụa tím sẫm sang trọng, cổ tay TRÁI đeo vòng ngọc bích xanh bóng, các ngón tay phải cầm chiếc tẩu đen không châm lửa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bãi bê tông cầu cảng cá Hòn Sóng (vạch sơn trắng phân ranh) (D7 night simultaneous with the climb) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bà Hai nhấc chiếc tẩu lên vài phân về phía đường áp giải, cử chỉ gọi người quen thuộc, mắt nheo lại nhìn ra đó. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Không ai trên đường quay lại; tay bà khựng trên không một nhịp, bà lẩm bẩm câu ngắn rồi hạ tẩu đặt xuống mặt đá cạnh hông, một tiếng cạch nhỏ. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Hai tay đặt lên gối, lưng vẫn thẳng; hơi thở ra chậm qua mũi, viên cảnh sát đổi chân, mắt bà vẫn nhìn con đường. Bà Hai nói ở Nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo · Đạo cụ khóa: Giữ nguyên vật dụng trên người.

clips.start_frame: Dũng on the custody road in the foreground, wrists cuffed in front, one escorting officer's hand at his elbow; in the depth, Bà Hai seated on the stone bench, hands on her knees, unlit holder on the stone beside her.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Dũng plants his boots against the escort's light pull and turns his head toward the bench, the cuff chain clinking as his hands tighten. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He asks his question across the distance, jaw working, eyes fixed on her face as if waiting for the next order. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Bà Hai gives no answer; her eyes drop to the jade bracelet on her left wrist. Dũng's shoulders sink a fraction, he breathes out and turns back toward the road as the escort's hand moves him on.
clips.end_frame: Dũng turned back toward the custody road, taking his next step under the escort's hand, cuffed wrists low in front; Bà Hai on the bench in the background, head bowed toward the jade bracelet on her left wrist, hands on her knees.

dialogue.speaker: DUNG
dialogue.text: Tay con khóa rồi. Má còn muốn con giữ ai nữa?

clips.lighting: Same night, simultaneous: steady harbour floodlight as hard high key on the stone bench, dark sea beyond.

cinematic.intent: Make Dũng ask for an instruction his loyalty can no longer produce.
cinematic.composition: Frame escorted Dũng medium with Bà Hai visible on the bench in the opposing depth.
cinematic.blocking: Dũng foreground frame left on the road, escort at his right elbow; Bà Hai deep frame right on the bench about eight paces away. Dũng turns only his head and shoulders, never steps toward her.
cinematic.performance: Dũng carries fatigue and an unwanted need for her approval; he hides how much he still waits for her voice. Bà Hai withholds the answer because she has none. No new threat, no melodramatic reaction.
cinematic.focus: Stay on the exchange of looks without magnifying either person into a melodramatic reaction insert.
cinematic.texture: Fresh custody cuffs remain secure; the old cut component is evidence, not hanging ready for another trick.
cinematic.sound_detail: Escort shoes halt briefly, a small cuff sound sits below his words, and the harbour continues normally.
cinematic.rhythm: A short halt, the question placed cleanly, then a real silence from her; his turn back to the road closes the relationship without a second look.

clips.wardrobe_note: Bà Hai wears her deep-violet silk áo bà ba, green jade bracelet on her LEFT wrist; her unlit black cigarette holder lies on the stone bench beside her, set down in 49.1. Dũng's wrists are locked in fresh steel handcuffs, his black shoulder bag confiscated and the old cut cuff ring logged as evidence.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Bà Hai mặc bộ áo bà ba lụa tím sẫm sang trọng, cổ tay TRÁI đeo vòng ngọc bích xanh bóng; chiếc tẩu đen không châm lửa đã đặt trên ghế đá cạnh bà từ 49.1. clips.start_frame: Close on Bà Hai's lap on the stone bench: jade bracelet on her left wrist, right fingertips resting beside it on the violet silk; the unlit black holder lies on the stone next to her knee.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Her right fingers close around the jade bracelet while her off-frame voice warns that no one is to touch it, she will take it off herself. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She works the bracelet over the knuckles of her left hand, stalls a breath at the widest point, then eases it free in one steady pull. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She sets the bracelet on the stone beside the holder; her fingertips rest on the jade a moment, lift away, and both bare wrists settle back onto her lap.
clips.end_frame: Jade bracelet and unlit holder side by side on the stone bench; both of Bà Hai's wrists bare, hands resting on the violet silk of her lap, fingers slowly loosening.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Đừng ai đụng vào. Để tôi tự tháo.

clips.lighting: Same night, simultaneous: steady harbour floodlight as hard high key on the stone bench, dark sea beyond.

cinematic.intent: Reduce the symbol of ownership to an object that no longer protects its owner.
cinematic.composition: Lock the detail on her LEFT wrist and the same bench surface beside the unlit holder.
cinematic.blocking: Detail stays on her hands and the bench edge: bracelet on her left wrist frame left, holder on the stone frame right. Her right hand does all the work and ends beside the left.
cinematic.performance: Pride first: she will not let anyone strip the bracelet from her. Underneath, a brief hesitation at the knuckle betrays what it meant. Deliberate hands, no theatrical trembling.
cinematic.focus: Keep bracelet, fingertips and holder in a plausible common plane without ornate reflections or inscriptions.
cinematic.texture: Jade keeps its existing colour and wear, violet cuff stays the same, no duplicate bracelet appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: A restrained jade-on-stone contact is enough; do not add a ceremonial chime or score swell.
cinematic.rhythm: The line and the grip arrive together, the removal takes the middle with one small stall, and the release onto the stone lands late and stays alive in the loosening fingers.

clips.wardrobe_note: Bà Hai wears her deep-violet silk áo bà ba; the green jade bracelet has been removed from her left wrist and placed beside her unlit holder as evidence.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Bà Hai mặc áo bà ba lụa tím sẫm; chiếc vòng ngọc bích bên cổ tay trái được bà tự tháo xuống, đặt cạnh chiếc tẩu đen trên ghế đá làm vật chứng.

clips.start_frame: Bà Hai standing in front of the stone bench facing one officer, both wrists bare at her sides; behind her the jade bracelet and unlit holder lie together on the stone.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Bà Hai raises both bare wrists toward the officer, chin level, eyes on his face rather than on the cuffs. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The officer closes his steel cuffs on her wrists in one ordinary movement; her fingers curl, then settle against each other. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Her head turns toward the lighthouse off frame, and she says, in a level voice, that Sơn is the son she raised, as if that explains everything; her breath lifts the violet silk.
clips.end_frame: Bà Hai standing cuffed in front of the bench, cuffed hands low before her, face turned toward the lighthouse off frame, lips just closing; the officer at her right side; bracelet and holder still together on the stone behind her.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Thằng Sơn trên tháp đó là con tôi nuôi.

clips.lighting: Same night, simultaneous: steady harbour floodlight as hard high key on the stone bench, dark sea beyond.

cinematic.intent: Keep the claim of motherhood present without allowing it to function as a defence against responsibility.
cinematic.composition: Frame her standing medium before the assisting officer, bench and surrendered objects behind.
cinematic.blocking: Bà Hai center facing frame left toward the officer, bench and surrendered objects behind her. After the cuffs she turns her head frame right toward the lighthouse; the officer stays at her right side.
cinematic.performance: She offers her wrists to keep the gesture hers, then claims Sơn as a fact of ownership to win back some power. She wants to be seen as a mother, not a seller. No pleading, no tears.
cinematic.focus: Keep face and cuffed hands within readable framing, avoiding an isolated beauty shot of the arrest.
cinematic.texture: Bracelet stays on the bench and never returns to her LEFT wrist; outfit remains immaculate but no longer commanding.
cinematic.sound_detail: One cuff closure follows ordinary procedure, her voice clear above the same floodlight-and-sea environment.
cinematic.rhythm: A clean offer, one quick procedural closure, then the glance and the line arrive after the arrest is complete; her breath keeps the end alive.

clips.wardrobe_note: Bà Hai wears her deep-violet silk áo bà ba; the green jade bracelet has been removed from her left wrist and placed beside her unlit holder as evidence.

clips.start_frame: Close on Bà Hai's face, eyes still turned toward the lighthouse off frame, cuffed hands below frame; steady floodlight on her powdered cheek, harbour dark behind her.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): She holds the look toward the tower, lips pressed together, a small pulse working at her jaw. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The officer's plain voice speaks from off frame; her eyes flick toward it and her chin loses a little height as the words land. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She lowers her gaze away from the tower to the ground in front of her, breath easing out through her nose, mouth set, eyes dry.
clips.end_frame: Bà Hai's face lowered, eyes down and away from the tower, mouth set; a slow breath moving her shoulders; floodlight steady on her cheek, nothing in her hands visible.

dialogue.speaker: OFFICER
dialogue.text: Lời bà tôi ghi lại rồi. Về đồn, bà khai rõ từng người bà đã bán.

clips.lighting: Same night, simultaneous: steady harbour floodlight as hard high key on the stone bench, dark sea beyond.

cinematic.intent: Let the law acknowledge her words while refusing to turn them into absolution.
cinematic.composition: Use the close-up on Bà Hai listening, officer remains a voice outside this frame.
cinematic.blocking: Close-up holds her face frame center; the officer stands off frame left, the lighthouse off frame right. Her eyeline travels from frame right to the voice at frame left, then down.
cinematic.performance: The officer's answer is a boundary she did not ask for. She contains the sting rather than confess, and she wants the conversation over. No sudden tears, no defiant speech.
cinematic.focus: Hold her eyes and the slight loss of chin height, no cut to a symbolic object during the line.
cinematic.texture: Bare wrists remain outside or low in frame, powdered face shows natural tired texture rather than sudden tears.
cinematic.sound_detail: The officer's off-frame words are plain and unamplified, with normal harbour noise beneath.
cinematic.rhythm: A held look, the officer's line taken without interruption, then a lowered gaze that arrives unhurried but does not linger like a farewell.

clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The escort's hand touches her elbow and Bà Hai starts toward the custody vehicle at a controlled pace, not looking back at the bench. clips.end_frame: Bench empty under the floodlight; the officer holds the evidence tray with bracelet and holder; Bà Hai and her escort a step from the open rear door of the custody vehicle, still walking, her back to the bench.

dialogue.speaker: HAINGOC
dialogue.text: Cái vòng đó cứ thu đi. Tôi hết cần nó rồi.

clips.lighting: Same night, simultaneous: steady harbour floodlight as hard high key on the stone bench, dark sea beyond.

cinematic.intent: Close her physical route without claiming the whole film has ended.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide to connect bench, evidence officer and custody vehicle on the protected road.
cinematic.blocking: Bench frame left foreground, custody vehicle frame right on the road about ten paces away. Bà Hai walks left to right with the escort on her right; the evidence officer stays at the bench.
cinematic.performance: She keeps her spine straight to pretend the walk is her choice and refuses to look back at what she owned. Her line is pride, not surrender. Nobody salutes her, no tearful glance.
cinematic.focus: Keep the emptied bench and departing figure readable in the same geography without a new crane move.
cinematic.texture: Bracelet and holder stay together in custody, not carried secretly in her clothing.
cinematic.sound_detail: Footsteps and vehicle preparation remain low and routine; incoming gallery wind can take over for the return upward.
cinematic.rhythm: Departure starts at once, the line falls mid-walk while the tray is filled, and the cut comes before she reaches the car door, the bench already emptied.

scenes.title: Đỉnh Hải Đăng
scenes.purpose: Mây giữ đối thoại, Hạ nhận ra lối thoát, Sơn không áp sát nòng súng.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep the established gallery wind and faint cable rattle. Backup light turns on only on the cue at 51.1.

clips.start_frame: Mây one step onto the gallery from the east main doorway frame left, hands open at her sides, Sơn a step behind her; Kiên at the south sea rail frame right, right hand gripping Hạ's left upper arm, handgun low in his left hand.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Mây takes one more step and stops short, five paces from the pair, palms turned open at hip height; Sơn halts a step behind her and stays there. Beat 2 (2.5–6.5s): She speaks to Kiên in an even voice, asking him to let Hạ stand apart while she listens, eyes moving between his face and his low gun hand. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Wind pulls at Hạ's grey hem as her eyes go from Mây to Sơn; Kiên's gaze flicks across both newcomers, gun still low, while Sơn's bare right hand opens at his side and his feet stay planted.
clips.end_frame: Four positions readable: Mây five paces inside the east doorway frame left, palms open; Sơn a step behind her; Kiên at the south rail frame right, right hand on Hạ's left upper arm, gun low in his left; service hatch out of his sight beyond the inner wall; wind moving hair and hems.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Kiên, tôi dừng ở đây. Cho Hạ đứng riêng, tôi nghe anh nói.

clips.lighting: Night gallery: low work lamps as warm side key, moonlit sea as cool fill from the south rail; backup lamp still off.

cinematic.intent: Give the audience a complete danger map before the last negotiation begins.
cinematic.composition: The wide places Mây at the eastern main doorway, Sơn behind, Kiên and Hạ near the southern rail.
cinematic.blocking: Mây and Sơn frame left at the east doorway, Kiên and Hạ frame right against the south rail, about five paces of open floor between them; inner wall center background with the north service hatch hidden behind its curve.

cinematic.intent: Expose Kiên's shrinking options while keeping the hostage and weapon physically distinct.

cinematic.performance: Kiên's demand masks fear behind practicality; he hides that his options are shrinking and wants obedience he can no longer force. Hạ stores information instead of panicking. No comic collapse, no waving gun.
cinematic.focus: Keep gun hand, controlling hand and face legible in one setup; do not add a separate weapon insert.

cinematic.texture: Grey dress, sandals and loose hair stay consistent, scarf still absent and no new weapon appears in her hand.

cinematic.sound_detail: One small clasp click, softened wind, no ticking until it actually resumes in the following shot.
cinematic.rhythm: A brief hold on the clasp under the short line, the opening in the middle, then a small tilt that lets the audience see what was hidden without a frozen tail.

clips.start_frame: Sơn seated against the inner wall, shoulders already off it, closed watch in his right hand; Hạ beside him, scarf over her grey dress; Mây standing at the gallery doorway by the stairs, about six paces away, facing them.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn rises in one careful effort, left shoulder against the wall for balance, while Hạ rises with him, a hand near his elbow. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He walks toward Mây on his own, both hands open in front of him at waist height, the closed watch resting on his right palm, Hạ following a step behind. cinematic.performance: Tired but definite: he hides the effort of standing and wants the choice to be visibly his. Mây receives it without satisfaction; Hạ watches rather than holds him back. No slogan, no salute.
cinematic.focus: Keep his entire approach and Mây's stationary position readable so the choice is unmistakably his.
cinematic.texture: LEFT bandage, black suit and Hạ's grey dress with returned scarf remain continuous.

cinematic.intent: Join his acceptance to the careful reality of custody, avoiding either punishment spectacle or easy forgiveness.

cinematic.blocking: Medium: Mây frame left, Sơn center facing her, Hạ behind his right shoulder frame right; the officer only at the frame edge. Hands and the speaking face share one readable plane.
cinematic.performance: He answers her with the consequence in front of his eyes, hiding nothing now. Mây's care with the bandage never turns into reluctance. No punishment spectacle, no easy forgiveness.
cinematic.focus: Keep hands and speaking face readable, not an extreme insert that hides his voluntary posture.
cinematic.texture: One intact pair closes, no old broken cuff returns and no wrist injury changes sides.
cinematic.sound_detail: A single subdued closure follows his answer, without repeated clicks, score hit or crowd reaction.
cinematic.rhythm: The answer comes first, the custody follows as one careful action, and the end holds him upright and still visibly choosing to stay.

cinematic.intent: Give Hạ authorship of the door decision without glorifying the danger she survived.
cinematic.composition: Close on her face and relaxed empty hands at table height, Mây remains her off-axis listener.
cinematic.blocking: Close-up holds Hạ's face frame right and her hands low frame center; Mây remains an off-axis listener frame left. Only her hands move, from open palms to flat on the table.

cinematic.focus: Hold her eyes and nearest fingertips within natural depth, keeping focus on a person deciding what to tell.
cinematic.texture: No prop is added to demonstrate the latch, and the clean blouse does not acquire new damage.
cinematic.sound_detail: Only her line and a quiet breath break the fan bed, no hatch noises replayed from the tower.
cinematic.rhythm: A breath of choosing, one pause before the reason inside the line, then the hands settle; this is testimony, not another suspense set piece.

scenes.purpose: Sơn nhận trách nhiệm cụ thể, không coi cứu Hạ là xóa tội.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Carry the station fan from the quiet holding room into morning evidence handover. Do not replay the statement or signature.

clips.start_frame: The recorder sits switched off at the centre of the interview desk. Mây is seated at the near left, black notebook open, pen in her right hand; Sơn sits across from her in his black suit, bare hands resting on the desk, left wrist bandaged.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Mây looks up from her notebook and confirms that Sơn has understood his rights as she speaks; he answers with a single small nod, eyes on hers. Beat 2 (2.5–6.0s): She presses the record button with her left forefinger, the small red light comes on, and she asks where he wants to begin. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): Sơn holds her gaze without the guarded half-smile he once wore; his hands stay still on the wood and he draws one slow breath, ready to answer, while Mây waits with her pen over the page.
clips.end_frame: Recorder light glowing steady at the desk centre. Mây seated at the near left, pen poised over her open notebook, eyes on Sơn; Sơn across the desk, upright, bare hands still on the wood, left wrist bandaged, drawing breath to answer.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Anh đã rõ quyền của mình. Giờ tôi ghi âm. Anh muốn khai từ việc nào?

clips.lighting: Late-night interview room: one warm desk lamp as low hard side key, dim cool corridor light through the door.

cinematic.intent: Make Sơn initiate an account that can cost him, even after the rescue earned sympathy.
cinematic.composition: Frame him across the interview desk with recorder centered and Mây listening, distinct from Hạ's prior table.
cinematic.blocking: Mây seated on the near side, screen left, three-quarter to camera; Sơn across the desk, screen right, facing her. Recorder centred between them. Pen in Mây's right hand, her left presses record; Sơn's hands stay on the desk.
cinematic.performance: Mây is procedural on purpose: she gives him no warmth to lean on, only a clear choice. Sơn wants no credit for the rescue; his steadiness hides what the first answer will cost. No confession theatrics, no softened smile.
cinematic.focus: Hold both faces in medium depth, keeping the recording light a modest factual indicator.
cinematic.texture: Black suit and LEFT bandage persist, closed watch stays secured in the pocket rather than being displayed.
cinematic.sound_detail: A single record-button click precedes Mây's question; the room is quieter than the public station.
cinematic.rhythm: Rights confirmed in a breath, one clean click, then the question; the last four seconds hold on Sơn's decision forming, still and breathing, ending ready to speak rather than speaking.

dramaturgy.turn_vi: Anh gọi tên địa chỉ và người xác nhận, ký vào trách nhiệm riêng.

scenes.title: Sổ Tiền Thành Hồ Sơ
scenes.purpose: Bằng chứng được xác minh và đời sống thị trấn bắt đầu trở lại.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep ordinary town morning sound from the walk to the family-house threshold. Market-stall planning happens after the home entry.

clips.start_frame: At the station desk an unnamed investigator bends over the sealed originals in a row: black ledger, red cloth ledger, USB and token in separate sleeves, beside Thành's open handover record and a radio handset. Thành stands at his shoulder; Mây waits in the doorway with tied witness files.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.5s): The desk radio delivers the task force's confirmation while the investigator runs a finger down Thành's record and checks each sealed item in turn, keeping the two ledgers apart and the USB and token sleeves separate. Beat 2 (4.5–7.5s): Mây crosses from the doorway and hands the tied bundle of local witness files to Thành, telling him they are complete. Beat 3 (7.5–10.0s): Thành enters the bundle on the last line of the handover record and turns the folder to the investigator, who initials it; a thin stack of local copies stays at Thành's elbow.
clips.end_frame: Handover record initialled and turned back toward Thành, the tied witness files logged beside the sealed originals, ledgers apart, USB and token sleeves separate; a thin stack of local copies at Thành's elbow; Mây standing at the desk end, hands free; the investigator straightening in his chair.

dialogue.speaker: RADIO
dialogue.text: Ban chuyên án báo: sổ đen, sổ đỏ đã khớp tang vật ở xưởng và lịch tàu.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Hồ sơ nhân chứng Hòn Sóng đủ rồi, Thành.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning: ordinary coastal daylight from the east, soft shade under roofs and awnings, neutral window light indoors; no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Resolve the evidence route with verification, not a celebratory announcement that retells the plot.
cinematic.composition: The wide connects investigator, originals, handover record and Mây's remaining witness files.
cinematic.blocking: Desk across frame centre with the originals in a row; investigator seated behind it, Thành standing at his left holding the leather folder; Mây enters from the doorway screen right and stops at the desk end. Radio handset lies on the desk.
cinematic.performance: Relief shows only as unhurried hands; nobody celebrates. Mây wants the local files counted as part of the same continuing case, not a souvenir of one night. Thành is careful, the investigator neutral. No applause, no triumphant looks.
cinematic.focus: Keep the relationship of original sleeves and local copies readable without trying to show legible account figures.
cinematic.texture: Black and red books remain distinct, original USB and token do not merge into one object.
cinematic.sound_detail: One concise radio confirmation sits over paper and station fan, not a triumphant theme or public cheer.
cinematic.rhythm: The radio confirmation and the item check share the first half, Mây's handover lands on one short line, and the take finishes on paperwork completed, not on a pause for an emotional ending.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and round glasses whose right temple arm is held with tape, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính gọng tròn ngay ngắn, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Đồn công an thị trấn Hòn Sóng (D8 morning) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (BLACK_BOOK, RED_BOOK, USB, TOKEN, DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–4.5s): Bộ đàm trên bàn báo kết quả của ban chuyên án trong lúc điều tra viên dò theo biên bản của Thành, kiểm từng vật chứng niêm phong, giữ hai cuốn sổ tách riêng, túi USB và túi token không lẫn vào nhau. Nhịp 2 (4.5–7.5s): Mây từ cửa bước tới, trao bó hồ sơ nhân chứng địa phương cho Thành, nói gọn rằng đã đủ. Nhịp 3 (7.5–10.0s): Thành ghi bó hồ sơ vào dòng cuối biên bản bàn giao, xoay bìa hồ sơ cho điều tra viên ký nháy; xấp bản sao địa phương nằm lại cạnh khuỷu tay Thành. Bộ đàm nói ở nhịp 1, Mây nói ở nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (BLACK_BOOK, RED_BOOK, USB, TOKEN, DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: Under the green awning, Bảy bends over a plastic chair lying on its side by the seaward table, one hand on its backrest, checkered cloth on his shoulder; Thành stands at the counter end with his leather folder under his left arm.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Bảy rights the chair and sets it in its regular place at the seaward table, asking Thành with weary dry humour whether the stall may sell coffee now. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): Thành answers with a small smile and a nod instead of words and, folder still tucked under his arm, slides the coffee tray with its phin filter along the counter toward Bảy. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Bảy steps behind the counter, pulls the cloth from his shoulder, wipes a glass and stands it on the counter, the first of the day, as the awning cloth lifts in the sea wind.
clips.end_frame: Chair upright at the seaward table; the first clean glass standing on the counter beside the coffee tray; Bảy behind the counter, cloth in hand; Thành at the counter end, folder under his arm, half smiling; the awning cloth stirring in the wind.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Trời quang rồi chú Thành. Tui bán cà phê lại được hông?

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning: ordinary coastal daylight from the east, soft shade under roofs and awnings, neutral window light indoors; no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Return the town to an ordinary transaction rather than another retelling of the fight.
cinematic.composition: Frame Bảy and Thành at the coffee counter with the familiar chair and first clean glass.
cinematic.blocking: Seaward table screen left, counter screen right. Bảy moves from the chair to behind the counter; Thành stays at the counter end, folder under his left arm, right hand on the tray. The counter mirror shows only the street.
cinematic.performance: Bảy covers the fear of the last days with practical humour; he wants permission to go back to ordinary. Thành's reply stays in a shy look. No laughter beat, no curtain-call reaction, no retelling of the fight.
cinematic.focus: Keep both at conversational medium depth, without isolating the chair like a sacred relic.
cinematic.texture: Counter, chair and glass are the same worn everyday items, no new flowers or hero portrait appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: Chair feet on concrete and a glass placed normally create a lighter rhythm after the interview quiet.
cinematic.rhythm: The question rides the chair being set down, the nod and the tray slide carry the middle, and the first clean glass lands as the endpoint, ready to serve, without a pause for applause.

clips.wardrobe_note: Thành wears his light-blue shirt and round glasses whose right temple arm is held with tape, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính gọng tròn ngay ngắn, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm. Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly, tay thao tác với khay ly cà phê hoặc thùng nhựa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Quán cà phê cóc của Ông Bảy bên bờ kè biển (D8 morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (CLIPBOARD, COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Bảy dựng chiếc ghế nhựa lên, đặt về đúng chỗ quen bên bàn hướng biển, hỏi Thành bằng giọng hài hước mệt mỏi xem đã bán cà phê lại được chưa. Nhịp 2 (3.5–7.0s): Thành không đáp bằng lời, chỉ cười nhẹ gật đầu, bìa hồ sơ vẫn kẹp dưới nách, đẩy khay cà phê và cái phin dọc mặt quầy về phía Bảy. Nhịp 3 (7.0–10.0s): Bảy vòng vào sau quầy, rút khăn rằn trên vai lau một cái ly rồi đặt đứng trên quầy, ly đầu tiên trong ngày; tấm bạt phập phồng trong gió biển. Bảy nói ở nhịp 1, Thành đáp bằng ánh mắt.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (CLIPBOARD, COFFEE_TRAY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh · Đạo cụ khóa: CLIPBOARD, COFFEE_TRAY.

clips.start_frame: Mây walking along a reopened fish-market aisle between ice tubs and crate stacks, duty pouch at her hip; ahead, two unnamed sellers work beside the repaired side gate, one shovelling ice into a tub, the other stacking crates.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây walks the last stretch of the cleared aisle, glancing along the route, and as she reaches the gate thanks the two sellers for getting people out and keeping the rear way open. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): The nearer seller shrugs it off with a short answer, still shovelling ice into the tub, while the other lifts a crate onto the stack. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Mây rests a hand on the repaired gate post, looks through the gate along the rear exit route, gives a short satisfied nod and turns back toward the aisle as the sellers keep working.
clips.end_frame: Mây at the repaired side gate, her hand leaving the gate post as she turns back toward the busy aisle; the two sellers at work beside her, ice sliding into the tub, a crate settling on the stack; water running along the aisle floor.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Cảm ơn bà con đã đưa người ra, giữ lối sau thông thoáng.

dialogue.speaker: EXTRA
dialogue.text: Có gì đâu cô. Chợ mở lại là mừng rồi.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning: ordinary coastal daylight from the east, soft shade under roofs and awnings, neutral window light indoors; no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Show communal repair through checking people, not praising Sơn as the town's saviour.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide along the reopened market lane, Mây meeting the two existing unnamed sellers near the gate.
cinematic.blocking: The aisle runs from frame left to the side gate at screen right. Mây walks toward the gate and stops beside it; the two sellers stay at their tub and crate stack. Duty pouch on her hip, her hands free.
cinematic.performance: Her gratitude is real but brief; she wants them back to normal life more than she wants to thank them. The sellers treat it as nothing special, workers with a morning to run. No cheering, no saviour talk.
cinematic.focus: Keep the route and activity readable in ordinary depth, no spotlight isolating Mây in the crowd.
cinematic.texture: Gate stays repaired in its existing place, carts and tubs return to functional positions rather than fight poses.
cinematic.sound_detail: Market voices and normal water sounds resume beneath her thanks, replacing the night command bed.
cinematic.rhythm: Walk and thanks arrive together, the reply comes without anyone stopping work, and the take ends with everyone moving on, not posed for a group moment.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong chợ cá Hòn Sóng (D8 morning) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây đi nốt đoạn lối chợ đã thông, mắt rà dọc tuyến, tới cổng phụ thì cảm ơn hai người bán đã đưa người ra và giữ lối sau thông thoáng. Nhịp 2 (3.5–7.0s): Người bán đứng gần xua tay đáp gọn, tay vẫn xúc đá vào thùng; người kia nhấc một két cá lên chồng. Nhịp 3 (7.0–10.0s): Mây đặt tay lên trụ cổng mới sửa, nhìn qua cổng dọc lối thoát phía sau, gật nhẹ hài lòng rồi quay lại lối chợ, hai người vẫn làm việc. Mây nói ở nhịp 1, người bán đáp ở nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
