clips.start_frame: Linh at the clinic sink, coat sleeves pushed up, the emptied canvas response bag dripping in his hands; above the bench beside him an empty hook, a cup of water on the bench; his medical notes already filed on the desk behind.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Linh shakes the water out of the bag over the sink and hangs it by its strap on the hook above the bench, murmuring his line to himself. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He turns and lowers himself onto the bench beneath it, his shoulders dropping as his full weight settles for the first time in hours. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He picks up the cup of water, drinks a slow mouthful, lets out a long breath and rests his head back against the wall while the bag above him sways and drips.
clips.end_frame: The emptied bag hanging from the hook above the bench, still swaying faintly and dripping; Linh seated beneath it, head back against the wall, the cup of water in his right hand on his knee, stethoscope around his neck, eyes half closed.

dialogue.speaker: LINH
dialogue.text: Ca trực dài nhất đời. Không mất một ai.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning: ordinary coastal daylight from the east, soft shade under roofs and awnings, neutral window light indoors; no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Let Linh's private fatigue provide a human consequence without restarting the medical suspense.
cinematic.composition: Frame the clinic sink, bag hook and bench medium, Linh already finished with his notes.
cinematic.blocking: Sink screen left, bench and hook screen right; Linh moves two steps from sink to bench. The bag goes from his hands to the hook; the cup stays on the bench until his right hand takes it.
cinematic.performance: Private fatigue after a night of keeping people breathing; he lets it show only in the shoulders. He wants nothing from anyone, just to sit down. No collapse, no tremor, no haunted stare to camera.
cinematic.focus: Keep bag placement and seated figure in one composition, avoiding another medical-object montage.
cinematic.texture: Bag is the same used at the van, now emptied; no timer, amber antidote or new blood-stained item appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: Water at the sink settles into ventilation and a quiet cup contact under Linh's murmured words, with no lingering emergency tone.
cinematic.rhythm: The practical task completes in the first three seconds, the sit is the release, and the last three seconds are one ordinary breath of rest with the bag still moving above him.

clips.wardrobe_note: Bác sĩ Linh wears his worn white medical coat with stethoscope around his neck, keeping his canvas emergency medical bag and breathing-support kit at hand.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Bác sĩ Linh khoác áo blouse trắng sờn vai, cổ đeo ống nghe y tế, tay xách túi cấp cứu vải bố có sẵn bình trợ thở.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Phòng khám đa khoa thị trấn Hòn Sóng (D8 morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (MED_BAG).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Linh giũ nước khỏi chiếc túi trên bồn rửa, treo quai túi lên móc phía trên ghế băng, khẽ nói một câu với chính mình. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Ông quay lại, hạ người ngồi xuống ghế ngay dưới chiếc túi, vai chùng xuống khi lần đầu sau nhiều giờ được buông cả sức nặng. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Ông cầm ly nước uống một ngụm chậm, thở ra dài, ngả đầu tựa tường; chiếc túi phía trên vẫn đung đưa, nhỏ giọt. Linh nói ở nhịp 1.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (MED_BAG) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: At the station case board, the emergency duty roster is pinned over the ordinary patrol map; Thành, in new intact round glasses, reaches toward its top pin with his leather folder open in his left hand; Mây stands beside him.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.0s): Thành unpins the emergency roster and lifts it off the board, uncovering the ordinary patrol map, as he asks Mây whether tonight's patrol goes back to the old routine. Beat 2 (4.0–7.5s): Mây answers that it is the regular shift and that he rides with the escort to the province shortly, smoothing the map's curled corner and pressing its pin home. Beat 3 (7.5–10.0s): Thành slides the roster into his folder and closes it, nudges his new glasses up with one finger and looks over the restored map as Mây turns back toward her desk.
clips.end_frame: The ordinary patrol map fully visible on the case board, its corner pinned flat; the emergency roster closed inside Thành's folder under his arm; Thành looking over the map through his new glasses; Mây half turned toward her desk.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Gỡ bảng trực khẩn cấp rồi. Tối nay mình tuần tra như cũ hả chị?

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Ca thường thôi. Lát nữa em theo xe áp giải lên tỉnh.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning: ordinary coastal daylight from the east, soft shade under roofs and awnings, neutral window light indoors; no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Use the return of a normal shift to show the emergency has ended without claiming the case is over.
cinematic.composition: Frame Thành and Mây at the ordinary patrol map with the temporary roster in hand.
cinematic.blocking: The case board fills the back wall; Thành at its left, Mây at its right. The roster goes from the board into Thành's folder; Mây's hands touch only the map pin. The map stays unreadable shapes and lines.
cinematic.performance: Thành's question is half relief, half readiness for the next job; he hides how tired he is behind the new glasses. Mây answers like a supervisor on an ordinary day. No moral speech, no farewell mood.
cinematic.focus: Keep his replacement glasses and the map relation readable at medium distance, no generated text close-up.
cinematic.texture: New intact glasses appear here after the taped pair, paper roster stays one distinct sheet.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper filing and ordinary station sounds sit below the short line, no radio alarm interrupts the calm.
cinematic.rhythm: Question and answer overlap the two small tasks; the filing closes the take inside ten seconds, an administrative beat with no lingering.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính gọng tròn ngay ngắn, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Đồn công an thị trấn Hòn Sóng (D8 morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, CLIPBOARD).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–4.0s): Thành gỡ ghim, nhấc tờ lịch trực khẩn cấp khỏi bảng, để lộ bản đồ tuần tra thường lệ, vừa hỏi Mây tối nay có tuần tra như cũ không. Nhịp 2 (4.0–7.5s): Mây đáp là ca thường, lát nữa Thành theo xe áp giải lên tỉnh, tay vuốt phẳng góc bản đồ bị quăn và ấn ghim lại. clips.start_frame: Morning light on the main street: Hạ stands on the police-post doorstep, the family-house key in her right hand, pale-blue scarf at her neck; Mây steps out of the doorway behind her, hands empty.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây comes alongside Hạ on the step and, with a tilt of her head toward the harbour houses, tells her to go home first and leave the rest for later. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): Hạ glances down the road toward the pier, closes her fingers round the key and agrees, saying she will measure the stall site after the house; she steps down onto the street. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): They walk off side by side toward the harbour houses, away from the pier, Hạ setting the pace with Mây half a step behind, the scarf lifting in the sea breeze.
clips.end_frame: Hạ and Mây walking side by side along the sunlit street toward the harbour houses, backs half turned to camera, the key in Hạ's right hand, Mây half a step behind; the pier road empty behind them, scarf ends lifting in the breeze.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Nắng lên rồi. Về nhà ba mày trước, chuyện khác từ từ.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Ừ. Ghé nhà xong, tao ra chợ đo chỗ làm sạp.

clips.lighting: Day-eight morning: ordinary coastal daylight from the east, soft shade under roofs and awnings, neutral window light indoors; no action lighting.

cinematic.intent: Carry Hạ toward her own home so recovery becomes action rather than a waiting-room image.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide at the station doorway, Hạ holding the family key and Mây joining empty-handed.
cinematic.blocking: Post doorway centre frame; the pier road leads off screen left, the harbour houses lie screen right. Both exit screen right. The key stays in Hạ's right hand; Mây carries nothing.
cinematic.performance: Hạ's apprehension is quiet and forward-facing; she wants to see her father's house before she lets herself think of anything else. Mây offers company without steering. No tearful look back, no pep talk.
cinematic.focus: Keep their shared direction clear, not alternating isolated reaction shots that stall the walk.
cinematic.texture: White blouse, jeans and long scarf remain the same, key stays with Hạ after the interview handover.
cinematic.sound_detail: Ordinary morning street sound replaces case-room fan, Mây's line light enough to belong to friends.
cinematic.rhythm: Invitation and answer take the first seven seconds and turn straight into walking; the take ends in motion toward the next threshold.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Hạ wears a clean borrowed white blouse, blue jeans, flat sandals, and her pale-blue silk scarf neatly draped at her neck.

dramaturgy.turn_vi: Hồ sơ chuyển giao xong, ghế quán dựng lại, người trực trở về lịch bình thường.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Một chiếc ghế và chiếc kính mới thay lời ca ngợi người hùng.

scenes.title: Chỗ Của Hạ
scenes.purpose: Hạ có mục tiêu đời sống riêng và bắt đầu thực hiện.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Keep the approaching transport engine into Sơn window-side view. Hạ already holds the single lily; do not wrap it again.

clips.start_frame: Hạ and Mây on the doorstep of her father's small harbour house; the weathered wooden door is closed and locked, the key already in its lock under Hạ's right hand; Mây stands a pace back, outside.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ turns the key, the old lock gives smoothly, and she pushes the door open and steps across the threshold first, telling Mây over her shoulder to come in, it is her house. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): Mây stays on the doorstep a moment, looking past her into the bright room, and answers that the house is as bright as when they were small. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): Hạ stands just inside her own threshold with one hand on the open door, letting her eyes travel over the room; Mây lifts her foot onto the threshold step to follow.
clips.end_frame: Door open, Hạ standing just inside her own threshold with one hand on its edge, the key still in the lock, eyes on the room; Mây on the doorstep beginning her step in; harbour morning light falling across the floorboards.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Khóa vẫn êm ru. Vô đi Mây, nhà tao mà.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Nhà vẫn sáng như hồi tụi mình còn nhỏ.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning: soft window daylight inside the house, bright open sun on the public walkway with sea bounce on faces.

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ claim the right to invite someone into her own space again.
cinematic.composition: Frame the old house threshold wide, key in her RIGHT hand and Mây remaining outside.
cinematic.blocking: Doorway centre frame; Hạ enters first while Mây stays outside at screen left until invited. The key turns under Hạ's right hand; her left pushes the door inward. Nobody else is in the house.
cinematic.performance: Through fatigue, a small reclaiming humour: Hạ wants to be the host in her own house, not someone led inside. Mây's pause is respect and memory. No declaration that the trauma is over, no tears at the door.
cinematic.focus: Keep opening door and Hạ's first step readable with Mây's respectful pause in the same field.
cinematic.texture: Key remains the one from the station, no new house furnishing or welcoming relative appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: A normal key turn and door hinge sit under her invitation, with harbour morning sounds beyond.
cinematic.rhythm: Unlock and entry happen in one movement under the first line, the reply follows, and the last four seconds are Hạ taking in the room while Mây starts to follow; a single entry, no second door shot.

clips.start_frame: Hạ alone before her father's old workbench, dust on its surface, a framed lighthouse photograph propped at the back; a small cloth bag hangs from her left shoulder and an old rag lies at the bench edge.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ looks over the dusty bench, says her quiet line to herself and picks up the old rag. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She wipes one clear patch at the front of the bench in a few firm strokes, dust lifting in the window light; her eyes rest briefly on the lighthouse photograph and return to the work. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She slips the bag from her shoulder and sets it down beside the clean patch, smoothing its strap flat, then straightens with her palm resting on the wiped wood.
clips.end_frame: One clean patch on the dusty workbench with her small cloth bag set down beside it; Hạ standing at the bench, palm on the wiped wood, rag in her other hand; the lighthouse photograph behind; dust still drifting in the window light.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Nhà của ba, giờ là nhà của mình.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning: soft window daylight inside the house, bright open sun on the public walkway with sea bounce on faces.

cinematic.intent: Make inhabiting the house a concrete first task, not another memorial scene.
cinematic.composition: Use medium framing around the existing workbench and lighthouse photograph with Hạ alone.
cinematic.blocking: Workbench along the wall, photograph at its back centre; Hạ faces it, three-quarter to camera. Rag in her right hand; the bag comes off her left shoulder onto the bench at her left. The rest of the bench stays dusty.
cinematic.performance: Practical attention with grief held to one look: she wants the room to be hers, not a shrine to her father. The resolve lives in the firm strokes. No crying at the photograph, no reverent pause.
cinematic.focus: Keep cleared patch and face naturally visible, avoiding a shrine-like focus pull to the photograph.
cinematic.texture: Dust stays where she has not wiped, ordinary bag and worn bench remain materially specific.
cinematic.sound_detail: Cloth against wood and the bag settling are enough, no remembered father voice or music cue.
cinematic.rhythm: The quiet line opens the take, the wiping is a few decisive strokes, and setting the bag down is the claim; the end stays on one usable space, not a tidied house.

clips.start_frame: Empty concrete strip beside the fish-market entrance, no stall built yet, a fresh chalk tick on the ground. Hạ crouches at it, tape-measure case in her right hand and chalk in her left; Mây stands beside her; market traffic passes beyond.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.0s): Hạ pulls out the tape's end and hands it to Mây, asking her to hold it on the chalk tick and adding that the morning market crowd passes right here; Mây crouches and pins the hook. Beat 2 (4.0–7.0s): Hạ walks backward along the strip paying out the tape, eyes moving between the tape and the entrance traffic, as Mây remarks that the spot catches the early sun, good for flowers. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Hạ stops at a modest table length, crouches to chalk a second tick and rises; both look over the marked space.
clips.end_frame: Two chalk ticks a modest table length apart on the bare strip, the tape lying slack between them; Hạ standing at the far tick, Mây at the near one, both facing the future stall position; morning market traffic passing beyond.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Giữ đầu thước ngay vạch phấn nghe Mây. Sáng đi chợ, người qua đây đông.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Chỗ này đón nắng sớm, bày hoa là hợp.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning: soft window daylight inside the house, bright open sun on the public walkway with sea bounce on faces.

cinematic.intent: Translate Hạ's earlier wish into a choice of dimensions and a workable place.
cinematic.composition: The wide shows the empty market strip, both ends of the tape and existing entrance traffic beyond.
cinematic.blocking: The strip runs across frame with the market entrance beyond. Mây holds the tape end at the near tick, screen left; Hạ pays it out toward screen right. Tape case in Hạ's right hand, chalk in her left.
cinematic.performance: Hạ is absorbed in making something workable; the old wish becomes a measurement. She wants Mây here as a friend, not as an approving officer. No dreamy gaze at a future shop, no speech.
cinematic.focus: Keep marked ground and the two people's roles legible in depth, not a premature finished-shop fantasy.
cinematic.texture: Chalk mark, tape and bare space remain ordinary; no flower display materializes before construction.
cinematic.sound_detail: Tape extending and morning market chatter support the line, with no triumph fanfare.
cinematic.rhythm: Instructions come quickly with the handover of the tape, the walk-back fills the middle, and the second chalk tick is the decision at seven seconds; the end holds on the marked space.

clips.start_frame: Hạ kneels at a chalk mark on the bare market strip, tape case in her right hand and chalk in her left; the tape runs back to Mây, who stands a table depth away holding its end to the ground.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây, keeping the tape end steady, asks whether Hạ means to wait until the trial in the province is over before opening; Hạ's eyes stay on the tape. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): Hạ draws the tape taut toward the agreed edge and answers without looking up that she will not wait, she opens to live her own life from today, a trace of a smile for her friend. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): She presses the tape to the concrete at the edge, chalks a firm tick beside it and looks up at Mây with quiet certainty; Mây gives a small nod.
clips.end_frame: Tape stretched taut to the agreed edge with a fresh chalk tick beside it; Hạ kneeling there, chalk in her left hand, looking up at Mây with quiet certainty; Mây holding the tape end, a small nod finishing; passers-by and market sound beyond.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Mày không đợi tòa xử xong rồi mới mở sạp sao Hạ?

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Không đợi. Tao mở sạp để sống đời tao, từ hôm nay.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning: soft window daylight inside the house, bright open sun on the public walkway with sea bounce on faces.

cinematic.intent: Make Hạ's independence a working decision rather than an inspirational slogan delivered to camera.
cinematic.composition: Medium coverage keeps her at the chalk mark, Mây holding the same tape end.
cinematic.blocking: Hạ kneels screen right at the edge mark, Mây stands screen left holding the tape end; the tape runs straight between them. Tape case in Hạ's right hand, chalk in her left.
cinematic.performance: Mây's question is a friend's worry dressed as practicality. Hạ's certainty is plain, with a little teasing warmth; she wants her life to start now, not as defiance of Sơn. No slogan to camera, no defiant chin.
cinematic.focus: Keep her face and tape hand within one setup, allowing Mây's listening reaction without a new cut.
cinematic.texture: Tape stays at the same edge and grey-to-white wardrobe change is already complete, no new symbolic prop appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: Tape movement and normal market bed continue under the short line, making it part of a real conversation.
cinematic.rhythm: The question is asked while the tape holds still, the answer is spoken inside the work, and the chalk tick lands as the decision at seven seconds; the take ends with the project moving forward.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Hạ đã thay sang áo sơ mi trắng sạch sẽ, quần jean xanh, đi dép bệt và quàng chiếc khăn lụa xanh nhạt quanh cổ.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Khoảng sân trống đầu cổng chợ cá nơi Hạ đo đất mở sạp hoa (D8 morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Mây giữ chắc đầu thước, hỏi Hạ có định đợi phiên tòa trên tỉnh xử xong rồi mới mở sạp không; mắt Hạ vẫn dán vào thước. Nhịp 2 (3.5–7.0s): Hạ kéo căng thước tới mép đã thống nhất, không ngẩng lên mà đáp sẽ không đợi, cô mở sạp để sống đời mình từ hôm nay, khóe miệng thoáng cười với bạn. screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: On the windowsill stands her father's small yard vase of white lilies; one lily has been drawn out and laid across a sheet of plain paper beside it; Hạ's hands at its stem, small scissors open in her right hand.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ's right hand closes the scissors on the lily stem at a slant and the cut end drops onto the sill, as her voice off screen says why only this one flower. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Her hands set the scissors aside, lay the lily diagonally on the paper and fold the lower corner up over the stem. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She rolls the paper snug around the stem, pinches the fold closed and lifts the wrapped lily off the sill; the lilies left in the vase stay untouched, petals stirring in the window breeze.
clips.end_frame: Hạ's hands holding the single lily wrapped in plain paper just above the windowsill; the yard vase behind with its remaining lilies undisturbed, petals stirring in the window breeze; the cut stem end and the scissors lying on the sill.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Một bông thôi. Đủ để tiễn một người.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning: soft window daylight inside the house, bright open sun on the public walkway with sea bounce on faces.

cinematic.intent: Choose one personal farewell object without restarting the whole flower-shop romance.
cinematic.composition: Lock the detail on the single white lily at the existing home windowsill and Hạ's hands.
cinematic.blocking: Windowsill across frame, the vase at its right end, paper and lily at its centre. Scissors in Hạ's right hand until set down at the left; both hands then fold and roll. Nothing else on the sill.
cinematic.performance: A florist's everyday sureness in the fingers with a private purpose under it: she wants to be seen, not to mourn. The hands stay steady. Nothing funereal, no trembling, no lingering caress of the petals.
cinematic.focus: Keep stem, paper and fingers within a plausible detail plane, no new written message needs to be legible.
cinematic.texture: Plain paper, natural petal imperfections and the same window light make the flower ordinary and specific.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper folds and a quiet stem contact follow her few off-screen words, with home breeze and harbour sounds still present.
cinematic.rhythm: The cut is the first sound, the fold and the roll are continuous and practised, and the lift completes a single wrap; the take ends ready to carry, never on duplicate bouquets.

clips.wardrobe_note: Hạ wears a clean borrowed white blouse, blue jeans, flat sandals, and her pale-blue silk scarf neatly draped at her neck.

screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Căn nhà nhỏ của người cha gác đèn để lại cho Hạ gần cảng (D8 morning) · Góc máy: Đặc tả đạo cụ (85mm Insert) — khóa nét vào bàn tay và vật dụng mấu chốt. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (LILY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Tay phải Hạ khép kéo cắt xiên cuống hoa ly, đoạn cuống rơi xuống bậu cửa, giọng cô ngoài khung nói chỉ cần một bông. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Đôi tay đặt kéo sang bên, xếp bông ly chéo trên tờ giấy mộc, gấp góc dưới lên che cuống. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Cô cuộn giấy ôm sát cuống, miết chặt nếp gấp, nhấc bông hoa đã gói khỏi bậu cửa; những bông còn lại trong bình vẫn nguyên, cánh hoa khẽ lay trong gió cửa sổ. Hạ nói ngoài khung ở nhịp 1.

clips.start_frame: Public seafront walkway under a line of trees beside the main transport road; Hạ and Mây walking in along it, Hạ holding the paper-wrapped lily in both hands at waist height, Mây on her inner side; the road beyond the curb empty.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): As a vehicle engine rises from the station direction, they reach a clear spot under the trees and Hạ stops at the walkway's safe edge, telling Mây she will stand right here because he will see her as the vehicle passes. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): As the engine grows, Hạ's weight tips half a step toward the curb; she draws it back and plants both feet on the walkway, the lily steady at her waist. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Mây settles beside her on the inner side; both face the road, the scarf and the leaves moving in the sea wind as the engine sound comes closer.
clips.end_frame: Hạ standing still at the safe edge of the walkway under the trees, the wrapped lily held at waist height in both hands, facing the road; Mây beside her on the inner side; the transport lane still empty, engine sound growing, leaves and scarf moving in the wind.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Tao đứng đây thôi Mây. Xe chạy ngang, ảnh sẽ thấy tao.

clips.lighting: Same day-eight morning: soft window daylight inside the house, bright open sun on the public walkway with sea bounce on faces.

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ choose a safe visible place for the farewell instead of repeating a desperate chase.
cinematic.composition: The wide connects public walkway, tree line and transport road without placing either woman in traffic.
cinematic.blocking: Walkway and tree line across the foreground, the road beyond the curb in the middle ground. Both walk in from screen right, the town side, and stop centre a full pace back from the curb. Lily in both of Hạ's hands.
cinematic.performance: Confident but restrained: Hạ wants to be seen, not to stop the vehicle or run after it. The half step toward the road betrays how much it matters, and she corrects it herself. No desperate chase, no rehearsed wave.
cinematic.focus: Keep their relation to the road clear, no long-lens compression suggesting they are directly in its path.
cinematic.texture: One lily remains in plain paper, scarf and clean clothes unchanged, no sudden crowd gathers to see Sơn off.
cinematic.sound_detail: The approaching transport engine motivates her attention, ordinary morning sea sound remains beneath it.
cinematic.rhythm: Arrival and the line take the first beat, the half step and its correction are the held tension, and the end waits, alive, for a vehicle that has not appeared yet.

dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Hạ có bắt đầu sống trước khi biết bao giờ Sơn trở lại?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Cô nhận nhà và đo chỗ làm sạp hoa cho chính mình.

scenes.title: Qua Ô Cửa Xe
scenes.purpose: Chia tay bằng một ánh nhìn, không diễn lại nhiều lần.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Let the inland vehicle engine recede into cabin wind after the transport has left the picture.

clips.start_frame: Inside the moving prisoner transport: Sơn, changed into his olive field jacket, sits facing forward with no bag, cuffed hands low in his lap, left wrist bandaged, the mesh side window at his right shoulder; Thành sits opposite, the transfer file open on his knee.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–2.5s): Thành looks up from the file toward the road ahead, recognises the walkway and, lifting two fingers toward the mesh at Sơn's right, tells him where to look. Beat 2 (2.5–6.0s): Sơn thanks him quietly; his eyes move first, then his head turns a few degrees toward the mesh while his cuffed hands stay low. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): Thành lowers his gaze to the file and leans back against the wall to give him room; Sơn's shoulders follow his eyes toward the window, breath held, mesh shadows sliding over his face.
clips.end_frame: Sơn turned toward the right-side mesh window, shoulders angled to it, cuffed hands low in his lap, eyes searching the passing roadside; Thành leaning back opposite, eyes lowered to the transfer file open on his knee; mesh shadows sliding over both of them.

dialogue.speaker: THANH
dialogue.text: Anh Sơn, nhìn bên phải, chỗ hàng cây phía trước.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Ừ. Cảm ơn cậu.

clips.time_ellipsis: later before transport, Sơn has changed back into his stored olive jacket
clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning: daylight through the side mesh window as soft side key inside the vehicle, hard coastal sun outside.

cinematic.intent: Place the farewell inside the unavoidable movement of custody, not a private romantic escape.
cinematic.composition: Frame Sơn by the RIGHT mesh window, Thành opposite with the existing transfer file.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn on the forward-facing bench with the mesh window at his right shoulder; Thành on the opposite bench facing him. The transfer file rests on Thành's knee and his right hand points to the mesh. Sơn's cuffed hands stay in his lap.
cinematic.performance: Thành's courtesy is discreet; he wants to give Sơn this moment without making it official. Sơn's anticipation is held in a small turn, the hope kept off his face. No impulsive lunge to the window, no smile yet.
cinematic.focus: Keep the window direction and opposing seats clear, no confusing mirror reversal of right and left.
cinematic.texture: Olive jacket has returned only after the stated clothing change, LEFT bandage and closed watch remain consistent.
cinematic.sound_detail: Transport engine and tires form a steady bed, Thành's line concise without radio chatter over it.
cinematic.rhythm: The direction is given quickly and only once, the turn of the eyes and head takes the middle, and the last four seconds are held anticipation while the vehicle keeps moving.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần, cổ tay trái quấn băng trắng. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính gọng tròn ngay ngắn, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong xe chuyên dụng chuyển phạm nhân rời thị trấn (D8 late morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (CLIPBOARD).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–2.5s): Thành ngẩng khỏi hồ sơ nhìn về đoạn đường phía trước, nhận ra lối đi bộ, đưa hai ngón tay chỉ về ô lưới bên phải Sơn và bảo anh nhìn. Nhịp 2 (2.5–6.0s): Sơn khẽ cảm ơn; mắt anh chuyển trước, rồi đầu xoay vài độ về phía ô lưới, đôi tay bị còng vẫn để thấp. Nhịp 3 (6.0–10.0s): Thành cúi xuống hồ sơ, ngả lưng vào vách để chừa khoảng cho anh; vai Sơn xoay theo ánh mắt về phía cửa sổ, hơi thở nén lại, bóng lưới lướt qua mặt. Thành nói ở nhịp 1, Sơn đáp ở nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (CLIPBOARD) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: Sơn's point of view through the transport's right-side mesh window: the public walkway sliding closer, and under the trees Hạ standing at the safe edge with one paper-wrapped lily at waist height, Mây beside her.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Through the mesh, Hạ's eyes find the approaching window and she begins to raise the lily, murmuring her line toward it. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): As the vehicle draws level she holds the lily at chest height and keeps it there, Mây still beside her, neither of them stepping toward the road. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Hạ's eyes follow the moving window without a wave or a step; the mesh pattern slides across both women as they drift toward frame right and tree trunks pass between.
clips.end_frame: Through the mesh, Hạ holding the single wrapped lily against her chest, eyes on the moving window, Mây beside her on the walkway; both drifting toward frame right behind passing tree trunks, morning light on Hạ's white blouse.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Lời hẹn ở Hòn Sóng vẫn còn nguyên, anh.

clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning: daylight through the side mesh window as soft side key inside the vehicle, hard coastal sun outside.

cinematic.intent: Make one small flower gesture carry the farewell from Hạ's side.
cinematic.composition: Use the established moving view through Sơn's RIGHT mesh window toward the safe walkway.
cinematic.blocking: Mesh fills the foreground; the walkway runs parallel beyond the road. Hạ and Mây enter frame left and drift right with the vehicle's motion. The lily is in both of Hạ's hands; Mây's hands hang at her sides.
cinematic.performance: Hạ's steadiness is the gift; she wants him to see the promise kept, not her pain. Mây gives her the space. No running, no repeated waving, no staged sobbing.
cinematic.focus: Keep the roadside distance believable through the mesh, do not make a perfect unobstructed glamour portrait.
cinematic.texture: Plain paper and one lily remain unchanged, morning light touches her white blouse naturally.
cinematic.sound_detail: Engine is filtered by the window, sea and walkway sounds stay modest beyond it, no extra dialogue.
cinematic.rhythm: The lift starts with the murmured line and completes as the vehicle draws level; the held look carries the end while the women slide out of reach, leaving the reply to the next shot.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Hạ wears a clean borrowed white blouse, blue jeans, flat sandals, and her pale-blue silk scarf neatly draped at her neck.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Hạ đã thay sang áo sơ mi trắng sạch sẽ, quần jean xanh, đi dép bệt và quàng chiếc khăn lụa xanh nhạt quanh cổ.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Góc nhìn qua ô cửa lưới xe chuyển trại ra lối đi bộ ven biển (D8 late morning) · Góc máy: Qua vai / Điểm nhìn (50mm Over-shoulder/POV) — khóa trục ánh nhìn đối diện. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Qua ô lưới, ánh mắt Hạ tìm thấy ô cửa xe đang tới, cô bắt đầu nâng bông ly lên, khẽ nói một câu về phía cửa xe. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Khi xe chạy ngang, cô giữ bông hoa ngang ngực, không nâng thêm; Mây vẫn đứng cạnh, không ai bước ra đường. clips.start_frame: Sơn at the mesh window, face turned to it, sunlight and mesh shadow sliding across his face; his cuffed hands low in his lap; the closed watch's chain hidden inside his olive jacket.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Sơn's eyes find Hạ outside and stay there; his breath stops for a moment as he murmurs, almost to himself, that seeing her at peace is enough. Beat 2 (3.0–6.0s): He gives one small nod toward her, the chin dipping and rising, his cuffed hands staying low in his lap. Beat 3 (6.0–10.0s): His head turns slightly as his eyes keep following her past the rear edge of the window; a contained exhale, the jaw holding steady, no smile.
clips.end_frame: Sơn's nod finished, head turned toward the rear edge of the mesh window, eyes still following her; light and mesh shadow flickering over his face, jaw steady, cuffed hands low in his lap, the watch chain hidden inside his jacket.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Thấy em bình yên. Vậy là đủ rồi.

clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning: daylight through the side mesh window as soft side key inside the vehicle, hard coastal sun outside.

cinematic.intent: Let Sơn receive the farewell without mistaking it for release from what lies ahead.
cinematic.composition: Close on him beside the mesh, cuffed hands low and the chain secured inside the olive jacket.
cinematic.blocking: Sơn in profile to three-quarter, the mesh window beside his face at screen right; his eyeline travels from the front edge of the window to its rear edge. Hands stay low in his lap; nothing moves toward the watch.
cinematic.performance: Gratitude and loss at once: he wants her to see that he received it, and he hides what the distance costs. The sentence ahead stays in his eyes. No smile of release, no tears, no second monologue.
cinematic.focus: Keep face and mesh edge readable, avoiding an invented reflected Hạ portrait or a new watch insert.
cinematic.texture: Bandage remains LEFT, watch lid stays CLOSED, jacket and chain do not migrate to a different pocket.
cinematic.sound_detail: Road sound and a contained exhale are enough, no swelling song or second internal monologue.
cinematic.rhythm: Recognition and the murmured line come first, the nod is brief and complete, and the remaining four seconds are living attention as her position slides out of sight.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần, cổ tay trái quấn băng trắng.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong xe chuyên dụng chuyển phạm nhân rời thị trấn (D8 late morning) · Góc máy: Cận cảnh (85mm Close-up) — bắt trọn ánh mắt, cơ mặt và nhịp thoại dứt khoát. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (WATCH).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mắt Sơn tìm thấy Hạ bên ngoài và dừng lại ở đó; hơi thở anh ngưng một nhịp, anh khẽ nói gần như với chính mình rằng thấy em bình yên là đủ. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.0s): Anh gật đầu một cái nhỏ về phía cô, cằm hạ xuống rồi nâng lên, đôi tay bị còng vẫn để thấp trong lòng. Nhịp 3 (6.0–10.0s): Đầu anh xoay nhẹ khi mắt vẫn dõi theo cô qua mép sau ô cửa; một hơi thở ra nén lại, quai hàm giữ yên, không cười. Sơn nói khẽ ở nhịp 1.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (WATCH) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: Walkway beside the main street, late morning: Hạ holds the wrapped lily against her chest, eyes on the transport already small down the road; Mây stands beside her; the market lies the other way.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ watches the vehicle shrink a moment longer, lowers the lily from her chest to her side and tells Mây it is time to go, the flower table still has to be built. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She draws a breath and turns her back on the road, the turn a little stiff, to face the market; Mây turns with her. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): They walk toward the market side by side, Hạ's first steps careful and then steadier, the lily hanging at her side, while the vehicle keeps receding behind them.
clips.end_frame: Hạ and Mây walking side by side toward the market, the wrapped lily lowered in Hạ's right hand; behind them the transport small and receding down the road; walkway trees and morning traffic moving around them.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Đi thôi Mây. Còn cái bàn hoa phải đóng.

clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning: daylight through the side mesh window as soft side key inside the vehicle, hard coastal sun outside.

cinematic.intent: Return Hạ to her own direction immediately after the one farewell has happened.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide with transport already beyond them, walkway and route toward the market both clear.
cinematic.blocking: The road leads off screen left toward the crossroad, where the transport recedes; the market lies screen right. Both turn from facing the road to walking screen right. The lily is in Hạ's right hand once lowered.
cinematic.performance: The turn is deliberate and a little difficult: Hạ wants her own direction more than one more look, and hides the ache in a held breath. Not instantly cheerful, no collapse into grief, no look back.
cinematic.focus: Keep their first returning steps readable in the same geography, without a new farewell reverse angle.
cinematic.texture: The same single flower stays in her hand, no petals scatter or symbolic object falls behind her.
cinematic.sound_detail: Engine recedes while ordinary market sound begins to reclaim the scene around Hạ's one short line.
cinematic.rhythm: The lowering and the decision land in the first three seconds, the turn is the hard part, the walk is the release; cut while they are moving, before any second goodbye.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Hạ wears a clean borrowed white blouse, blue jeans, flat sandals, and her pale-blue silk scarf neatly draped at her neck.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Hạ đã thay sang áo sơ mi trắng sạch sẽ, quần jean xanh, đi dép bệt và quàng chiếc khăn lụa xanh nhạt quanh cổ.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Trục đường chính thị trấn biển Hòn Sóng (D8 late morning) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ nhìn chiếc xe nhỏ dần thêm một thoáng, hạ bông ly từ ngực xuống bên hông, nói với Mây đi thôi, còn cái bàn hoa phải đóng. Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Cô hít một hơi, quay lưng lại với con đường, cú quay hơi gượng, hướng về phía chợ; Mây quay theo. Nhịp 3 (6.5–10.0s): Hai người sánh vai đi về phía chợ, mấy bước đầu của Hạ còn chậm rồi vững dần, bông ly buông bên hông, chiếc xe vẫn xa dần phía sau. Hạ nói ở nhịp 1.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.
screenplay_vi.directing_vi: Góc máy Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo · Đạo cụ khóa: DUTY_POUCH.

clips.start_frame: Inside the transport, Sơn sits facing forward with no bag, back against the bench, cuffed hands low in his lap; beyond the mesh at his right shoulder the last houses of town thin out; Thành sits opposite, the transfer file closed on his knee.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Thành opens the destination transfer file on his lap and turns to its first page, pen in hand, as Sơn's voice-over begins. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Sơn lets his shoulders settle against the bench and keeps his eyes forward rather than on the window while the voice-over ends. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): The vehicle sways over a seam in the road; Thành makes a short note in the file; Sơn sits quietly, breathing evenly, passing light flickering over them both.
clips.end_frame: Sơn seated quietly facing forward, cuffed hands low in his lap, eyes ahead; Thành opposite with the transfer file open in his lap, pen moving along a line; beyond the mesh, open coastal road replacing the last houses, light flickering over them.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Lần đầu, tôi rời đi bằng tên thật. Không phải ngoái lại trốn ai.

clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning: daylight through the side mesh window as soft side key inside the vehicle, hard coastal sun outside.

cinematic.intent: Name Sơn's changed relationship to responsibility once, after the farewell image is already gone.
cinematic.composition: Medium interior returns to Sơn facing forward, Thành across with the destination file.
cinematic.blocking: Same seats: Sơn forward-facing with the mesh at his right shoulder, Thành opposite facing rearward. File and pen stay in Thành's hands. Sơn's hands stay in his lap and he does not turn to the window.
cinematic.performance: Sơn's calm is new and unshowy; he hides the loss and wants nothing more from the road behind. Thành keeps to his work as a courtesy. No proud smile at the narration, no glance back for Hạ.
cinematic.focus: Keep the ordinary seated posture and file in the existing depth, avoiding another close-up of cuffs or watch.
cinematic.texture: Olive jacket, LEFT bandage and closed watch position remain fixed, no new destination sign is generated.
cinematic.sound_detail: His short voice-over rides the same engine note and paper movement, no musical statement of redemption.
cinematic.rhythm: The file opens under the start of the narration, the settling takes the middle, and the last three seconds are ordinary travel, the vehicle moving on without another farewell.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged. Thành wears his light-blue shirt and neat round wire glasses, carrying his leather evidence folder and police radio handset.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần, cổ tay trái quấn băng trắng. Phó Thành mặc áo sơ mi xanh nhạt, đeo kính gọng tròn ngay ngắn, tay luôn kẹp bìa hồ sơ da, bút ghi biên bản và bộ đàm.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong xe chuyên dụng chuyển phạm nhân rời thị trấn (D8 late morning) · Góc máy: Trung cảnh (50mm Medium) — tập trung tương tác tay, đạo cụ và biểu cảm đối thoại nhanh. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (CLIPBOARD).

clips.start_frame: The coastal crossroad from the opening, late morning: the coach stop on the inland road, the sea bright beyond the south side; the prisoner transport approaching along the coast road, Sơn a dim seated shape behind its side mesh.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The transport slows toward the crossroad as Sơn's voice-over plays, its engine loud over the sea wind. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): It turns onto the inland road and rolls past the coach stop where he once stepped down, the mesh window sliding by with nobody looking out. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): It leaves frame along the inland road; dust settles at the turn, the sea stays bright beyond the south side and roadside grass bends in the wind as the engine fades.
clips.end_frame: Empty crossroad, the coach stop standing alone on the inland road and the sea bright beyond the south side; dust settling where the transport turned, roadside grass bending in the sea wind, the engine sound fading inland.

dialogue.speaker: SON
dialogue.text: Tôi để biển lại phía sau, cho một ngày trở về.

clips.lighting: Day-eight late morning: daylight through the side mesh window as soft side key inside the vehicle, hard coastal sun outside.

cinematic.intent: Close the outward journey geographically without creating another performance of parting.
cinematic.composition: The wide frames the same crossroad as the opening, sea visible beyond the southern side.
cinematic.blocking: The coast road enters from screen right, the inland road leads off screen left past the coach stop, sea in the background. The transport follows that path in one continuous move; nobody steps out.
cinematic.performance: If Sơn is seen at all he is part of the moving vehicle, a still shape, never a memory figure. The place, not a person, carries the feeling. No face pressed to the window, no looking back.
cinematic.focus: Keep the road choice readable in natural depth, no drone pull or time-lapse as the vehicle exits.
cinematic.texture: Crossroad sign remains unreadable, no new grave, message or flower appears beside the road.
cinematic.sound_detail: Engine recedes inland and sea wind remains after it, with no extra concluding narration.
cinematic.rhythm: One continuous departure across the frame: approach, turn, exit; the last three seconds belong to the empty crossroad, alive with wind and dust rather than a frozen postcard.

clips.wardrobe_note: Sơn wears his faded olive field jacket, grey shirt, dark trousers and worn boots, bare hands, LEFT wrist bandaged.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Sơn mặc áo khoác vải màu ô liu, áo thun xám, quần dài tối màu và giày da cổ thấp sờn cũ, hai bàn tay trần, cổ tay trái quấn băng trắng.

Nhịp 2 (3.0–6.5s): Xe rẽ vào đường đất liền, chạy qua trạm xe đò nơi anh từng bước xuống, ô cửa lưới lướt qua, không ai nhìn ra. dramaturgy.dramatic_question_vi: Hai người có thể chia tay mà không cần lời hứa dễ dàng?
dramaturgy.turn_vi: Một bông hoa, một cái gật; Hạ quay về công việc, Sơn đi tiếp bằng tên mình.
dramaturgy.hook_vi: Ô kính xe tạo khoảng cách không thể rút ngắn bằng chạy theo.

scenes.title: Căn Nhà Còn Mở Cửa
scenes.purpose: Thị trấn giữ ký ức nhưng tiếp tục sống, Hạ bắt tay làm sạp.
scenes.outgoing_audio: Match the newly sanded table surface to the finished flower counter years later, with a clear morning/time change and older faces.

clips.start_frame: Inside the emptied one-room cabin, door open: Bảy just inside the threshold holding a wooden repair box, checkered cloth on his shoulder; Mây mid-room with her black notebook open to the rental inventory, pen in hand; bare cot to the west, cleared table under the east window.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Bảy sets the repair box down by the threshold and says he will fix the door this very afternoon so the cabin can be let to guests, while Mây looks over the bare cot and ticks a line. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): Mây crosses to the cleared table, runs a finger over its empty surface, ticks the last line and agrees that a house warms up only with people living in it. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): She closes the notebook; both turn toward the doorway, and Bảy tests the loose door on its hinge with one hand, already sizing up the work.
clips.end_frame: Empty cot, cleared table, repair box by the threshold; Bảy at the open door, one hand testing its loose hinge; Mây closing her notebook and turning toward the marked doorframe; afternoon light and moving pine shadow on the floorboards.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Chiều nay tui sửa cửa luôn, mai mốt còn cho khách thuê chớ.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Phải rồi chú. Nhà có người ở mới ấm.

clips.lighting: Day-eight afternoon: warm sun from the west on the working porch, pine shadows moving naturally, soft interior bounce.

cinematic.intent: Keep the cabin part of a working town rather than a monument reserved for Sơn.
cinematic.composition: The wide establishes Bảy with repair box and Mây doing the final inventory in the emptied room.
cinematic.blocking: Door and threshold screen right, cot screen left, table under the east window at the back. Bảy stays by the door; Mây moves from the cot to the table and back to centre. Notebook and pen in Mây's hands; repair box on the floor.
cinematic.performance: Bảy refuses a shrine without dismissing what happened; he wants the place back in use. Mây agrees with ordinary warmth. No mournful look at the empty cot, no keepsakes, no sad pause.
cinematic.focus: Keep room proportions and threshold readable, not a mournful push toward an absent person's bed.
cinematic.texture: Cleared table, empty bed and existing repair box carry the material change, no sentimental objects left behind.
cinematic.sound_detail: Wood creak and box placement accompany conversation, pine wind present without a sad musical reprise.
cinematic.rhythm: The inventory moves at working pace under both lines; the turn toward the door is the decision, and the take ends ready to repair, not as if this were the last scene.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly, tay thao tác với khay ly cà phê hoặc thùng nhựa.
screenplay_vi.start_vi: Bối cảnh: Bên trong căn chòi gỗ một gian trên đồi dương (D8 afternoon) · Góc máy: Toàn cảnh (35mm Wide) — bao quát không gian, vị trí nhân vật và đạo cụ mang theo. Vào hình ở 0.0s với đầy đủ phục trang và đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, COFFEE_TRAY).
screenplay_vi.beats_vi: Nhịp 1 (0.0–3.5s): Bảy đặt hộp đồ nghề xuống cạnh ngưỡng cửa, nói chiều nay sửa cửa luôn để mai mốt còn cho khách thuê; Mây nhìn chiếc giường trống, đánh dấu một dòng. Nhịp 2 (3.5–7.0s): Mây bước tới chiếc bàn đã dọn, lướt ngón tay trên mặt bàn trống, đánh dấu dòng cuối, đồng ý rằng nhà có người ở mới ấm. Nhịp 3 (7.0–10.0s): Cô gập sổ; cả hai quay về phía khung cửa, Bảy lấy một tay lắc thử cánh cửa lỏng bản lề, ước lượng việc phải làm. Bảy nói ở nhịp 1, Mây đáp ở nhịp 2.
screenplay_vi.end_vi: Khóa tư thế và vị trí đạo cụ (DUTY_POUCH, COFFEE_TRAY) tại giây 10.0s, giữ nhịp thở và chuyển động môi trường tự nhiên không đóng băng hình.

clips.start_frame: The damaged wooden doorframe with exactly seven tally marks cut in one row, no eighth; Mây's right hand below them holding her phone, screen turned away, her left fingertips near the frame edge.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Mây's hand lifts the phone and squares it to the seven marks, her left fingertips steadying the frame edge clear of the cuts, as her voice off screen notes the count for the record. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): The phone holds still for the soft shutter click, and her thumb lifts from the screen. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She lowers the phone and draws both hands away; the seven marks stay in the wood exactly as they were while pine shadow slides across the frame.
clips.end_frame: Seven tally marks still in the wood, no eighth; Mây's hand lowering the phone out of view, her left fingertips leaving the frame edge; pine shadow sliding across the doorframe.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Đúng bảy vạch. Chụp một tấm lưu hồ sơ.

clips.lighting: Day-eight afternoon: warm sun from the west on the working porch, pine shadows moving naturally, soft interior bounce.

cinematic.intent: Preserve the fact of seven days without starting a new ritual of waiting.
cinematic.composition: Lock the detail on the SAME damaged frame with exactly seven marks and Mây's phone.
cinematic.blocking: Doorframe upright through frame centre, the marks at its middle height. Phone in Mây's right hand, left fingertips on the frame edge beside the cuts, never on them. No tool or second hand enters.
cinematic.performance: Professional and gentle: she wants an accurate record, not a ritual. Her hands never hover over the wood as if to add a mark. No caress, no lingering stare at the cuts.
cinematic.focus: Keep tally depth and phone relation clear, avoiding readable screen text or a second overlapping photograph.
cinematic.texture: Seven marks remain seven, no knife, hair clip or new scratched row is introduced.
cinematic.sound_detail: One camera sound and the phone returning to rest are enough, with ordinary cabin wind.
cinematic.rhythm: Lift, click, lower: three clean steps and a single record taken; the last beat leaves the wood as part of a door about to be repaired, not an altar.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Các đạo cụ trên bàn và hiện trường giữ nguyên vị trí liên tục từ cú máy trước.

clips.start_frame: Afternoon on the south porch: Bảy beside the porch table and two stools, checkered cloth on his shoulder, a plastic crate at his feet; Mây in the doorway behind him; Hạ coming up the dune path, a folded wooden market table under her right arm.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.0s): Hạ climbs onto the porch with the folded table, shifts its weight at the top step and asks Bảy whether she can use the porch to prepare her flower buckets until the site at the market is ready. Beat 2 (4.0–7.5s): Bảy tells her to spread out and work, his tools are all here, and drags a stool and the plastic crate aside to clear a stretch of boards along the rail. Beat 3 (7.5–10.0s): Hạ lowers the folded table flat onto the cleared boards with a modest knock and straightens, brushing her palms, while Bảy nudges the crate further aside.
clips.end_frame: The folded market table lying flat on the cleared porch boards; Bảy beside it, still nudging the plastic crate aside with his foot; Hạ straightening at the table, brushing her palms on her jeans; Mây in the doorway; pine shadows moving over the porch.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Chú Bảy, chờ chỗ ngoài chợ xong, cho con mượn hiên soạn xô hoa nghe.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Cứ bày ra làm đi con, đồ nghề chú có đủ.

clips.lighting: Day-eight afternoon: warm sun from the west on the working porch, pine shadows moving naturally, soft interior bounce.

cinematic.intent: Bring Hạ into the cabin through work she has chosen, not through waiting for its former occupant.
cinematic.composition: Use the wide porch with Bảy already outside and space for the folded table she carries.
cinematic.blocking: The dune path meets the porch at its left end; table and stools centre, rail along the front. Hạ carries the table under her right arm onto the boards; Bảy clears space to her right; Mây stays in the doorway.
cinematic.performance: Hạ is practical and a little hopeful; she wants a place to work, not a blessing. Bảy answers with action rather than sentiment. Nobody looks at the cabin as a memory. No speeches, no slow tour of the room.
cinematic.focus: Keep table weight, her footing and the cleared porch area readable, no sudden finished stall appears.
cinematic.texture: White blouse, jeans and scarf remain day-eight clothes, table still unfinished and empty of sale flowers.
cinematic.sound_detail: Table legs touch wood with a modest knock, porch wind and daytime voices keep the work alive.
cinematic.rhythm: Arrival and request overlap, the answer rides the clearing, and the knock of the table on the boards ends the take as work begun, not a pause.

clips.wardrobe_note: Mây wears her khaki field shirt with rolled sleeves, dark-brown leather crossbody duty pouch, small black notebook, radio handset and steel handcuffs at her belt. Hạ wears a clean borrowed white blouse, blue jeans, flat sandals, and her pale-blue silk scarf neatly draped at her neck. Ông Bảy wears his white cotton singlet and rubber sandals, checkered wiping cloth draped over his shoulder while handling coffee glasses or stall crates.

screenplay_vi.gear_vi: Mây mặc áo sơ mi kaki xắn tay gọn gàng, đeo túi da chéo công tác bên hông, cầm sổ tay nghiệp vụ màu đen, bộ đàm và khóa còng số tám ở thắt lưng. Hạ đã thay sang áo sơ mi trắng sạch sẽ, quần jean xanh, đi dép bệt và quàng chiếc khăn lụa xanh nhạt quanh cổ. Ông Bảy mặc áo thun ba lỗ trắng, quần đùi, đi dép cao su, vai vắt chiếc khăn rằn lau ly, tay thao tác với khay ly cà phê hoặc thùng nhựa.

clips.start_frame: On the porch the folded market table lies flat; Bảy crouches at its near end gripping the folded legs, checkered cloth on his shoulder; Hạ stands at the far end holding an empty plastic flower bucket by its rim.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Bảy swings the legs out on their stiff hinges and, with Hạ's free hand steadying the far edge, stands the table upright, telling her the sea wind at the market gate is fierce so the legs must be firm. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): He presses on the near corner, feels a slight wobble and knocks the loose leg true with the heel of his hand. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Hạ sets the empty bucket upright at the centre of the table and presses lightly on its rim; the table holds level, and she shifts her stance, satisfied, as Bảy gives a short nod.
clips.end_frame: The table standing level on the porch boards, one empty bucket upright at its centre, Hạ's hand just leaving the rim; Bảy at the near end, palm resting on the corner, checkered cloth on his shoulder; pine shadows moving over the wood.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Đầu chợ gió biển dữ lắm. Chân bàn phải chắc nghen con.

clips.lighting: Day-eight afternoon: warm sun from the west on the working porch, pine shadows moving naturally, soft interior bounce.

cinematic.intent: Make support between ordinary people tangible through a table that must actually stand.
cinematic.composition: Frame Bảy at one table end, Hạ with the empty bucket, both in medium depth.
cinematic.blocking: Table across frame centre; Bảy at the near end, screen left, Hạ at the far end, screen right. Bucket in Hạ's right hand while her left steadies the edge; Bảy's hands work the legs and the corner.
cinematic.performance: Bảy's advice is dry and practical; his care is in his hands. Hạ answers by testing rather than talking, wanting the table to truly stand. No carpentry show, no extra joke, no fuss.
cinematic.focus: Keep supporting hands and the table's level readable without cutting to new tools or angles.
cinematic.texture: Worn hinges and an unpainted leg keep the table plausible, bucket stays empty and unique.
cinematic.sound_detail: Leg hinges, a light wobble and bucket contact supply gentle rhythm under the line.
cinematic.rhythm: Unfold and line together, one wobble and one fix in the middle, and the bucket test as the single payoff, ending on a steady table.

clips.start_frame: On the porch beside the work table, Mây holds the old doorframe strip with its seven tally marks, removed during the repair; Hạ stands beside the table; behind them the cabin doorway shows its pale new frame.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.5s): Mây turns the strip in her hands, thumb clear of the marks; Hạ looks at it and asks to have it, saying she will fix it under her counter, to remember and not to count. Beat 2 (4.5–7.5s): Mây answers that the photograph is already in the file and holds the strip out; Hạ takes it in both hands. Beat 3 (7.5–10.0s): Hạ's thumb passes across the seven marks without pressing; she tucks the strip against her side and turns toward the work table, Mây turning with her.
clips.end_frame: The seven-mark strip held low in Hạ's hands against her side; Mây's hands empty; both turning toward the work table; behind them the pale new doorframe in the cabin doorway; pine shadows moving on the boards.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Cho tao mảnh gỗ đó. Tao đóng dưới gầm quầy, giữ để nhớ, không phải để đếm.

dialogue.speaker: MAY
dialogue.text: Ừ. Hình chụp lưu rồi, mày giữ đi.

clips.lighting: Day-eight afternoon: warm sun from the west on the working porch, pine shadows moving naturally, soft interior bounce.

cinematic.intent: Move the marks into a useful future object while keeping their past meaning modest.
cinematic.composition: Medium framing includes Mây with the removed old strip, Hạ beside the work table and repaired frame behind.
cinematic.blocking: Work table screen right, the cabin doorway with its new frame in the background centre. The strip passes from Mây at screen left to Hạ at screen right. No knife or tool comes near it.
cinematic.performance: Hạ's remembrance is matter-of-fact; she wants the past under the counter, not in front of her, and never as a tally of years. Mây's reply is procedure that hides affection. No glamorising of the marks, no tears.
cinematic.focus: Keep wood strip and faces readable, avoiding a glamour close-up that turns the marks into a supernatural token.
cinematic.texture: Old seven-mark strip is distinct from the new doorframe, repair occurs this afternoon consistently with the earlier line.
cinematic.sound_detail: Old wood touching her hands and work sounds beyond the line retain a practical environment.
cinematic.rhythm: The request takes the first half, the handover is one clean exchange, and attention returns to the table in the last beat instead of dwelling on an absent man.

clips.start_frame: Afternoon porch: the unfinished flower table standing on its new legs; Hạ at the near side with a sanding block on the top; Bảy kneeling at one leg, screwdriver in its bracket; Mây steadying the far corner; the seven-mark strip resting on a stool.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.5s): Bảy tightens the last leg bracket with a few turns of the screwdriver, saying one more screw and the legs stand straight, while Mây holds the corner and Hạ sands along the grain. Beat 2 (3.5–7.0s): Hạ, still sanding, thanks them both and says her stall is taking shape; Mây lets go of the corner as Bảy rises. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Bảy rocks the table gently with both hands and it stands straight; Hạ sweeps the sawdust off the surface with the flat of her hand, a fine haze drifting through the pine-shadowed light.
clips.end_frame: The flower table standing straight on the porch, its sanded top bare and pale; Hạ's hand sweeping the last sawdust off the surface in a drifting haze; Bảy and Mây on either side; pine shadows moving over the wood; the seven-mark strip untouched on the stool.

dialogue.speaker: BAY
dialogue.text: Siết con vít này nữa là chân đứng thẳng nghen.

dialogue.speaker: HA_N
dialogue.text: Cảm ơn chú, cảm ơn Mây. Sạp hoa thành hình rồi.

cinematic.intent: Use collective work as a time bridge, not one more farewell tableau.
cinematic.composition: The wide holds the three people around the same unfinished table, porch and repair area recognizable.
cinematic.blocking: Table centre frame; Hạ on the near side facing it, Bảy kneeling at the left leg, Mây at the far right corner. Sanding block in Hạ's right hand, screwdriver in Bảy's right. The strip stays on the stool, unworked.
cinematic.performance: Concentration and small cooperative adjustments carry the warmth; Hạ wants them to know it matters without making a speech. Nobody looks toward the road for Sơn. No lingering, no added tally, no group pose.
cinematic.focus: Keep work relationships and the increasingly level surface readable without internal montage or speed changes.
cinematic.texture: Natural sawdust and moving pine shadows retain texture, seven-mark strip is kept for underside use, not re-scratched.
cinematic.sound_detail: Soft sanding and wood contact continue as a real work bed, no sentimental reprise required.
cinematic.rhythm: Steady work under two short lines; the table standing straight is where it lands, and the sawdust sweep keeps the end alive for the match to the finished counter years later.

scenes.story_time: LATER many years after the case

clips.start_frame: Many years later: the finished wooden flower counter, smooth and worn, lined with buckets of fresh white lilies; older Hạ behind it in her green apron, setting the last stems into a bucket; the front shutters still closed; the old marked strip in shadow under the counter lip.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): Hạ settles the last lily stems into the bucket and murmurs to herself that the lilies are fresh today and it is time to open. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She steps to the front and pushes the wooden shutters open; morning light falls across the counter and the market entrance comes alive beyond. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Back behind the counter, she lifts a bucket of lilies into the light at the front and wipes her hands on her apron as the first blurred customers slow outside.
clips.end_frame: The shop open to the morning, older Hạ behind the counter among buckets of white lilies, hands on her apron, shears in its pocket; blurred customers slowing at the entrance beyond; the old marked strip unnoticed in shadow under the counter lip.

dialogue.speaker: HA_O
dialogue.text: Bông ly bữa nay tươi ghê. Mở hàng thôi.

cinematic.intent: Establish that Hạ has built a full working life before the returning man enters it.
cinematic.composition: Match the finished counter surface to the earlier table, then keep older Hạ and shop opening in the wide.
cinematic.blocking: Counter across the foreground, shutters along the front, the doorway toward the coach stop at screen right. Hạ moves from behind the counter to the shutters and back. Lilies stay in their buckets.
cinematic.performance: Years of ownership in her ease: she wants nothing from the road and expects no one. The pleasure is in the work itself. No grief pose, no glance toward the coach stop, no nostalgic touch of the strip.
cinematic.focus: Keep counter and shop depth readable, with old marked wood discreetly underneath rather than staged for a reveal.
cinematic.texture: Older face and hair remain distinct from day eight, cream blouse, green apron and same blue scarf consistent.
cinematic.sound_detail: Shutters, wrapping and ordinary market morning sounds establish continuity of life, not a return-theme fanfare.
cinematic.rhythm: Work is already underway at the cut, the shutters open on the middle beat, and the shop is fully alive by the end; no coach has interrupted her morning yet.

clips.start_frame: Older Mây stopped at the flower counter, her motorcycle helmet hanging from her left hand by its strap; behind the counter, older Hạ already holds one bunch of white daisies wrapped in paper.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–4.0s): Mây lays a folded banknote on the counter with her right hand, asking for her usual bunch of white daisies and saying she will come for dinner after her shift. Beat 2 (4.0–7.0s): Hạ hands the daisies across and Mây takes them in her right hand; they share a familiar look as Hạ tells her to come early, she will cook fish soup. Beat 3 (7.0–10.0s): Hạ picks up the note, counts a few coins from her apron pocket and holds the change out across the counter while Mây shifts the helmet strap to free her fingers.
clips.end_frame: Mây holding the white daisies in her right hand, helmet hanging from her left, fingers freeing to take the change; Hạ holding the coins out across the counter; both wearing the easy half-smile of an old habit; the market morning moving behind Mây.

cinematic.intent: Show enduring friendship as an ordinary purchase rather than a recap of every intervening year.
cinematic.composition: Medium coverage holds older Mây outside with helmet in hand and Hạ behind her counter.
cinematic.blocking: Counter between them; Hạ behind it at screen left, Mây outside at screen right. The helmet stays in Mây's left hand and the flowers go to her right; note and coins pass over the counter.
cinematic.performance: Their friendship lives in habit: Mây wants the dinner more than the flowers, and Hạ already knew the order. Nothing about the case or prison is said or shown. No hug, no ceremony, no promise to wait.
cinematic.focus: Keep faces and the transaction readable, no focus flourish on silver hair as an aging announcement.
cinematic.texture: Mây's increased silver and Hạ's mature features stay consistent, helmet remains in hand and flowers remain one purchase.
cinematic.sound_detail: Paper and coins are small sounds under the line, shop and market bed continues naturally.
cinematic.rhythm: Order, handover and reply run at working pace through the first seven seconds; the change closes the exchange naturally, without a pause for meaning.

clips.start_frame: Years later at Bảy's coffee stall under the green awning: older Bảy behind the same counter, wiping a clean glass with his checkered cloth; in front, the sea-facing plastic table with one empty chair; a coach engine sounding from the crossroad.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): As the coach engine rises, Bảy's hands pause on the glass and he looks toward the crossroad, remarking half to himself that the early coach is in and a glass should be ready in case a customer stops by. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He comes around the end of the counter at his own slow pace, the glass in one hand and the cloth in the other. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He sets the clean glass on the sea-facing table in front of the empty chair, nudges the chair square to the table and drapes the cloth back over his shoulder.
clips.end_frame: One empty chair squared at the sea-facing table, a clean glass set before it; older Bảy straightening beside it, cloth over his shoulder, glancing toward the crossroad; the green awning stirring; the coach engine louder.

cinematic.performance: Ordinary hospitality, the habit of a lifetime: he is attending to possible business and would admit nothing more. Any hope stays in the slowness of his hands. No knowing smile, no wink at the audience.
cinematic.focus: Keep the empty chair and counter connected spatially, no new photograph or memorial detail on the table.
cinematic.texture: Older hands and same moustache remain natural, one clean glass appears, existing table position does not reverse.
cinematic.sound_detail: Coach engine begins off screen within established town geography, glass contact remains a small foreground sound.
cinematic.rhythm: The engine motivates the glance and the line, the walk is unhurried, and the glass and chair complete the small preparation, ending without holding for a reveal.

clips.start_frame: The coach stands at the crossroad stop, door open; on its doorway step, an older man in a faded olive field jacket, the weathered dark-olive backpack on his left shoulder, left hand on its strap, right hand bare at his side, a repaired silver watch chain at his jacket.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The man steps down onto the asphalt, measured and a fraction slower than a younger man, the boot landing and the knee taking the weight, as his voice-over begins. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): He moves one pace clear of the door and settles his balance; the door folds shut and the coach pulls away out of frame left, its draught tugging at the jacket hem. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): He stands in the settling dust, the watch chain catching the light inside his open jacket; his bare right hand opens and closes at his side, and his weight eases toward the town.
clips.end_frame: The older man standing where the coach stood, backpack on his left shoulder, left hand on its strap, right hand bare and open at his side; the repaired watch chain glinting at his jacket; dust settling around his boots, sea wind moving the jacket hem; the road empty behind him.

cinematic.intent: Repeat the opening arrival with a changed hand and age, while keeping identity just outside full view.
cinematic.composition: Frame below the older man's shoulders in medium, coach door, canvas bag and ground readable.
cinematic.blocking: Coach door left of centre; he steps down toward camera and stops a pace clear while the coach leaves frame left. The backpack stays on his left shoulder with the left hand on its strap; the right hand stays bare and empty.
cinematic.performance: Older and measured, neither swaggering professional nor frail: twenty years sit in the knees and the feeling stays inside. He wants to arrive quietly. No pause for effect, no hero stance, no face shown.
cinematic.focus: Keep the same repaired watch chain briefly readable inside the jacket, never show or add another watch.
cinematic.texture: Faded olive fabric and older hand texture carry the years, no fresh wound, gun or disguise appears.
cinematic.sound_detail: One footfall and the departing engine echo the first scene naturally, with no voice-over naming the man.
cinematic.rhythm: One step down, one settle, and the coach gone by six and a half seconds; the last beat holds his presence in the town, breathing and still, not yet walking toward the shop.

clips.start_frame: Older Hạ behind the counter, a single white lily half wrapped in plain paper in her hands, eyes on her work; outside, the coach engine fading toward the inland road.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): The coach sound thins into sea wind and footsteps begin on the pavement outside; her hands slow on the paper as she murmurs that the footsteps sound familiar. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): Her hands stop; her eyes lift toward the doorway, uncertain, a small crease between her brows, her breath held. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): Recognition arrives late and unevenly, a flicker of disbelief before warmth reaches her eyes; without looking down she lays the single lily on the counter, her eyes staying on the doorway.
clips.end_frame: Older Hạ looking at the doorway, breath just released, warmth settling into her face; her hand leaving the single lily on the counter at the lower edge of frame; the scarf stirring in the sea wind; footsteps stopping outside.

dialogue.speaker: HA_O

cinematic.intent: Let Hạ recognize a possible return without abandoning the life already shown around her.
cinematic.composition: Close on older Hạ at the counter, one lily held before the approaching footsteps reach the doorway.
cinematic.blocking: Hạ faces camera behind the counter; the doorway lies off frame right toward the coach stop and her eyeline goes there. Lily and paper in both hands until laid on the counter. She does not leave her place.
cinematic.performance: Recognition that comes gradually and unevenly: disbelief first, then warmth she allows herself. She has built a life and does not drop it to run. No instant tearful grin, no gasp, no rush to the door.
cinematic.focus: Stay on her face through the change, keeping the lily only as a lower-frame reference, no rack to the unseen visitor.
cinematic.texture: Mature features, green apron and worn blue scarf remain continuous; no second watch emerges from a drawer.
cinematic.sound_detail: Coach fades into sea wind and incoming footsteps, with no new score forced over the recognition.
cinematic.rhythm: The murmured line comes early with the footsteps, the face holds its question through the middle, and recognition lands late, in the last three seconds, together with the lily set down.

clips.start_frame: Older Hạ behind the counter, the single lily lying on it beside a bucket of lilies; at the doorway edge stands an older man in a faded olive jacket, backpack on his left shoulder, his bare right hand lifted toward the counter edge; daylight beyond.
clips.action: Beat 1 (0.0–3.0s): His bare right hand comes to rest flat on the counter, no watch at the wrist; Hạ's eyes go to the hand and she tells him he has kept the promise. Beat 2 (3.0–6.5s): She slides the bucket of lilies aside to clear the counter beside the single lily, making room for him, and invites him to sit at Bảy's and look at the sea with her. Beat 3 (6.5–10.0s): She lifts her eyes from the hand to his unseen face and holds them there, a slow smile settling; his fingers relax on the wood, and sea wind moves the paper and her scarf.
clips.end_frame: Hạ facing the unseen visitor across the counter, a quiet smile settled; his bare right hand resting on the wood, the single lily between them, his left hand on the backpack strap at the doorway edge; daylight and sea wind beyond the open door.
